details:

Network & Endpoint Security
Firewalls & VPN
EDR / XDR
SIEM & Security Monitoring
Vulnerability Management
Identity & Access Management
MFA & Privileged Access Management
Incident Response
Security Hardening
Risk Management
Security Awareness

title: Product Owner – HR, Attendance & Workforce Management
details:
Job Description
Product Owner – HR, Attendance & Workforce Management
Location: Egypt
Business Environment: B2B Enterprise / GCC Markets
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Product Owner – HR, Attendance & Workforce Management to lead the functional ownership, continuous enhancement, and business evolution of our enterprise HR and Workforce Management solutions.
The selected candidate will be responsible for defining and maintaining the product vision, managing the product backlog and lifecycle, analyzing customer and business requirements, controlling scope, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet agreed business requirements and acceptance criteria.
The role covers HR, Attendance, Leave Management, Payroll Inputs, Overtime, End-of-Service (EOS), Workforce Management, biometric device integrations, ERP integrations, and Wage Protection Systems (WPS/SIF), where applicable.
The Product Owner will work closely with customers, Project Owners, QA, Sales, Support, and Technical Management.
The Product Owner is responsible for defining what needs to be delivered, why it is required, its business priority, and the acceptance criteria, while the Technical Management team remains responsible for the technical architecture, design, implementation approach, technical resource allocation, and deployment strategy.
⸻
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Vision & Roadmap
* Define, maintain, and communicate a clear product vision and roadmap.
* Manage the evolution of HR, Attendance, Leave, Payroll, Overtime, EOS, and Workforce Management capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for product standardization and continuous improvement.
* Balance strategic product development with customer requirements and regulatory needs.
* Ensure product functionality remains aligned with applicable labor and regulatory requirements.
2. B2B Client Requirement Analysis
* Engage directly with HR, Finance, Operations, and IT departments of enterprise customers.
* Lead requirement-gathering and business-analysis sessions.
* Understand and document:
* Attendance policies
* Shift rules
* Flexible working rules
* Leave policies
* Overtime calculations
* Payroll inputs and deductions
* End-of-Service rules
* Approval workflows
* Reporting requirements
* Device and system integrations
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with Technical Management regarding technical design and implementation requirements.
3. Product Backlog Ownership & Prioritization
* Own and maintain the Product Backlog.
* Create clear and complete User Stories.
* Define measurable Acceptance Criteria.
* Prioritize requirements based on:
* Business value
* Customer impact
* Regulatory requirements
* Severity
* Product strategy
* Dependencies
* Ensure development teams receive complete and approved requirements before implementation begins.
* Maintain visibility of backlog status, priorities, and pending decisions.
4. Change Request & Scope Management
* Review customer requests and correctly classify them as:
* Bug
* Change Request (CR)
* Enhancement
* New Requirement
* Configuration Requirement
* Determine whether requests fall within the agreed project/product scope.
* Prevent unapproved customer requests from being transferred directly into development activities.
* Assess the business impact and urgency of Change Requests.
* Coordinate with Technical Management to assess technical impact, effort, dependencies, and delivery feasibility.
* Coordinate with Sales and Management when a Change Request requires a commercial proposal, quotation, or customer approval.
* Maintain clear documentation and traceability of approved changes.
5. Integrations & System Connectivity
Oversee the functional requirements and business validation of integrations with:
* Biometric attendance devices
* Payroll systems
* ERP platforms
* Government platforms
* Wage Protection Systems (WPS/SIF)
* Third-party APIs and enterprise systems
Ensure that:
* Business integration requirements are clearly documented.
* Data mapping requirements are defined and validated.
* Expected synchronization behavior is clearly specified.
* Integration results meet agreed business requirements.
Technical architecture and implementation remain the responsibility of the Technical Management team.
6. UAT, Business Validation & Release Acceptance
* Define business acceptance criteria before development begins.
* Coordinate with QA to ensure test scenarios cover agreed business requirements.
* Review completed functionality against approved requirements.
* Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with customers.
* Track UAT observations and ensure proper classification and resolution.
* Provide business acceptance before functionality is considered complete.
* Confirm that agreed business requirements have been successfully delivered before production release.
The Product Owner is responsible for business and functional acceptance, while QA remains responsible for functional testing, regression testing, defect validation, and test evidence.
7. Product Stability & Recurring Issues
* Monitor recurring production incidents from a business and customer-impact perspective.
* Identify patterns in recurring customer issues.
* Work with Support, QA, and Technical Management to prioritize permanent improvements.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis where business rules or product behavior are involved.
* Ensure that recurring issues are addressed through product improvements rather than repeated temporary solutions.
* Monitor the accuracy and reliability of attendance, payroll-related calculations, and business reports.
Technical performance, database optimization, infrastructure, and code-level troubleshooting remain under Technical Management.
8. User Experience & Product Adoption
* Collaborate with UX/UI teams to improve the user experience.
* Simplify workflows, dashboards, forms, approvals, and reports.
* Analyze customer feedback and usability issues.
* Support customer demonstrations and product presentations when required.
* Support UAT and customer training initiatives.
* Improve product adoption through better functionality and usability.
9. Compliance, Access & Data Protection
* Ensure functional requirements properly address employee data confidentiality.
* Review business requirements related to roles, permissions, and access control.
* Ensure Role-Based Access Control requirements are properly defined.
* Consider applicable labor, payroll, and regulatory requirements during product development.
* Coordinate with Technical Management regarding technical security implementation.
10. Reporting & Product KPIs
Prepare periodic reports covering:
* Product roadmap progress
* Backlog status
* Open Change Requests
* Critical customer requirements
* UAT status
* Release readiness
* Recurring product issues
* Product usage and adoption
* Customer feedback
* Delivery risks and blockers
Track relevant KPIs related to product quality, adoption, outstanding requirements, recurring errors, and customer satisfaction.
Job Requirements
Required Skills & Competencies
HR, Attendance & Workforce Management Expertise
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience working with one or more of the following:
* HR Management Systems
* Attendance & Time Tracking
* Workforce Management
* Leave Management
* Payroll Systems / Payroll Inputs
* Overtime Calculations
* End-of-Service (EOS)
Strong understanding of:
* HR operational workflows
* Attendance policies
* Shift management
* Payroll cycles
* Overtime and deduction rules
* Approval workflows
* HR reporting
Product Ownership & Business Analysis
* Strong experience in requirement gathering and business analysis.
* Experience managing Product Backlogs.
* Ability to write high-quality User Stories and Acceptance Criteria.
* Strong understanding of Change Request and Scope Management.
* Experience with UAT and business acceptance.
* Ability to distinguish between bugs, enhancements, CRs, configuration requirements, and new requirements.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Technical Understanding
The candidate does not need to be a developer but must have sufficient technical understanding to work effectively with technical teams.
Preferred knowledge includes:
* APIs and system integrations
* ERP integrations
* Biometric attendance devices
* Data mapping and synchronization
* SaaS platforms
* Basic understanding of databases and enterprise application architecture
Communication & Client Management
* Strong experience dealing directly with enterprise B2B customers.
* Ability to lead requirement-gathering workshops.
* Ability to communicate effectively with HR, Finance, IT, Technical, and Management teams.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage conflicting customer requirements professionally.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
⸻
Strong Advantages
Candidates with the following experience will have a strong advantage:
* Previous experience with HR, Attendance, Payroll, or Workforce Management products in Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, or other GCC markets.
* Knowledge of GCC labor and payroll practices.
* Experience with WPS/SIF.
* Experience integrating biometric attendance or Access Control devices.
* Experience with government or large enterprise customers.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS HR platforms.
* Agile/Scrum Product Owner certification.
⸻
Education & Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant professional experience.
* At least 3 years of practical exposure to HR, Attendance, Payroll, Workforce Management, or related enterprise systems.
Relevant previous roles may include:
* Product Owner
* Senior Business Analyst
* HR System Consultant
* Workforce Management Consultant
* Functional Consultant
Agile/Scrum certifications are preferred but not mandatory.
⸻
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a candidate who can sit with a customer and understand a complex attendance or payroll requirement, convert it into a clear and controlled business requirement, define acceptance criteria, prioritize it correctly, and follow it through Development → QA → UAT → Business Acceptance → Release.
The candidate should not simply forward customer requests to Development. The Product Owner is expected to analyze, challenge, classify, document, prioritize, and control requirements before they enter the development cycle.

title: Full Stack Developer
details:

Full-Stack Software Engineer
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
$50 - $100/hr
Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired as long as there is activity.
We are looking for highly skilled Full-Stack Software Engineers to contribute to an AI training project involving software development, technical problem-solving, debugging, system architecture, and code evaluation.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging software-engineering tasks across front-end and back-end systems and helping with translating full coding builds from one particular language into another.

Develop, modify, and debug front-end and back-end application components.
Implement user-facing features and the services, APIs, and data models that support them.

Process
Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
Complete a technical assessment, if required.
Complete the hiring manager review.
Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum number of tasks per week.
Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: IT Systems & Network Administrator
details:
Job Description
Our company is looking for a hands-on IT Systems & Network Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our on-site IT infrastructure and end-user environment. You will be the go-to technical resource responsible for keeping our Ubiquiti network, Synology servers, virtual machines, RingCentral phone system, and office hardware running smoothly. This is an ideal role for a versatile IT generalist who enjoys owning the full stack—from configuring VLANs and backups to troubleshooting a workstation or office printer.
Key Responsibilities
Network Administration (Ubiquiti): Manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our Ubiquiti UniFi ecosystem, including gateways/firewalls, switches, and wireless access points. Configure VLANs, VPNs, firewall rules, and traffic management to ensure reliable, secure connectivity.
Servers, Storage & Virtualization: Administer our Synology NAS servers (DSM), including file shares, user permissions, RAID health, and backup schedules. Manage and maintain on-premises Virtual Machines (VMs) and core local services.
Unified Communications: Oversee our RingCentral VoIP phone system, including user provisioning, desk phone setup, call queues, IVR auto-attendants, and call routing updates.
End-User & Hardware Support: Set up, deploy, and maintain Windows/macOS desktop PCs, laptops, network printers, scanners, and other LAN-connected office devices. Provide responsive day-to-day technical support to staff.
Security & Documentation: Apply regular firmware, OS, and software patches across all network gear, servers, and workstations. Maintain up-to-date network diagrams, asset inventories, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Preferred Qualifications (Bonus)
Experience with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration.
Familiarity with endpoint security/antivirus management and automated backup verification.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network+, Security+, or Ubiquiti certifications).
Job Requirements
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in a Systems Administrator, Network Administrator, or Tier 2/3 IT Support role.
Networking: Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and firewall administration—specifically within a Ubiquiti UniFi environment.
Storage & VMs: Direct experience administering Synology NAS devices and managing Virtual Machines (e.g., Synology Virtual Machine Manager, VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox).
VoIP Systems: Familiarity with cloud phone administration, ideally RingCentral (or similar platforms like 8x8, Zoom Phone, or Vonage).
Hardware & Endpoints: Solid troubleshooting skills for physical PCs, Windows OS, shared network printers, and general LAN cabling/peripherals.
Soft Skills: Strong communication skills, a customer-service mindset when helping non-technical staff, and the ability to prioritize tasks independently.

title: Middle Security Operations Center Engineer L2
details:
Job Description
We are looking for a Middle SOC Engineer (L1/L2) to join our team and provide advanced security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response for an enterprise client within a B2B environment. This role focuses on deep security triage, active incident investigation, and coordination of threat containment for international clients in English.
The position requires working in a 3-shift rotation (8 hours per shift) based on Cairo time:
Morning Shift: 08:00 AM – 04:00 PM
Evening Shift: 04:00 PM – 12:00 AM (Midnight)
Night Shift: 12:00 AM – 08:00 AM
 
What you'll be doing
Perform real-time security monitoring, deep-dive analysis, and triage (L1/L2) of security alerts escalated from multiple sources (SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and system logs).
Log, track, and manage complex security incidents through ticketing systems, driving them to resolution or coordinating escalations.
Analyze network traffic (PCAP), system logs (Windows/Linux), and endpoint behavior to track lateral movement and analyze malware delivery.
Coordinate host isolation, credential revocation, and other immediate threat containment actions according to incident response playbooks.
Investigate multi-stage security incidents, draft detailed incident reports, and perform thorough root cause analysis (RCA).
Work on fine-tuning SIEM correlation rules, security tool dashboards, and optimizing detection alerts to minimize false positives.
Develop, test, and automate incident response runbooks (playbooks) and response procedures.
Communicate technical incident findings clearly to international clients and internal stakeholders via email, chat, and online meetings.
What We Offer
Opportunity to work on large-scale, impactful projects
Clear career growth path within a team with 27+ years of experience
Professional, friendly, and supportive team environment
EST time zone schedule with paid overtime when applicable (up to 12 hours per shift)
Modern office in the Smart Village district.
Flexible and transparent compensation review system
Overtime compensation options
Private medical insurance after completing the probation period
Payments in USD
 
Job Requirements
Upper-Intermediate to Advanced English (B2/C1, written and spoken) for daily client and internal communications.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in a SOC, Security Operations Center, or active incident response role.
Solid knowledge of operating systems (Windows and Linux administration, system logs) and core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS).
In-depth familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, common attack vectors, and techniques used by threat actors.
Practical experience working with SIEM platforms (such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or Elastic) and EDR/XDR solutions (such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender).
Strong practical skills in using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot), including effective prompting and applying AI in everyday work tasks.
Strong analytical thinking, technical documentation skills, and the ability to work under high pressure during major security incidents.
Availability to work on an 8-hour rotational shift schedule, including night shifts, weekends, and holidays.

Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA CySA+, Blue Team Level 1/2, CEH, GCIH, or Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate).
Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or Bash for security integrations and workflow optimization.

title: Senior QA Automation & Performance Engineer (Web, Mobile & Load)
details:
Job Description
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced QA Automation & Performance Engineer (SDET) to lead quality assurance, test automation, and heavy-load performance engineering for our flagship B2B E-Commerce Marketplace.
Our ecosystem consists of three modern React web applications (Buyer Marketplace, Supplier Portal, and Admin Dashboard), two native mobile applications (iOS in Swift and Android in Kotlin), and a Node.js / MongoDB (Amazon DocumentDB) backend hosted on AWS.
You will be responsible for designing and scaling our automated testing frameworks from the ground up across browsers and mobile devices, as well as executing heavy-load and stress tests to ensure our platform can handle thousands of concurrent buyers, suppliers, bulk catalog operations, and high-traffic commercial events without performance degradation.
Key Responsibilities
1. Performance, Stress, and Heavy Load Testing
Design, script, and execute load, stress, spike, and endurance tests using tools such as Grafana k6, Apache JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
Simulate high-volume production B2B traffic, including thousands of concurrent users searching large product catalogs, filtering complex attributes, uploading bulk media to AWS S3, and submitting Requests for Quotation (RFQs).
Collaborate with Backend (Node.js/Express) and DevOps (AWS ELB, NGINX, DocumentDB) teams to identify performance bottlenecks, slow database queries, memory leaks, and server concurrency limitations.
Establish performance baselines and Service Level Agreement (SLA) thresholds, including response time, P95/P99 latency, throughput/requests per second (RPS), and error rates.
2. Web Browser Test Automation
Build, maintain, and scale end-to-end (E2E) cross-browser automation frameworks using Playwright (preferred), Cypress, or Selenium with TypeScript/JavaScript.
Automate critical B2B workflows across the company's three React-based web platforms:
Buyer Website: Product search, multi-tier pricing and Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) calculations, RFQ submission, OAuth login, and checkout flows.
Supplier Dashboard: Product creation, image cropping and uploads, inventory updates, and order management.
Admin Portal: Supplier KYC verification, catalog moderation, and role-based access control (RBAC).
Validate multilingual localization (i18n) and right-to-left (RTL) and left-to-right (LTR) layouts in Arabic and English across desktop and mobile web viewports.
3. Native Mobile Application Automation (iOS and Android)
Design and maintain automated UI and regression test suites for native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit) and Android (Kotlin) applications using Appium, Maestro, XCUITest, or Espresso.
Automate mobile-specific features, including push notifications (FCM), camera and QR/barcode scanning, offline caching (Core Data/Room), geolocation/maps, and deep linking.
Execute automated tests on real-device cloud platforms such as BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm, and Sauce Labs, as well as local Xcode Simulators and Android Emulators.
4. API and Integration Testing
Convert manual Postman collections into automated API test suites using Newman, Playwright API, RestAssured, or SuperTest.
Validate RESTful API contracts, JSON schemas, status codes, JWT authentication, session security, and edge-case error handling.
Test asynchronous processes and third-party integrations, including Google Cloud Vision and Translation APIs, AWS S3 uploads, and email/push notification triggers.
5. QA Process and CI/CD Integration
Upgrade test management workflows from Excel/Google Sheets to structured test management tools integrated with Jira, such as Xray, Zephyr, or TestRail.
Integrate Web, Mobile, API, and Performance test suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
Implement automated quality gates for every pull request and release to maintain software quality and reliability.
Job Requirements

title: AI Engineer
details:
Job Description
We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer with a strong background in .NET backend development and AI-Native Software Architecture to design, develop, and integrate intelligent capabilities into enterprise applications.
The ideal candidate should understand how to build the complete software architecture surrounding Large Language Models (LLMs), transforming AI models into secure, scalable, observable, and production-ready business solutions.
This role is not focused on training AI models from scratch. Instead, it focuses on LLM integration, AI orchestration, context engineering, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and building robust .NET services around AI models.
Key Responsibilities
Design and implement AI-Native Software Architecture using C#, ASP.NET Core, and .NET.
Build modular AI application layers integrating LLMs with enterprise systems.
Develop AI orchestration services, prompt management, context engineering, and conversation memory components.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.
Build AI agents capable of tool calling, function execution, and integration with internal business APIs.
Develop secure API layers connecting LLM providers such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and other hosted or local models.
Implement AI guardrails, input/output validation, access controls, and responsible AI mechanisms.
Design observability and monitoring capabilities for AI requests, token usage, latency, cost, and model performance.
Build AI evaluation and testing mechanisms to assess response quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Integrate AI services with existing enterprise applications, databases, and business workflows.
Apply clean architecture, SOLID principles, and modern software engineering practices.
Collaborate with software architects, backend developers, and product teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.
Job Requirements
Must-Have Skills
3+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience in C# and ASP.NET Core.
Solid understanding of Clean Architecture, layered architecture, REST APIs, dependency injection, and microservices.
Practical experience integrating LLMs through APIs such as OpenAI or Azure OpenAI.
Understanding of AI-Native Architecture and the software components surrounding LLMs.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, and structured LLM outputs.
Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector search, and document retrieval.
Familiarity with AI agents, function calling, and tool integration.
Strong knowledge of SQL Server and database integration.
Understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and secure AI integration.
Experience with Git and modern development workflows.
Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable agent frameworks.
Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search.
Vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, or PostgreSQL with pgvector.
Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Multi-agent orchestration and agent workflows.
AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, and OpenTelemetry.
Redis for caching and conversation memory.
Docker, CI/CD, and cloud deployment.
Experience with local LLMs using Ollama or similar technologies.
Knowledge of AI security, prompt injection prevention, and data privacy.
What We're Looking For
We are particularly interested in engineers who understand that building an AI application is much more than sending a prompt to an LLM API.
You should be able to architect and implement the software layers that make AI reliable, secure, maintainable, and useful within real enterprise applications.
An ideal candidate can take an existing .NET business application and transform it into an AI-Native application by designing and implementing the required AI integration, orchestration, retrieval, memory, security, and observability components.

title: Junior Data Engineer
details:
Job Description
Role Summary
You build and maintain data pipelines for our clients - different industries, different stacks, one engineering standard. Python and SQL will be your daily tools; a mentor and code review will be your safety net. We hire data engineers, not software developers who occasionally work with data: fundamentals, the habit of asking "why", and a real grasp of what the craft is about. The rest we teach.
 
The Mission
Build pipelines that produce data people can trust: they run on schedule, fail loudly, and are easy to fix - regardless of the platform.
 
The Tech Stack
Core Languages: Python (clean, tested code), SQL (solid basics). Scala welcome.
Processing Frameworks: PySpark (concepts to basics), Pandas and Polars for local analysis.
Clouds (exposure to): AWS, GCP, or Azure - storage, compute, IAM.
Orchestration: Airflow, Dagster, or similar (concepts).
You will learn: dbt, Docker, CI/CD, Databricks/Snowflake, Terraform.
 
Your Responsibilities
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines from APIs, databases, and files.
Validate your data before passing it downstream: row counts, nulls, duplicates.
Write tests, participate in code reviews - your code and others'.
Help troubleshoot and monitor pipelines in production.
Learn deliberately - dbt, Snowflake, Terraform - and share what you learn.
 
What We Offer:
Long-term career stability with a competitive salary paid in USD.
Conditions for steady career development.
Development supported by dedicated mentors and a variety of programs focused on expertise and innovation.
Private medical insurance provided after successful completion of the probationary period
A well-equipped and cozy office supports comfort and productivity across all project stages.
Welcoming atmosphere and a friendly corporate culture.
Job Requirements
Your Skills
Experience: 1+ year building software in Python.
Python Engineering: clean modular code, OOP basics, and a project set up from scratch: virtual environment, dependencies, sensible layout, pytest tests for your own code.
Git: daily fluency, not just familiarity: branches, commits, pull requests, review comments.
SQL: joins, aggregations, window functions; any relational database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
DE Concepts: you chose data engineering deliberately. You can explain ETL vs ELT, what a warehouse is and how it differs from a database and a lake, and why pipelines must be idempotent.
Processing & Orchestration: you know why Spark and Airflow exist (distributed processing, DAGs). Concepts are required; basic hands-on with at least one of them is a strong plus. Pandas or Polars for local work is assumed.
Terminal: bash basics: navigate, grep logs, ssh.
Cloud: conceptual understanding of one major platform.

title: Civil / Architectural Engineer – Construction Management Systems Consultant
details:
Job Description
Are you a Civil or Architectural Engineer looking to take your engineering experience into technology? Your engineering experience is the key to your next career move that takes that experience into technology without leaving construction behind.
If you’re a Civil or Architectural Engineer with 2–5 years of construction experience, there is another career path where your industry knowledge matters: Construction Technology & Functional Consulting.
We are looking for engineers who want to use their construction expertise differently, working with construction companies to understand their operations, solve business and project-management challenges, and help shape how technology can support the way they work.
This is a career shift, not a restart.
What does the role actually mean?
Today, you apply your engineering expertise within a specific project or site. In this role, you’ll apply it at a broader level, understanding how construction companies operate, analyzing their processes and challenges, and working with them to improve how their operations are managed through a Construction Management Technology Platform.
You may already know engineers whose careers developed in a technology-focused direction, such as Planning Engineers working extensively with Primavera, or BIM professionals combining engineering knowledge with digital technology.
Construction Functional Consulting is another technology-focused career direction where your construction knowledge remains central to the job.
What will you do?
Understand how their projects and operations are currently managed
Analyze their processes and operational challenges
Identify how a construction management system can support and improve their way of working
Define what the system needs to achieve from a construction and business perspective
Guide client teams in adopting and using the solution effectively
So you’re not moving away from engineering. You’re becoming the construction expert who connects industry needs, business processes, and technology.
Who could be a good fit?
Whether you’re a Site Engineer, or Technical Office Engineer, or QS Engineer, or Cost Control Engineer, or Planning Engineer, or in another construction-related role, your experience could be relevant. We’re not looking for someone who has worked in all these areas.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering
2–5 years of practical experience in the construction industry
Strong practical understanding of how construction projects operate
Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Good command of English and proficiency in MS Excel
Are interested in technology and how it can improve construction operations
Are interested in developing into a client-facing consulting role
Previous exposure to ERP or construction management technology can be useful, but it is not a requirement.
Where can this lead?
You are taking the construction expertise you already have and developing it in a different professional direction:
Construction Expertise + Business Processes + Technology + Consulting
Over time, this can grow into a career in Construction Systems Functional Consulting, with exposure to different construction companies, projects, and business challenges.
If you're not yet familiar with this career path, you can still apply. If your experience matches, we’ll contact you, answer your questions, and give you a clearer picture of the role so you can decide if it’s the right move.

title: Software Integration Engineer
details:
Job Description
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Software Integration Engineer to bridge physical data acquisition hardware with our central software systems. In this role, you will develop and maintain backend applications in Node.js that communicate directly with wired DAQ units and wireless gateways using TCP, UDP, MQTT, and WebSockets. You will handle incoming telemetry, parse custom payloads, and interface field data with SCADA systems using Modbus protocols to ensure robust, real-time industrial monitoring.
Key Responsibilities:
• Backend Gateway Integration: Design, develop, and maintain Node.js backend services to receive data from wireless gateways and wired DAQs via network protocols (TCP, UDP, MQTT, and WebSockets).
• Protocol & Data Processing: Implement robust socket and message-broker handling to parse data streams, manage device connections, and ensure reliable telemetry delivery.
• SCADA & Modbus Integration: Interface the backend architecture and field data with SCADA systems using Modbus (RTU/TCP) for seamless supervisory control and monitoring.
• API & System Architecture: Build APIs or event-driven pipelines to route device data into databases, visualization dashboards, or alert systems.
• Testing & Debugging: Troubleshoot network-level communication issues, packet loss, socket drops, and device handshakes between field hardware and backend servers.
• Documentation: Document network configurations, payload schemas, API endpoints, and connection workflows.
Job Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Strong proficiency in JavaScript (Node.js) with deep familiarity with network programming using built-in or third-party libraries for TCP/IP sockets, UDP datagrams, MQTT, and WebSockets.
• Solid understanding of Modbus (TCP/RTU), MQTT brokers, and serial communication standards.
• Ability to read hardware datasheets, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals for field instruments and DAQ systems.
• Familiarity with handling JSON/binary payloads and time-series data.
Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):
• Experience with industrial automation, PLC programming, or SCADA software packages.
• Proficiency with Git version control, Linux environments, and containerization tools (Docker).
Males Only

We run three WordPress websites and are looking for a developer to take ongoing responsibility for them: day to day maintenance, content and design updates, and search performance.
This is a remote role. You will work directly with the Director and with our internal IT.
The first piece of work is a fixed-price project with an agreed timeline: audit all three websites, analyze the issues, and propose the fixes. The main goal is for the three organizations to come up in AI search answers, for example ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI results, alongside normal Google search performance. If the project goes well, it leads to ongoing paid work implementing the fixes and looking after the sites.
What the audit should cover
Technical health of each site: speed, mobile performance, errors, crawling and indexing.
On-page SEO: titles, headings, metadata, internal linking, duplicate content.
Structured data, and how each organization is described on Google and other listings.
How the three organizations currently appear, or fail to appear, in AI search answers, and what is causing that.
Arabic content and right to left layout.
A prioritized list of fixes with the effort and expected impact of each, plus a fixed price and timeline to carry them out.
The AI search and GEO side of the audit
How the three organizations are represented in the sources AI assistants rely on: Google Business Profiles, maps, directories, health and education listings, and mentions on other websites.
Whether our pages can be read and cited by AI systems: content structure, clear headings, question and answer sections, and plain factual statements rather than marketing language.
Schema markup describing each organization, its services, locations and licensing, so machines can read it.
Crawler access: robots.txt, llms.txt, and whether AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended are allowed.
Entity consistency: the same name, address, phone number and description everywhere, so the three organizations are recognized as separate and not confused with one another.
Content gaps: the questions parents actually ask that our sites do not answer.
A baseline of how the three organizations come up today in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews for the searches that matter, and a way to measure it again after the fixes.
Ongoing work after the audit project
Maintain the three WordPress sites, including theme and plugin updates, backups, and security.
Monitor the sites and respond quickly when something breaks or a site goes down.
Build and edit pages in Elementor in both English and Arabic, with correct right to left layout for Arabic.
Carry out technical SEO work: page speed, structured data, metadata, internal linking, redirects, and fixing crawl and indexing errors.
Manage Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4, and report on performance monthly.
Improve how the three organizations appear in AI search answers as well as in Google results.
Make sure every page works well on a phone.
Coordinate with internal IT on hosting, domains, and anything that affects all three sites.
Job Requirements
3 to 7 years of hands-on WordPress development.
Strong technical SEO experience, with examples of results you have achieved.
Fluent Arabic and English, including building Arabic pages that read right to left.
Good working knowledge of Elementor, Yoast or a similar SEO plugin, Google Analytics 4, and Search Console.
PHP, HTML and CSS at the level needed to fix theme and plugin issues.
Experience with page speed optimization and mobile performance.
Experience with structured data and local search listings.
Available during Doha working hours and able to respond quickly to urgent site issues.
Experience improving visibility in AI search answers (AEO and GEO), not search engine work alone.
Able to quote a fixed price and a timeline for the audit, and to explain your findings in plain language.
Practical knowledge of how AI assistants pick and cite sources: schema and entity markup, content written so it can be quoted, crawler access through robots.txt and llms.txt, and consistency across Google Business Profiles, maps and directories.
A way to measure AI search visibility before and after the work, so we can see whether it moved.

Proficient in troubleshooting hardware/software/network issues.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Office Suite, Windows OS, and common enterprise applications.
Familiarity with Active Directory, Office 365, printers, and antivirus solutions.

Platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Synapse, Redshift.
Orchestration: Airflow or Azure Data Factory; Dagster.
Transformation: dbt (Core/Cloud), Spark/PySpark (optimization focus).
Streaming: Kafka, Kinesis, or Event Hubs (working basics).
Infrastructure: Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes basics, CI/CD.
 
Your Responsibilities
Design and build pipelines: ingest, clean, transform into lakes and warehouses.
Optimize for performance and cost - know a working query from an efficient one (FinOps).
Deploy through CI/CD and Terraform; keep environments reproducible.
Implement quality checks and freshness monitoring; alert before the client notices.
Clarify requirements with stakeholders; review and guide Junior engineers.

title: Senior Odoo Implementation Consultant (Hybrid — Project-Based)
details:

The Egyptian Developers (TEDs) is an Official Odoo Partner based in Cairo, delivering Odoo ERP implementations, eCommerce platforms, and mobile applications. Our projects are large and multi-module: retail, eCommerce, wholesale, and finance-led implementations, including Saudi ZATCA e-invoicing.
PLEASE READ THE JOB REQUIREMENTS AND APPLICATION CONDITIONS BEFORE APPLYING.
Applications that do not meet every mandatory requirement will not be considered.
The opportunity
We are looking for a senior, certified Odoo Implementation Consultant to lead functional delivery on large implementations. You will work with our project management, development, and design teams, own the client relationship on the functional side, and take projects from discovery to a stable go-live.
This is a hybrid, project-based engagement: you are engaged per project, with a fee agreed upfront and paid by milestone. Work is mainly remote, with on-site workshops at our office or at client sites when needed.
What you will do
Analysis and design
- Lead discovery workshops with executives, department heads and process owners
- Map As-Is workflows and design To-Be processes with each department
- Write Business Requirement Documents (BRD), fit-gap analyses, and Scope of Work documents, with clear acceptance criteria for every requirement
- Recommend standard Odoo first, then Studio, and custom development only where it is truly needed
Implementation
- Configure Odoo Enterprise end-to-end: accounting, inventory, purchase, sales, eCommerce, CRM, helpdesk and marketing
- Implement localisation, VAT and e-invoicing, including Saudi ZATCA Phase 2
- Write functional specifications for the development team, review custom features and validate integrations (payment gateways, delivery carriers, messaging)
- Build workflows, approvals, automations, and reports with Odoo Studio
- Create management dashboards that support data-driven decisions
Data, testing and go-live
- Plan and run data migration: audit, cleansing, import templates, reconciliation and exception reports for large product catalogues, customers, suppliers and opening balances
- Prepare functional test scenarios, run UAT with key users and track defects to closure
- Support major-version upgrades and post-upgrade testing
Training and handover
- Train key users and end users, and write SOP manuals and user guides
- Monitor usage after go-live, close gaps and provide first-line functional support
- Report progress to management and keep the project register, timesheets, and decisions up to date
Job Requirements
Mandatory
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
- Minimum 5 years of hands-on Odoo implementation experience
- Valid Odoo certification, version 18 or 19 (a verifiable certification link is required)
- At least 3 full-cycle implementations delivered from discovery to go-live, each with 20+ modules or multi-branch / multi-company operations, and live on production servers today
- Expert knowledge of Odoo accounting: multi-currency, analytic accounting, taxes, bank reconciliation, and period closing
- Expert knowledge of Odoo inventory and supply chain: multi-warehouse, routes, lots and expiry dates, replenishment and valuation
- Strong experience with Odoo Website and eCommerce
- Hands-on experience with Odoo.sh: branches, staging, deployments and backups
- Proven ability to write BRDs, workflow diagrams, functional specifications and test scripts
- Proven experience with large data migrations
- Excellent Arabic and English, written and spoken
- Able and willing to travel for project work, inside and outside Egypt
Strong advantages
- Saudi ZATCA Phase 2 or other e-invoicing implemented in a live project
- Retail, wholesale (B2B), real estate, construction, or multi-branch implementations
- Experience with payment gateways (Moyasar, Tap, HyperPay, PayTabs, Tamara, Tabby) or carriers (SMSA, Aramex)
- Live projects with Subscriptions, Appointments, Helpdesk, or Marketing Automation
- Technical understanding: Python, the Odoo ORM, XML views, QWeb, OWL and PostgreSQL
- Experience with major-version upgrades
- Pre-sales experience: demos and solution presentations
- Project management experience
What we offer
- Large, multi-module Odoo projects
- A project fee agreed upfront and paid by milestone
- Hybrid flexibility, with a structured delivery process and a senior team
- An ongoing relationship across our upcoming projects
APPLICATION CONDITIONS — READ BEFORE APPLYING
1. Apply only if you meet ALL the mandatory requirements above.
2. A valid Odoo 18 or 19 certification is required. Applications without a verifiable certification link will not be reviewed.
3. A minimum of 5 years of hands-on implementation. Courses, training, or self-study do not count.
4. You must be able to travel for project work, inside and outside Egypt.
5. Each project is covered by a contract that includes a confidentiality agreement (NDA) and the assignment of all project work to the company.
6. The work must be delivered by you personally. Subcontracting is not permitted.
7. Shortlisted candidates complete a technical interview and a practical Odoo case review.
How to apply
Apply through Wuzzuf and include:
- Your CV
- Your Odoo certification link (version 18 or 19)
- At least 3 Odoo projects you delivered: industry, Odoo version, number of modules and users, and your role

title: Testing Engineer
details:

Job Description
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Tester to join our software company, specializing in enterprise-grade ERP web and mobile applications. In this role, you will lead and execute comprehensive testing strategies spanning ASP.NET backend web APIs, Angular web frontends, and Flutter mobile applications. You will be responsible for end-to-end QA activities including manual test case writing, stress and performance testing, automation testing, and bug reporting, while actively researching and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to enhance test suite efficiency and automation.

[High Priority] Analyze requirements and ERP business workflows (such as ERP business logic, data integrity, and role-based access controls) to design, write, and execute comprehensive test cases and test scenarios across Web, Mobile (Flutter), and Web APIs (ASP.NET), using Google Sheets and Jira for test management.

[Medium Priority] Perform stress, load, and performance testing using Apache JMeter to validate system stability, scalability, and backend reliability under heavy load.
[Critical Priority] Architect, execute, and maintain automated testing scripts and regression suites using Java with Selenium WebDriver and TestNG or TypeScript with Playwright (TypeScript Playwright preferred), applying the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern across UI, web, mobile, and API layers to support continuous integration and automated functional testing.
[Medium Priority] Research, evaluate, and integrate AI-powered agentic testing frameworks (such as Healwright) to drive self-healing test automation, script resilience, and improve overall QA suite efficiency.
[High Priority] Conduct specialized backend and API validation using Postman to verify endpoint responses, data formatting, and error handling; create detailed bug reports, perform root-cause analysis using fundamental web, OOP, and database technical foundations, and collaborate closely with cross-functional development teams (ASP.NET, Angular, Flutter) to track and verify defect fixes.
[High Priority] Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and retrospectives using Jira, Git, and Maven to estimate user stories, clarify requirements, manage version control, and drive defect tracking throughout the release lifecycle.
Job Requirements
Job Requirements
Domain Experience & Core Responsibilities: Strong knowledge of ERP business processes, complex workflow validation (e.g., ERP business logic, data integrity, access control), and enterprise-grade application testing in a software development environment.
Technical Stack & API Validation: Hands-on testing experience across ASP.NET Web APIs, Angular web applications, and Flutter mobile applications; proficiency with specialized API testing via Postman (endpoint verification, data formatting, error handling) and performance/load testing using Apache JMeter.
Testing Methodologies, Tools & Agile Management: Solid understanding of ISTQB Foundation principles, test planning, manual test case design, defect tracking (Jira), version control (Git, Maven), software development lifecycles (SDLC), and Agile management practices.
Automation & Agentic AI: Proven capability in architecting and maintaining UI/Functional automated testing scripts using Playwright (TypeScript preferred) or Selenium WebDriver with TestNG (Java) using POM, combined with Agentic AI testing tools/frameworks like Healwright for self-healing script resilience.
Technical Foundation & Continuous Research: Solid grasp of technical foundations (JavaScript, HTML, OOP, database management) for root cause analysis, alongside a proactive mindset toward continuous learning and modern QA methodologies.

**Role Summary**

AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The AI Software Engineer designs, builds and deploys production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high-quality data. They turn use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation.

The role is alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview-governed data foundation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and deploy AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases.
* Build retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, prompt orchestration and grounding on curated Gold-layer data.
* Embed explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubai's AI ethics principles.
* Expose AI capabilities through secure APIs and integrate them with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access and data masking enforced.
* Work with data engineers to prepare AI-ready datasets and feature pipelines, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls.
* Define accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, and run structured evaluations before each release.
* Apply UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging.

* Familiarity with lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview.
* Awareness of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
* Arabic proficiency is advantage.

details:
**Siemens Digital Industries Software** is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

**About the role**

Join our engineering software team to build our Enterprise Physics AI solution, a product that gives customers a complete workflow around physics AI models that cut simulation time from dayrs or hours to minutes or seconds. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll collaborate with software developers, AI and simulation specialists, and product managers to turn engineering needs and customer feedback into reliable, scalable, easy-to-use enterprise software. This role brings together software development and engineering knowledge, with opportunities to contribute across the development lifecycle and work with a range of technologies.

**What you’ll do**

You’ll design, develop, and maintain software for engineering applications, creating code that is reliable, reusable, and easy to maintain.

Working closely with development teams and product managers, you’ll turn engineering requirements and user needs into practical software solutions.

As part of an Agile/Kanban environment, you’ll contribute to code reviews,

development discussions, testing, debugging, and software improvements.

You’ll take part in user testing and use feedback to improve applications and interfaces. You’ll also investigate technical issues, explore solutions, and contribute ideas that improve the quality and usability of our software.

**What you bring**

* A degree in Computer Eningeering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* Professional experience in software development, with the ability to take ownership of software solutions from development through delivery.
* Programming experience with Python and/or C++/Java, with Python particularly relevant to this role.
* Knowledge of data structures and algorithms, together with experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and engineering simulation processes.
* Experience with databases and microservices, and familiarity with technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Exposure to graph databases is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Git, Jira, and Confluence, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with colleagues from different disciplines.

**Why Us?**

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion**

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

details:
مهندس حلول تقنية وعروض فنية أول - Senior Full-Stack Solution & Proposal Engineer)

الهدف من الوظيفة (Job Purpose)

البحث عن مهندس برمجيات شامل (Full-Stack Engineer) يمتلك خبرة عملية في تطوير الواجهات الأمامية والخلفية (Frontend & Backend)، لتولي دور هندسة الحلول الرقمية وإعداد العروض الفنية (RFPs/RFQs) للمنافسات الحكومية والشركات الكبرى في المملكة. يتطلب هذا الدور الجمع بين الخلفية البرمجية العميقة وقدرات التصميم الهندسي للأنظمة، وذلك لبناء المنهجيات الفنية، وهندسة الربط والتكامل (APIs)، وتطوير حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي (ChatGPT/LLMs)، وضمان المطابقة التامة مع معايير هيئة الحكومة الرقمية (DGA).

المهام والمسؤوليات الفنية والتقنية (Key Responsibilities)

1. تصميم وبناء هندسة الحلول الشاملة (Full-Stack Solution Architecture):

o ترجمة المتطلبات الوظيفية المعقدة في كراسات الشروط إلى بنية برمجية متكاملة وقابلة للتنفيذ (Monolithic vs Microservices Architectures).

o تصميم وهندسة العمليات الخلفية (Backend logic) والواجهات الأمامية (Frontend UIs) للأنظمة والمنصات المطلوبة في العرض.

o تصميم حلول متقدمة في مجالات الحوسبة السحابية، والذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، وأتمتة العمليات (Workflow Automation).

2. هندسة الربط والتكامل وتطوير الـ APIs (System Integration & API Engineering):

o تصميم وتوثيق مخططات الربط المعقدة (API Topologies & Integration Flows) بين نظام الـ CRM والأنظمة الداخلية والخارجية (مثل ServiceNow، تطبيقات المفتشين، وأنظمة GRP).

o تحديد الممارسات الهندسية المثلى لربط قنوات التواصل المتعددة (Omnichannel)، والاتصال الصوتي، وأنظمة الدخول الموحد (SSO) وإدارة الهوية والوصول (PAM/IAM).

3. صياغة العروض المنهجية والمحتوى الفني التخصصي (Technical Proposal Development):

o صياغة "منهجيات التطوير والتشغيل" (مثل Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines) بشكل هندسي دقيق وعميق يعكس آلية كتابة وإصدار الأكواد البرمجية الفعالة.

o كتابة وتدقيق نطاق العمل التفصيلي (Scope of Work)، ومخرجات المشروع التقنية، وجداول مصفوفات الصلاحيات بحرفية برمجية تمنع أي ثغرات عند التنفيذ.

o صياغة اتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة (SLA) ومؤشرات الأداء (KPIs) التقنية المرتبطة بالاستجابة وأداء النظام (Performance & Tuning).

4. تخطيط ترحيل البيانات وضمان جودة الكود والأداء (Data Migration & Code QA Framework):

o رسم خطط واستراتيجيات ترحيل ومعالجة البيانات (Data Migration & Sanitization) من الأنظمة القديمة إلى الحديثة (مثل معالجة واستخراج البيانات إلى Microsoft Dynamics 365).

o صياغة استراتيجيات اختبار جودة الأنظمة (كتابة سيناريوهات حالات الاختبار UAT، واختبارات الأتمتة لقواعد البيانات، واختبارات الضغط والتحمل Performance & Load Testing).

o وضع الحلول الهندسية لضمان خلو النظام من رسائل الأخطاء البرمجية (مثل 404، 500) وحل مشاكل بطء الأداء وعمل فهارس (Indexes) لقواعد البيانات.

5. إعداد مصفوفة المطابقة الفنية وإدارة التقديم (Compliance & Submission Management):

o إعداد مصفوفة المطابقة الفنية (Technical Compliance Matrix) لربط كافة متطلبات الكراسة بالحلول البرمجية الهندسية والأدلة المقترحة وتتبعها بدقة لضمان عدم الاستبعاد الفني.

o قيادة المراجعة التقنية والمنطقية الشاملة للعرض الفني، وتنظيم ملفات التقديم (السير الذاتية للفريق، ملف الشركة، والشهادات الاحترافية)، وإدارة رفع العطاء عبر منصة اعتماد والمنصات الشريكة.

المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة (Qualifications & Skills)

* المستوى التعليمي: درجة البكالوريوس في (علوم الحاسب، هندسة البرمجيات، تقنية المعلومات، هندسة الحاسب، أو أي تخصص هندسي تقني مماثل).

* الخبرة البرمجية والعملية (Mandatory Technical Backround):

o خبرة عملية سابقة كـ مطوّر برمجيات شامل (Full-Stack Developer) تشمل التعامل مع لغات ومكتبات الواجهات الأمامية (مثل React, Angular) والواجهات الخلفية (مثل Node.js, .NET, Python, Java).

o خبرة قوية في تصميم وإدارة قواعد البيانات (مثل SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)، وكتابة الاستعلامات المعقدة (Queries Optimization)، والتعامل مع الـ RESTful APIs.

* الخبرة في هندسة الحلول والعروض الفنية (Pre-Sales & Proposals Experience):

o خبرة عملية في كتابة العروض الفنية الفائقة الجودة، وتحليل الكراسات (RFPs)، وإعداد خطط العمل والمخرجات للمنافسات التقنية في السوق السعودي.

* المعرفة بالسوق السعودي والحوكمة: فهم ممتاز لنظام المنافسات والمشتريات الحكومية، والتعامل مع منصة اعتماد، ومعايير وإجراءات هيئة الحكومة الرقمية (DGA).

* المهارات الاحترافية: مهارة عالية في رسم المخططات البرمجية وهندسة الحلول، دقة واهتمام شديد بالتفاصيل الفنية، والقدرة على العمل بمرونة تحت ضغط المواعيد النهائية للمنافسات.

(Senior Full-Stack Solution & Proposal Engineer)

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and technical Senior Full-Stack Solution & Proposal Engineer with a strong software engineering pedigree. In this role, you will bridge the gap between heavy technical development and strategic pre-sales engineering. You will dissect complex RFPs/RFQs, architect secure and scalable enterprise systems, design microservices/API integration topologies, and author high-quality, fully compliant technical proposals for Saudi Arabian government and private sector digital transformation opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Full-Stack Solution Architecture & Design:

o Evaluate multi-layered client requirements to design end-to-end software architectures, defining the optimal balance between Frontend components and Backend logic (Monolithic vs. Microservices frameworks).

o Conceptualize and draft multi-tenant solution architectures covering Cloud computing environments, workflow automations, and modern Generative AI / Large Language Model (LLM) integrations.

o Actively lead the technical Bid/No-Bid workflow from a software feasibility, performance capability, and operational risk standpoint.

2. System Integration & API Engineering Blueprinting:

o Map out, document, and model comprehensive integration topologies and secure API orchestration structures linking core legacy databases or CRMs with modern multi-platform environments (e.g., ServiceNow, inspector mobile solutions, state GRP networks).

o Blueprint omnichannel communication mechanics, biometric single sign-on (SSO) frameworks, and precise identity governance layers (PAM/IAM standards).

3. Specialized Technical Proposal & Methodology Development:

o Architect and write deeply customized, non-generic technical approaches, operational methodologies, and delivery lifecycle structures (e.g., Agile/Scrum, DevSecOps pipelines, automated CI/CD configurations, and ITIL matrices).

o Author precise, programmatic Scopes of Work (SoW), explicit technical boundary layouts, and trace modular system deliverables to lock down delivery expectations.

o Structure comprehensive application Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and infrastructure performance indicators (Technical KPIs).

4. Data Migration Planning & Automated Quality Assurance (QA):

o Engineer logical data migration pathways, staging parameters, and validation scripts to securely process and extract legacy database profiles into modernized environments (e.g., MS Dynamics 365 data structures).

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
details:
**Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with**. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

**What You Will Do**

* **Own outcomes, not tickets.** Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
* **Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on.** OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
* **Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade.** A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
* **Work directly with customers.** You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
* **Raise the bar on the codebase.** Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
* **Push the team forward.** Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

* **You ship.** Ideas without execution do not count for you.

* **Strong opinions, loosely held.** You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
* **Curious about the domain.** Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
* **Fluent with AI.** You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
* **Care about humans on the other end.** Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. * You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
* You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
* You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
* You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.

Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
details:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

**Role Summary**

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join the team building the region's leading property marketplace. You'll work on high-traffic, consumer-facing products, from the Next.js web experience to the services behind it, where latency, reliability and cost efficiency directly shape the experience of millions of buyers, renters and agents.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll design and own features and services end to end across frontend and backend, influence architecture beyond your immediate squad, and raise the engineering bar for the people around you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and operate the web experiences and backend services that power core marketplace experiences
* Own your work end to end across the stack: technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and iteration based on production data
* Build fast, accessible and SEO-friendly user-facing features in React and Next.js, using the right rendering and caching strategy for each page (SSR, static generation, client-side)
* Build new services and features primarily in TypeScript (Node.js), while supporting and evolving our existing Go services
* Work with product managers, designers and mobile engineers to turn requirements into well-architected, maintainable systems and polished user experiences
* Drive operational excellence on both server and client: monitoring, alerting, real-user monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance
* Mentor other engineers, review designs and pull requests thoroughly, and contribute to frontend and backend standards and best practices

**Desired Experience**

* 6+ years of software engineering experience across frontend and backend, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript on both the backend (Node.js), which is the primary language for all new services and features, and the frontend Strong production experience with React and Next.js, including server-side rendering, data fetching and caching, and web performance (Core Web Vitals)
* Working proficiency in Go, or the ability to ramp up quickly.
* Our existing production services are written in Go, and you'll maintain and evolve them alongside new development Solid experience designing and operating microservices: API design (REST/gRPC), service boundaries, versioning, and inter-service communication patterns Production experience with AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, CloudFront, RDS, ElastiCache or equivalents) and containerised deployments on Kubernetes
* Hands-on experience with data stores and search: relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), OpenSearch/Elasticsearch and Redis, including schema design, indexing strategy and query performance tuning
* Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing (Kafka, SQS or similar) Strong grounding in observability and reliability: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, SLOs and incident management

**Nice to have**

* Experience integrating AI/LLM-backed features into production services (e.g. AWS Bedrock, prompt-serving infrastructure, latency and cost optimisation for model calls)
* Experience with edge computing (Lambda@Edge, CDN-level logic) and multi-region considerations
* Experience with frontend tooling at scale: monorepos (e.g. Turborepo), design systems, and frontend testing (Jest, Playwright) Experience with SEO-critical web applications, internationalisation and right-to-left (Arabic) layouts
* Exposure to billing/subscription systems, identity platforms, or geospatial/location data Experience in marketplace, classifieds, or other two-sided platform products

**How You Work**

* You take ownership beyond your ticket: you notice problems, propose solutions and follow through
* You communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and back your arguments with data
* You hold a high bar in code review and design review, and you make the engineers around you better
* You're pragmatic: you know when to build for scale and when to ship the simple thing, and you can quantify the cost of both

title: Tech Lead (Hands-on) - Full Stack
details:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

**About the Role**

This is a hands-on Tech Lead role: you’ll spend about 80% of your time writing, reviewing and shipping code. You’ll build across the stack of the region’s leading property marketplace, from the Next.js web experience to the TypeScript and Go services behind it, where latency, reliability and cost directly shape the experience of millions of buyers, renters and agents.

You’ll lead the team’s technical work from inside the codebase. You’ll set direction through the code you write, the designs you propose and the reviews you give.

**What You’ll Build (about 80% of your time)**

* Ship features end to end, from the React/Next.js UI through the TypeScript (Node.js) and Go services, APIs and data stores behind it, all the way to production
* Design and build APIs and service boundaries that other teams can safely depend on
* Make the web fast and findable: server-side rendering, caching, Core Web Vitals, SEO-critical pages and Arabic right-to-left layouts
* Evolve our existing Go services while building new ones in TypeScript, and keep both well tested and easy to change
* Own what you ship in production: instrument it, define SLOs and alerts, join the on-call rotation, debug incidents and fix root causes
* Build product ideas behind feature flags and A/B experiments, then use production metrics to judge what worked
* Prototype quickly to de-risk an idea before the team commits to it
* Improve the team’s engineering foundations, such as tests, CI/CD, local development and observability, so everyone ships faster

**Where the Other 20% Goes**

* Design: write short design docs for significant changes and review the ones your teammates write
* Mentoring: grow the engineers around you through pairing, reviews and example, not status meetings
* Planning: work with product managers and designers to break work into small, shippable pieces, and flag technical risk and cost early
* Hiring: take part in interview loops, including the coding rounds
* Cross-team work: align with mobile, platform and data engineers on shared APIs and engineering standards

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required skills**

* 6+ years writing production code across frontend and backend, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems. You still write code most days.
* Deep, current expertise in TypeScript (Node.js) and React/Next.js. You can take a feature from an empty file to production on your own.
* Go experience, or the ability to pick it up quickly: several of our existing services are written in Go
* Strong backend design skills: microservice architectures, API design (REST/gRPC), service boundaries, inter-service communication and data modelling
* Hands-on experience with AWS and containerised deployments, and with databases and search such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and Redis, including data modelling, performance tuning and caching
* Solid web performance skills: server-side rendering, caching, bundle size and Core Web Vitals
* Testing discipline across unit, integration and end-to-end tests
* Production ownership: observability, SLOs, debugging live incidents and writing post-mortems that lead to real fixes
* A track record of technical leadership from inside the codebase: driving design decisions, setting review standards and mentoring engineers
* Clear written communication in design docs, pull requests and trade-off discussions with engineers and product partners

**Nice to have**

* Experience building AI/LLM-backed features in production, including managing the latency, quality and cost of model calls
* Fluent use of AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, with the judgement to review what they produce
* Experience with event-driven architectures, edge computing (such as CDN-level logic) or multi-region systems
* Experience with SEO-critical web applications, internationalisation and right-to-left (Arabic) layouts
* Experience in marketplace, classifieds, or other two-sided platform products

**How You Work**

* You lead by building: the team follows your code, designs and reviews, not your title
* You ship small and often, and you’d rather prove an idea with a prototype than debate it in a meeting
* You own outcomes in production, not just merged pull requests, and you watch the dashboards after a release
* You protect the quality bar in code review and production, while keeping the team shipping
* You’re pragmatic: you know when to invest in scale and when to ship the simple thing, and you can quantify the cost of both
* You make decisions with data and explain trade-offs clearly
