title: Senior React Native & React Engineer PK
details:
**Lead-level frontend and mobile ownership. AI-first delivery. Architecture decisions.**

We are looking for a highly senior engineer who can operate at Lead Engineer level across frontend and mobile applications.

This is not a role for someone who only executes tickets. We need someone who can make architecture decisions independently, design scalable frontend and mobile systems, and turn ambiguous product needs into production-ready applications.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean team. The default mode of execution is AI-first. Engineers use AI agents and tools such as Cursor, Claude, and similar platforms to accelerate research, planning, implementation, testing, and refinement, but ownership stays fully with the engineer. The person in this role must be able to use AI to move fast while maintaining strong judgment around architecture, correctness, performance, usability, maintainability, and overall product quality.

**The work**

* Design and own frontend and mobile application architecture across React, React Native, and Next.js
* Make architecture decisions independently, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability
* Build production-grade applications using TypeScript across web and mobile environments
* Work with GraphQL APIs and define clean integration patterns across frontend, mobile, and API layers
* Define scalable engineering patterns across React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQL
* Own application quality standards across architecture, code structure, testing, responsiveness, and developer experience
* Define technical direction, not just implementation details
* Set and enforce quality standards across both AI-generated and manually written code
* Use AI-first and agentic development workflows with tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate delivery without compromising engineering standards
* Translate ambiguous product needs into clear technical solutions
* Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications across web and mobile
* Collaborate directly with clients to ensure smooth communication and strong understanding of requirements
* Contribute to system design, performance strategy, testing strategy, and engineering productivity
* Apply a basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift when working with React Native integrations, debugging, or platform-specific requirements

This is a fast-paced environment with real production stakes. You will be expected to move quickly, think at systems level, and make strong technical decisions with minimal hand-holding. If you are comfortable owning frontend and mobile architecture, working across React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and AI-first workflows, and raising the technical bar in a high-accountability environment, this role is for you.

**Candidate requirements**

* Strong proficiency in React, React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript
* Strong experience working with GraphQL APIs
* Extensive AI/ML or agentic development experience using Cursor, Claude, or similar tools
* Basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift
* Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining production web and mobile applications
* Strong understanding of performance, responsiveness, maintainability, and overall software quality
* Proven ability to make architecture decisions independently and own technical direction
* Ability to communicate clearly with clients and stakeholders
* Full-time availability in a remote environment
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on development experience
* Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to pass a background check with good references

**Details**

* Fully remote
* Paid in USD
* EST or PST aligned hours

title: Growth Marketing Manager
details:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an ambitious, data-driven Growth Marketing Manager to join our rapidly expanding international team at Property Finder. This role presents an exciting opportunity for continuous professional and personal growth within an environment that champions trust, autonomy, and a performance-driven culture.

In this role, you will lead growth marketing efforts across branding and performance marketing in our key markets, while directly contributing to our global expansion strategy. You will leverage cutting-edge growth frameworks, modern AI tooling, and cross-channel paid media to acquire high-intent users, scale lead generation, and enhance our brand equity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Campaign Strategy & Hands-On Execution:** Own end-to-end campaign lifecycles from defining strategic objectives, target audiences, and KPIs to hands-on setup and launching across key international markets.
* **Full-Funnel Paid Media Management:** Build, execute, and continuously optimize paid media campaigns across PPC/SEM, Paid Social (Meta), Display/Programmatic, and Video.
* **AI-Driven Growth & Automation:** Integrate agentic AI platforms and modern AI workflows (such as Claude, ChatGPT, or specialized workflow automation tools) into daily operations to accelerate research, creative iteration, campaign analysis, and marketing automation.
* **Budget & Bid Optimization:** Manage and monitor multi-market paid media budgets, ensuring optimal capital allocation, lower CAC, and maximized ROAS/CPL across digital channels.
* **Data, Tracking & Performance Reporting:** Partner with business and product analytics to monitor end-to-end funnel metrics, attribution, and LTV. Translate complex campaign data into actionable insights and present weekly/monthly performance reviews to stakeholders.
* **Creative Strategy & Localization:** Work closely with creative and content teams to brainstorm, test, and deploy high-converting ad copy, visual assets, and landing pages tailored to local regional nuances.
* **Market & Competitive Intelligence:** Conduct regular competitive analyses and market research to identify whitespace opportunities, emerging channels, and tactics to expand share of voice (SOV).
* **Cross-Functional Ownership:** Drive individual tactical initiatives and partner closely with Product, SEO, CRM, and Commercial teams to ensure unified messaging and an integrated customer journey.

**Desired Experience:**

* Minimum of 4-6 years of hands-on digital growth or performance marketing experience in a fast-paced environment (tech, marketplace, classifieds, or high-growth scale-up).
* AI Tooling & Innovation: Hands-on experience working with Agentic AI platforms (e.g., Claude, LLM-powered agents etc.) to streamline workflow efficiency, content ideation, data synthesis, or campaign experimentation.
* Professional proficiency in both written and spoken Arabic and English (essential for localizing campaigns and creative testing across regional markets).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Media Expertise: Proven track record of managing significant paid media budgets with verifiable success in scaling user acquisition and conversion rates.
* Analytical Toolkit: High proficiency with modern analytics suites (e.g., Google Analytics 4 and Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs such as Kochava, AppsFlyer, or Adjust).
* Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving ability, and an agile, experiment-driven testing mentality.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Industry Experience:**

* Direct background in Real Estate, Online Classifieds, PropTech, or high-volume Lead Generation marketplaces.
* Global Exposure: Prior experience operating in an international or multi-market setup with distributed teams.
* Technical Growth Skills: Baseline familiarity tag management (GTM), conversion rate optimization (CRO) platforms, or feed management.

### **Our promise to talent**

At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.

title: Tenant Relations Manager
details:
**Job Requisition ID:** 179888

Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

**Overview of the role:**

Manage the tenant and customer liaison function by ensuring Cairo Festival City Mall tenants adhere to Al-Futtaim retail standards, business compliance requirements, and agreed tenant obligations. The role is responsible for strengthening tenant performance, improving commercial value, supporting customer satisfaction, and ensuring a positive customer experience across every touchpoint of the customer journey. The position works closely with tenants, internal stakeholders, and senior management to identify opportunities, drive performance improvement, enhance retail standards, and implement customer experience initiatives in line with the mall’s vision.

**What you will do:**

* Ensure all tenants adhere to industry standards, government regulations, Al-Futtaim policies, lease requirements, and the Tenant Manual.
* Identify and improve operational systems and processes to strengthen tenant compliance, service delivery, and overall retail standards.
* Act as a key point of contact between the mall and tenants, managing expectations and providing practical solutions that support improved commercial performance.
* Monitor tenant sales performance, footfall, and commercial trends, and prepare relevant reports and analysis to identify opportunities to maximize revenue and improve tenant performance.
* Work collaboratively with HR Business Partners, AFTC, Line Managers, Senior Management, and other stakeholders to align priorities, share workloads, and deliver agreed initiatives.
* Ensure tenants and key stakeholders are aware of relevant standards, products, services, initiatives, and expectations, using appropriate communication and capability-building approaches.
* Identify retail learning and development needs and support the implementation of innovative solutions, tools, technologies, and initiatives that create competitive advantage.Maintain effective systems for tracking, analyzing, and reporting retail development and performance metrics, ensuring Senior Management receives accurate and timely updates.
* Manage and support projects and initiatives designed to improve tenant performance, customer satisfaction, and the overall mall experience.
* Regularly gather and analyze customer feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and implement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction.
* Conduct competitor visits and monitor retail, hospitality, customer experience, and technology trends to identify relevant opportunities for the mall.
* Develop and execute customer experience and service strategies aligned with the mall’s vision, including the use of technology-driven solutions such as chatbots and mobile applications.

**Required Skills to be successful:**

* Extensive experience in retail operations and tenant management, acting as a key point of contact between the mall and tenants, with exposure to retail standards, store operations, and customer experience.
* Proven experience in managing footfall and sales performance, with exposure to budgeting, forecasting, commercial analysis, and initiatives aimed at improving tenant performance and customer satisfaction.
* Strong retail operations and sales background, with knowledge of retail best practices, tenant management, customer experience, commercial performance, and project management.
* Strong consulting, analytical, collaborative problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with tenants, internal teams, and senior management.
* High level of computer literacy and ability to use data, reporting, and performance metrics to support decision-making.
* Experience working within large, culturally diverse organizations is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholder expectations effectively.

**What equips you for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a relevant field, preferably with a specialization in Retail and Sales.
* Strong knowledge of retail operations, tenant management, retail and sales best practices, and customer experience principles.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, commercial performance analysis, and project management.
* Strong understanding of customer feedback, satisfaction measurement, service improvement, and retail trends.
* Ability to work collaboratively with tenants and cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining high standards of accountability and customer centricity.
  

**About Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
  
The real estate development and operations arm of Al-Futtaim, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi-billion-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
  
Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
  
AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

title: Security Engineer (Cloud & AI Focus)
details:
**Who we are:**

Bayzat is at the forefront of transforming workplaces through innovative solutions in HR, Payroll, Finance, and Insurance. Renowned as a leading SaaS platform for employee benefits and a key player in the Insurance sector, we are committed to our mission: empower every company to create a remarkable workplace by supercharging people processes and payments.

As one of the MENA region's fastest-growing Scale-Ups, Bayzat is celebrated for its innovative product offerings, backed by over 300 team members from 35+ nationalities. Recognized by Forbes as a promising UAE-based startup and supported by leading VCs like Mubadala and Point72 Ventures, we are among the best-funded HRTech scale-ups in the region.

At Bayzat, culture is paramount. We are a principle-driven, merit-based organization where authenticity, collaboration, and unpretentiousness thrive. Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimize efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a forward-thinking Security Engineer to evolve our security posture from"gatekeeper" to "enabler." You will not just find bugs; you will architect the automated guardrails that allow our developers to ship code fast and securely. As a core member of the Engineering team, you will tackle security challenges across our entire stack; from traditional Web/Mobile apps and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) to our emerging AI-driven features. You will play a pivotal role in defining how we secure Generative AI integrations and protect our customer data in an era of evolving threats.

**Some high-impact responsibilities you will be entrusted with:**

**Application & AI Security (AppSec)**

* **Secure the AI Frontier**: Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new product features, specifically focusing on LLM (Large Language Model)  
  integrations. You will mitigate risks such as Prompt Injection, Data Poisoning, and Model Theft (adhering to the OWASP Top 10for LLMs).
* **Shift-Left Security**: Embed security into the SDLC. Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA(Software Composition Analysis) tools directly into our CI/CD pipelines to catch vulnerabilities before they reach production.
* **Vulnerability Management**: Move beyond manual reporting. Triage results from automated scans and Bug Bounty programs, and work directly with developers to implement remediation patches.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Security**

* **Cloud-Native Protection**: Harden our AWS environment using industry best practices (CIS Benchmarks)
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security**: Review and secure Terraform/CloudFormation scripts to ensure infrastructure is secure by design before it is deployed.
* **Container Security**: Implement security controls for Docker containers and Kubernetes (K8s)clusters, ensuring isolation and minimizing the attack surface.

**Operations & Culture**

* **Automate Everything:** Use Python, Go, or Bash to write scripts that automate repetitive security tasks, alerting, and incident response workflows.
* **Security Champions**: Mentor developers and product managers. Run internal workshops on secure coding practices (including safe use of AI coding assistants like Copilot).
* **Incident Response**: detect, investigate, and respond to security anomalies using modern SIEM tools.

**What you will need to have:**

**Technical Skills**

* **Experience:**3+ years in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, or a related field.
* **Coding:** Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Go, or Ruby) to read code and write automation tools.
* **Cloud Fluency:** Deep understanding of AWS services (IAM, VPC, Guard Duty, WAF, Inspector) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
* **AppSec Tooling:** Hands-on experience with tools like Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, or similar enterprise equivalents.
* **AI/ML Knowledge:** Familiarity with the security implications of Generative AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, and API security.

**Soft Skills & Mindset**

* **Builder Mindset**: You don't just say "No"; you say "Here is the secure way to do it."
* **Communication**: Ability to translate complex security risks (like an Insecure Direct Object Reference or a Prompt Injection) into business terms for Product Managers.
* **Curiosity**: A demonstrated history of self-learning (e.g., HTB, TryHackMe, or building your own labs).

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in implementing controls for compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2,PCI DSS, or similar frameworks.
* Active participation in the security community (Bug Bounties, GitHub contributions, CTFs).
* Certifications: OSCP, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, or CKS (Certified Kubernetes SecuritySpecialist).
* Experience securing Vector Databases (e.g., Weaviate, Pinecone, Milvus)

**What’s in it for You**

At Bayzat, we don’t sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture — we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You’ll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you’ll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Meritocracy at its core:** Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.
* **Freedom to shape your path:** We support cross-functional moves and growth transitions when you drive value.
* **Real feedback culture:** Feedback is coaching — empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
* **Barrier-free collaboration:** Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you’ll have a seat at the table — even with the CEO.
* **Accelerated growth:** Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
* **Flexible work setup:** Remote and hybrid options designed around performance.
* **Inclusive culture:** Regular company-wide all-hands, OKR tribe meetings, and annual awards that celebrate real impact.

This isn’t for everyone — but if you want to be pushed, inspired, and rewarded for what you deliver, **welcome to Bayzat.**

title: Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
details:
### **Description**

An engineering role for a developer who wants to own test automation: you'll build the framework, wire it into CI and make quality part of how the team ships. Web first, then mobile.

**About the role**

Bizimply builds workforce management software used by hospitality and retail businesses to schedule, pay and manage their frontline teams. We're looking for an engineer who treats test code as production code and wants to own how we test.

You'll start with our web application: building and scaling an end-to-end and API automation suite that runs on every pull request. Once that's solid, you'll extend the same approach to our iOS and Android apps. You'll work inside the engineering team, reading source code, debugging failures down to the root cause, and shaping testability from design onwards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Web (first 6 months)**

* Design, build and own our web end-to-end automation framework (Cypress or Playwright), with clean architecture, stable selectors and low flake rates.
* Write API tests in code that cover contracts, error handling and edge cases, and run in the pipeline alongside UI tests.
* Integrate all suites into CI/CD (e.g. GitHub Actions) so every pull request gets fast, trustworthy feedback.
Validate data flows and migrations with SQL, checking integrity, transactional state and schema changes.  

**Mobile (next)**

* Extend automation to our native/hybrid iOS and Android apps using Appium, Maestro, Detox or similar.
Choose the mobile tooling and decide how it fits into the existing framework and pipeline.  

**Across the team**

* Join sprint planning, design reviews and PR reviews to push for testability early.
* Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to speed up test authoring, generate test data and debug flaky tests.
* Triage and track defects in Jira, and write clear, reproducible bug reports.
* Coach developers to write and maintain tests for their own code.

* **3 months:** Critical web user journeys are automated and run on every PR, and the team trusts the results.
* **6 months:** PR feedback in under [15] minutes, flake rate below [2%], and API coverage on core services.
* **12 months:** Mobile smoke and regression suites run in CI, and developers write tests as part of normal delivery.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

**What you'll bring**

* **5+ years** in software engineering or test automation, with at least 2 years writing automation code as your main job. A background as a developer or a CS/software engineering degree is strongly preferred.
* **Web automation:** Hands-on experience building and maintaining an E2E framework in Cypress or Playwright (JavaScript/TypeScript), not only adding tests to someone else's.
* **API test automation:** Testing APIs in code (Cypress, Playwright, REST Assured or similar) or Postman/Newman running in CI.
* **CI/CD:** You've set up and maintained automated test runs in a pipeline (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Bitrise).
* **SQL:** Confident writing your own queries to validate backend data and migrations.
* **Code-level debugging:** Comfortable reading application source code to find the cause of a failure.
* **AI tooling:** You already use AI coding tools in your daily work and can tell when their output is wrong.

* **Mobile automation** on iOS and Android (Appium, Maestro, Detox or similar). This is a strong plus because mobile is our next phase.
* Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features, such as evaluation suites and handling non-deterministic outputs.
* Datadog or similar APM tools for log analysis, synthetic tests and checking service health after deployment.
* Performance and load testing with k6, Locust or JMeter.

  

### **About Bizimply**

Bizimply is a multi-platform solution **born in the world of cafes, bars, restaurants and pubs, where getting your wage spend right is crucial**. We’ve been transforming hospitality scheduling in the UK and Ireland for over a decade. Our shared experience gave us the expertise to help create spot-on staff rotas and keep everything compliant, giving our customers more bandwidth to focus on what’s important.  
Our intuitive design ensures that every manager has the tools to hit their **sales per labour hour** **goals**, with a complete view of their day-to-day operations. From streamlined scheduling to effortless compliance, we make every shift run like clockwork.  
At Bizimply, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, gain hands-on experience, and be part of a team that’s revolutionising the hospitality industry.

title: QA Lead
details:
**About Take In**
-----------------

Take In is a food delivery platform on a mission to make food delivery fairer, for customers and for restaurants. We launched in January 2026 in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia and are live in production, processing real orders daily. We're hiring across product, engineering, and operations to scale what we've built.

**Why this role exists**

Our QA team has three manual testers and nobody leading them. We want to move from manual testing to automation, and we want someone who builds that, leads it and does it.

**What you'll do**

* Lead and grow the QA team. You'll start with three manual testers and later hire an automation engineer who reports to you.
* Set the automation strategy for backend APIs and our mobile apps.

* Coach the team into automation. Pairing, code reviews, clear standards.

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in QA, including 2+ years leading or mentoring QA engineers.

* Strong hands-on mobile automation for iOS and Android with tools like Appium, Detox, Maestro or WebdriverIO. React Native experience is a strong plus.

Four conversations, all live, no take-home tasks:

title: Product Engineer
details:
About the role

We’re looking for a Technical Product Lead to own a portfolio of live and in-progress digital products: a fintech app, a marketplace, mobile apps and client web projects. You’ll be the founder’s right hand on everything product and tech: shipping new features, keeping what’s live healthy, and spotting what needs to be upgraded before it breaks.

This is not a pure coding job and not a pure management job. You need to understand development deeply enough to direct AI coding tools and developers, judge their output, and fix problems yourself when needed.

What you’ll do

* Own multiple projects at once. Know the status, priorities and open issues of every product in the portfolio, and keep them moving in parallel.
* Ship new features. Turn ideas into clear specs and tasks, build them with AI coding agents (and developers when needed), review the result, test it, and release it.
* Maintain what’s live. Handle bugs, outages, dependency updates, security patches and app-store releases. Keep things stable without waiting to be told.
* Find what needs upgrading. Regularly audit each product (code, performance, UX, infrastructure, costs) and come back with a prioritized list of what to fix or improve, and why.
* Run the AI workflow. Write good prompts and specs for AI agents, check their work critically, and improve how we use AI across development and operations.
* Solve problems end to end. When something is broken or unclear, dig in, find the root cause and propose a fix, not just report the symptom.
* Communicate clearly. Give the founder short, honest updates: what shipped, what’s blocked, what needs a decision. Work with clients, designers and freelancers when a project needs it.
* Keep things documented. Maintain task boards, release notes and simple docs so any project can be picked up quickly.

Must-haves

* Solid development understanding. 2+ years building or shipping software. Comfortable reading code across frontend, backend and mobile (e.g. React / React Native, Node or Python, SQL, REST APIs). Understands Git, deployments, CI/CD and cloud hosting basics.
* Strong with AI tools. Uses AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily. Knows how to break work down for them, spot when they’re wrong, and fix the result. Can show real examples.
* Problem solver. Debugs methodically, works through unclear or messy situations, and makes sensible calls without needing every detail spelled out.
* Good communicator. Writes clear, short updates and specs in English. Explains technical issues to non-technical people. Says early when something is late or off track.
* Ownership. Treats the products as their own: follows through, keeps track of many threads, and doesn’t drop things between projects.

Nice to have

* UI/UX sense. Notices when a screen feels wrong and can suggest a better flow. A portfolio or examples of screens you improved is a big plus.
* Arabic and English: our products are Arabic-first for the GCC market.
* Experience with fintech, marketplaces or mobile app-store releases (iOS and Android).
* Experience with Supabase, Netlify / Cloudflare, or similar modern stacks.
* Has run or worked in a startup, or managed freelancers.

How we work

We’re a small, AI-first team. Much of the day-to-day development and operations work is done with AI agents, and your job is to steer them, check them and fill the gaps.

* Proactive with stakeholders. You’ll work actively with the founder, clients and partners: raise questions early, share progress and flag risks before being asked. The tools we use matter less than keeping everyone in the loop.
* The founder is often in meetings during the day, so work is mostly async: you’ll be trusted to decide and move, with a short daily check-in.
* Location: Bahrain preferred (remote within the GCC considered).
* Type: full-time.

title: Senior Mobile Platform Engineer
details:
Proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work®, we are an AI-native customer experience platform purpose-built for emerging markets. With more than 25 years of conversational AI research and development, we serve over 5,000 enterprises across MENA and are pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through our Agentic Studio platform. As the category takes shape, the way Unifonic is perceived — by buyers, analysts, media, and the broader market — is a strategic asset. This role owns that perception.

We thrive on creativity, collaboration, and fun, where every idea is welcomed and celebrated. As shareholders in the company, we’re more than just communicators—we’re innovators shaping the future together. We are Unifones. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!

**Meet the team!**

Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.

As a Mobile Platform Engineer, you’ll own our SDK platform end to end—treating it like a product that developers rely on every day. You’ll shape the foundations that make our mobile experiences reliable, extensible, and easy to integrate.

Your week will span the full platform lifecycle: roughly a third of your time will go into the shells, packaging, and add-ons that bring the SDK to life; about a fifth will focus on the core SDK and the contracts that keep it stable and predictable. The rest will take you across customer troubleshooting, release engineering, documentation, and exploring new platform capabilities.

**Help us shape the future of communication by:**

* Designing the public API of the SDK on your primary platform and keep it idiomatic: async and AsyncSequence on iOS, suspend and Flow on Android, Promises and events on the web.
* Writing the contract for each feature by hand: new event and command variants in the core, the public API shape, and the conformance vectors that every shell must pass.
* Implementing features in the Rust core and the shell executors, with coding agents doing much of the typing and you owning every line that merges.
* Translating OS lifecycle into SDK behavior: scene phases, process death, background limits, push wake-ups, connectivity changes, app extensions.
* Building and keeping green the release pipeline: one coordinated release produces the XCFramework, AAR, npm packages and sample apps, signed, with symbols, SBOM and privacy manifest.
* Running the consumer test matrix: tiny storefront apps per configuration (minimum Xcode and AGP, R8 full mode, arm64-only ABI filters, React Native new architecture, Expo prebuild, Vite, webpack, Next.js).
* Handling merchant tickets on rotation: triage by layer, replay diagnostics bundles, fix with a new vector or platform test, ship a patch release.
* Shipping platform-specific add-ons beside the common SDK: rich push with product images, in-app campaign UI, Android Binder service, FCM forwarding, App Attest and Play Integrity.
* Keeping the observability contract: structured logs with correlation ids, metrics callbacks, stable error codes, diagnostics() and selfCheck() .
* Tracking annual OS, Xcode, AGP and React Native changes and land them before merchants hit them.
* Writing what you decide: ADRs, changelogs, migration notes and integration docs that a person or a coding agent can follow to a first tracked event in under 30 minutes.

**What you'll bring:**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years working on a library, SDK, framework, or platform consumed by third-party developers.
* Strong experience with public API design and Semantic Versioning (SemVer), including managing deprecations without breaking existing customers.
* Deep understanding of mobile platform lifecycles, including process death and restoration, background execution limits, push wake-ups, extensions, and platform services.
* Hands-on experience with native build systems and packaging, including publishing to a package registry and troubleshooting third-party builds.
* Experience with FFI and language interoperability, such as JNI/NDK on Android, C interoperability with Swift, or another production-shipped language boundary.
* Experience supporting third-party integrators through documentation, technical support, troubleshooting, and analyzing symbolicated crash reports.
* Strong testing mindset, using tests as a design tool rather than simply a validation step; experience with property-based or mutation testing is a plus.
* Excellent technical writing skills, with experience creating ADRs, changelogs, migration guides, and developer documentation.
* Comfortable reviewing code across Android and iOS, with the ability to identify lifecycle, concurrency, and threading issues.
* Strong experience with AI-assisted development and coding agents, with the ability to thoroughly review, validate, and explain AI-generated code before it reaches production.

* **iOS**
  + Shipping and maintaining an iOS library/SDK consumed by third parties and distributed through SPM or CocoaPods.
  + Production experience with Swift 6 concurrency, including actors, Sendable, and structured concurrency.
  + Building or maintaing app extensions, ideally a Notification Service Extension.
  + Hands-on experience with XCFrameworks, code signing, dSYMs, and privacy manifests.
* **Android**
  + Shipping and maintaining an Android library/SDK consumed by third parties and distributed through Maven Central.
  + Experience with consumer ProGuard/R8 rules and JNI/NDK, including native library packaging across ABIs.
  + Production experience with Android lifecycle and background execution, including process death, Doze, background restrictions, and WorkManager.
  + Strong TypeScript experience, including at least one published npm package.
  + Experience building React Native native modules using the New Architecture.

**AI Proficiency:**

* **Minimum Level: L5** — Advanced proficiency in AI-assisted software development, using AI for coding, code review, testing, debugging, and optimization.
* **Expected:** Uses AI effectively to improve development speed, code quality, and engineering efficiency.
* Hands-on experience with **Claude Code**, including skill files, commands, and structured prompts.
* Understands **context separation and sub-agents** and knows when to use them for complex or parallel tasks.
* Critically reviews and validates all AI-generated code before production use.

**Craft & Toolkit:**

* Mobile SDK & Library Development
* Public API Design & Versioning
* iOS & Android Platform Expertise
* Native Build & Package Management
* FFI & Native Interoperability
* Mobile Lifecycle & Background Execution
* Third-Party Integration & Support
* Testing & Quality Engineering
* Technical Documentation
* AI-Assisted Software Development

**Character Traits:**

* Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions.
* Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion.
* Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams.
* Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals.
* Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools.
* Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know.
* Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively.
* Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement.
* Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas

**As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits:**

* Competitive salary and bonus
* Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!)
* 30 holiday days after the first anniversary
* Your Birthday off!
* Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world!

* Work closely with product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, refine user stories, and agree on acceptance criteria.
* Promote consistent use of Mendix best practices and reusable components across the team.
* Provide honest, accurate effort estimations for tasks, user stories, enhancements, and bug fixes.

### **Quality Assurance and Lifecycle Management**

* Set up and manage CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and Git branching strategies.
* Run unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests, including full System Integration Testing.
* Diagnose and fix complex bugs including integration failures, performance issues, and concurrency problems, often under tight timelines.
* Manage the full application lifecycle including branching, versioning, environment configuration across dev, test, acceptance, and production, deployment processes, and rollback procedures.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

### **Certifications and Education**

* Mendix Advanced or Expert Certification. Expert is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

### **Technical Skills**

* At least 3 years of hands-on Mendix development experience, with at least one complex application delivered to production.
* Deep knowledge of domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, Mendix security models, Java Actions, JavaScript Actions, and Mendix best practices.
* Solid experience with REST and SOAP integrations, API design, versioning, authentication, and documentation.
* Hands-on experience with Git-based development, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
* Experience deploying and managing applications on Mendix Cloud, Azure, OpenShift, and on-premise environments.
* Advanced SQL skills covering complex queries, joins, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Proven experience carrying out Mendix major version upgrades.
* Strong Mendix Mobile experience covering offline and sync logic, performance optimization, secure storage and encryption, and managing app builds, signing, and store distribution for iOS and Android.
* Solid understanding of enterprise networking concepts including certificates, firewalls, and proxy configurations.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, Grok, and Maia to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.
* Proven ability to produce and maintain comprehensive documentation including API docs, Low-Level Design documents, and client handover packages.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel for documentation and reporting.

### **Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, especially for complex integration and performance issues where the deadline is not flexible.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication. You can write a client email that does not need to be rewritten by someone else.
* Good at facilitating workshops and requirement sessions without letting them run in circles.
* Comfortable in both agile and waterfall delivery environments and able to manage scope and customer expectations in either one.
* Proactive. You notice when something is blocked, you say something, and you propose a way forward.
* Able to work independently and lead technical workstreams without needing constant direction.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience leading a Mendix development team or workstream.
* Familiarity with Mendix QSM and performance analysis tools.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or private cloud Mendix deployments.
* Participation in Mendix Capture the Flag events or solid awareness of Mendix security vulnerabilities and how to address them.

**Why Omnix**
-------------

The projects here are real and the scale is not small. You will work alongside experienced architects and delivery teams on initiatives that cut across the GCC and Egypt. You will own what you build, deal with genuinely complex problems, and have room to grow technically and as a lead. If you want a role where you are always learning and never just maintaining the status quo, this is a reasonable place to look.

*Omnix International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.*

title: Senior Software Developer
details:
### **About Trufla**

Trufla builds the digital infrastructure that Canadian P&C insurance brokerages run on: quoting, client portals, mobile apps, marketing automation, and the data products behind them. Our customers are brokers dealing with legacy systems, manual workflows, and too many hours in the day spent on work software that should have handled itself. We're a product company, not an agency — what we ship goes straight into the hands of brokers and their clients. Work Smarter, Not Harder: we mean it internally too, and that's a large part of what this role is about.

### **About the Role**

We're hiring a Senior Software Developer who is strong on the fundamentals and already working the way the industry is heading. The job is still the job: design, build, and run production web software in Node.js and React. But how that work gets done has changed. Our engineers write specifications that agents implement, build the harnesses and evaluation loops those agents run inside, and spend proportionally more of their time on design, review, and verification than on typing out implementations. If you've been doing this genuinely, not just with autocomplete turned on, we want to talk. If you've been skeptical of it and have sharp, specific reasons, we want to talk to you too.

### **What You'll Do**

  

* Design and ship features end to end across our Node.js services and React front ends, from data model to deployed and monitored.
* Write specifications precise enough to be executed, covering clear contracts, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and failure modes. Treat those specs as the durable artifact, not a throwaway ticket description.
* Build and tune the loops: agent harnesses, tool definitions, context strategies, automated verification gates, and evals that tell you whether a change is actually correct before a human ever reads it.
* Review generated and human-written code with the same rigour, and know where the difference matters.
* Own production. Instrument what you ship, respond when it misbehaves, and fix the cause rather than the symptom.
* Raise the floor for the team through patterns, internal tooling, and documented practice that make the next person faster.
* Work directly with product and with the brokers who use what we build. Context is not filtered through three layers here.

### **What We're Looking For**

### **Required**

* 5+ years building and maintaining production software, with real ownership of what you shipped.
* Deep Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You understand the runtime, not just the framework.
* Strong React, including state management, performance, and component design that survives contact with a growing codebase.
* Solid grounding in the boring essentials: relational data modelling, HTTP and API design, testing, CI/CD, Git.
* Working fluency in AI-assisted development as a discipline: spec-driven workflows, agentic development lifecycle practices, and the judgment to know when the loop is producing good work and when it's confidently wrong.
* Clear written communication. In a spec-driven team this is a core engineering skill, not a soft one.
* Comfortable collaborating with a distributed team across Canadian and Egyptian time zones.

### **Nice to Have (any one of these is a plus, none are dealbreakers)**

  

* Cloud and container experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform).
* Observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, tracing.
* Mobile or cross-platform experience (React Native, Swift, Kotlin).
* Experience building internal developer tooling or frameworks.
* Insurance, fintech, or another regulated domain.

### **How We Work**

  

* Small teams, direct ownership, short path from idea to production.
* Specs and design docs over ad-hoc tickets.
* Automated verification before human review. We'd rather catch it in the loop.
* Tooling budget and time set aside to improve how we build, not just what we build.

### **What We Offer**

  

* Competitive salary
* Medical insurance, social insurance, and other benefits
* Hybrid attendance policy
* Access to the AI tooling you need to do this job properly
* A team that treats "how we build" as a real engineering problem

* Hands-on experience developing against Dockerized applications (building/running containers, Compose-based local setups, troubleshooting environment issues that block frontend delivery)

* Proven collaboration with backend engineers on contracts, integrations, and production issues across the stack

* Ensure that solutions comply with organizational requirements for security, privacy, accessibility, performance, maintainability, governance, and data integrity.

* Partner with business stakeholders, platform teams, architects, content owners, and technology suppliers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions, resolve complex issues, and recommend sustainable improvements.

title: Senior Backend Architect PK
details:
**Lead-level backend ownership. AI-first delivery. Architecture decisions.**  
  
We are looking for a highly senior backend engineer who can operate at **Lead Engineer / Architect level**.

This is not a role for someone who only executes tickets. We need someone who can **make architecture decisions independently**, design systems with long-term scalability in mind, and turn ambiguous product needs into production-ready backend solutions.  
  
This is a high-ownership role on a lean team. The default mode of execution is **AI-first**. Engineers use AI agents to accelerate research, planning, implementation, testing, and refinement, but ownership stays fully with the engineer. The person in this role must be able to use AI to move fast while maintaining strong judgment around architecture, correctness, security, performance, and reliability.

We are specifically looking for candidates who have already held responsibilities similar to **Lead Engineer, or Architect** in previous roles.  
  
**The work**

* Design and own backend services in NestJS and TypeScript, from schema to production
* Make architecture decisions independently, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and reliability
* Build and maintain GraphQL APIs across a microservices environment
* Own database design, optimization, and reliability in Postgres
* Define technical direction, not just implementation details
* Set and enforce quality standards across both AI-generated and manually written code
* Translate ambiguous product needs into clear technical solutions
* Contribute to system design, infrastructure decisions, testing strategy, and developer productivity
* Operate in an AI-first workflow without compromising engineering standards

This is a fast-paced environment with real production stakes. You will be expected to move quickly, think at systems level, and make strong technical decisions with minimal hand-holding. If you are comfortable owning architecture and raising the technical bar in a high-accountability environment, this role is for you.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Extensive hands-on experience with Node.js, Express.js or Nest.js
* Hands-on Experience with GraphQL and TypeORM
* Production experience with backend frameworks in high-scale environments.
* Expertise in relational and non relational databases.
* Advanced knowledge of MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL, with strong database design, administration, and optimization skills.
* Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, and working with microservices architecture.
* Proficient in client-side scripting, JavaScript frameworks, and handling cross-browser compatibility issues.
* Experience with version control systems like Git and an understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

title: Senior Software Tester Engineer
details:
**Job Summary:**  
Owns quality end to end for an assigned product area or squad. Plans and executes the testing for that scope, builds and maintains its automated coverage inside the established Playwright framework, and mentors mid-level and junior engineers day to day. Works to the test strategy and standards set by the Software Testing Director and operationalised by the Principal Quality Engineer: applies them consistently within scope, and raises gaps or improvement proposals upward rather than changing them independently. Framework architecture and cross-team standards remain with the Principal Quality Engineer. No direct reports.

 **Requirements**

**Quality Ownership for an Assigned Scope**

* Own the test approach, coverage and quality outcome for an assigned product area, module or squad.
* Analyse requirements and acceptance criteria early, identify risk areas and testability problems, and raise them before development starts.
* Estimate testing effort for own scope and commit to sprint and release timelines.
* Plan and execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and UAT testing across web and mobile.
* Report testing status, risks and quality evidence for own scope, and give a clear readiness view at release checkpoints.

**Test Automation**

* Design, build and maintain automated test suites within the established Playwright framework, following the agreed structure and conventions.
* Extend shared framework components — helpers, fixtures, page objects, utilities — under the architectural direction of the Principal Quality Engineer.
* Keep automated coverage for own scope growing in line with the agreed plan, and keep the suites reliable rather than muting failures.
* Automate API-level checks (Postman, RestAssured or equivalent) and validate data with SQL.
* Run and troubleshoot automated suites in CI/CD pipelines and act on the results.

**Applying Standards & Supporting the Practice**

* Apply the agreed test strategy, standards and processes consistently across own scope.
* Peer-review test cases and automation code written by mid-level and junior engineers.
* Flag gaps, friction or risks in the agreed standards and propose improvements to the Principal Quality Engineer or the Software Testing Director.
* Contribute root cause input on escaped defects within own scope.

**Mentoring & Collaboration**

* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on test design, automation and tooling, and support their onboarding.
* Act as the day-to-day quality point of contact for the squad's developers, Product Owner and Business Analyst.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
* Apply approved Generative AI practices in daily work, and pilot new ones when asked to do so.

**Job Specification:**

* Experience: 4 to 7 years in software testing or quality engineering, including at least 2 years writing and maintaining automated tests in a production framework.
* Automation: Strong hands-on Playwright (preferred) or an equivalent modern framework, with working code fluency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java or Python, and practical experience running suites in CI/CD.
* Technical breadth: Solid API testing (Postman, Swagger, RestAssured or similar), SQL for data validation, and experience testing both web and mobile applications.
* Generative AI: Practical, consistent use of AI-assisted tooling in testing work — test design, data generation, documentation and analysis. ISTQB CT-GenAI an advantage.
* Process: Able to own the test approach for a product area, estimate effort, apply risk-based techniques, and work to standards set by others within Agile/Scrum delivery.
* Mentoring: Demonstrated experience guiding less experienced engineers and reviewing their work constructively.
* Certifications: ISTQB Foundation Level required; a further ISTQB certification (Agile Tester, Mobile, Performance or CTAL) preferred.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Languages: Good to fluent English, written and spoken. Arabic an advantage.
* Role boundaries: Test strategy, test plans and departmental direction are set and owned by the Software Testing Director. Automation architecture and cross-team standards sit with the Principal Quality Engineer. This role owns quality for an assigned scope, applies the agreed strategy and standards within it, mentors more junior engineers, and escalates gaps upward. No direct reports.
* Growth path: Progression to Principal Quality Engineer (Technical Team Lead), with framework architecture, cross-team standards and strategy contribution as the main development areas.

details:

Bayzat is at the forefront of transforming workplaces through innovative solutions in HR, Payroll, Finance, and Insurance. Recognized by Forbes as a promising UAE-based startup and supported by leading VCs like Mubadala and Point72 Ventures, we are among the best-funded HRTech scale-ups in the region.

At Bayzat, culture is paramount. We are a principle-driven, merit-based organization where authenticity, collaboration, and unpretentiousness thrive. Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimize efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a driven DevOps Engineer to automate, scale, and secure our infrastructure while championing engineering best practices across the team. You'll own the full stack — from cloud architecture to on-call operations and play a key role in shaping Bayzat's engineering culture.

**Some high-impact responsibilities you will be entrusted with:**

* Automate tools to reduce repeating efforts of processes
* Develop high quality software that is scalable and secure
* Build tools and integrations that monitor and create alerts
* Adapt cloud best practices
* Troubleshoot errors across the entire stack - from software to hardware to cloud resources
* Spread Dev-Ops culture across company
* Continuously improve your technical and soft skills
* Join our 24x7 on-call rotation
* Make systematic documentation
* Contribute to Bayzat Engineering Culture by making presentations or explaining concepts to a multinational team

**What you will need to have:**

* 3+ years experience in at least one programming language: Java, Python, Golang, or TypeScript
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills in English
* BS degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related technical field
* Strong understanding of CS fundamentals such as data structures and algorithms
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Strong experience and understanding of Git
* Experience with Unix-like systems and Bash scripting
* Experience with application packaging using Docker
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform)
* Understanding of network stack basics
* Solid AWS fundamentals with hands-on experience (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, and related services)
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies
* A mindset for operational excellence

**Nice to haves:**

* Familiarity with container orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, AWS ECS)
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (GitHub Actions) -
* Experience with building developer tooling and developer experience (DX) -
* An ability and desire to mentor and coach engineers -
* A deep understanding of Observability (monitoring, logging, and tracing) standard methodologies

**What’s in it for You**

At Bayzat, we don’t sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture - we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You’ll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you’ll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Meritocracy at its core:** Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.
* **Freedom to shape your path:** We support cross-functional moves and growth transitions when you drive value.
* **Real feedback culture:** Feedback is coaching - empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
* **Barrier-free collaboration:** Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you’ll have a seat at the table — even with the CEO.
* **Accelerated growth:** Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
* **Flexible work setup:** Remote and hybrid options designed around performance.
* **Inclusive culture:** Regular company-wide all-hands, OKR tribe meetings, and annual awards that celebrate real impact.

This isn’t for everyone - but if you want to be pushed, inspired, and rewarded for what you deliver, **welcome to Bayzat.**

title: Technical Support Engineer III - German
details:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

The Sr. Technical Support Engineer is a strategic customer advisor and the internal voice for our customer base within a highly technical area of Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform (IAM). The Sr. Technical Support Engineer will both have the accountability and responsibility to deliver on our customers' needs. This role is the technical domain expert between customers and all functions within Docusign to resolve technical support inquiries. Working with resources across Docusign, this role expedites the resolution of complex technical issues to empower customers to achieve the highest value and adoption of our software.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Technical Support Manager.

**Responsibility**

* Provide outstanding technical support for the Docusign ecosystem and associated services
* Handle escalated cases of incoming support channels to troubleshoot issues customers face when using Docusign products, including but not limited to API integrations, embedded systems issues, network and security-related impediments, 3rd party integrations, and multi-product workflows, in accordance with team-specific scope
* Own customer issues to engineering interface to resolve technical bugs and influence development roadmap
* Use broad technical product expertise within Docusign ecosystem areas to help customers increase adoption
* Use support tools and resources vital to get the job done, including Salesforce, Jira, Docusign proprietary logging systems, browser developer tools, internal admin console, SQL, and text analysis tooling
* Identify improvements to the product, identify bugs and otherwise determine high-impact opportunities to improve the customer experience
* Promote Docusign products and services to customers and prospective customers via consultative discussion and evaluation of their service and support needs
* Partner with non-delivery teams to identify needs and develop product training
* Collaborate and communicate with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Account Management to ensure alignment on plans
* Meet and exceed Docusign Customer Support service level goals for areas of Docusign ecosystem expertise
* Serve as an escalation point for eSign Technical Support Team Engineers and Non-eSign aligned TCSMs as needed
* Act as an On-Call escalation contact in a rotation during weekend hours

  
  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Remote:** Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* Bachelor of Science degree in a Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical subject area
* 5+ years of SaaS network troubleshooting experience in a Technical Support and/or Network Operations Center (NOC) capacity
* Experience with modern markup and programming languages such as XML, JSON
* Experience troubleshooting in a web-based environment including HTTP, JSON, HTML
* Log analysis experience using network tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, browser developer tools or similar
* Fluent in German and English

  

**Preferred**

* Self-motivated, goal-oriented, excellent organizational skills and outstanding time management skills
* Knowledge of web services, SDK's, REST and SOAP API's
* Microsoft System Administration work experience
* Docusign organization administration work experience
* Effective communication skills which are a key component of this role, with audiences that include customers, peers, and occasional executive presence
* Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers
* Experience troubleshooting embedded signing and sending, as well as Docusign On-demand Signature Service and Docusign Central data replication scenarios
* Expertise with reporting using Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint to an executive audience
* Mastery troubleshooting regular expressions, debugging code and/or complex data validation rules
* Domain expertise with web-based applications, web service APIs, monitoring tools (e.g. Dynatrace), and authentication technologies such as SAML, oAuth, SSO and IDP's
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**AI in Our Hiring Process**
  
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
