title: Field Operations and Technical Assistance Manager
details:
**Job Description**

**Work Arrangement:** This role is categorized as onsite. this means the successful candidate to report to the GM office full time.

  

**The Role**
------------

The Field Operations and Technical Assistance Manager leads GM’s field service and Technical Assistance Center (TAC) activities across Egypt and North Africa. The role ensures assigned dealers receive timely, effective technical and operational support, and that complex vehicle and customer concerns are investigated, escalated, resolved, and used to drive continuous improvement.

Working with the Service Operations Manager, dealer leadership, and cross-functional teams, this manager strengthens dealer service capability, repair quality, customer experience, and field execution. The role turns technical case data, customer feedback, and field observations into clear priorities and measurable actions for dealers and GM stakeholders.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Lead field service and TAC priorities in alignment with CCA and Service Operations objectives; translate business and customer needs into practical dealer-support plans.
* Lead, coach, and develop field service and TAC team members, prioritize workload, and coordinate territory and dealer coverage.
* Build strong working relationships with dealer service team and provide hands-on support through field visits, performance reviews, operational assessments, and follow-up.
* Oversee the end-to-end TAC case process, including intake quality, prioritization, technical analysis, escalation, response timeliness, case documentation, and verified closure.
* Guide the investigation of complex or repeat vehicle concerns, ensuring appropriate diagnostic steps, evidence, repair direction, and escalation to the relevant engineering, quality, or global technical teams.
* Support urgent, safety-related, customer-impacting, and repurchase-risk cases; coordinate prompt ownership, clear communication, and a documented resolution path.
* Use Field Product Reports (FPRs), TAC cases, warranty information, customer feedback, and dealer observations to identify emerging product or process trends and communicate actionable findings.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Warranty, Customer Care, and regional or global teams to support containment, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, validation, and recurrence prevention.
* Monitor dealer and field-support indicators such as customer satisfaction, fixed right first time, repeat visits, technical case aging and closure, dealer service capability, and field-action execution; highlight gaps and recommend countermeasures.
* Develop and track dealer improvement plans with clear owners, milestones, and follow-up; review progress with dealer management and escalate unresolved barriers appropriately.
* Coordinate dealer readiness and field execution for recalls, field actions, service campaigns, and other customer-support programs, including repair information, tools, parts, technician capability, and completion monitoring.
* Support new-model and new-technology readiness—including electric vehicles—by identifying technical support needs, special tools and safety requirements, service information gaps, and dealer capability actions.
* Ensure dealers receive clear, timely technical communications, service procedures, diagnostic guidance, and lessons learned; coordinate updates with the appropriate GM functions.
* Prepare concise management updates and performance reviews that summarize customer and vehicle concerns, technical risks, dealer actions, trends, and decisions required.
* Promote consistent use of GM service, technical-assistance, safety, warranty, and quality processes; identify compliance risks and drive corrective follow-through.
* Represent GM professionally in dealer and cross-functional discussions, building alignment while protecting customer interests and GM standards.
Perform other related duties as assigned.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**
-----------------------------------------------------

### **Educational and Experience Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered in accordance with local requirements.
* Minimum of 8 years progressive experience in automotive aftersales, dealer service operations, field service, technical support, or a Technical Assistance Center environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams or coordinating technical and dealer-facing work across multiple stakeholders.
* Experience investigating complex vehicle concerns and managing issues from initial report through technical escalation, repair validation, and closure.
* Experience working with dealer networks and collaborating across functions such as Quality, Warranty, Engineering, Manufacturing, Customer Care, and Training.
* Experience supporting new-model launches, field actions, recalls, or new vehicle technologies is an advantage.
Strong written and spoken English and Arabic communication skills.  

  

### **Technical and Professional Skills**

* Strong understanding of automotive service operations, dealership workshops, vehicle repair processes, and dealer support.
* Technical case management, diagnostic reasoning, evidence review, escalation, and repair validation.
* Structured problem solving, including root-cause analysis, containment, corrective action, and recurrence prevention.
* Working knowledge of Field Product Reports, service information, diagnostic tools, warranty processes, and field-action execution.
* Dealer performance analysis and the ability to translate customer, technical, and operational data into focused improvement actions.
* Strong written communication, technical reporting, presentation, and meeting-facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with dashboards or business-intelligence tools is an advantage.
* Ability to travel to dealer locations and support field activities across the assigned geography.

### **Competencies**

* Customer-focused judgment and ownership through resolution.
* People leadership, coaching, and development.
* Clear communication and effective influence across a dealer network and matrixed organization.
* Analytical thinking and sound technical judgment.
* Strong prioritization, follow-through, and escalation discipline.
* Cross-functional collaboration and relationship building.
* Accountability, integrity, and commitment to safety and compliance.
* Adaptability and continuous-improvement mindset in a changing technical environment.







**About GM**

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

**Why Join Us**

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

**Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities**

General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.
  
  
We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** .

**Accommodations**

General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, **email** us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: ERP Implementor Specialist
details:
***Are you ready to lead organizations through transformative ERP implementations, driving efficiency and business success with your expertise?***

**Job Summary:**

The ERP Implementation Specialist will be responsible for delivering comprehensive business process and application consulting services, including business analysis, solution design, gap analysis, software installation, configuration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, all in line with established implementation methodologies. A key aspect of the role also involves fostering long-term, successful relationships with clients and providing them with industry best practices to ensure optimal utilization of the solutions.

* Maintain detailed and organized records of all client communications to ensure seamless follow-up and effective project management.

* Proactively address client inquiries, serve as a key escalation point for resolving concerns, and coordinate internal communications to ensure smooth implementation progress.

* Collaborate with the customization team to design and implement tailored solutions that align with the client's specific requirements.

**Why Join Dafater?**

* Be part of a forward-thinking company that values creativity and innovation.

* Work with a talented and passionate team dedicated to making a difference.

***Ready to make a significant impact? Apply now and lead transformative ERP implementations, driving business success and operational efficiency!***

title: Senior Client Solutions Manager - X
details:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**

At **Aleph**, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

This is a paid media, social advertising, and account management role for someone who enjoys campaign optimization, client consulting, and turning data into results. You will ensure the successful design and delivery of all assigned campaign strategies, including original content, custom-built, high-impact, and targeted media.

### **What You Will Do**

* Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to shape strategies that help clients scale their business on the platform.

* Plan and host educational sessions with campaign managers at agency level and with clients.

title: Customer Success Manager
details:
The Customer Success Manager is responsible for managing and developing long-term customer relationships across ZainTECH's Managed Services portfolio, ensuring customer satisfaction, service continuity, contract retention, and recurring revenue growth. The role serves as the primary post-sales relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring that contracted services are effectively delivered, consumed, billed, and renewed in accordance with customer expectations and commercial commitments.

Working closely with Account Management, Managed Services, Technical Delivery, Finance, and other internal stakeholders, the Customer Success Manager translates operational performance and customer requirements into actionable improvements and commercial opportunities. The role drives customer engagement, service governance, contract renewals, account health monitoring, and revenue expansion while maintaining clear ownership of customer escalations.

Responsibilities:

Customer Relationship Management & Escalation Handling

* Own customer escalations end to end, coordinating with Delivery, Account Management, and vendors as required, while ensuring clear and timely customer communication.
* Ensure all customer concerns, including technical, commercial, and billing-related issues, are logged in ServiceNow within one business day, with a clearly assigned owner.
* Acknowledge customer concerns on the same day, align internally on the proposed response, and document all commitments.
* Escalate repeated or unresolved issues to the Head of Managed Services and keep the Customer Success Lead informed.
* Review all Poor CSAT responses within five working days, agree on corrective actions with the responsible teams, and monitor them through to closure.

Service Governance & Account Health Management

* Conduct service reviews and executive reviews in accordance with customer service tiers, ensuring meeting minutes and action items are documented and shared with customers.
* Record customer concerns raised during service reviews as ServiceNow cases and flag them appropriately for escalation.
* Monitor account health across service performance, open escalations, commercial standing, and customer relationships, identifying at-risk accounts and reporting them during monthly portfolio reviews.
* Conduct regular cost and consumption reviews for cloud customers in collaboration with Managed Services and present optimization recommendations to customers.

Revenue Growth & Account Development

* Drive recurring revenue growth from the existing customer portfolio, targeting a minimum year-on-year growth of 15%.
* Maintain account plans for all High Touch customers, mapping currently consumed services against the ZainTECH service catalogue and identifying quarterly upselling opportunities.
* Identify and qualify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, coordinating with Account Management and Presales within five working days and ensuring opportunities are recorded in the CRM / ServiceNow.
* Collaborate with Account Management and Presales to support commercial expansion opportunities, while ensuring ownership of quotations and pricing remains with the Account Manager.
* Engage customers within ten working days when Operations identify workload peaks or consumption anomalies, agreeing on appropriate upselling or remediation actions and documenting the resulting decisions and revenue impact.

Delivery Readiness & Service Handover

* Provide Tower Leads, NOC, Service Desk, and Professional Services teams with a rolling 30/60/90-day forecast of won and expected work to support resource planning and delivery readiness.
* Manage the transition of customers from Sales and Projects to Managed Services, ensuring all required documentation is completed before go-live.
* Ensure service handovers include signed Statements of Facts (SOF), agreed scope, SLAs, customer contacts, expected consumption against estimates, and completed onboarding checklists.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure operational teams are adequately staffed and certified ahead of service commencement.

Contract Management, Renewals & Offboarding

* Monitor customer contracts and service commitments to support timely renewals, continuity of services, and commercial compliance.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to ensure contractual scope, service levels, and customer commitments are properly maintained throughout the service lifecycle.
* Support contract-related follow-ups and identify potential risks associated with contract expiry or service continuity.

Billing, Collections & Dispute Management

* Conduct monthly account reviews covering contracted versus billed services, billed versus consumed services, issued invoices, collections, overdue ageing, and outstanding disputes.
* Monitor account financial health using Green / Amber / Red classifications and identify potential revenue leakage, including unbilled services, expired contracts still in service, and invoices not raised against valid purchase orders.
* Coordinate with Finance and customers on overdue collections, agree on payment commitments, and participate in collection reviews in accordance with the AR Collections SOP.
* Investigate disputed invoices against contractual agreements and service delivery records within five working days, coordinating with Finance, Professional Services, and Managed Services.
* Provide recommendations to the BU Head to support the resolution of invoice disputes within the agreed ten-working-day timeframe.

*Our Culture & Code of Conduct:*

*At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.*

 **Requirements**  

* 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Service Delivery Management within managed services, cloud, or IT outsourcing environments, preferably supporting enterprise customers across the GCC.

* Proven track record of growing revenue from existing customer portfolios and managing contract renewals.
* Strong commercial and financial understanding, including the ability to review contracts, purchase orders, invoices, ageing reports, and prepare basic account P&L analysis.
* Working knowledge of cloud and managed services, including Azure, AWS, OCI, private cloud, and Microsoft 365.
* Understanding of cloud cost and consumption basics (FinOps, reservations, and licensing models)
* Familiarity with vendor licensing models, particularly Microsoft CSP and Oracle licensing.
* Experience with ServiceNow's Customer Service Management, Case Management, and Contract modules.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM.
* Advanced level in Excel and Power BI dashboards.
* Degree in IT, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Required Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation, One cloud fundamentals certification (AZ-900, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or OCI Foundations).
* Preferred Certifications: Customer Success certification (e.g., CCSM), FinOps Certified Practitioner, or ServiceNow CSM Fundamentals.

title: Shutdown Co-ordinator
details:
*Asante Gold Corporation ('Asante') is a gold exploration, development and operating company with a high-quality portfolio of mines and projects in Ghana. The Company currently operates the Bibiani and Chirano Gold Mines and is advancing the Kubi Gold Project. Asante is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: ASE), the Ghana Stock Exchange (GSE: ASG) and the OTCQX Market in the United States (OTCQX: ASGOF).*

*Driven by a vision to become the preferred Tier-1 mining company in West Africa, Asante is committed to building a safe, efficient and responsible mining business that delivers sustainable value to its employees, communities, shareholders and other stakeholders.*

*At Asante, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing an environment where employees can undertake meaningful work, develop their careers and contribute to the future of mining in Ghana.*

*Our culture is guided by the core values of Safety, Ownership, Teamwork and Continuous Improvement and we seek individuals who demonstrate accountability, integrity, collaboration and a passion for excellence.*

*If you share our ambition and are looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a dynamic and growing organization, we invite suitably qualified candidates to apply for the following position:*

***About This Role***

Responsible for coordinating and controlling shutdown and major maintenance activities to ensure work is executed safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets, while minimizing operational risk and downtime.

***Key Responsibilities***

* Create Shutdown Charter
* Develop the shutdown schedule
* Conduct scope challenge process
* Handover schedule to area maintenance and contractor supervisors
* Lead daily shutdown progress review meetings
* Prepare Shutdown Closeout report
* Review Shutdown performance against the shutdown cost, work plan and KPIs
* Develop corrective actions to mitigate shutdown performance loss.
* Coordinate daily shutdown activities across all disciplines.
* Ensure work progresses according to the shutdown schedule.
* Manage activity interfaces between departments and contractors.
* Escalate schedule risks and recommend recovery actions.
* Coordinate schedule updates with the Shutdown Planner
* Actively participate and promote continuous improvement initiatives
* Provide line staff with the necessary training, skills, knowledge and tools to do their jobs safely
* Observe operations to detect violations of Legal and Corporate requirements and report to management
* Assist in accident and incident investigations and ensure that remedial actions are implemented by scheduled dates.
* Perform other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

***Education, Work Experience & Key Competencies***

* Bachelor's degree equivalent qualification in a relevant engineering discipline (Mechanical or Electricals) from a recognized tertiary institution.
* Minimum of 5 years' experience in mining, mineral processing, power generation, or heavy industry, with demonstrated experience managing shutdowns.
* Inspecting Engineer Certificate of Competency issued by the Mines Inspectorate Division of the Minerals Commission is desirable.
* Excellent knowledge in Maintenance Planning.
* Shutdown planning skill and experience highly regarded.
* Knowledge of a standard work management system.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, particularly PowerPoint, Word, Project and Excel.
* Excellent leadership, management, and technical skills relevant to the effective provision of maintenance services.
* Ability to work in multi-cultural environment and respect other people values and opinions

title: Regional Representative (ROMENA), D1
details:
Org. Setting and Reporting

This position is located in the Regional Office for the Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA) of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) in Cairo, Egypt. The incumbent will work under the overall guidance of the Director for the Division for Operations (DO) and direct supervision of the Deputy Director of DO in coordination with the Regional Section for Africa and the Middle East (RSAME) located at UNODC headquarters in Vienna. For more information on UNODC, please visit our website: www.unodc.org.

Responsibilities

The Regional Representative heads the Regional Office for the Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA). Within delegated authority, the incumbent is responsible for the effective implementation of UNODC programmes and activities in the Middle East and North Africa in supporting Member States’ capacities to deal effectively with issues related to drug control, organized crime, crime prevention, countering corruption and terrorism prevention. The incumbent will be responsible and accountable for the efficient management of all human, financial and physical resources allocated to the programmes and the office, as well as for ensuring outputs of a high-quality standard. The incumbent is also a member of the United Nations Country Teams (UNCTs), under the strategic guidance and coordination of the relevant United Nations Resident Coordinators (UNRC), and member of the United Nations Regional Collaborative Platform and Development Group (UNDG) Regional Team wherever applicable. As a member of the UNCTs, and of the UNDG Regional Team, the incumbent leads UNODC’s engagement in UN common country and regional planning, programming, funding, monitoring and evaluation activities and actively contributes towards UN-wide strategic planning and cooperation in the field, in particular with the UN Development Coordination Office (UN DCO) and the UN Sustainable Development Group (UNSDG), including ensuring that drugs/crime related issues are embedded in key UN programmatic instruments such as the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF). In particular, the incumbent will perform the following specific duties: Strategic and Policy Advice • Provide policy advice to the highest levels of Governments in the assigned region (and countries) on the development of interregional, regional and national long term political, policy, strategic and tactical capacity-building in drug control, organized crime and crime prevention, in order to promote adherence to and ensure consistency with the terms of the United Nations conventions, drug control treaties, the Conventions against Transnational Organized Crime (UNTOC) and Corruption (UNCAC) and the international instruments to counter terrorism, as well as with the goals and objectives of the 20th Special Session of the General Assembly. • Represent UNODC’s position and interests in the region/countries in several fora, especially within the host countries, and promote solid partnerships with Governments, institutions, civil society, work in close coordination with UNCTs and UNRCs, regional and international aid agencies, financial institutions and other stakeholders, parliamentarians and the media. • Advise and assist the Governments in the assessment of planning, design and management of response policy measures, in particular developing and proposing national as well as regional cooperation strategies. • Provide political and diplomatic leadership in promoting a better understanding of the importance of drug and crime related matters, encourage increased priority attention to all aspects of drug control, organized crime and crime prevention, and advocate the inclusion of these issues in government planning documents as well as in relevant programmes of other bilateral, multilateral and non-governmental organizations. Advise UNODC, UN DCO and UN DPPA senior management on national, regional and continental dynamics and possible policy and operational responses related to political developments, policy shifts, trends and emerging issues pertaining to UNODC’s mandates or resulting from the UN Development System Reform and 2030 Agenda based on close interaction with other UNODC Field Offices, and HQ divisions. Programme development & Resource Mobilization • Contribute towards UN-wide strategic planning and cooperation in the field, in particular with the UN Development Coordination Office (UN DCO) and the UN Sustainable Development Group (UNSDG), including ensuring that drugs/crime related issues are embedded in key UN programmatic instruments such as the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF). • Provide strong leadership in formulating programme objectives as regards technical assistance for the region/countries, in order to stress the essential importance of an effective technical cooperation of improved planning • Lead the exploration of opportunities to grow the Regional Office programme portfolio (and respective components) in line with UNODC strategy and governments requests, increase programme of work, develop proposals and oversee their implementation. • Support UNODC senior management in developing and maintaining partnerships for field-based services to Member States and the joint resource mobilization for new activities. Demonstrate analytical and diplomatic skills in assessing partners’ requirements, gain their trust and respect, propose new solutions and foster intellectual, substantive policy-level dialogue with Member States on programme development in UNODC mandate areas, maintaining sensitivity to political issues. • Ensure that a resource mobilization strategy remains in place that promotes long-term involvement and financial and in-kind support and resources by governments, international, public and private sector donors to the work of UNODC for the core infrastructure and technical assistance programme of UNODC in the countries and region. At the same time the incumbent engages in joint resource mobilization efforts with the UNCTs and in line with the UNDSDF budgets. Programme implementation • Direct the implementation’s coordination, monitoring and evaluation of the overall progress of ongoing activities in the region/countries through all available platforms of intervention and coordination, internally as well as externally in order to ensure the effective project/progamme delivery and use of funds as well as consistency, substantively, technically and financially with the objectives set forth in the programming tools. • In the project cycle management, approve directly project documents in conformity with respective UNODC Management Instructions (MI), intervene when difficulties arise, take remedial actions as required and identify appropriate solutions. • Manage corresponding budget and programme resources. • Lead the Regional Office’s work in relation to Enterprise Risk Management. • Ensure integrity and timely substantive and financial reporting; ensure that donor funding agreements are honoured. • Lead team members’ efforts to collect and analyze data and provide insight to identify trends or patterns for data driven planning, decision-making, presentation and reporting. Ensure that everyone can discover, access, integrate and share the data they need. • Ensure integration of human rights and gender system-wide policies in planning and delivery of assistance. • Keep UNODC headquarters informed of the progress being made and ensure the effective communication of UNODC’s work and its impact in the region. Office management • In accordance with established policies and delegated authority direct and manage the UNODC Regional Office for the Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA). Oversee the management of the financial, human and physical resources assigned to the UNODC Regional Office and sub-offices (Country and Programme Offices). Oversee programmes and activities in the region in supporting Member States capacities to deal effectively with issues related to drug and crime. Oversee the successful implementation of activities in the region in close consultation with existing representatives, regional advisors and thematic/programme coordinators, as well as ensure performing the oversight for coordination of cross-regional activities. • Oversee the recruitment of staff and affiliate personnel; ensure effective utilization, supervision and development of human resources; guide, evaluate and mentor personnel; promote professional development and create an inclusive and diverse work environment which fosters civility and respect among colleagues and uphold zero tolerance to harassment, including sexual harassment/exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. As member of the local Security Management Team (SMT), and as outlined in the "Handbook for United Nations Designated Officials for Security”, support and advise the local Designated Officials in all security management related matters. The UNODC Regional Representative is accountable to the Secretary General through the UNODC Executive Director. • Be responsible for the implementation of local security management decisions taken by the Designated Officials and SMTs and appropriate security and safety measures and arrangements for UNODC staff, personnel, eligible family members, as well as for all UNODC premises and operations in the country/region, in coordination with the local UNDSS security officials, and with advice from the UNODC Focal Point for Field Security at Headquarters Vienna, as appropriate. • Oversee the planning, development and management of procurement and inventory for the office and projects in line with the established policies and delegated authority. • Perform other work-related duties as may be required.

Competencies

• Professionalism: Has demonstrated professional competence and mastery in programme development and execution, advocacy as well as in providing seasoned effective specialized advice in a broad range of development assistance issues and on matters related to drug control, organized crime and crime prevention. Has ability to negotiate and resolve complex and politically sensitive issues/problems with governments and cooperating institutions. Ensures adequate preparation of reports and papers on technical issues as well as rationale with respect to key technical assistance decisions. Has ability to supervise and to review the work of others. Has ability to apply United Nations rules, regulations, policies and guidelines in work situations. Has proven administrative/financial and human resources management ability. Has capacity to stimulate intellectual, substantive policy-level dialogue with Government on programme development in drug control and crime prevention issues, and technical cooperation coordination. Has sensitivity to political issues and adaptability to local environment, hardship, and security/emergency situations. Has ability to analyze and interpret data in support of decision-making and convey resulting information to management. title: Lead Technical Architect
details:
**Job Description:**

**Essential Job Functions:**

  

**Technical Architecture Alignment:**

* Lead technical discovery and establish the target architecture blueprint connecting Temenos Transact R26 with enterprise middleware, Common Payment Gateway (CPG), trade/custody systems and cloud data infrastructures.

* **Core & TAFJ Governance:** Oversee the technical setup of the TAFJ runtime environment, application server, database layer, and environment parameter configurations for the Initial System Build (ISB).
* **Integration & Streaming Architecture Oversight:** Review the architectural design for real-time and batch integration patterns across 20+ interfaces:
* **Real-time API Framework:** IRIS for channel interactions (Internet Banking, Platform).
* **Event Streaming & Data Hub:** Review the Temenos Data Hub (TDH) event extraction via AWS MSK for downstream analytics and regulatory feeds.
* **Batch & Transactional Engine:** Open Financial Services (OFS) queues and multi-threaded processing frameworks.
* **Technology Compliance & Performance:** Support the Bank Infrastructure team to meet strict High Availability (HA), RPO/RTO targets and peak transaction throughput (TPS) requirements while ensuring zero lock wait contention during online processing and Close of Business (COB) execution.
* **Security Architecture:** Define technical security standards including token propagation, role-based access control (SMS security), payload encryption, audit logging, and audit trail extraction compliance.
* **L3 Technical Gap Governance:** Review technical gap specifications, ensuring custom TAFJ/Java plugins, pre/post processors, and L3 code extensions adhere to Temenos design standards without impacting core upgradeability.
* **Environment & Release Architecture:** Collaborate with Temenos & Bank team to validate the Client Configuration Environment (CCE) and initial build setups, managing technical risks and dependency logs.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Expert-level knowledge of **Temenos Transact R23+ Technology architecture**, **TAFJ** and experience with Amazon Cloud Deployments.
* Deep expertise in **IRIS (REST)**, **Integration Framework (IF)**, **Design Studio** and **Temenos Data Hub (TDH)**
* **Enterprise Integration & Middleware:** Hands-on knowledge of Apache Kafka/AWS MSK, Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), Payment Gateway (CPG) abstraction layers, and microservices design patterns.
* **Database & High Performance:** In-depth understanding of relational database management systems (PostgreSQL), connection pooling, thread locking mechanics (F.LOCKING), indexing strategies and COB batch optimization.
* **Messaging & Regulatory Protocols:** Good understanding of Transact event Notification frameworks, ISO 20022 XML messaging formats (pacs, camt, pain) and regulatory data pipelines.
* **Technical Leadership & Governance:** Proven capability to work with Bank’s architecture Team, Author Technical Solutions Architecture (TSD) and present recommendations/blueprints to Enterprise Architecture Boards.  
    
  **Basic Qualifications:**
* 16+ years of progressive technical experience in enterprise banking software architecture.
* Minimum 8+ years acting as Lead Technical Architect on major Temenos Transact implementation projects.
* Track record of successfully delivering Architecture Blueprints and design sign-offs on Transact core transformation programs.

With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

### **Context**

In the scope of developing new IoT offerings, Orange aims to design and operate a dedicated Mobile Core platform tailored for IoT applications. This platform primarily comprises a 4G/5G mobile core network, an IMS solution, and an SMSC platform, all built upon a cloud-native Kubernetes infrastructure. The platform will support 4G/5G data, voice, and SMS services.

Within this framework, we are seeking a **System Technical Architect** to serve as the end-to-end solution implementation leader. The incumbent will be responsible for defining, implementing, and maintaining the detailed architecture at the execution level.

### **Main Responsibilities**

In collaboration with the Solution Architect (responsible for High-Level Design), the Telco Cloud Infrastructure team, and the Telecom & IT Engineering teams, the System Technical Architect will:

* Translate high-level architecture and system requirements into detailed, implementable Low-Level Designs (LLD), including:
  + Overall Kubernetes infrastructure design, encompassing:
    - CNF deployment patterns
    - Namespace and isolation strategies
    - Networking configurations
    - Security policies and RBAC implementation
  + Application-level configurations for telecom components such as:
    - Data core network
    - IMS
    - SMSC functions
    - Signaling and roaming functions
* Develop flow matrices, network diagrams, IP addressing plans, and security policies for the entire architecture, ensuring proper interworking with external networks and systems.
* Manage capacity planning based on traffic forecasts.
* Ensure system observability and traceability by designing low-level monitoring and observability solutions, including tracing tools, in collaboration with relevant experts.
* Guarantee security by design, working closely with the security team to incorporate security best practices into the architecture.
* Oversee solution delivery by:
  + Collaborating with infrastructure teams responsible for Kubernetes cluster deployment and operations.
  + Coordinating with engineering teams across subsystems to ensure seamless vertical and horizontal integration, validation, and deployment.
  + Managing dependencies with external teams.
  + Applying Orange’s processes for IP pool management, referential updates, flow provisioning across networks, and complex end-to-end integrations.
* Refine the architecture in response to integration issues, in coordination with the system architect and engineering teams.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation and version control of architectural evolutions.

### **Support to Qualification Team**

The System Technical Architect will also play a key role in supporting the qualification process by:

* Defining target call flows for voice, data, and SMS services.
* Assisting in the development and refinement of testing strategies.
* Supporting troubleshooting activities for complex integration issues, including trace analysis and root cause identification.

### **Required Skills**

#### **Technical Skills:**

* **Telecom System Expertise (Mandatory):**
  + 4G EPC / 5G Core (5GC)
  + IMS / VoLTE / SMS architectures
  + Signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, HTTP/2 SBA
* **IP/Infrastructure Low-Level Architecture Design:**
  + Flow matrix development
  + IP/MPLS networking
  + Security architecture design
  + Resilient architecture implementation
* **Cloud-Native & Containerization Skills:**
  + Basic proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker
* **Complex Integration & Troubleshooting:**
  + Strong skills in system integration and issue resolution
  + Security considerations and operational readiness (design for security, observability, ease of operation)
* **DevOps Practices:**
  + Awareness and understanding of DevOps methodologies

#### **Non-Technical Skills:**

* Ability to operate effectively within large and complex organizational structures
* Excellent communication skills for collaboration across multiple teams in an international environment
* Strong self-organization skills with the ability to manage details efficiently
* Analytical skills to evaluate, compare, and propose solutions on complex architectural topics
* Proficiency in documenting and structuring technical documentation effectively

### **Profile**

* Senior Technical Architect with at least 10 years of professional experience
* Extensive experience as a system architect in large-scale mobile projects
* Engineering degree or equivalent in telecommunications, computer science, or related fields

title: Accounting Manager – Aventura Travel Agency
details:
**About Aventura**  
Aventura is a UAE-based travel agency focused on delivering exceptional travel experiences and high-quality services to individual, corporate, and hospitality clients.  
We are looking for an experienced and highly organized **Accounting Manager** to join our Egypt-based team and provide comprehensive accounting and financial support to Aventura’s UAE operations.  
The successful candidate will manage the day-to-day accounting function, maintain accurate financial records, oversee receivables and payables, monitor cash flow, support financial reporting, and ensure effective financial controls across the business.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**1. Accounting & Financial Management**

* Manage the day-to-day accounting operations for Aventura’s UAE business.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* Oversee general ledger, journal entries, accruals, prepayments, reconciliations, and month-end closing activities.
* Prepare and review monthly management accounts and financial reports.
* Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability, and financial performance.
* Ensure proper allocation and recording of revenues and costs by business line, client, supplier, and transaction where applicable.
* Maintain organized and accurate financial documentation and supporting records.

**2. Accounts Receivable & Revenue Control**

* Monitor customer accounts and outstanding receivables.
* Follow up on overdue payments and coordinate with the Sales and Operations teams regarding collection.
* Ensure invoices are issued accurately and on time.
* Reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor deposits, advance payments, refunds, credit notes, and adjustments.
* Maintain proper controls over travel bookings and related financial transactions.

**3. Accounts Payable & Supplier Management**

* Manage supplier invoices and payment processes.
* Verify invoices against approved bookings, contracts, quotations, and supporting documentation.
* Maintain accurate supplier statements and conduct regular reconciliations.
* Monitor supplier payment schedules and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with Operations and Procurement to resolve invoice discrepancies.
* Ensure payments are properly authorized and supported by the required documentation.

**4. Travel Industry Accounting**

* Maintain accurate financial records relating to travel bookings, hotels, flights, transportation, excursions, tours, and other travel-related services.
* Reconcile booking-related collections and supplier payments.
* Monitor commissions, mark-ups, service fees, and other sources of travel-related revenue.
* Review profitability of bookings and packages where required.
* Work closely with the Operations and Sales teams to ensure financial transactions are accurately captured.
* Monitor cancellations, amendments, refunds, and associated financial adjustments.

**5. UAE Financial & Tax Compliance**

* Support the company in maintaining compliance with applicable UAE accounting, taxation, and financial requirements.
* Assist with **VAT** accounting, reconciliations, documentation, and periodic VAT return preparation in coordination with the company’s UAE tax advisors/accountants.
* Maintain proper records required for audits, tax reviews, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure financial transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and approval.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and other financial service providers when required.

**6. Cash Flow & Banking**

* Monitor company cash flow and upcoming financial obligations.
* Prepare cash-flow reports and payment forecasts.
* Monitor bank accounts and perform regular bank reconciliations.
* Coordinate payment requests and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained.
* Assist management with cash-flow planning and working-capital management.
* Identify potential cash-flow risks and communicate them to management in a timely manner.

**7. Financial Reporting & Management Support**

* Prepare regular financial reports for management.
* Provide analysis of revenue, costs, margins, receivables, payables, and cash flow.
* Assist management in preparing budgets and financial forecasts.
* Track actual performance against budgets and highlight significant variances.
* Provide financial information and analysis to support business decisions.
* Develop and maintain financial dashboards and KPIs where required.

**8. Internal Controls**

* Establish and maintain effective accounting procedures and financial controls.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and approval processes.
* Review transactions for accuracy, completeness, and proper authorization.
* Identify financial discrepancies, control weaknesses, or unusual transactions and escalate them appropriately.
* Support the implementation and improvement of accounting systems and processes.

**9. Team & Cross-Department Coordination**

* Work closely with the UAE management, Sales, Operations, and other departments.
* Coordinate effectively between the UAE business and the Egypt-based support team.
* Provide financial guidance to non-finance departments where required.
* Support the development and implementation of efficient accounting procedures.
* Supervise and guide other accounting staff if applicable.

  
**Requirements**  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Accounting, Finance, or a related field**.
* Professional accounting qualification such as **ACCA, CMA, CPA, or equivalent** is an advantage.

**Experience**

* **10+ years of relevant accounting experience**, preferably including experience in an Accounting Manager position.
* Previous experience working with a **UAE-based company** is highly preferred.
* Experience in the **travel, tourism, hospitality, or service industry** is an advantage.
* Strong experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliations, financial reporting, and cash-flow management.
* Practical knowledge of UAE VAT and accounting practices.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
* Excellent Excel skills and experience with accounting/ERP systems.
* Strong understanding of VAT and financial controls.
* Ability to analyze financial data and identify discrepancies or trends.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of business operations.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify issues before they become problems.

**Working Relationship**

The Accounting Manager will be based remotely at **Aventura’s Egypt office** while providing accounting and financial support to the company’s **UAE operations**.  
The position will require regular communication and coordination with:

* UAE Management
* Sales Team
* Travel Operations Team
* Suppliers and Service Providers
* UAE Banks and Financial Institutions
* External Auditors
* UAE Tax Consultants / Advisors
* Egypt-based Finance & Administrative Team

The role may occasionally require coordination outside standard Egypt working hours to align with UAE business operations.  
  
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**  
Performance in this role will be measured through:

* Accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.
* Timely completion of monthly closing and reconciliations.
* Accounts receivable collection and aging management.
* Accuracy and timely processing of supplier payments.
* Cash-flow forecasting accuracy.
* VAT and financial compliance.
* Reduction of accounting discrepancies and outstanding reconciliations.
* Accuracy of booking-related financial transactions.
* Effectiveness of internal financial controls.
* Timely response to management financial requests.
* Quality and reliability of financial analysis provided to management.

**Confidentiality**  
The Accounting Manager will have access to confidential financial, commercial, supplier, customer, and business information and is expected to maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and professional conduct at all times.

The Customs Manager will also supervise a customs team, ensuring effective task allocation, performance management, capability development and consistent execution across the region.

The role will work closely with Logistics, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commercial, Finance, Tax, Legal, local operations and external service providers.

* Provide coaching, guidance and performance feedback to team members, supporting their professional development.
* Ensure appropriate workload distribution, operational coverage and continuity within the customs function.

* Monitor regulatory changes and translate new requirements into practical procedures and controls.
* Develop, implement and maintain regional customs policies, standard operating procedures and compliance controls.
* Manage relationships with customs brokers, freight forwarders, consultants and customs authorities.
* Monitor service-provider performance, including clearance lead times, declaration accuracy, costs and compliance incidents.
* Identify opportunities to optimize customs duties and costs through free trade agreements, duty exemptions, temporary admission, bonded warehousing and other customs regimes.
* Support customs audits, inspections and investigations, ensuring that corrective actions are implemented on time.
* Provide customs advice for new products, suppliers, customers, routes, contracts and business models.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Location: Cairo, Egypt

title: DevOps Engineer - Senior Consultant - Cairo
details:
Location: Cairo

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: 30 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1708856

We are the AI Hub delivering advisory services focused on data architecture and data-driven transformation.
  
We work closely with client and internal stakeholders, including cybersecurity and data protection teams, data analysts, and data scientists to ensure use cases have a solid foundation and deliverables meet expectations.

  

We support organizations in designing and delivering next-generation data platforms to accelerate analytics, decision-making, and innovation. Our work typically includes assessing architecture maturity, defining target-state data platform blueprints, and building pragmatic roadmaps that cover governance, protection, migration, and cloud enablement. We deliver in a consulting environment that requires strong stakeholder management, delivery discipline, compliance with regulatory requirements, and coordination across service lines when integrated delivery is needed.

  

Sound interesting? Well this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

  

**The opportunity**

  

As a Senior DevOps Engineer in the AI Hub, you will design, automate, secure, and operate cloud and hybrid platforms for AI-driven applications. You will own CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, release governance, and production readiness so teams can move from prototype to production safely and repeatably. Azure is the primary platform, with client on-prem/hybrid environments a key delivery context.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

You will partner with developers, AI/data engineers, product owners, security teams, and client stakeholders to architect solutions and standardize reliable delivery.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Own an Azure-first DevOps/developer platform: reusable templates, pipeline blueprints, environment patterns, and deployment standards

* Enable teams to ship quickly with CI/CD, IaC, observability, and security controls built into the “golden path” for new services

* Partner on solution/platform architecture (hosting choices, environment design, integration patterns, security, scalability, reliability, production readiness)

* Build and optimize CI/CD for front-end, back-end, data, and AI/ML services (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions or equivalent)

* Define and evolve IaC modules and standards (Bicep/Terraform/ARM)

* Deploy and run services on Azure (App Service, Functions, Static Web Apps, Container Apps, AKS) with sound release and environment management (approvals, gates, rollback)

* Embed security by design and in pipelines (Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC, Key Vault, private endpoints; scanning/policy checks; secure releases)

* Establish operational readiness: monitoring/alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and incident response (Azure Monitor/App Insights/Log Analytics)

* Help productionize AI/GenAI workloads (LLMOps/MLOps patterns, quality gates, monitoring)

* Support cloud/hybrid/on-prem deployments (secure connectivity, network constraints, integration with client infrastructure)

* Automate ops with scripting (PowerShell/Bash/Python/Azure CLI) and drive reliability/performance/cost improvements (RCA, capacity, optimization)

* Collaborate across engineering, security, product, and clients; contribute runbooks, standards, and documentation that raise delivery quality

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* 7+ years in DevOps/platform or cloud engineering (infrastructure automation)

* Strong hands-on Azure experience in production/enterprise environments

* CI/CD pipeline delivery (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar)

* Developer enablement via reusable platform patterns, templates, and deployment standards (internal developer platforms a plus)

* Infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform, ARM, or equivalent)

* Deploy/operate web apps, APIs, containers, and serverless on Azure (App Service, Functions, Container Apps, AKS, Key Vault, Monitor/Log Analytics, networking)

* Docker and container patterns; Kubernetes/AKS strongly preferred

* Observability/monitoring, alerting, incident response, and production troubleshooting

* Enterprise security and hybrid/on-prem constraints (identity/RBAC, secrets, private networking, controlled releases, VPN/private endpoints)

* Comfortable in iterative delivery teams (PoCs, MVPs, and production)

**Ideally you’ll also have**

* Microsoft certifications (e.g., AZ-400 DevOps Engineer Expert)

* Deep AKS/Kubernetes operations (Helm, ingress, registries, container security)

* Reusable infrastructure modules (Terraform and/or Bicep)

* Azure governance (Landing Zones, Policy, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel)

* Regulated/security-sensitive environments (privacy, auditability, access control, data residency)

* AI/GenAI platform experience (RAG, vector DBs, prompt/eval pipelines, monitoring)

* On-prem/hybrid infrastructure (Windows/Linux, enterprise networking, VPN/private connectivity, modernization)

* FinOps/cost optimization (monitoring, budgets, controls)

* SAP/ERP and enterprise system integrations (Azure or hybrid)

**What we look for**

  

We are interested in entrepreneurs who have the confidence to develop and promote a brand new strategic vision both internally and externally. You will be business savvy with a passion for innovation as well as the motivation to create your own EY journey.

  

**What we offer**

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Plus, we offer:

  

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  

**If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**

  

**The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.**

**EY | Building a better working world**

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Lead Agentic Developer
details:
**About Integrant**

*For 34 years, Integrant has designed and delivered advanced, business solutions for U.S. enterprises in biotech, medical devices, manufacturing, finance, and related highly regulated industries. Our teams are experts in traditional web and mobile applications, AI/HPC infrastructure support, data engineering, predictive AI, machine learning, and Agentic solutions. We build long-term partnerships—two-thirds of our customers choosing to partner with us 5+ years—by solving mission-critical problems with rigor, empathy, and measurable outcomes.*  
  
Role overview

**Title:** Agentic Developer (Enterprise Agentic Systems)

**Mission:** Build production-grade AI agents that run real business processes inside enterprise environments — reliably, securely, observably, and with measurable ROI.

This is not a prompt-engineering or demo-building role. The person we hire owns the full lifecycle of an agent: design, implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. They treat an agent as a distributed software system with a probabilistic component, not as a chatbot with tools attached.

**Stack-agnostic by design.** We use Python and TypeScript, and frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, Bedrock Agents, and Copilot Studio appear in our work as examples, not requirements. We hire for the underlying engineering judgment: someone who can pick up any orchestration framework in a week because they understand what every framework is abstracting.  
  
Key responsibilities:

**1. Agent design & orchestration**

* Design single-agent and multi-agent systems: planner/executor, supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and event-driven patterns, choosing the simplest pattern that meets the requirement.
* Model agent workflows as explicit state machines or graphs with defined states, transitions, retries, timeouts, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Define tool contracts (schemas, idempotency, error semantics) and implement tool-calling with validation and graceful degradation.
* Implement memory strategies: short-term context management, long-term memory stores, and session persistence with clear retention rules.

**2. Retrieval & knowledge (RAG at scale)**

* Build and tune retrieval pipelines: chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking, metadata filtering, and query rewriting.
* Handle enterprise document realities: permissions-aware retrieval, multi-tenant isolation, freshness and sync from source systems.
* Measure retrieval quality (recall, precision, groundedness) and fix it at the pipeline level, not the prompt level.

**3. Evaluation, testing & quality**

* Build eval suites before shipping: golden datasets, task-level success metrics, LLM-as-judge with calibration, regression tests on every change.
* Write unit and integration tests for tools, state transitions, and guardrails; test the non-LLM 80% like any other software.
* Run offline and online evals; use A/B or shadow deployments to validate changes against production traffic.

**4. Observability & operations**

* Instrument agents end-to-end: traces per run, token/cost accounting, latency per step, tool-call outcomes, and failure classification.
* Define SLOs for agents (success rate, p95 latency, cost per task) and build dashboards and alerts against them.
* Operate agents in production: on-call participation, incident analysis, root-cause on model and non-model failures.

**5. Security, safety & governance**

* Implement defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and tool misuse; enforce least-privilege for every tool and integration.
* Apply input/output guardrails, PII handling, content policies, and audit logging that satisfies enterprise compliance.
* Design human-approval gates for high-impact actions and make agent decisions explainable to auditors and business owners.

**6. Enterprise integration**

* Integrate agents with ERP, CRM, ITSM, document management, and identity systems via APIs, event streams, and MCP-style tool servers.
* Handle authentication and authorization on behalf of users (OAuth, service principals, delegated access) correctly.
* Build agents that survive real data: inconsistent records, partial failures, rate limits, and legacy interfaces.

**7. Delivery & collaboration**

* Translate business processes into agent specifications with clear success criteria and ROI measures.
* Produce architecture decision records, runbooks, and handover documentation.
* Mentor engineers transitioning into agentic development; review designs and code for agent-specific pitfalls.

  
**Requirements**

**Must-have**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 1–2 years shipping LLM-based systems to production users.
* Strong in Python or TypeScript, working proficiency in the other; comfortable with async programming, API design, and typed data models (e.g., Pydantic/Zod).
* Has built at least one agent that runs a real multi-step workflow with tool calls in production, and can describe its failure modes and how they were fixed.
* Hands-on with at least one orchestration framework (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Bedrock Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and able to explain what it abstracts and when to drop to raw API calls.
* Practical RAG experience: vector and hybrid search, chunking strategy, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Experience writing evals for LLM systems and treating prompt changes as code changes with regression coverage.
* Working knowledge of observability tooling (OpenTelemetry-style tracing, LLM tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or equivalent).
* Understanding of LLM security threats (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency) and standard mitigations.
* Experience integrating with enterprise systems through REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, or message queues, including auth flows (OAuth 2.0, service accounts).
* Experience with workflow engines (Temporal, or Durable Functions, or Step Functions) for long-running agent processes.
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) server or client implementation.

**Nice-to-have**

* Cloud deployment experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with containers and CI/CD
* Fine-tuning or distillation experience, or structured-output and function-calling optimization at scale.
* Knowledge-graph or semantic-layer experience for grounding agents.
* Exposure to regulated environments (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and audit requirements.
* Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package
* PTO, full medical and dental coverage, etc.
* Opportunity to travel and work onsite with U.S. customers
* In-house Technical and English training programs
* Dedicated learning time (check out our 4Plus1 Program)
* Interest free loans
* Flexible work schedules
* Perks: events, sponsored lunch, game area, rooftop hangout + more!

title: Venture Lead - Developer Solutions
details:
About Nawy

Nawy is Egypt's largest proptech ecosystem, reshaping how people discover, buy, sell, and invest in real estate. We've built powerful engines across sales, data, technology, and brand — and we're now turning those capabilities into products and services for the wider market.

The Opportunity

We're launching Nawy Developer Solutions: a new business line that packages Nawy's sales, data, and research capabilities into products and services for real estate developers — helping their sales teams sell more, their development teams plan smarter, and their research teams see the market more clearly.

We're looking for a Venture Lead to build it from the ground up: own the P&L, define the products, win the first clients, and scale it into a profitable, standalone business. You'll start with a blank page and Nawy's considerable capabilities behind you and you'll be accountable for turning that into revenue and profit. If you've built a business or business line before and want the autonomy to do it again with real assets behind you, this is for you.

What You'll Do

* **Own the P&L.** Build and run a ring-fenced P&L for Developer Solutions — accountable for revenue, margin, and profitability.

* **Set pricing and packaging.** Define the product catalog and commercial model, and sequence launches by margin and readiness.
* **Build the pipeline and land clients.** Own business development to developers; personally win the first anchor accounts and grow them into recurring relationships.
* **Stand up delivery.** Build the operating model, standards, and systems that deliver these services at quality and target margin.
* **Build the team.** Recruit and lead a cross-functional team, and partner with Nawy's core functions to draw on their capabilities.
* **Shape strategy.** Report to the Chief Growth Officer and help set the direction for one of Nawy's newest growth pillars.

In Your First Year

title: DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering
details:
**DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering**

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

  

**Who we are**

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About the role**

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

**Why you'll enjoy working here:**

* **Greenfield projects at scale**: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.
* **The full automation lifecycle**: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.
* **Real process depth:** Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.
* **Room to innovate**: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.
* **A strong professional community:** 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

**Location**

Denmark - Kalundborg

  

**Experience**

Minimum 8 Years

  

**Department**

Automation & IT

**How you might spend your days**

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

* **Shape the control systems.** Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.
* **Stand side by side with the client**. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.
* **Solve problems where code meets equipment**. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.
* **Fine-tune to the finish line**. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.
* **Connect with experts across disciplines**. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

**Who you are**

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

* Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences
* Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns
* Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks
* Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects
* Reliable, curious and eager to learn
* Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

**What you bring to the role**

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

* **Engineering foundation**: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience
* **Hands-on DCS skills**: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine
* **Batch know-how**: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly
* **Regulated or project experience**: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful
* **Cross-disciplinary mindset**: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment
* **Digital and AI-savvy**: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions
* **Future-oriented**: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

**Why choose NNE?**

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here****.**

  

**Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.**

  

**Deadline of application is** **14th December 2026**

  

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Manager Ditte Høiberg Møller on +45 3075 5028 or Manager Volker J. Jentzsch on +45 3191 1540.

**Please note:**

* We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system
* You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV
* We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:**

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?**

If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site
