title: Senior AI engineer
details:
Requirements and responsibilities

**About Prendio**
=================

Prendio is the leading cloud-based procure-to-pay platform built specifically for the life sciences industry. From requisition and approvals through order placement, ERP integration, and payments, Prendio helps biotech and life science companies streamline procurement so scientists, finance teams, and venture-backed portfolio companies can spend less time on administrative overhead and more time advancing research. Our platform has saved life sciences teams over 356,000 hours of lab time, driven $47M+ in cost savings, and now manages more than $17B in platform spend. Prendio is headquarteredin Burlington, MA, is SOC 2 compliant, and has been recognized as one of the Boston Globe's Best Places to Work.

**About the Role**

Prendio is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team, reporting to ourEngineering Manager. You'll build and maintain core procurement functionality across a Play/Scala and Spring Boot service tier, a React front end, and Python-based data and AI workloads — working on features end-to-end, from design through production. AI is part of how this team builds software day to day: you'll use AI code-generation tools as a standard part of your workflow, and you'll help extend our platform with agentic AI capabilities.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership: contributing to active modernization efforts (framework upgrades, legacy runtime migration), improving reliability, and setting technical direction alongside the team rather than just executing tickets. You'll also help junior engineers grow, through code review, pairing, and technical mentorship.

**What You'll Do**

**AI-Assisted Engineering & Agentic AI**

* Use AI code-generation tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) as a standard part of your daily development workflow.

* Design and build agentic AI features for our SaaS platform — contributing to services such as our Python/FastAPI/LangGraph/LangChain-based AI orchestrator.

* Help evolve engineering practices and tooling as AI-assisted development matures, sharing patterns that work with the rest of the team.

**Feature Development**

* Design and build features across our procurement platform, working in Java/Scala (Play Framework) and Java/Spring Boot services, plus our React/TypeScript front end.

* Write and review acceptance criteria for enhancements alongside Product, and translate them into a technical implementation plan.

* Work with relational and document databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) to design schema changes and write performant queries.

**Modernization & Technical Debt**

* Contribute to active migration efforts — including framework upgrades (e.g., off pre-GA or end-of-support Spring Boot versions) and legacy runtime modernization (e.g., Java 8 to Java 17).

* Identify and help retire technical debt before it becomes a production incident, in partnership with the DevSecOps team.

* Participate in architecture and design review for changes with meaningful technical or operational risk.

**Quality, CI/CD & Reliability**

* Write automated tests and participate in CI/CD pipelines as a first-class part of delivering a feature, not an afterthought.

* Triage and resolve production issues, partnering with QA and DevSecOps during release readiness and incident response.

* Review pull requests and mentor other engineers, helping raise the bar on code quality and system design across the team.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications.

* Firm requirement: demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI code-generation tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as part of your regular development workflow.

* Experience designing or building agentic AI solutions for a SaaS product (e.g., LLM-orchestrated workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain).

* Strong experience in Java and/or Scala; comfort working in JVM-based frameworks (Spring Boot and/or Play Framework).

* Experience building and consuming REST APIs, and working with relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL) in production.

* Experience with front-end development in React and TypeScript, or willingness to work full-stack as needed.

* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing as part of the standard development workflow.

* Track record of leading or contributing significantly to a technical migration or modernization effort (framework upgrade, runtime migration, or similar).

* Strong code review and mentorship instincts — comfortable giving and receiving direct technical feedback.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Python, especially in data or AI/ML-adjacent services.

* Experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent).

* Familiarity with AWS services (RDS, Lambda, ECR) from an application-engineering perspective.

* Experience working in a SOC 2 or similarly compliance-driven environment.

* Troubleshoot campaign delivery, audience, trigger and personalisation issues.
* Support the implementation of best-practice naming conventions, tagging and campaign governance.
* Analyse open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates and attributed leads.
* Support A/B testing and experimentation.

**Key Experience**

* Must-have: 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Braze.
* Strong experience building campaigns and journeys using Braze Canvas.
* Advanced knowledge of segmentation, triggers, audience filters and event-based campaigns.
* Strong working knowledge of Liquid templating and dynamic personalisation.

* Understanding of customer data, event tracking and user attributes. Strong campaign QA and troubleshooting skills. A
* bility to independently build, test and launch campaigns without requiring significant technical hand-holding.

* Experience with mobile app CRM and web-to-app conversion. Knowledge of APIs, SDKs and data integrations.

* Develop automated lifecycle journeys using Braze Canvas.
* Establish reusable campaign templates and personalisation frameworks.

title: Senior Lead Software Developer in Test (SDET)
details:
**About Integrant**

For 34 years, Integrant has designed and delivered advanced software solutions for U.S. enterprises in biotech, medical devices, manufacturing, finance, and related highly regulated industries. Our expertise spans traditional web and mobile applications, AI/HPC infrastructure, data engineering, predictive AI, machine learning, and Agentic solutions.

We build long-term partnerships — two-thirds of our clients choose to work with us for five or more years — by solving mission-critical problems with rigor, empathy, and measurable outcomes.

**Role Overview**

**This is a working lead role — not a management track.**

The Senior Lead SDET owns the full testing roadmap, leads and mentors the team, and remains hands-on in the code. You will set quality benchmarks in collaboration with stakeholders, guide adoption of effective testing methodologies, and ensure the team delivers robust, high-quality solutions for U.S. enterprise clients in regulated industries.

**Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership**

* Own the testing roadmap — define and evolve both automation and manual testing strategies across the team
* Collaborate with stakeholders to establish quality benchmarks, KPIs, and acceptance criteria
* Drive adoption of effective testing methodologies and continuously improve team processes
* Create, review, and oversee execution of test plans and test strategies
* Provide comprehensive test reports and quality metrics to project managers and clients
* Communicate proactively with the project manager on issues, schedule impacts, and performance concerns

**Test Design and Execution**

* Review requirements and system design to identify testability gaps early
* Design and review test cases, test scripts, and test data
* Define test case execution priority and conduct impact analysis
* Recommend, implement, and manage test management, defect management, performance, and automation tools
* Log, track, and drive defects through to closure
* Coordinate with engineers on defect and results status regularly

**SDET — Hands-On Engineering**

Core coding responsibilities — minimum 50% hands-on time is expected:

* Write unit tests for the API and business layer
* Enhance code testability in collaboration with developers
* Fix minor defects discovered during testing
* Implement test support features and automation utilities
* Document API endpoints and services to support both testing and development
* Actively participate in code reviews — contribute improvements to code quality and standards adherence

**Agile and Team Collaboration**

* Work within an agile, self-organizing Scrum team
* Champion quality ownership within the squad
* Stay current with emerging testing techniques, tools, and technologies — including AI-assisted testing

 **Requirements**

**Experience and Core Skills**

* **Experience:** 12+ years of hands-on software testing and automation
* **Programming:** Proficient in one or more of C#, Java, JavaScript, or SQL with strong OOP foundations
* **Automation frameworks:** Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, NUnit
* **Testing coverage:** UI, System/Integration, API, Performance, and Agile testing — hands-on across all
* **Test planning:** Strong test planning and test strategy design skills
* **BDD:** Behavior-Driven Development using Cucumber or SpecFlow in production projects
* **English:** Proficient verbal and written English for direct U.S. client communication
* **Database:** SQL and database manipulation skills

**SDET — Advanced Technical Requirements**

* **Advanced programming:** Custom exceptions, intermediate LINQ, dependency injection, and loose coupling to increase testability
* **CI/CD:** Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent pipeline tools
* **Design patterns:** Solid understanding of common design and architecture patterns
* **Data structures:** Dictionary, List, HashSet, and equivalents — applied in framework design

**AI and Agentic Testing**

* **Agentic SDLC:** Understanding of the Agentic Development Life Cycle
* **AI application testing:** Experience testing AI applications, LLM outputs, and agentic workflows across web, API, and integrated system layers
* **Workflow design:** Ability to create and validate workflows with rules and guardrails
* **AI agent development:** Hands-on experience building and using AI agents to support and enhance the software engineering process — spanning testing, code generation, defect triage, and release validation. At this level of the craft, the boundary between testing and development is increasingly blurred; the Senior Lead SDET is expected to operate confidently on both sides.
* **Agentic toolchain integration:** Experience integrating AI agents into CI/CD pipelines, test automation frameworks, or developer workflows — including MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration and Playwright MCP Protocol where applicable.
* **Formal AI evaluation:** Ability to conduct structured evaluation of agentic and RAG systems — including metrics such as faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision, and hallucination rate — with hands-on experience using Ragas, DeepEval, or similar evaluation frameworks.

**Additional Skills**

* **Cloud, ETL, DevOps:** Fair working knowledge of cloud platforms, ETL pipelines, and DevOps practices
* **Estimation:** Testing estimation techniques for sprint and release planning

**Nice to Have**

* ORM frameworks — .NET Entity Framework, Hibernate, or Spring
* Mocking frameworks — Mockito, NMock, or equivalent
* **ISTQB CT-GenAI — Certified Tester Testing with Generative AI** Preferred
* **ISTQB CT-AI — Certified Tester AI Testing** Preferred

*Both certifications are preferred rather than mandatory — candidates who demonstrate genuine understanding of AI and agentic testing in practice will be equally considered.*

**Professional Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail
* Self-motivated, collaborative team player with a positive attitude
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Organized, reliable, and adaptable to client and project changes

**Why Integrant**

* Work directly with U.S. enterprise clients on mission-critical, regulated-industry software
* 34-year track record — stability, long-term partnerships, and a culture built on rigor and trust
* A working lead role where you stay hands-on — no forced drift into pure management
* Exposure to AI, agentic, and data engineering projects at the frontier of the field
* A team that values engineering depth as much as delivery speed

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package
* PTO, full medical and dental coverage, etc.
* Opportunity to travel and work onsite with U.S. customers
* In-house Technical and English training programs
* Dedicated learning time (check out our 4Plus1 Program) [link]
* Interest free loans
* Flexible work schedules
* Perks: events, sponsored lunch, game area, rooftop hangout + more!

details:

**Collaboration & Feedback**

**Requirements**

* **Executive Presence:** Excellent personal presentation and verbal communication skills, suitable for interacting with client stakeholders.
* **Empathy & Patience:** Ability to de-escalate tense situations and handle frustrated customers with professionalism.

* Knowledge of ITIL principles (Incident & Problem Management).

title: Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform (IDP)
details:
#### **About this Position**

Henkel is building an Internal Developer Platform that gives engineering teams governed, self-service access to cloud infrastructure across Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Henkel Private Cloud based on OpenShift, and Alibaba Cloud. The platform replaces manual request paths with a developer portal, reusable Infrastructure as Code, automated delivery workflows and integrations with enterprise systems. As a Platform Engineer, you will help turn this design into a product that developers can use in their daily work.  
  
  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Build and run self-service journeys for cloud projects, subscriptions, namespaces and supporting platform services.
* Develop the software catalog, golden paths and automation that connect developer requests with compliant infrastructure.
* Integrate the platform with ServiceNow, LeanIX, cloud foundations and delivery pipelines.
* Help establish the platform as a reliable product with clear ownership, documentation and measurable adoption.

**Developer portal and self-service:**

* Model and maintain catalog entities, relations, ownership and role-based access.
* Build self-service actions and golden paths that take a developer from request to a provisioned, compliant resource.
* Keep catalog information aligned with relevant source systems and make ownership and platform standards visible.

**Multi-cloud automation:**

* Develop and extend reusable Terraform modules for Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Henkel Private Cloud and Alibaba Cloud.
* Automate project, subscription and namespace setup, including identity, networking, policies, budgets and tagging.
* Apply policy-as-code and platform guardrails so standard requests are compliant by default

**CI/CD, GITOPS and Integration:**

* Build portal-triggered pipelines with GitLab CI/CD and Azure DevOps, using reviewable Git-based change flows.
* Run platform components and integrations on Kubernetes using Helm and GitOps practices.
* Integrate ServiceNow request and approval workflows and keep catalog and CMDB information consistent.
* Build secure API and webhook integrations using OAuth 2.0, service accounts and enterprise secrets management.

**AI, Security, Operations & Enablement:**

* Deliver secure, AI-assisted platform capabilities for self-service and troubleshooting.
* Establish monitoring, alerting and runbooks, and support incident and problem resolution.
* Help development teams adopt the platform and use their feedback to guide backlog priorities.

#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3-5 Years of Hands-on experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps or SRE.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
* Strong Terraform skills, including module design, state management, CI-driven plan/apply and multi-environment patterns.
* Production experience with Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of the other; OpenShift-based private cloud experience is an advantage.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI and/or Azure DevOps and using Git-based review workflows.
* Practical Kubernetes experience, including Helm and GitOps concepts with Argo CD or Flux.
* Scripting or programming experience in Python, Go, Bash or TypeScript, plus REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and YAML.
* A sound understanding of IAM, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, secrets management and network segmentation.
* Clear communication and the ability to own work from design through production support.

#### **Some perks of joining Henkel**

* Flexible work scheme with flexible hours, hybrid work model, and work from anywhere policy for up to 30 days per year
* Diverse national and international growth opportunities
* Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
* Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
* Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares

title: UNFPA Egypt CO - National Consultancy - Demographic resilience reviews and foresight-based scenario planning in Egypt
details:
**Hiring Office:**  
UNFPA, Egypt

**Purpose of consultancy:**  
Background
  
Demographic change occurs through shifts in population size, composition (by age and sex), and territorial distribution and manifests, for example, in population ageing, youth bulge, changing household structure, distinct migration patterns, rural depopulation and rapid urbanization. These dynamics are not merely outcomes of development; they are powerful drivers. They influence economic growth and transitions, labor markets, fiscal systems and the demand for and sustainability of social services like pensions, education, healthcare and employment. They can affect inequalities and social cohesion. And they interact with climate change in affecting our planet. The relationships are bidirectional. Socio-economic conditions, peace and stability, housing, access to health and education and employment, just to name a few, significantly determine morbidity and mortality, the realization or non-realization of fertility aspirations and migration flows.

Amongst the questions linked to demographic shifts to which governments need to provide answers are the ones that relate to the future demand for public goods and services - like education, health, social protection, employment, physical infrastructure etc. - and the evolution of fiscal space. Population size, demographic composition and territorial distribution in fact shape the global and local demand for goods and services, and fiscal revenues and public spending. Through the fourth outcome of its Strategic Plan, 2026-2029, UNFPA seeks to support member states towards evidence-based and rights-based adaptation to their demographic trajectories.

Part of UNFPA’s approach is support to member states in undertaking demographic resilience reviews. These reviews entail a comprehensive forecast of the demand for various public goods and services - education, health, social protection, labor market and other public goods and services - based on projected changes in the total population and the population age structure within a longer time horizon (e.g. up to 50 years). The forecasts include baseline estimates (applying current and/or historical ratios for various public goods and services (e.g. teacher/pupil ratio) and alternative estimates assuming defined levels of improvement (based, for example, on national development visions, SDG targets and other nationally determined targets). The demand forecasts are applied further to estimate the fiscal and revenue implications of changing population age structure, taking into consideration gender, regional and other disparities.

The Egypt Country Office is seeking the services of a national consultant to contribute to a multi-country activity as part of an interregional effort by UNFPA regional offices for Eastern Europe and Central Asia (EECA) and Arab States (AS) to support evidence-based policies for adaptation to demographic change in selected countries (EECA - Uzbekistan, Georgia and Kyrgyzstan; AS - Egypt, Morocco and Tunisia.). The goal of the initiative is to develop and implement an integrated framework to support countries in long-term planning for sustainable provision of public goods and services aligned with their demographic trajectories. The initiative will document the full methodology and implementation experiences to support its adaptation to different country contexts.

The consultant will contribute to two complementary processes: (1) demographic resilience reviews; and (2) foresight-based scenario planning. On demographic resilience review, the national consultant will work closely and in a complementary manner with an international consultant leading the work in selected countries in the Arab States region. The results of the demographic resilience reviews will feed into a complementary scenario-based foresight analysis to broaden the range of probable and plausible scenarios of future demand for and supply of public services and goods taking into consideration other relevant factors and strengthen countries’ long-term planning. The national consultant will also support this part of the activity.

**Scope of work:(Description of services, activities, or outputs)**  
The demographic resilience reviews will be based primarily on secondary data. The national consultant will support the analysis in close coordination with the international consultant. The foresight-based scenario planning part of the work will be in support of a second international consultant. The analysis will address the following questions for each of the selected countries:
  
1. How will future demand for public goods and services, like education, health, social protection, pensions etc., evolve with projected changes in the size, age structure and territorial distribution (e.g. rural vs. urban) of the population? In other words, how many more/less doctors, nurses, hospital beds, teachers, schools, childcare places, etc. will be needed in 20-50 years to respond to the needs of the population?
  
2. What will happen to public budgets and fiscal balances as the population size and structure change? In other words, how will the projected demographic shifts affect the government revenues (through changes in the working-age population and the dependency ratios, and the fiscal base) and expenditures (strongly driven by age-specific population groups)?
  
3. How might other major factors or shifts in the horizon, for example, in the technological, social, political, environmental and other spheres, affect the demand for and the supply of public goods and services? In particular, how may technological progress (e.g. digitalization and AI) and its uptake (e.g. telemedicine, virtual schooling, etc.) impact the provision of public goods and services? How can these shifts be integrated with demographic change for a more comprehensive (foresight-based) long-term planning of public goods and services?
  
4. How might forecasts be influenced by and in turn influence gender, regional and other disparities?

The national consultant will undertake the following tasks:
  
1. Support inception and planning by undertaking the following tasks:

* Review the project concept note and other demographic resilience reviews developed by UNFPA and contribute to refining the methodological approach for the assignment to reflect national circumstances.
* Prepare a background summary on the country's demographic, socio-economic and institutional context. This includes collecting and compiling pertinent sectoral information, such as sectoral set-up, long-term planning approaches and procedures, profiles, legislation, policies and strategies relevant to demographic resilience (e.g. in health, education, etc), including subnational population demographic projections, as guided by the lead international consultant. The background assessment should also identify existing national demographic foresight exercises, long-term development strategies and institutional mechanisms through which demographic evidence informs public policy and planning. To the extent possible, the background paper should address the following issues:

i. Labor supply and economic absorption: current gender-specific barriers to economic participation, implementation gaps in labor regulations, youth unemployment figures, childcare support systems, and labor market entry barriers;
  
ii. Social safety net optimization: the fiscal structure of existing social subsidy programs, coverage of social safety nets, and the long-term solvency parameters of national pension and cash transfer frameworks;
  
iii. Institutional service efficiency: service delivery and cost-containment models in healthcare and higher education networks, particularly regarding digital service delivery and decentralized healthcare systems; and
  
iv. Spatial budget allocation: the current legislative and financial criteria governing capital budget allocations to subnational regions or governorates.

* Prepare a comprehensive inventory of available demographic and sectoral data sources and assist in discussing access to and compiling national datasets that are not publicly available. The consultant should also assess the quality, interoperability, geographical disaggregation and sustainability of available demographic and sectoral data systems to support long-term demographic resilience analysis.
* Contribute to preparation of the inception report and workplan.

2. Support stakeholder engagement. This entails coordinating interviews, consultations and organizing technical meetings and validation workshops as needed in close collaboration with the UNFPA Country Office. Particular attention should be given to ensuring representation from national planning institutions, statistical authorities, ministries responsible for public finance and sectoral planning, academia and relevant research institutions to strengthen national ownership of the review.
  
3. Support the overall analysis and report development. This involves:

* Contributing to the analyses and the development of the draft reports - demographic resilience review and foresight-based scenario planning report - especially on the contents related to the country context.
* Providing quality assurance for the analysis and reports to ensure national relevance and that the analysis, assumptions, scenarios and policy recommendations are technically robust, nationally relevant and aligned with existing national development priorities and institutional realities.
* Participating in discussion and validation of findings at national and multi-country levels.

4. Document country-specific innovations, good practices and lessons learned that could inform the refinement of the overall methodological framework and facilitate its replication in other UNFPA program countries.

**Deliverables**  
1. A background summary report on the country's demographic, socio-economic and institutional context, including legislation, policies and strategies relevant to demographic resilience and relevant sectors (e.g. in health, education, etc), and national and subnational population projections and demographic trends for the country. This background summary report should include an assessment of national demographic governance arrangements, institutional capacities for anticipatory planning and existing foresight initiatives relevant to demographic resilience.
  
2. A comprehensive inventory of available demographic and sectoral data sources, including data to be compiled from national datasets that are not publicly available.
  
3. Datasets compiled for the analysis
  
4. Documented contributions to all study reports, i.e. inception report, demographic resilience review report, foresight-based scenario planning report, and methodological report.

**Duration and working schedule:**  
The duration of the assignment is 30 working days, spread from Dec 2026 to March, 2027.

**Budget and payment schedule**  
The consultancy is expected to deliver at specialist level. The daily rate will be determined based on consultant qualifications and experience. Payment will be tied to the successful completion of deliverables as follows:
  

* 30% upon submission of Deliverables 1 and 2.
* 40% upon submission of Deliverable 3.
* 30% upon submission of foresight-based scenario planning report, and methodological report (Deliverable 4).

**Place where services are to be delivered:**  
Home based work.

**Delivery dates and how work will be delivered (e.g. electronic, hard copy etc.):**  
The consultant will provide all deliverables within the period of the assignment from December 2026 to March 2027.

**Deliverable Timeline**  
Background summary report and data source inventory.End Dec-26
  
Datasets compiled for the demographic resilience review.Jan-26
  
Foresight-based scenario planning report.Mar-27

**Monitoring and progress reporting**  
The consultant’s work will be monitored by the Country Office Population and Development Analyst, in collaboration with the Regional Population and Development Advisor.

**Supervisory arrangements:**  
The consultant will perform under the overall guidance of the Country Office Population and Development Analyst and the Information Decision Support Center (IDSC). Additional coordination will be provided by the international consultant and Regional Population and Development Advisor. Performance will be monitored through weekly or fortnightly progress review meetings and submission of progress reports.

**Required expertise, qualifications and competencies, including language requirements:**  
1. Advanced university degree in demography, economics, statistics, social sciences or related fields.
  
2. Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience in demographic, economic or development policy analysis.
  
3. Proven experience working with national public finance data, public expenditure assessments, or sectoral budgeting models.
  
4. Demonstrated active local network or prior history of collaborating with the specific government entities that hold the required data.
  
5. Excellent analytical and writing skills.
  
6. Demonstrated expertise in drafting technical reports and policy briefs.
  
7. Strong communication and analytical skills.
  
8. Familiarity with the mandate of UNFPA is an asset.
  
9. Experience with the UN or INGO in the area of economic policies will be an asset.
  
10. Experience working in the Arab context is an asset.
  
11. Full professional proficiency in both written and oral English and Arabic.

**Inputs / services to be provided by UNFPA or implementing partner (e.g support services, office space, equipment), if applicable:**  
IDSC and UNFPA will provide the national consultant with all necessary materials, data, information, and reports that are publicly available.

Role Purpose

The FP&A Manager – Supply Chain is responsible for leading the financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and performance management agenda for the Supply Chain function. The role partners closely with Supply Chain leadership, Operations, Procurement, Control, Commercial Finance, and FP&A teams to provide accurate financial analysis, clear business insights, and timely visibility of risks and opportunities. This role translates supply chain financial results into practical actions that support cost discipline, productivity delivery, investment governance, and strong business decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

* Lead the Supply Chain planning and forecasting cycles, including AOP, monthly forecast, rolling forecast, latest estimate, and periodic performance reviews, ensuring timely and accurate submissions aligned with finance timelines and business priorities.
* Analyze actual results versus plan, forecast, and prior year across supply chain cost lines, identifying key drivers, variances, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Supply Chain teams to track manufacturing, agro, logistics, warehousing, productivity, cost optimization, and operational efficiency performance.
* Prepare high-quality management reporting packages, dashboards, and leadership updates that clearly explain Supply Chain financial performance and required actions.
* Support productivity and cost transformation initiatives by validating assumptions, tracking delivery, quantifying financial impact, and highlighting gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with project owners and cross-functional teams on CAPEX planning, business cases, phasing, spend tracking, and financial governance where relevant.
* Build and maintain financial models, scenario analysis, and business cases to support decision-making, resource allocation, investment evaluation, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Ensure strong financial governance, data integrity, documentation, and compliance with PepsiCo finance policies, controls, and reporting requirements.
* Collaborate with Control, Procurement, Commercial Finance, Operations, and regional or sector Finance teams to validate inputs, align assumptions, and resolve performance or reporting issues.
* Identify simplification, automation, and continuous improvement opportunities across planning, reporting, and analysis routines to improve speed, accuracy, and decision quality.
* Support ad-hoc analysis and leadership requests, translating financial data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
* Coach and guide analysts or junior team members where applicable, supporting capability building, quality review, and delivery of team priorities.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; CMA, CPA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent finance qualification is preferred.

title: Junior Full-stack Engineer
details:
**What Do We Do At Marketeers**
-------------------------------

**Data Analytics**
------------------

Our team is capable of collecting data from all around us and extracting the most beneficial data points and all the little gaps in data that get left unnoticed. Every day, they continuously learn new ways to look at data through training sessions that they learn and immediately apply to their work. Join a team that’s dedicated to developing their analytical skills every day for the sake of growth and transformation in this fast-changing market.

**Automation and R&D**
----------------------

Our Automation and R&D team develop and optimize all our AI and statistical methods and models for our Data Analysis team to ensure that the efficiency and effectiveness of our tools always run as fast and as accurately as possible. Join an inventive team that’s always exploring new ways to innovate data tools.

**Market Analytics**
--------------------

Our team has the statistical know-how and business understanding to analyze numbers and extract insights into actionable business strategies for our client base. Join a team of research-savvy business experts that guide clients toward their best opportunities for growth.

**Business Development**
------------------------

Client engagement specialists are both research and business experts that have the understanding and skills to translate the needs of clients into implementable research directions and methodologies that the team guides from A to Z.

**Digital Marketing**
---------------------

We support Marketeers by acting as their main communication tower by marketing all the company’s services and news to our entire network. Join a team that builds digital marketing strategies that are highly optimized according to everyday digital analysis that engages and grows our audience to ensure that Marketeers is positioned as industry leaders in our respective region and field.

**Operations**
--------------

We ensure high-quality data collection using different methodologies whether it’s online or offline for both qualitative and quantitative research. Join a team that works rigorously to monitor and maintain the whole entire data collection process by probing and navigating any issues that occur on the field all the way up till the project is complete.

**Accounting**
--------------

Accounting is a vital department dedicated to maintaining the financial health of Marketeers’. Beyond bookkeeping, we act as analysts and consultants that analyze research projects and overall expenses to recommend directions to ensure cost efficiency. This includes adjusting the operations team’s budget plan for projects, coordinating with global vendors and suppliers, and maintaining the company’s day-to-day expenses. Join an analytical team dedicated to supporting and diagnosing all of Marketeers’ financial aspects.

**People and Talent Development**
---------------------------------

Marketeers works hard in headhunting the brightest minds in today’s market. We strive to find raw talent that matches each team’s dynamic based on personality and critical thinking to match our team dynamics. Join a team that aims to support the growth of all the company’s departments so that they can flourish into experts in their respective fields.

  

#### **Junior Full-stack Engineer**

We are looking for a junior full-stack engineer to build out and manage our entire web infrastructure.

Successful candidates will have 1-3 years of recent experience with all of the skills listed below.

Our projects entail implementing our pre-approved UI, constructing our API, connecting the two, and setting up our server infrastructure.

This includes all associated areas such as database and architecture design.

* Design and implementation of the overall web architecture
* Design and deployment of our database
* Ensuring the entire stack is designed and built for speed and scalability
* Design and construction of our REST API and other API technologies.
* Integrating our front-end UI with the constructed API
* Design and implementation of continuous integration and deployment

  

### **Job Requirements**

* 1-3 years of experience with:
* Experience with flutter for iOS and Android development
* Writing with different JavaScript frameworks (React JS, Angular JS).
* Being up on the latest practices is a must, e.g., HTML5, CSS3, and ECMAScript 6 (minimum)
* A relevant back-end programming language using Python.

* Server management and deployment for the relevant environment
* Familiarity with Data analysis Packages such as NumPy and Pandas

* Thorough understanding of user experience and possibly even product strategy
* Experience implementing testing platforms and unit tests
* Proficiency with Git – Appreciation for clean and well-documented code

title: Data Scientist
details:
**About AlgoDriven**
--------------------

AlgoDriven builds AI software for the automotive industry. Our products (EvalExpert, DriveExpert and InspectExpert) help dealer groups, banks and OEMs appraise, inspect and price vehicles across Australia, New Zealand, the Middle East and South East Asia.

**The role**
------------

You'll own the machine learning models that tell our customers what a used car is worth, today and next month. Working mainly in Python in a small team, you'll take models from idea to production and keep pushing their accuracy, including by putting the latest AI developments to work, from modern deep learning and time series architectures to foundation models and LLMs.

**Location:** Hybrid, 4 days a week in our Downtown Cairo office and 1 day remote. Full-time.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design, train and deploy machine learning models that predict and forecast vehicle prices
* Write clean, production-grade Python for modelling, feature engineering and evaluation
* Track new AI research and tooling, and apply the techniques that measurably improve accuracy
* Build rigorous validation and backtesting so every improvement is real
* Work with market data from websites and APIs, including linking duplicate listings across sources
* Integrate models with our Node.js services and monitor them in production
* Use SQL to investigate data-quality issues and explain anomalies
* Explain results clearly to product, commercial and customer teams

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 5+ years as an employed data scientist (not counting internships or study)
* Strong Python, including code you've written and maintained in a production ML system
* Professional experience building, evaluating and improving machine learning models, including forecasting (prices, demand, sales or similar)
* A track record of lifting model accuracy through experimentation, and a habit of keeping up with current AI developments
* Experience collecting data from websites and APIs
* Professional Node.js experience
* Strong SQL
* Clear, professional spoken and written English
* You enjoy a startup environment with high ownership and few handoffs

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Deep learning or LLMs used in production
* Experience with automotive, marketplace or pricing data

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

* Application with short screening questions
* A ~25-minute AI-led interview you complete at a time that suits you, reviewed by our team
* An online skills assessment (TestGorilla)
* A final interview with the hiring manager

title: Senior Data Engineer
details:
**About Payrails**
==================

Payrails is a global payment software company helping leading enterprises to take control of their payment operations and maximize performance. With deep experience in the payments space and firsthand knowledge of merchants' challenges, we’ve seen how fragmented, complex, and inefficient these systems can become. Now, we are setting a new industry standard for how enterprises around the world manage and optimize payments, with more control, visibility and flexibility than ever before.

Our vision is to reimagine payments from the ground up. We are building a deeply integrated meta layer that spans the entire payment lifecycle with a modular architecture. This helps us give leading brands building blocks to craft solutions to most complex operational challenges, tailor seamless customer experiences and grow their business.

We are backed by some of the world’s top investors including Andreessen Horowitz, HV Capital, EQT Ventures and General Catalyst, who share our mission to simplify payment complexity globally.

At Payrails, we’re committed to building a team of exceptional people - not just talented, but driven to build, solve, and deliver at the highest level. Excellence isn’t just a value here; it’s a way of working. We believe that great people thrive in environments where there’s trust, clarity, and shared purpose. We work openly and collaboratively, with deep respect for each other’s craft. Everyone is encouraged to understand the bigger picture - what we’re building, why it matters, and what stands in the way. When people have that context, they move faster, take ownership, and make better decisions. We care about creating a culture where people feel inspired to do their best work and a deep sense of responsibility to help us bring our vision to life. Success at Payrails means staying focused on the problems that matter most, and executing with purpose.

**Your team**
=============

At Payrails, data is at the core of everything we do. We don’t just analyze data; we turn it into actionable insights that fuel smarter decision-making and drive the future of our products. As we continue to revolutionize the payments industry we are seeking an exceptional Senior Data Engineer to help us in our mission.

Our tech team offers you the chance to work alongside a group of highly ambitious and knowledgeable Engineers, while being faced with complex problems that affect customers on a global scale.

**How you will make an impact**
===============================

* Work alongside a talented team of analysts, data scientists and engineers to build data products and services that meet business requirements.
* Design, develop and maintain robust, scalable and observable batch and real-time data pipelines.
* Architect, build and maintain the data infrastructure at Payrails.
* Advocate for and implement data governance and security best practices.
* Contribute to tooling that improves data quality, CI/CD workflows, and data observability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and design optimal solutions.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* You have 5-7 years of extensive experience in data engineering roles building reliable, scalable and observable production-grade data pipelines and services.
* You have strong proficiency in Python. Experience with GoLang is a plus.
* You are proficient in SQL, data modelling and operating common OLTP (e.g. PostgresSQL) and OLAP databases (e.g. Snowflake, Bigquery) at scale.
* You develop and maintain data pipelines using workflow management platforms such as Apache Airflow.
* You are knowledgeable of containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* You communicate effectively and are proficient in English.
* You work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with real-time streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka, Kinesis) and distributed stream processing technologies (e.g. Apache Flink, Apache Beam, Kafka Streams) is an advantage.
* Familiarity working with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) is preferred.
* FinTech or payments domain experience is a plus.

**What we offer**
=================

* High impact and high velocity environment with the most talented and ambitious people you will ever work with
* A chance to shape the story of a company and a category from the ground up
* Real ownership. You’ll have the freedom and trust to build, test, and take lead
* A product used by the best brands around the world
* Hybrid working with an office in the heart of New Cairo
* Regular team events, activities and off-sites
* Competitive salary and equity package
* 27 days of annual paid vacation

title: Lead Data Scientist - AI & Machine Learning
details:
**This position is not for urgent hiring.**

Integrant is looking for game changers to join our team as "Data Scientist - AI & Machine Learning" with below roles and responsibilities:

* Use mathematics, statistics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques to extract knowledge and insights from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy predictive and prescriptive machine learning models.
* Conduct open research and experimentation to develop innovative solutions for complex client challenges.
* Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into AI and Data Science solutions.
* Design and implement end-to-end Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions.
* Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and intelligent agent-based applications.
* Develop scalable model deployment and monitoring solutions using MLOps best practices.
* Monitor model performance, detect concept drift, and continuously improve deployed systems.
* Collaborate with software engineering teams to productionize AI applications and ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Mentor and coach junior Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers.
* Lead technical discussions, knowledge transfer sessions, and client-facing AI engagements.
* Stay current with emerging AI, Machine Learning, MLOps, and Generative AI technologies and frameworks.

  
**Requirements**

**Education & Experience**

* + 10+ years of professional experience, including 7+ years in Data Science, Machine Learning & MLOps
  + MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  + PhD is preferred, in related field.
  + Experience mentoring, coaching, or leading technical team members.

**Data Science & Machine Learning**

* + Strong foundation in Machine Learning techniques including Classification, Regression, Clustering, Association Rule Mining, Feature Engineering, and Model Evaluation.
  + Experience with Deep Learning concepts and frameworks.
  + Extensive hands-on experience with Python and the Data Science ecosystem.
  + Experience with one or more ML frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch.
  + Experience conducting research, experimentation, and hypothesis-driven analysis.

**MLOps & Production AI**

* + Experience deploying and managing Machine Learning models in production environments.
  + Experience monitoring model performance, detecting concept drift, and driving continuous improvements.
  + Hands-on experience with MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, experiment tracking, monitoring, and observability.
  + Experience deploying AI/ML solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, or Databricks.
  + Experience with ML platforms and services including Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.
  + Familiarity with deployment and serving tools such as MLflow, FastAPI, and Streamlit.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI**

* + Hands-on experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and semantic search applications.
  + Experience working with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, or Azure AI Search.
  + Experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
  + Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks such as LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent.
  + Experience implementing MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, and function-calling workflows.
  + Strong understanding of prompt engineering techniques and LLM optimization.
  + Experience evaluating LLM applications using frameworks such as LangSmith, RAGAS, or similar tools.
  + Experience with Embeddings, Vector Retrieval, Semantic Search, Fine-Tuning, and LoRA techniques.

Nice to Have:

**Advanced AI & Data Science**

* Reinforcement Learning (RL)
* Optimization techniques, including single-objective and multi-objective optimization
* Stochastic Local Search methods
* Knowledge Graphs and Graph Machine Learning.

**Cloud & Data Engineering**

* Experience building large-scale data pipelines on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Experience with Databricks and Apache Spark.
* Experience with distributed data processing architectures.

**Leadership & Consulting**

* Experience leading AI initiatives and technical strategy.
* Experience working directly with international clients and stakeholders.
* Experience defining AI architecture, standards, and best practices across teams.

*Please note that this role is part of a selective talent pipeline we are building, aimed at engaging with strong profiles early and aligning on meaningful opportunities as they emerge, ensuring a faster and more tailored process when the right fit arises.*

 **Benefits**  

* Salary paid in USD
* Six-month career advancing opportunities
* Employee parking space
* Supportive and friendly work environment
* Premium medical insurance [employee +family]
* English language development courses
* Interest-free loans paid over 2.5 years
* Technical development courses
* Planned overtime program (POP)
* Employment referral program
* Premium location in Maadi & Nasr City
* Social insurance
* Opportunity to travel and work onsite with U.S. customers
* In-house Technical and English training programs
* Dedicated learning time (check out our 4Plus1 Program)
* Flexible work schedules
* Perks: events, sponsored lunch, game area, rooftop hangout + more!

title: Validation Engineer
details:
**Job Description**

**Work Arrangement:** This role is categorized as onsite. this means the successful candidate to report to the GM office full time.

  

**The Role:**  
The Validation Engineer plans, coordinates, and executes product and vehicle validation activities, including fuel-calibration validation, to confirm that requirements are met and technical issues are identified and resolved. The role analyzes test results and data, investigates problems, recommends corrective actions, and works with engineering teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to support project delivery. The engineer manages assigned work with initiative, follows applicable procedures and company policies, and communicates findings through clear reports and presentations.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute assigned engineering validation and fuel-calibration activities in line with project requirements, schedules, and approved procedures.
* Develop or support test plans, test methods, and validation activities in consultation with the supervisor and product engineering teams.
* Coordinate required test resources, vehicles or components, data, and supplier support to complete validation work on time.
* Collect, interpret, and analyze test results and engineering data; document conclusions and identify deviations from requirements.
* Investigate test failures and technical issues, determine likely root causes, and recommend or follow through on corrective actions with the responsible teams.
* Communicate validation status, risks, results, and open issues to engineering stakeholders and leadership as appropriate.
* Work closely with suppliers and internal engineering teams to clarify technical issues, coordinate investigations, and support resolution.
* Prepare accurate technical reports, records, and presentations that communicate methods, results, conclusions, and recommended next steps.
* Incorporate relevant customer feedback and project learning into validation activities and improvement recommendations.
* Conduct relevant technical research to support test direction, problem solving, and engineering decisions.
* Manage assigned daily workload and project tasks, raising schedule, resource, or technical concerns promptly.
Follow standard operating procedures, safety requirements, and company policies while carrying out test and engineering work.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualification)**  
**Educational and Experience Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Automotive, Mechatronics, Electrical, or another relevant engineering discipline.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in same field.
* Demonstrated experience or academic/project experience in product, vehicle, component, or system testing and validation.
* Experience analyzing engineering test data, investigating technical problems, and documenting findings.
* Exposure to fuel-system, powertrain, or vehicle calibration validation is an asset and should be emphasized where applicable to the local role.
Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams is an advantage.  

  

**Technical Skills**

* Engineering test planning, coordination, execution, and validation documentation.
* Understanding of product and vehicle requirements and the use of test evidence to assess compliance.
* Test-data interpretation, trend analysis, and preparation of clear technical conclusions.
* Structured technical problem solving, including root-cause investigation and corrective-action follow-up.
* Familiarity with fuel-calibration validation activities and the ability to analyze related test results
* Technical report writing, data presentation, and maintenance of accurate engineering records.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, for data review and reporting.
Ability to learn and follow applicable GM engineering systems, test procedures, and quality processes.  

  

**Competencies**

* Analytical and detail-oriented, with sound judgment when interpreting test evidence.
* Takes initiative and works independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance or escalating complex issues appropriately.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and persistence in driving technical issues toward resolution.
* Effective written and verbal communication, including the ability to present technical findings clearly.
* Collaborative approach when working with supervisors, product engineers, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
* Organized in managing multiple tasks, priorities, documentation, and project timelines.
* Accountable for the accuracy and quality of work and for following procedures and company policies.
* Adaptable and willing to undertake relevant research and learn new products, test methods, and engineering processes.







**About GM**

title: R&D Section Head Engineer - Manufacturing
details:
**Jadeer is hiring on behalf of one of our esteemed clients, a leading company specializing in security solutions and products, located in 10th of Ramadan City.**

* Ability to identify innovation opportunities and translate technical challenges into practical engineering solutions.

* Excellent leadership, team development, performance management, and communication skills.
* Ability to drive innovation, optimize work processes, and ensure accountability.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

### **What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Successful development and commercialization of innovative products that meet customer, technical, and regulatory requirements.
* Effective implementation of technology roadmaps and new product development strategies.
* Timely delivery of R&D projects within established scope, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Improved product performance, reliability, durability, and manufacturability.
* Successful development and validation of alternative materials and manufacturing technologies.

* Well-maintained design standards, engineering specifications, and technical databases.
* Strong collaboration between R&D, Engineering, Production, Quality, Sourcing, and Marketing teams.

### **What You'll Gain: Engineering Leadership, Innovation & Growth**

title: (Senior) Analytics Engineer
details:

title: Engineering Technology & AI Lead
details:
SSE is looking for an **Engineering Technology & AI Lead** to help us be more efficient in how we design, engineer and deliver projects through technology, automation and AI.

This is not a traditional IT or “AI tools” role. You will work directly with our engineering and design teams to understand how work is done, identify where time and effort are being lost, and redesign workflows around technology and AI.

Your job is to determine how software and AI can **reduce the repetitive work**, while keeping technical judgement, validation and accountability with the engineer.

Engineering will be the first focus, with the capability eventually expanding across SSE's support functions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Map SSE's engineering workflows and identify the **10–20 highest-volume / highest-friction processes**.
* Assess opportunities based on **hours × frequency × complexity × error risk × automation potential**.
* Redesign workflows to increase engineering capacity, speed and quality.
* Build and deploy practical **GenAI, RAG, AI-agent and automation solutions**.
* Build SSE's internal **Engineering AI Layer** around:  
  **SSE Data + SSE Standards + SSE Workflows + SSE Engineering Knowledge.**
* Connect and integrate AI into existing engineering tools, systems and data rather than creating disconnected applications.
* Build systems that capture and reuse SSE's engineering knowledge across projects.
* Measure impact through **time saved, capacity created, quality improved and rework reduced**.
* Establish a repeatable approach that can eventually be applied across Finance, HR, Business Development, Operations and other support functions.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Strong hands-on experience building and deploying **Generative AI / Agentic AI solutions**.
* Strong **Python** development skills.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, AI agents, APIs, databases and cloud technologies.
* Experience processing and working with unstructured data such as PDFs, documents and images.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, data integration and production deployment.
* Experience with frameworks such as **LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI or AutoGen** is a plus.
* Engineering, construction, architecture, BIM or technical project experience is highly desirable.
* Strong ability to translate real business/engineering problems into practical technology solutions.

### **What Success Looks Like**

**Less repetitive work Faster delivery Higher engineering capacity Better quality Reusable SSE knowledge.**

title: Senior Client Relations Specialist and Account Manager
details:
**Senior Client Relations Specialist**
======================================

Are you an experienced client relations or account management professional who knows how to build strong relationships, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities for account growth?

Join **KALAM** as a **Senior Client Relations Specialist** and take ownership of a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary link between them and our internal teams. You will play a key role in strengthening client satisfaction, supporting retention and renewals, managing escalations, and identifying opportunities to expand our partnerships.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Client Relations Specialist, you will manage the day-to-day relationship with assigned clients and develop a strong understanding of their business, priorities, expectations, and evolving needs.

This role goes beyond responding to client requests. You will proactively monitor account health, identify potential risks, coordinate the resolution of service issues, support renewals, and uncover opportunities for account growth.

You will work closely with Operations, Service Delivery, Quality, Finance, Business Development, Technology, and other internal teams to ensure client commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Client Relationship & Portfolio Management**

* Own the day-to-day relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients.
* Act as the primary coordination point between clients and KALAM's internal teams.
* Develop a deep understanding of each client's business, operating model, requirements, priorities, and contractual commitments.
* Build trusted professional relationships with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* Maintain proactive and regular communication with clients.
* Ensure clients receive accurate, professional, consistent, and timely communication.
* Monitor overall account health and proactively identify potential risks and opportunities.

### **Client Experience & Retention**

* Monitor client satisfaction and the overall client experience across assigned accounts.
* Identify early signs of dissatisfaction, service concerns, relationship deterioration, or potential churn.
* Coordinate proactive actions with internal teams before issues escalate.
* Support client retention and renewal activities.
* Gather, document, and communicate client feedback to relevant stakeholders.
* Help strengthen relationships that position KALAM as a trusted long-term business partner.

### **Complaint & Escalation Management**

* Own client complaints and escalations from acknowledgment through resolution and closure.
* Assess issue urgency, severity, and business impact.
* Coordinate with Operations, Service Delivery, Quality, Finance, Technology, and other relevant teams to resolve issues.
* Keep clients informed throughout the resolution process.
* Follow up on agreed actions and ensure commitments are completed.
* Support root-cause analysis to help prevent recurring issues.
* Escalate major relationship, service, contractual, or financial risks when required.

### **Account Growth & Commercial Opportunities**

* Identify potential opportunities for account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and additional services.
* Understand changing client requirements and translate them into potential business opportunities.
* Qualify potential opportunities before escalating them to the Senior Client Relations Manager and/or Business Development team.
* Provide relevant client and account intelligence to support opportunity development.
* Coordinate internally to confirm operational feasibility before commitments are made.
* Support proposals, renewals, and account expansion discussions.
* Maintain ownership of the overall client relationship while senior management or Business Development leads final commercial negotiations.

### **Renewals & Contract Support**

* Monitor upcoming contract renewals and begin preparations well in advance.
* Review client satisfaction, account performance, risks, outstanding issues, and potential growth opportunities before renewal discussions.
* Coordinate required information with internal stakeholders.
* Support renewal negotiations and discussions.
* Ensure agreed contractual changes and client commitments are clearly communicated internally.

### **Financial & Collection Support**

* Maintain awareness of the financial status of assigned client accounts.
* Coordinate with Finance regarding overdue invoices and collection priorities.
* Follow up professionally with clients regarding outstanding balances.
* Escalate payment disputes, recurring collection issues, or financial risks when needed.
* Coordinate with Finance to resolve client queries related to invoices.

### **Client Intelligence & Forecasting**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on assigned accounts.
* Track changes in client demand, expected volumes, service requirements, business conditions, and expansion plans.
* Share relevant client insights with Operations, Planning & Control, Finance, Business Development, and other stakeholders.
* Support operational and commercial forecasting through timely client intelligence.
* Identify relevant market or competitor information obtained through client interactions.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate closely with Service Delivery, Operations, Planning & Control, Quality, Finance, Business Development, Technology, and other departments.
* Translate client requirements into clear and actionable internal information.
* Ensure internal stakeholders understand client priorities and commitments.
* Coordinate cross-functional actions related to assigned accounts.
* Follow up on delays, gaps, conflicting information, or unresolved actions that may affect the client relationship.
* Ensure external commitments remain aligned with KALAM's operational capabilities.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

### **Experience**

* **3–4 years of relevant professional experience.**
* At least **2–3 years of experience in Client Relations, Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery, BPO, or a similar client-facing role.**
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts or stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
* Previous experience within **BPO, outsourcing, interpretation, contact centers, customer experience, or professional services** is highly preferred.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Client Relationship Management
* Account Management
* Customer Success & Retention
* Complaint & Escalation Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Business Development & Account Growth
* Negotiation & Commercial Awareness
* Problem Solving
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Client Reporting & Account Intelligence
* Time Management & Prioritization

**Why Join KALAM?**
-------------------

KALAM provides language and business-process solutions to organizations across international markets, with services covering areas such as remote interpretation, customer experience management, shared services, and digital CX.

If you are passionate about building strong client partnerships, solving complex challenges, and contributing to long-term account growth, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Engineer - Senior
details:
**AI Engineer - Senior**
------------------------

**Field**

**Details**

**Location**

Abu Dhabi and Dubai, UAE

  

**Engagement Model**

Full-time

  

**Language**

Arabic, English

  

**Employment Type**

OCS

  

**Duration**

6 months

**Role Summary**

AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and deployment of production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high-quality data. They own the technical architecture and quality of AI solutions end to end, turning complex use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation.

The role works alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council, and acts as the technical lead and mentor for junior AI engineers. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production at scale, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview-governed data foundation, and to set the engineering and responsible-AI standards the team follows.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end design, development and deployment of AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases, from use-case shaping through to production operations.
* Architect enterprise-scale retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking, agentic and prompt orchestration, and grounding on curated Gold-layer data, optimising for accuracy, latency and cost.
* Define and operationalise responsible-AI controls covering explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubai's AI ethics principles, and present them to the Data Governance Council.
* Design secure, scalable APIs and integration patterns that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access, data masking, private networking and identity controls enforced.
* Partner with data architects and data engineers to define AI-ready data products, feature pipelines and data-quality gates, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls.
* Establish the evaluation framework: accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, automated regression testing, red-teaming and go/no-go release criteria applied before each release.
* Own CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, drift detection, observability and cost management for AI workloads in production.
* Lead the application of UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including threat modelling, data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging, in coordination with security and data-protection teams.
* Act as technical lead for the AI workstream: lead and mentor junior AI engineers, run design and code reviews, set engineering standards and best practices, and support estimation, planning and delivery quality.
* Advise senior business and technology stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, roadmap and trade-offs, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Produce and review model cards, solution architecture and design decisions, runbooks and audit evidence for each AI component.
* Lead capability building for Client's counterparts in AI engineering practices, tooling and responsible-AI operations so that solutions can be sustained after handover.

### **Must Have**

* AI certification.
* 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years designing, building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production, including ownership of multiple enterprise-scale deployments.
* Proven experience as a technical lead, guiding and mentoring a team of engineers and owning solution architecture and delivery quality.
* Expert-level Python skills, with deep experience in frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch, scikit-learn or Hugging Face, and in building agentic and multi-step LLM workflows.
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning and vector databases, including hybrid retrieval, evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.
* Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Strong command of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt engineering, red-teaming, observability and responsible-AI practices.
* Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview.
* Working knowledge of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR, with experience applying it in delivery.
* Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.

### **Good to Have**

* Arabic proficiency and Arabic NLP experience.
* Relevant Microsoft Azure AI or architecture certifications (for example Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Experience in government or other regulated sectors.

**Job Description & Summary**

Practice Description:
  
Our Digital Identity team helps organizations build the identity foundations required to secure access across employees, customers, applications, cloud platforms and increasingly non-human identities.
  
  
We work with clients on questions such as: What should our future identity architecture look like? How can we modernize fragmented IAM environments? How should privileged and machine identities be governed? And how do we make access more secure without creating unnecessary complexity for the business?
  
  
As a Manager or Senior Manager, you will lead complex IAM transformations, shape enterprise identity architectures and advise senior stakeholders on how identity should support security, cloud adoption and broader business transformation.

**Core Activities:** “ *What You’ll Be Working On”*

* **Lead enterprise IAM transformations:** Define the approach, manage multidisciplinary delivery teams and take responsibility for complex identity programs.
* **Design target IAM architectures:** Shape how identity governance, authentication, privileged access, workforce identity and customer identity should work together.
* **Derive IAM strategies:** Translate security, regulatory and technology requirements into practical architectures and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
* **Modernize identity environments:** Help clients move from fragmented or manual access models toward automated lifecycle management, modern authentication and cloud-based identity.
* **Advise on emerging identity challenges:** Shape approaches for areas such as Zero Trust, passwordless authentication, non-human identities and workload identity.
* **Challenge technical designs:** Review architecture and implementation decisions, identify weaknesses and ensure solutions are scalable, secure and maintainable.
* **Advise senior stakeholders:** Explain identity-related risks, architecture choices and investment priorities to CIOs, CISOs and other senior leaders.
* **Lead teams and client relationships:** Develop junior colleagues, build trusted client relationships and ensure consistent quality across engagements.

**Key Skills:** “ *What you need to have”*

Typically **8+ years of relevant experience** in IAM, identity architecture, cybersecurity engineering, cloud security or large-scale technology transformation.

We are looking for people who combine **deep IAM expertise with strong delivery and client leadership** . You should be able to design enterprise identity architectures, challenge complex technical solutions and guide implementation teams while translating identity decisions into business and security outcomes.

Strong experience across multiple identity domains — such as **IGA, Access Management, PAM, workforce or customer identity** — is expected, together with knowledge of modern cloud and authentication architectures.

Extensive experience in **leading client engagements, developing sales proposals and supporting business development** is important. You should also have proven experience in **leading, coaching and technically guiding junior consultants, engineers and architects** .

**Knowledge Exposure:** “ *What you'll build expertise in”*

As a Manager or Senior Manager, you will broaden your expertise from individual IAM technologies toward **enterprise identity strategy and architecture** . You will strengthen your ability to lead large transformation programs, advise senior stakeholders, shape emerging identity solutions and build high-performing delivery teams, while contributing to new client opportunities and the continued growth of the Digital Identity team.
