title: AI-First Product Designer
details:
**WHY US?****/**
----------------

**Up to EUR 16,000** per year, on a full time, contractor contract
  
Fully remote working from anywhere in Egypt!
  
Working with globally recognisable brands in US TV and entertainment
  
✨ A craft role with AI agents, skills and automation at the centre of how the work gets made — not bolted onto it
  
High-end, fast computer and all the latest creative software and AI tools you'll need

**Who We Are****/**
-------------------

**About the Role**

We're hiring an **AI-First Product Designer** to design and ship thoughtful product improvements across Storm's products.

You'll own well-scoped problems from initial framing through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, and shipped release — staying close to the work rather than handing over a static design and moving on.

Storm is an AI-native company, so you'll use AI coding assistants, design tools, APIs, and rapid prototyping environments to turn ideas into working experiences quickly and test real interactions early.

Strong product design craft still comes first. You'll combine interaction design, visual design, product thinking, and clear UX writing with an AI-first way of building and iterating.

**About Storm Ideas**

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We build products, produce content at scale, design smarter ways for clients and internal teams to work, and keep looking for new ways to improve how the company operates.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.

**What You’ll Make Happen****/**
--------------------------------

This role will provide you with the opportunity to:

* **Design and ship end-to-end:** own small, well-scoped product improvements from problem framing through wireframes, high-fidelity UI and shipped release — not handing off a static file and walking away.
* **Prototype with AI, not just for it:** use AI coding assistants and design tooling to go from idea to working prototype in hours, so we test real interactions instead of debating static mockups.
* **Write the words as well as the pixels:** prompts, system messages, empty states, microcopy and model-facing instructions are part of the design surface here.
* **Solve real customer problems:** collaborate with Product, Engineering and Solutions to scope simple, pragmatic solutions that work for our clients.
* **Make things measurable:** define what "good" looks like for a feature, help instrument it, and use qualitative and quantitative signal to iterate — not just ship and hope.
* **Look after the design system:** contribute components, patterns and documentation that keep our products consistent as we scale across web and mobile.
* **Think from first principles:** break problems down, reason about trade-offs, and pick the simplest approach that works.
* **Learn in the open:** participate in design and code reviews (giving and receiving feedback), pair with teammates, and share what you're learning.
* **Own your work:** plan your tasks, communicate progress, and follow through to high-quality releases.

**YOUR EXPERTISE****/**
-----------------------

**What's important to us:**

* **A genuine excitement for AI and AI-assisted design — this is a must-have.** You're curious about LLMs and actively use (or are eager to use) AI tools, code assistants and AI APIs to move faster, while verifying outputs with testing and sound reasoning.
* **Strong core product design craft:** interaction design, information architecture, visual hierarchy and typography. You can take an ambiguous problem to a clean, usable, well-considered interface.
* **A portfolio that shows thinking, not just screens:** we want to see the problem, the options you considered, what you cut, and what happened after it shipped.
* **Comfort with ambiguity in products:** you can design for systems that are probabilistic, occasionally wrong, and change underneath you.
* **Clear problem-solving:** you can break a task down, reason from first principles, and explain trade-offs simply.
* **Reliability and follow-through:** you meet agreed timelines, communicate early if blocked, and finish well.
* **Openness to feedback:** you're coachable, curious, and iterate based on what you learn.
* **Strong written and verbal communication;** you can collaborate well in a remote setting.
* **Reliable, consistent internet access** for remote work.

**What's nice to have:**

* Side projects, a small repo, a shipped AI experiment, or a write-up showing how you learn.
* Hands-on experience building with AI tooling — prototyping in v0/Cursor/Claude Code, wiring up an AI API, or building your own agents and automations.
* Enough front-end literacy to prototype or tweak your own work — HTML/CSS, basic TypeScript or React.
* Experience designing for both web and mobile.
* Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards, or motion and prototyping tools.
* Backgrounds we've seen succeed are varied — self-taught, bootcamp, adjacent disciplines. A design degree is not required.

**What It’s Like To Work Here****/**
------------------------------------

**Modern Tools & A Real AI Stack**
  
The latest hardware and professional creative software, plus a properly provisioned AI stack with real access to current tools and agents, supported by our AI Operations team.

**Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works**
  
We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.

**Team-Based**
  
You'll work with production managers, creative teams, and account teams across an international, remote-first company of 175+ people. We hire for skill, drive, and authenticity.

**Remote-First & Flexible**
  
Fully remote within Egypt.

**Recruitment process****/**
----------------------------

Apply with your CV or resume. Any work you want to show us? It's optional but would be a bonus! Anything you think might be relevant.

* **First interview:** you'll meet members of the Storm team via MS Teams so we can get to know each other, understand how you think and work, and answer your questions
* **Practical task:** if successful, you'll complete a short, time-boxed product design exercise based around a realistic problem. We'll be interested in the decisions you make, the trade-offs you consider, and how you use AI and prototyping tools — not just the final screens
* **Final interview:** you'll then have a second conversation with a senior member of the team, and that's it

**Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We're more interested in your craft, your judgment, and how you work with AI than in a perfect traditional CV.**

title: Procurement Officer, P3
details:
Org. Setting and Reporting

This position is located in the Regional Office for the Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA) of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) in Cairo, Egypt. As Head of the Middle East and North Africa Procurement Hub, the incumbent works under the direct supervision of the Chief Procurement Officer (UNOV/UNODC Procurement Unit, Vienna), and the overall guidance of the UNODC Regional Representative for the Middle East and Northern Arica. The incumbent will execute his/her functions as part of the ROMENA Operations Team and work in close coordination with the Administrative and Finance Officer. For more information on UNODC, please visit the following website: www.unodc.org

Responsibilities

The incumbent coordinates, supports and provides supervisory oversight of the procurement function at UNODC ROMENA and the UNODC Office for the Gulf Cooperation Council Region (OGCCR). The incumbent is expected, upon request, to support other UNODC offices and Global Programmes in the procurement hub where UNODC operates. Within assigned authority the Procurement Officer will provide the following specific duties: • Serve as the procurement and contracting expert for technically and legally complex procurement processes across a wide range of goods and services (e.g. information technology, specialized electronic equipment and instruments, medicines, safety and security equipment, including personal protective equipment, food goods, building maintenance materials, office supplies, furniture, construction, refurbishment work, fuel, office lease etc.), while considering local market conditions. • Plan, develop and manage procurement activities related to infrastructure and major construction projects, including those of significant value, in consultation and supported by the UNOV/UNODC Procurement Unit, in close cooperation with UNODC architects, engineers, and national authorities to ensure that all applicable building codes, regulations and safety precautions are followed. • Lead and manage all procurement activities, ensuring compliance with policies and providing end-to-end support across projects and programmes. • Review and evaluate procurement requests, ensuring technical specifications are appropriate, and guide and support buyers and requisitioners through quality assurance and coordination. • Develop procurement procedures, workflows, standards and evaluation criteria; organize staff development and training activities. • Conduct and lead negotiations with supplier representatives; prepare and manage complex contracts for procurement of non-routine and technologically advanced commodities or long-range services; long term agreements, and tender processes; evaluate bids and recommend award of contracts; sign procurement orders up to the authorized limit under delegated authority or prepare submissions to the Contracts Committee for review and subsequent approval by the authorized official. • Plan, develop and manage all procurement activities related to UNODC construction projects. • Develop strategies and design innovative solutions to resolve issues/conflicts for complex procurement projects, particularly of construction projects in cooperation with architects, engineers and other UNODC staff, experts and consultants. Liaise closely with the national authorities in conforming with local construction laws. • Prepare, review, clear and/or approve a variety of procurement-related documents, note to file, contracts, communications, guidelines, and instructions. • Establish strategies and solutions to address complex procurement challenges, including contract negotiations and dispute resolution. • Ensure procurement activities comply with the United Nations Secretariat Financial Regulations and Rules; coordinate with other UN entities such as the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in line with the Mutual Recognition principle. • Promote and support discussions within the UN system in the context of Business Operating Strategy (BOS) which aims at increasing the number of established Long-Term Agreements to support UNODC. • Contribute to the development of regional procurement guidance note, procedures, workflows, standards, templates, innovation initiative and criteria for the evaluation of goods, services, and supplier capacity; streamline procurement processes and support implementation of UNOV/UNODC and Secretariat-wide initiatives, in close coordination with the ROMENA Operations Manager. • Develop and deliver training, coaching and guidance on procurement practices to staff and stakeholders. • Improve and streamline procurement processes through analysis, standardization, and implementation of new tools and initiatives undertaken by the UN Secretariat. • Develop templates, standard operating procedures and other planning and monitoring tools to enhance efficiency and oversight. • Manage, as appropriate, the preparation of accurate and timely reports of procurement activities. • Monitor and manage reporting, auditing, and compliance of procurement activities, ensuring timely responses to recommendations and audit findings. • Lead the implementation of Enterprise and Corporate tools mandated by the Organization to enhance productivity and improve overall operations. These tools may include the Procurement Tracker, the e-tendering tool (Ariba), the Instant Feedback System (IFS) and the Contract Performance Reporting Tool (CPRT). Following deployment, ensure their effective utilization through user support, guidance, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives to maximize organizational benefits and compliance. • Monitor various corporate dashboards to ensure compliance with key performance indicators related to procurement and coordinate with counterparts to ensure compliance with procurement standards. • Provide guidance to and supervise the procurement staff related to the hub. • Review and monitor the implementation of the acquisition plan for the ROMENA Hub. • Collect and analyze data to identify trends or patterns and provide insights through graphs, charts, tables and reports using data visualization methods to enable data-driven planning, decision-making, presentation and reporting. • Monitor and oversee the use of Low Value Acquisition (LVA) within the Hub, with the aim to identify opportunities for consolidation, reducing reliance on LVA, and promoting the establishment and use of Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) for the Hub. • Liaise closely with all programmes and project teams in the Hub and ensure efficient and continuous communication and exchange of information, while ensuring equitable workload distribution among buyers across the hub, and formalizing arrangements for ad-hoc mutual support with the UNOV/UNODC Procurement Unit. • Participate in United Nations inter-agency activities related to procurement, such as the Operations Management Team (OMT) subgroup on Procurement and the Regional Operations Management Team (R-OMT) Subgroup on Procurement. to ensure UNODC’s interests are reflected in UN common system activities related to common back-office services and premises, cost recovery and cost sharing arrangements and others. • Conduct missions to Programme Offices, and other locations as and when needed. • Perform other work-related duties as required.

Competencies

Professionalism: Has knowledge of internationally recognized procurement standards and of all phases of international procurement techniques and operations used in contracting for highly complex and technologically advanced goods and services. Has knowledge of contract law and expertise in handling complex procurement and contract issues. Has knowledge of quantitative methods to measure supplier capacity systems and ability to identify sources of supply, market trends and pricing. Is able to shape and influence agreements with requisitioning units and vendors. Has ability to apply technical expertise to resolve a range of complex and/or sensitive issues/problems. Is able to develop procurement policies, procedures and new programmes. Has ability to analyze and interpret data in support of decision-making and convey resulting information to management. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work. Accountability: Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honours commitments; delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards; operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules; supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments; takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable. Client Orientation: Considers all those to whom services are provided to be “clients” and seeks to see things from clients’ point of view; establishes and maintains productive partnerships with clients by gaining their trust and respect; identifies clients’ needs and matches them to appropriate solutions; monitors ongoing developments inside and outside the clients’ environment to keep informed and anticipate problems; keeps clients informed of progress or setbacks in projects; meets timeline for delivery of products or services to client.

Education

An advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in business administration, commerce, engineering, law or a related field is required. A first-level university degree in similar fields in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Job - Specific Qualification

Professional certification in supply chains such as Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply certification (CIPS Level 4) or equivalent is required. Evidence of such certification must be uploaded as part of the application.

Work Experience

A minimum of five years of progressively responsible professional work experience in procurement or related area is required. Work experience in using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems is required. Work experience with SAP (such as Umoja) is desirable. At least one year of demonstrated work experience with construction projects, including the procurement of architectural and construction services, is desirable. At least one year of demonstrated procurement work experience in multiple field locations, including hands-on experience supporting project-based client operations in a decentralized environment, is desirable. At least one year of demonstrated work experience in managing a team within the United Nations system or another international organization is desirable. Work experience in using e-tendering solutions (such as Ariba) is desirable. Experience in data analytics or related area is desirable.

English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this job opening, English is required. Either French **or** Arabic is desirable. title: Service Project Manager
details:

This position plans, organizes, monitors, drives processes and resources to achieve order and project objectives within scope, time, quality, and budget. The Service Order Manager is also responsible for managing and monitoring the backlog of service orders, managing customer contact during execution and representing Compression Service to clients whenever needed, driving revenue growth, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

Coordinates internal teams (Technical Support, Engineering, Product Competency Centers, Sales, etc.) to clarify technical requests from the customer and resolve delivery concerns.

Coordinate with Field Service (FS) organization globally and with the regional FS teams to ensure proper outage planning and staffing, and timely delivery of reports.

Manages and executes service orders that can be extended to the middle eastern region as applicable. **What You Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, logistics, or a related field.

* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship-building skills.
* Should possess strong leadership skills and the ability to convince stakeholders in the interest of the project.

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

details:

If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Who we are**

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About the role**

We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Denmark - Kalundborg

Minimum 5 Years

AIT Project Quality Management

* Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.
* Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.
* Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.
* Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.
* Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who you are**

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

* Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.
* Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.
* Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.
* Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What you bring to the role**

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

* A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.
* Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.
* Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.
* Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.
* Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE**

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. title: Senior AI Software Engineer
details:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

LEONI is a global provider of products, solutions and services for energy and data management in the automotive industry. The group of companies has around 86,000 employees in 21 countries and generated consolidated sales of EUR 3.9 billion in 2025.

The value chain ranges from standardized cables and special and data cables to highly complex wiring systems and related components, from development to production. As an innovation partner with distinctive development and systems expertise, we support our customers on the path to increasingly sustainable and connected mobility concepts from autonomous driving to alternative drives as well as charging systems.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Are you passionate about building AI solutions that solve real business problems and work reliably beyond the prototype?

As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you design, build and operationalize software solutions in which AI is a core part of the solution. You combine rapid experimentation, enterprise software engineering and production operation to bring solutions from an initial idea into secure, maintainable operation.

When a business team comes to you with a problem nobody yet knows how to solve, you are the person who steps in: you clarify the real need, say openly when a simpler solution will do, and otherwise build it together with them end to end — safely, reliably and in production.

1. Design and build AI-enabled applications

* Build AI-enabled solutions, web apps, APIs and workflow integrations using GenAI, agents, document intelligence, computer vision, classical machine learning or similar, but only where AI beats simpler conventional solutions.
* Turn unclear business problems into testable hypotheses and working vertical slices for early user validation.
* Assess prototypes from LEONI’s Core AI team, business users, or citizen developers. Decide with stakeholders whether to harden, rewrite, integrate, buy or discontinue them, and take the chosen ones to production with tests, CI/CD, observability and documentation.

2. Integrate AI with LEONI systems and data

* Build secure, reusable integrations, MCPs and APIs to LEONI enterprise and engineering systems.
* Respect existing identity, access and data-governance boundaries instead of copying data into isolated AI apps.
* Work with system owners to make strategic systems increasingly AI-ready.

3. Engineer reliable AI behavior

* Design evaluations, test datasets and tests for probabilistic outputs, with quality thresholds agreed with process owners.
* Implement risk-appropriate safeguards, human review and fallbacks, and make model limitations visible to users.
* Protect AI solutions against AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, data leakage through retrieval and unintended agent actions, and, in collaboration with Legal and Information Security, implement controls that relate to compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act and LEONI's InfoSec requirements.
* Monitor quality, usage, latency, cost and failures in operation.

4. Contribute to AI platforms and reusable foundations

* Build reusable AI services, templates, starter repositories and reference implementations.
* Shape LEONI's approach to AI-assisted development for IT as well as Citizen Developers and governed business-built applications.
* Select and compare models and hosting options (e.g. cloud-hosted vs. open-weight) on quality, cost, latency and data-protection criteria, and manage model updates, deprecations and migrations without disrupting users.
* Help define standard interfaces for document processing, retrieval, model access, authentication, logging and evaluation.

5. Support improvement of engineering practices in the AI era

* Promote sound fundamentals such as modular design, version control, automated testing and code review.

* Use AI coding assistants productively while staying accountable for the result and help set lightweight standards for AI-generated code.

* Take part in architecture and security reviews and help design proportionate controls for different risk levels.

6. Work across business, AI and IT

* Collaborate with LEONI’s Core AI Team, IT architecture, IT security, other IT roles, data owners and process experts to turn business outcomes into delivery increments.
* Explain trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and coach other IT Engineers or Citizen Developers, where needed.
* Contribute implementation know-how to other IT and Citizen Development colleagues without becoming the permanent support owner for a locally built app.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

Must-have

* Experience: Typically 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building AI- or LLM-based solutions, or equivalent demonstrated impact.
* Engineering: Strong professional experience building and operating full-stack, pro-code applications in an enterprise environment of comparable size or complexity, with solid fundamentals in architecture, APIs, integration, testing, security and deployment.
* AI: Proven experience building AI and agentic solutions and running them in production, including evaluation, regression testing and quality monitoring; Python and/or TypeScript on a major cloud platform (ideally Azure).
* Ownership: A proven track record of solving open-ended business problems hands-on with AI — from the first conversation to a reliably running production solution — rather than only implementing well-specified use cases.
* Mindset: A product mindset: you consider the end user, business outcome and long-term operation, not just the initial implementation.
* Languages: Fluent English; German at least at B2 level, or willingness to reach it within the first year.

Nice-to-have

* Experience working across business functions and technical teams.
* Experience with LLM and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or comparable libraries.
* Familiarity with Microsoft technologies and tools used in enterprise environments.
* Experience with industrial AI in production, such as visual inspection, predictive maintenance or anomaly detection, including MLOps for traditional machine-learning and computer-vision models.

Experience in manufacturing, Tier 1 automotive supply or the automotive industry, ideally with smart-factory topics such as shop-floor data integration, produ

**Benefits**
------------

* You’ll be part of a cross-functional automation team in a global environment
* You will collaborate with business and IT stakeholders while contributing to scalable automation initiatives.
* You’ll work in an environment that values innovation, experimentation, and growth.
* Opportunities for certifications and development.

title: Grant Finance Officer
details:
**Reports to:** Grants Finance Manager  
**Location:** Cairo, Egypt

### **Purpose of the position**

ICARDA designs and implements research projects that are funded by a diverse set of donors. The Grants Finance Officer (GFO) provides specific support to projects throughout their life cycle and works closely with the grant leader and various budget holders. The GFO is involved in the development of proposals to donors, the start of a new grant, all aspects of its financial management and its closure. The GFO must ensure that:

* Grant budgets (or other budgets they are responsible for) are up to date, realistic, appropriate and compliant with donor regulations and instructions,
* Expenses are incurred and recorded in an accurate and timely fashion and in compliance with all applicable policies and procedures,
* Budget utilization is aligned to project plans and progress,
* Donor reports and donor invoices are prepared in an accurate and timely manner and responds to donor requirements,
* Grant audits are conducted professionally, and audit reports are provided to donors on schedule and do not show any disallowed costs, and
* Financial risks associated with the grant are well understood and mitigated to the extent possible.

The GFO liaises with many colleagues across ICARDA, among which program directors, grant leaders, budget managers, finance colleagues, country office colleagues, procurement, Resource mobilization, and Grants Management.

### **About ICARDA**

The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) is a treaty-based international non-profit research organization supported by CGIAR. ICARDA’s mission is to reduce poverty, enhance food, water, and nutritional security, as well as environmental health in the face of global challenges including climate change. We do this through innovative science, strategic partnerships, linking research to development and capacity development that take into account gender equality and the role of youth in transforming the dry areas. ICARDA works in partnership with governments, universities, civil society, national agricultural research organization, other CGIAR Research Centers, and the private sector. With its temporary Headquarters in Beirut, Lebanon, ICARDA operates in regional and country offices across Africa, Asia and the Middle East. For more information: www.icarda.org.

**About the Project**  
Rural Employment through Animal Feed Production (REAP) is a five-year multi-country initiative intended to advance education and relieve poverty by enabling 1,000,000 financially disadvantaged young women and men, aged 18 to 35 years, to access new work opportunities in sustainable feed and livestock value chains across the seven countries. The Program will equip young people with technical, entrepreneurial, financial; digital and workplace capabilities linked to real economic opportunities and enable financially disadvantaged young people to access work, finance, productive assets, markets and income-generating opportunities that improve household resilience and wellbeing. Among its participants, the Program shall target 70% young women and at least 5% youth with disabilities and 20,000 refugees and displaced young people.

The programme will support youth-led and youth-inclusive enterprises to enter, stabilise and grow in feed and livestock markets; strengthen market systems, services, and commercial relationships; and improve policy, finance, innovation, extension, and other enabling systems required for youth-led enterprises to succeed and generate additional employment opportunities. Across these areas, it applies gender-transformative and inclusive approaches to address restrictive gender and social norms, reduce barriers to young women’s participation, and strengthen their agency, voice, leadership and access to resources and opportunities. Safeguarding measures are embedded throughout the programme to protect young people from harm and support their safe participation.

### **Main responsibilities:**

* Proactively support Budget Monitoring and Expense Utilization for an assigned set of grants:

o Regularly monitor project budget and expenditures and advise project managers on spending rates and potentials actions and adjustments, as may be needed.

o Ensure that expenses charged to the grant are allowable, allocable, reasonable and properly documented.

o Ensure compliance with agreement provisions on expense budget line items and reporting requirement.

o Regular review of outstanding commitments and ensure their validity and follow-up for their conversion to actual expenses.

o Review spending plans with budget holders to make sure that the budget is realistic and up to date.

* Facilitate Budget development and updates during the life of the grant:

o Ensure that the budget is clear and uploaded in the ERP (UBW) as soon as possible following approval of the grant.

o Facilitate preparation of annual Plan of Work and Budget (POWB) and upload of the same in OCS.

o Assist the project leader in planning and amending the POWB as needed following budget reviews or changes initiated by the donor or the environment.

o Assist the project leader in making changes to the grant budget as needed and prepare all necessary documents for the donor and assist in the approval process.

o Maintain activity-based budget for all grants under your responsibility.

o Ensure budget allocations are made in accordance with donor budget line items (nature, value).

* Prepare Reporting and Invoicing to Donors and Other Stakeholders:

o Prepare Accurate of the periodic financial report as required in the Project Agreement in consultation with the Project Leader in an accurate and timely preparation.

o Ensure timely invoicing of grant and minimizing pre-financing of project.

o Ensure availability and completeness of required supporting documents per grant agreement.

* Develop proposal budgets and more generally support Proposal Development:

o Review the donor guidelines and call for proposal to ensure compliance in the preparation of the budget.

o Support the development of a realistic, activity-based and donor compliant budget for new research project proposals by providing support to the scientists developing the proposal.

o Ensure that the proposed budget is properly costed in all aspects and based on the proposed activities of the project.

o Make sure that the proposed budget is compliant with the Full Cost Recovery Policy of the Center.

o In cases where the donor's indirect cost rate is below the Center's institutional rate, ensure that the difference will be covered as part of the direct costs.

* Support Subgrant Management:

o Coordinate due diligence reviews of grantee with Country offices and PDGMU and request amendments to the sub agreement as needed.

o Monitor the level of funds released to the partners and collaborators for the projects to carry out the activities.

o Ensure that partners submit reliable reports in a prompt and timely manner.

o Assist the Project Leaders in the development and monitoring of partners' subgrant. agreements and ensuring compliance on partners' reporting requirement are met.

o Prepare and complete all financial requirement for the project close out.

* Provide Administrative oversight:

o Review PRs for capital assets, consultants and other services.

o Provide advice to Project Leaders regarding the expenses and outstanding commitments.

o Prepare adjustments of expenses as necessary in consultation with the project leaders.

* Carry out other Grant Management duties:

o Monitor donor receivable and payable and follow up as needed.

o Regular review of grants funded with other foreign currencies and make the budget. amendment based on updated currency exchange rates.

o Support the process of seeking amendments to the Grant budget as needed.

title: Amazon Content Manager | Remote
details:
**Amazon Content Manager (m/f/d)**
----------------------------------

We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive **Amazon Content Manager (m/f/d)** to drive the growth and visibility of our product catalog across eight European marketplaces (DE, UK, FR, IT, ES, NL, IE, SE).

If you love dissecting what makes an e-commerce listing convert, enjoy combining keyword data with persuasive messaging, and want to master international marketplace operations using cutting-edge workflows and AI tools, we want to hear from you.

### **What Matters Most to Us**

We’re looking for a creative problem-solver rather than an asset updater. In this role, you’ll dive into real performance data to understand *why* a product isn’t performing—distinguishing visibility drop-offs from conversion bottlenecks—and design targeted, high-impact creative solutions that move the needle.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **High-Impact International Scope:** Shape the customer experience across 8 major European e-commerce markets.
* **Modern Tool stack & AI Workflows:** Hands-on experience scaling catalog optimizations using AI tools, automated pipelines, and advanced spreadsheet modelling.
* **Autonomous & Merit-Driven:** Freedom to test hypotheses, pitch visual/text updates, track outcomes, and own your optimization pipeline.
* **Comprehensive Onboarding:** Prior Amazon experience is a plus, but not mandatory. We provide thorough training on marketplace tools, flat files, and structured content frameworks.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Work alongside creative designers, operations leads, and international specialists in a fast-moving brand environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Amazon SEO & Catalog Visibility**

* Conduct in-depth keyword research and competitor analysis to uncover high-intent search terms.
* Optimize organic rank drivers across titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend search terms (search terms).
* Seamlessly weave keywords into readable, consumer-centric copy that preserves brand tone and intent.

**Conversion Rate & Visual Asset Optimization**

* Audit product galleries to identify gaps in visual hierarchy, infographics, and lifestyle imagery.
* Create detailed, structured creative briefs for graphic designers to highlight key product dimensions, USPs, and use cases.
* Develop and refine A+ Content modules, brand stories, and product comparison tables to build buyer trust and reduce return rates.

**Pan-European Marketplace Management**

* Adapt listings across European locales (Germany, UK, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Ireland, Sweden), accounting for local search behaviours and cultural purchase drivers.
* Leverage AI and translation tools systematically, verifying technical accuracy, formatting compliance, and localized tone.

**Process & Workflow Optimization**

* Utilize spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets) and Amazon bulk templates (flat files) to manage and implement updates at scale.

### **Key Requirements**

* **Analytical Mindset:** Comfortable diagnosing data, reading funnel metrics (sessions vs. conversions), and making decisions backed by logic.
* **Strong Copy & Communication Sense:** A natural feel for consumer psychology—knowing what information a shopper needs before buying.
* **Spreadsheet Proficiency:** Confident working with Excel or Google Sheets (filtering, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data hygiene).
* **Exceptional Attention to Detail:** High standard of quality assurance to prevent errors in product specs, pricing data, or marketplace compliance guidelines.
* **Language Skills:** Fluent/professional English is required. Working knowledge of German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, or Swedish is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.
* **Self-Directed & Organized:** Capable of balancing multiple projects, prioritizing high-impact catalog opportunities, and documenting workflows reliably.
* **E-Commerce Affinity:** Prior experience with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10,or flat-file uploads is a strong asset, but strong analytical problem solvers with a passion to learn are encouraged to apply.

**Role**: Amazon Content Manager (m/f/d)  
**Work Arrangement**: Remote  
**Employment type**: Full-time  
**Target Markets**: DE,UK,FR,IT,ES,NL,IE,SE,

* **Fixed Monthly Pay:** **Euro 290 / month**

title: Interior Design & Finishing Director
details:
**Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Business Strategy & P&L Ownership:**

* Develop and execute the overall business strategy for the Interior Design & Finishes function in alignment with the company's strategic objectives.
* Establish the department as a profitable and commercially sustainable business line.
* Own the department's P&L, revenue, gross margin, cost base, cash flow, and profitability.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue targets, budgets, and profitability objectives.
* Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, optimize costs, and enhance overall business performance.
* Establish the appropriate business model, pricing strategy, service offering, and operating structure for the function.
* Continuously assess market trends, customer needs, competitors, and emerging opportunities to maintain a competitive market position.
* Present regular business performance updates, forecasts, risks, and improvement plans to senior management.

**2. Commercial Strategy & Business Development:**

* Lead the commercial strategy for the Interior Design & Finishes business line and build a strong and sustainable project pipeline.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities across residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, and other relevant sectors.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with developers, investors, consultants, architects, contractors, suppliers, and key clients.
* Lead major commercial negotiations, proposals, tenders, and contract discussions.
* Establish pricing and costing strategies that balance market competitiveness with targeted profitability.
* Review and approve project proposals, quotations, budgets, variations, and commercial submissions within the approved authority limits.
* Ensure accurate estimation of project costs, resources, risks, overheads, and expected margins before project commitment.
* Monitor pipeline conversion, win rates, backlog, revenue forecasts, and project profitability.
* Develop strategic partnerships with suppliers, contractors, designers, and specialist subcontractors to enhance the company's market offering and commercial competitiveness.

**3. Project Management & Delivery:**

* Provide executive oversight of the complete project lifecycle from inception through design, procurement, construction, finishing, testing, and handover.
* Ensure all projects are delivered within approved time, cost, quality, and profitability parameters.
* Establish project governance frameworks, methodologies, reporting standards, and performance controls.
* Review project schedules, budgets, resource plans, procurement strategies, and delivery risks.
* Monitor project performance and intervene proactively where projects are facing delays, cost overruns, quality issues, or commercial risks.
* Ensure effective coordination between design, project management, procurement, commercial, finance, and site execution teams.
* Ensure appropriate project controls are in place for variations, claims, change orders, and scope management.
* Drive timely resolution of critical project issues and escalate major risks to senior management when required.
* Ensure successful project completion, handover, client satisfaction, and commercial closure.

**4. Interior Design Management:**

* Lead the overall interior design strategy and ensure consistency with the company's design vision, brand positioning, and project objectives.
* Oversee the development and review of design concepts, detailed designs, material selections, specifications, shop drawings, and finishes.
* Ensure design solutions are commercially viable, technically feasible, and aligned with project budgets and timelines.
* Balance design excellence with cost efficiency, constructability, availability, and lifecycle considerations.
* Ensure effective coordination between interior designers, architects, consultants, MEP teams, project managers, and contractors.
* Establish design standards, guidelines, and approval processes across projects.
* Review and challenge design proposals to ensure they deliver the required customer experience while protecting project margins.
* Ensure design changes are properly assessed for their impact on cost, time, quality, and project profitability.

**5. Finishes & Technical Management:**

* Oversee the selection, specification, procurement, and implementation of interior finishes and materials.
* Ensure finishes meet required quality, design, technical, durability, and commercial standards.
* Establish and maintain relationships with key suppliers, manufacturers, contractors, and specialist subcontractors.
* Drive value engineering initiatives without compromising the overall design intent or customer experience.
* Ensure material selections and specifications are aligned with approved budgets and project timelines.
* Monitor material costs, lead times, procurement risks, and market availability.
* Ensure effective quality control throughout installation and final delivery.

**6. Financial & Cost Management:**

* Ensure robust financial controls are implemented across all projects and the overall business line.
* Monitor project budgets, actual costs, commitments, forecasts, and projected margins.
* Establish mechanisms to identify and address cost overruns at an early stage.
* Drive cost optimization and value engineering initiatives across design, procurement, and execution.
* Ensure all commercial variations and additional works are properly evaluated, approved, priced, and documented.
* Work closely with Finance to monitor revenue recognition, billing, collections, cash flow, and project profitability.
* Review project financial performance and take corrective action where required.
* Ensure lessons learned from completed projects are incorporated into future pricing, budgeting, and delivery strategies.

**7. Procurement & Supply Chain:**

* Develop procurement strategies that support project timelines, quality requirements, and targeted margins.
* Oversee the procurement of materials, furniture, fixtures, finishes, and specialist works where applicable.
* Establish a strong supplier and subcontractor network to ensure competitive pricing and reliable delivery.
* Negotiate commercial terms, payment conditions, lead times, warranties, and service levels.
* Ensure procurement decisions support the overall project commercial strategy.
* Identify opportunities for framework agreements and strategic sourcing to improve cost efficiency and margins.

**8. Client & Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for key clients and strategic projects.
* Build long-term relationships with clients and understand their commercial, design, and operational requirements.
* Lead executive-level discussions regarding project performance, commercial matters, design decisions, and strategic issues.
* Ensure a high level of client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage expectations and ensure commitments made to clients are commercially and operationally achievable.
* Represent the company professionally in negotiations, presentations, industry events, and business development activities.

**9. Team Leadership & Organizational Development:**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Interior Design & Finishes organization.
* Define the appropriate organizational structure, roles, responsibilities, and reporting lines required to support the business.
* Set clear performance objectives and KPIs for the department.
* Develop the capabilities of project management, design, commercial, procurement, and technical teams.
* Establish a culture of accountability, commercial ownership, innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Identify critical talent and develop succession plans for key positions.
* Ensure effective workforce planning and resource allocation across the project portfolio.

**10. Governance, Risk & Compliance:**

* Establish appropriate governance and approval mechanisms across the Interior Design & Finishes business.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, contractual requirements, applicable regulations, and project standards.
* Identify commercial, contractual, operational, design, and delivery risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and controls are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor contractual obligations and work closely with Legal and Commercial teams on claims, disputes, and contractual matters.
* Ensure health, safety, quality, and environmental standards are maintained across project execution.

**11. Process Improvement & Business Transformation:**

* Review and continuously improve the operating model, processes, and systems of the Interior Design & Finishes function.
* Introduce effective project management and commercial control methodologies.
* Develop dashboards and performance reporting to provide visibility on revenue, margins, pipeline, project progress, and risks.
* Leverage technology and digital solutions to improve project monitoring, design coordination, cost management, and reporting.
* Establish lessons-learned mechanisms and continuously improve project delivery practices.
* Drive a performance-oriented culture focused on revenue growth, margin improvement, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in **Interior Design, Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management**, or a related field from a reputable university.
* A Master's degree or MBA would be an advantage.
* **20+ years of progressive experience** across Interior Design, Fit-Out, Finishes, Construction, Project Management, or related sectors.
* Significant experience in a **senior leadership role managing complex interior design and/or fit-out projects**.
* Strong proven experience in **commercial management, P&L ownership, budgeting, costing, pricing, and profitability management**.
* Demonstrated experience in managing the complete project lifecycle from design through execution and handover.
* Strong track record of delivering large-scale and complex projects within budget and timeline.
* Experience in developing new business and building a sustainable commercial pipeline.
* Strong understanding of procurement, subcontracting, contracts, variations, claims, and project controls.
* Experience working with high-end residential, hospitality, commercial, retail, or mixed-use developments is highly preferred.

title: Data Engineer
details:
**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics practice. The successful candidate will build and operate enterprise-scale data solutions using PySpark, Apache Spark and modern data engineering technologies, with a strong grounding in data warehousing, lakehouse architecture and large-scale data integration.

The target environment uses Cloudera Data Platform (CDP). Prior Cloudera experience is preferred but is not a mandatory requirement. Candidates with strong PySpark/Spark expertise and relevant experience on comparable enterprise data platforms will be considered, and Cloudera CDP upskilling will be provided to the selected candidate.

This role requires hands-on engineering capability, technical ownership and effective collaboration with architects, analysts, source-system teams and client stakeholders. Experience in banking and financial services is highly desirable.

Critical hiring priority: Strong, production-grade PySpark/Spark engineering skills and the ability to rapidly learn and work effectively within the Cloudera CDP environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Data Engineering & Development

Design, develop, test and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using PySpark.

Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for large-volume enterprise data workloads.

Develop reusable ingestion, transformation and validation frameworks.

Implement data quality controls, reconciliation checks, monitoring and operational logging.

Support dimensional, warehouse, data lake and lakehouse data modeling activities.

Apply Spark performance optimization techniques including partitioning, join optimization, caching and handling data skew.

Cloudera Platform Engineering

Develop and run Spark workloads within the Cloudera Data Platform (CDP) environment.

Work with components including Cloudera Data Engineering (CDE), Cloudera Data Warehouse (CDW), Hive, Impala, Ozone, Ranger, Atlas and NiFi.

Configure, execute, monitor and troubleshoot Spark workloads.

Performance-tune PySpark jobs, Spark configurations, SQL queries and Hive/Impala workloads.

Diagnose platform, ingestion, transformation, storage and workload execution issues.

Apply security, access-control, metadata and lineage practices using Ranger and Atlas.

Candidates without prior Cloudera experience will be expected to complete the required Cloudera enablement/upskilling and apply their existing Spark and data engineering knowledge to the platform.

Architecture, Governance & Delivery

Contribute to lakehouse implementations using modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg.

Apply engineering standards covering modular design, code quality, testing, version control and CI/CD.

Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, technical estimation and design reviews.

Support system integration testing, UAT, production deployment and operational readiness.

Produce clear technical documentation and deliver structured knowledge-transfer sessions.

Collaborate effectively with distributed, multicultural teams and technical and business stakeholders.

  

**Candidate Profile**

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.

At least 4 years of professional experience in data engineering.

At least 3 years of hands-on PySpark / Apache Spark development experience.

Experience delivering large-scale enterprise data pipelines and ETL/ELT solutions.

Cloudera CDP experience is an advantage, but not mandatory. Strong candidates from comparable Spark-based data platforms are encouraged to apply.

✓ PySpark

✓ ETL/ELT development
  
✓ Data warehousing concepts
  
✓ Linux

Cloudera CDP

Cloudera CDE and CDW

Hive and Impala

Ranger and Atlas

Apache NiFi and Kafka

Apache Airflow

Denodo and Informatica

Oracle and Teradata

Azure data services

DevOps and CI/CD pipelines

**Preferred Domain Background**

Banking and financial services

Digital banking platforms

Customer analytics

Regulatory reporting

Enterprise data warehousing

Data lakehouse implementation and migration programs

  

**Behavioural Competencies**

Strong analytical thinking and structured problem solving.

Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and deliver reliably.

Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team capability building.

Ability and willingness to quickly learn new data platforms and technologies.

Comfort working in distributed and multicultural delivery teams.

* Ensuring campaigns and content are executed seamlessly, meeting brand standards and performance goals.
* Providing meaningful insights and recommendations through reporting and analysis.

At Tribe X, we champion impact without ego by fostering a high-performance environment where your voice matters and your ideas scale. ------------

The Engineer - Procurement is responsible for providing process-driven execution and documentation support across the end‑to‑end Direct Procurement process within the Central Procurement Office (CPO), aligned to and supporting the Canada / USA procurement team.

This role ensures that all steps from Bid RFP Evaluation Recommendation PO/LOA are delivered accurately, on time, and in full compliance with established governance, service-delivery expectations, and process standards.

The Engineer - Procurement will work under the day‑to‑day direction of the Sr. Manager – Procurement (Core Process), with overall accountability held by the Associate Director, Direct Procurement. The role is focused on execution, coordination, and documentation support, and is not expected to make final commercial decisions, approve exceptions, or own strategic supplier outcomes; such matters must be escalated through the Sr. Manager – Procurement or Associate Director, as applicable.

**Your role**

* Undertake the suppliers financial and basic due diligence checks and evaluations
* Prepare SAB documentation.

* Assist in data gathering, analysis support, and preparation of materials for category-level review where needed.

* Good communication and coordination skills across internal and external stakeholders, including remote support to regional procurement teams.
* Proactive and solution-oriented, with a willingness to learn, improve processes, and solve day‑to‑day operational issues.
* Process Execution.
* Analytical & Commercial Fundamentals.
* Stakeholder Communication.
* Systems & Data Accuracy.
* Risk Awareness & Compliance Discipline.
* Time Management & Prioritisation.
* Collaboration & Team Mindset.

**Experience*** At least 3–5 years in B2B or technical sales, ideally in energy, power, industrial equipment or mining. A network in these sectors is an advantage.

title: QA Manager
details:
Requirements and responsibilities

**Job Description: AI-Native QA Manager**
=========================================

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an **AI-Native QA Manager** to transform how software quality is delivered. This is not a traditional QA leadership role—we're looking for someone who has already demonstrated measurable improvements in QA productivity, quality, and speed through the practical application of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices.

You'll lead a team responsible for quality across multiple SaaS products while fundamentally rethinking how testing is performed. We expect you to leverage AI agents, intelligent test automation, autonomous testing frameworks, and modern CI/CD practices to dramatically increase engineering velocity without compromising quality.

Experience in **Life Sciences, Healthcare, Medical Devices, or other regulated software environments** is highly desirable.

  

**What You'll Do**

**AI-Driven QA Transformation**

* Develop and execute an AI-first strategy for software quality.

* Introduce AI tools that significantly improve test creation, maintenance, defect detection, regression testing, and release confidence.

* Evaluate and implement emerging AI QA platforms, coding assistants, autonomous testing tools, and agentic workflows.

* Continuously measure productivity gains and quality improvements from AI adoption.

**QA Leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a distributed QA team.

* Establish quality standards across manual, automated, API, integration, UI and performance testing.

* Drive automation-first thinking while eliminating low-value manual work.

* Build scalable QA processes that support rapid software delivery.

**Engineering Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management and DevOps.

* Embed quality throughout the SDLC rather than treating QA as a downstream gate.

* Improve developer feedback loops through automation and intelligent tooling.

* Champion shift-left testing practices.

**Modern Test Automation**

* Improve automation coverage and reliability.

* Reduce regression execution times through intelligent automation.

* Build maintainable test frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

* Increase release confidence through automated quality metrics.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Own metrics such as:

* Test automation coverage

* Defect escape rate

* Mean time to detect defects

* Regression execution time

* QA cycle time

* Release quality

* Productivity improvements from AI

* Cost per release

* Manual effort eliminated

  

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 7+ years in Software QA, including leadership experience.

* Demonstrated success improving QA productivity through AI, automation, or modern engineering practices.

* Experience leading QA teams across multiple products.

* Strong understanding of modern software development practices and CI/CD.

* Experience with API, UI, integration and end-to-end testing.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable working in fast-moving SaaS environments.

**AI Experience (Highly Important)**

You should have practical experience using tools such as:

* GitHub Copilot

* Cursor

* Claude

* ChatGPT

* AI coding agents

* AI test generation platforms

* Autonomous testing tools

* AI-assisted debugging

* AI-assisted root cause analysis

We're interested in measurable outcomes, not simply familiarity with AI.

Examples include:

* Reduced regression effort by 70%

* Increased automation coverage from 40% to 90%

* Doubled QA throughput

* Reduced escaped defects

* Built AI workflows that replaced repetitive manual testing

  

**Bonus Experience**

Strong preference for candidates with experience in:

* Life Sciences software

* Clinical software

* Medical Affairs platforms

* GxP environments

* FDA-regulated software

* ISO 13485

* IEC 62304

* HIPAA

* SOC 2

* Other regulated industries (banking, aviation, insurance, government)

  

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

Within your first year, you will:

* Increase QA team productivity by **2–5x** through AI and automation.

* Significantly reduce manual regression testing.

* Improve release confidence while increasing release frequency.

* Implement AI-assisted test generation and maintenance.

* Embed quality throughout the SDLC rather than relying on end-of-cycle testing.

* Establish clear quality metrics and executive dashboards.

* Build a culture where QA engineers leverage AI as a core part of their daily workflow.

  

**Why Join Us**

You'll have the opportunity to reshape software quality from the ground up across a growing portfolio of SaaS products. We believe AI is fundamentally changing software engineering, and we want QA to lead that transformation—not follow it.

If you're excited about replacing repetitive work with intelligent automation, building AI-enabled teams, and delivering higher-quality software faster, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who ships complex product experiences end to end—from epic discovery with Product through design decisions and production-ready UI. You’ll lead the frontend on a Ruby on Rails platform while also building and evolving React-based experiences where the product needs richer client-side interaction. Product & epic partnership

Own features end-to-end: discovery design alignment implementation QA handoff* production follow-through and iterative improvement.

* Experience partnering with Product Owners on epic-level work—scoping, sequencing, and refining requirements into delivery plans
* Regular participation in design decision forums; ability to influence UX toward feasible, consistent, accessible outcomes
* Hands-on experience developing against Dockerized applications (building/running containers, Compose-based local setups, troubleshooting environment issues that block frontend delivery)
* Solid grasp of frontend architecture patterns (componentization, progressive enhancement, separation of concerns, API-driven UI) and pragmatic design judgment
* Proven collaboration with backend engineers on contracts, integrations, and production issues across the stack
* Strong code-review practice: thorough, timely reviews that raise quality without blocking unnecessarily, and a track record of mentoring through review feedback.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across browser, JS, and Rails-adjacent layers
* Active proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar)—fluent in prompting, context management, and knowing when human judgment is essential
* Comfortable owning features from ideation through production monitoring and iterative improvement

The Technical Lead acts as the technical authority across a portfolio of Azure cloud, hybrid or on-prem products supporting manufacturing operations. The role owns technical direction and engineering quality while working in partnership with Product Teams, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, IT/OT, operations, and external partners, the Technical Lead ensures high engineering quality, resolves complex issues, and supports solutions from proof of concept through production and ongoing evolution.

  
  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**• Technical leadership:** Set the technical direction for the product portfolio and guide internal teams and external partners through design, build, test, deployment, transition and continuous improvement.

**• Solution design:** Translate functional and non-functional requirements into solution architecture, technical specifications, integration designs, engineering enablers and delivery plans.

**• Technical decision-making:** Make and document decisions covering technology selection, solution patterns, security controls, integration approaches, deployment models and engineering trade-offs.

**• Azure architecture:** Design and review Azure solutions against security, availability, performance, resilience, scalability, observability, supportability and cost requirements. Ensure solution designs align with enterprise cloud governance, FinOps principles

**• Product-specific engineering:** Ensure the products use coherent patterns for identity, APIs, data, image processing, IoT connectivity, edge computing, mobile/web experiences, monitoring and operational support.

**• Architecture and governance alignment:** Work with Enterprise, Platform and Solution Architecture, Cyber Security, Data, Cloud Infrastructure and IT/OT teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards and approved roadmaps.

**• Integration and data:** Define secure integration patterns across plant systems, Azure services, enterprise platforms and downstream applications, with clear ownership of interfaces, data quality and failure handling.

**• DevSecOps and automation:** Establish effective practices for source control, code review, CI/CD, testing, release approvals, rollback, Infrastructure as Code, secrets management and traceability.

**• Engineering quality:** Set standards for code, design, testing, documentation and technical debt; conduct architecture, design and code reviews and ensure sustainable corrective actions.

**• Operational readiness:** Define monitoring, logging, alerting, service-level expectations, disaster recovery, support models, handover requirements and lifecycle plans before production release.

**• Troubleshooting:** Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex issues spanning application, cloud, network, identity, security, data, API, IoT and deployment layers. Ensure lessons learned are translated into measurable engineering improvements

**• Team capability:** Mentor engineers and developers, strengthen internal capability, promote knowledge sharing and reduce dependency on individual contributors and suppliers.

**• Stakeholder communication:** Explain technical options, risks, dependencies and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, enabling timely decisions.

**• Innovation and optimization:** Assess emerging technology pragmatically and recommend improvements that increase business value, adoption, reliability, delivery speed or cost efficiency.

  

**ARE THESE YOUR SECRET INGREDIENTS?**

**• Education:** Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**• Professional experience:** Significant experience in cloud architecture, software engineering, application integration or a comparable technical domain, including experience as a Technical Lead, Solution Architect, Principal Engineer or similar senior role.

**• Microsoft Azure:** Strong knowledge of Azure solution architecture and cloud-native services. Experience should include relevant compute, storage, integration, API management, identity, secrets, monitoring and governance capabilities.

**• Application engineering:** Experience working with edge-computing platforms, offline first architectures and distributed deployments in manufacturing environments. Strong understanding of modern web and mobile application patterns, APIs, event-driven integration, backend services, data persistence and distributed-system design.

**• AI and computer vision:** Working knowledge of image ingestion, computer vision or OCR workflows, model/service integration, confidence handling, validation, monitoring and responsible operational use.

**• IoT and manufacturing data:** Working knowledge of industrial IoT patterns, telemetry ingestion, edge-to-cloud connectivity, time-series data, equipment integration and the constraints of manufacturing environments. Experience integrating manufacturing applications with MES, PLC, SCADA, historians, maintenance and quality-management systems.

**• Identity and security:** Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, application identities, authentication and authorization, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, certificate management, security by design and least privilege.

**• Networking:** Good understanding of Azure networking and private connectivity, including VNets, subnets, DNS, routing, firewalls, private endpoints and hybrid connectivity.

**• DevOps:** Strong knowledge of Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, release management, Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms, automated testing and Infrastructure as Code.

**• Reliability and operations:** Ability to define and review non-functional requirements covering availability, performance, resilience, scalability, maintainability, observability, disaster recovery and supportability.

**• Leadership and communication:** Demonstrated ability to lead across multiple technical domains, make sound decisions, manage stakeholders and communicate complex topics clearly.

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience implementing computer vision, OCR, AI-assisted search or industrial IoT solutions.
