title: Premium Partner Support Team Leader
details:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

**Role Summary**

The Partner Support Team Leader – Frontline leads a team of Advisors who support our partners across phone, chat, email and WhatsApp. You’ll make sure every partner gets fast, accurate and personal support, and an experience that exceeds their expectations.

You’ll develop your people, deliver your team’s performance targets, and help bring Partner Support’s key initiatives, including AI and automation, to life on the frontline.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Deliver an exceptional partner experience**

* Make sure every partner gets fast, accurate and personal support that exceeds their expectations.
* Shift the team from reactive to proactive support, spotting partner needs before they become issues.
* Own frontline escalations through to resolution, keeping partners informed at every step.
* Raise incidents quickly when contact spikes signal a platform issue, and hand complex technical issues to Tech Operations with full context, following through until the partner is updated.

**Lead and develop the team**

* Lead, motivate and develop Advisors through regular 1:1s, side-by-side coaching and clear development plans.
* Set clear goals and expectations and manage performance fairly, recognising strong performance and addressing gaps early through improvement plans where needed.
* Manage attendance, punctuality, leave and absence.
* Use quality results, calibration sessions and insights from the Quality team to find skill gaps and focus coaching and refresher training where it matters most.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement, keeping the team engaged and attrition low.
* Take part in hiring and onboarding new Advisors.
* Identify and grow future Team Leaders and subject-matter experts.

**Deliver performance**

* Deliver team KPIs: SLA, first-contact resolution, average handle time, resolution time, CSAT, quality, productivity, schedule adherence and AI adoption.
* Run the daily frontline operation: huddles, shift handovers, real-time queue monitoring and moving Advisors between channels and queues to protect service level.
* Manage schedules, breaks and schedule adherence in line with the WFM plan.
* Make sure Advisors follow SOPs, policies, tagging and case-handling standards.
* Use data to find top contact drivers and repeat contacts, and suggest process, knowledge or tool improvements.
* Track performance daily, weekly and monthly, act on gaps quickly, and present results, insights and improvement ideas to management.

**Support strategic initiatives**

* Bring Partner Support initiatives to life on the frontline, from new tools and processes to service standards.
* Drive adoption of AI tools, suggested replies and knowledge search, and manage AI-to-human handoffs.
* Feed AI failures, knowledge gaps and partner feedback back to improve AI, workflows and knowledge.
* Guide partners to self-service and digital channels where they work best.
* Share updates, product changes and priorities with the team, and work closely with WFM, Quality, Training and other teams.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.
* 5+ years in Customer Support or Customer Operations, including 2+ years as a frontline Team Leader, ideally in tech, SaaS or marketplace businesses.
* Proven track record of meeting SLA, quality and CSAT targets in a multi-channel environment.
* Practical experience with AI tools, chatbots or automation in support, and working knowledge of WFM and intraday management.
* Strong coaching, performance management and escalation handling skills.
* Comfortable with dashboards, Excel/Google Sheets and CRM/ticketing tools (Salesforce, Zendesk or similar).
* Clear communication and presentation skills; fluent English and Arabic.

**Other Capabilities**

* Bias for impact: Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than activity and is comfortable challenging processes that do not create value.
* Customer obsessed: Understands the operational realities of our Real Estate partners and advocates for solutions that genuinely make it easier for them to do business with Property Finder.
* Technology curious: Actively experiments with AI and emerging technologies rather than waiting for solutions to be provided.
* Data driven: Uses evidence to identify problems, prioritise opportunities and measure success.
* Cross-functional influencer: Able to turn Partner Support insight into action across Product, Engineering, Commercial and Customer Experience.
* High ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes end-to-end and operates effectively in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
* Operational excellence: Runs a disciplined operation and reacts fast when things change.
* Coach first: Grows people through regular, practical feedback.

### **Our promise to talent**

At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.

**Property Finder Guiding Principles**

* Think Future First
* Data Beats Opinions, Speed Beats Perfection
* Optimise for Impact
* Act Like An Owner
* The Biggest Risk is Taking no Risk at All

title: AI Technical Lead
details:
Requirements and responsibilities

  

Lead Software Engineer

[Location] · [Full-time] · [Compensation range]

  

About Vigilix

Vigilix keeps about 100,000 point-of-sale systems in restaurants and grocery stores patched, monitored, and supported. We recently moved our platform from a colocation data center to AWS, and the next chapter is modernizing a system built largely on legacy VB.NET and WebForms — while bringing AWS costs under control.

  

The opportunity

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer to shape that modernization strategy and carry it out. On a small team, with a dedicated infrastructure and DevOps engineer as your partner, you'll have real ownership of the architecture and the roadmap. We expect you to use AI tools like Claude Code to understand and modernize large parts of the system faster and more safely than a traditional rewrite would allow — and we'll support you in doing it.

  

Your team

You'll lead a three-person engineering team: you, an infrastructure and DevOps engineer, and a developer you'll direct day to day. You'll work closely with our operations and product lead, who brings customer needs straight to engineering, and you'll report to our Managing Director.

  

What you'll do

* Assess the current system and define the modernization strategy and roadmap, then carry it out without disrupting customers

* Use AI-assisted development to map, test, and rewrite large parts of the codebase, with tests that prove behavior is preserved

* Partner with the infrastructure engineer on staged, low-downtime releases, testing under realistic load, with fast rollback when needed

* Set code standards, review code, and direct and mentor the team's developer

* Fix security issues in the code and build secure practices into how the team works, in a PCI-scoped environment

* Turn customer needs into technical priorities with operations and product

* Help bring AWS and licensing costs down through engineering choices, working with the infrastructure engineer

* Act as the escalation point for application incidents, including a shared on-call rotation with the infrastructure engineer

  

Your first year

* Assess the platform and set a modernization strategy — which could include replacing WebForms and VB.NET components, moving file-based message processing to a message broker, or other approaches you recommend

* Work with the infrastructure engineer on the database direction: keeping the current multi-terabyte SQL Server database healthy while planning a long-term move to PostgreSQL on a managed service such as Amazon RDS or Aurora

* Establish a release process with automated testing, staged rollout, and rollback

* Deliver the first steps of the modernization plan

  

What you bring

* 8+ years of professional software development, including several years leading engineers

* Deep C# and .NET skills — legacy .NET Framework and WebForms as well as modern .NET — with comfort reading and changing VB.NET

* Strong relational database skills: enough SQL Server to support and tune a production system at scale, plus hands-on PostgreSQL and managed databases such as Amazon RDS or Aurora (migration experience from SQL Server a strong plus)

* Real experience using AI coding tools to modernize or rewrite large codebases — and examples you can walk us through

* A track record of modernizing a legacy system while it stayed in production

* Modern web development (e.g., React), web API design, and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect

* Secure coding practices (OWASP) and secrets management

* Clear communication with non-technical colleagues and genuine curiosity about how customers use the product

  

Nice to have

* Broader AWS experience

* RabbitMQ or another message broker

* Duende IdentityServer or Python

* C++ or Windows agent development

* RMM, MSP, or point-of-sale software experience

* PCI DSS experience

  

How we work

We communicate early, document decisions, ship in small pieces, and own problems end to end. We don't fix things directly in production, and we treat customer issues as part of the job — not interruptions.

details:

title: Technical Lead (PHP, Laravel & Adobe Commerce)
details:
**Who are we?**

A world where complexity is the only constant demands a new breed of company. Brave Bison is a different beast: a media, marketing and technology company purpose built for the digital era.

  

Our universe is made up of award-winning business arms Brave Bison, Engage, SocialChain and MTM. And we’re underpinned by leading marketing training practice, MiniMBA, as well as our very own social-first media network who deliver monthly views in the billions for some of the biggest channels in sport and entertainment across YouTube, Snap, Meta and TikTok.

We’re a global collective who live and breathe digital, working with some of the boldest brands in the world to capitalise on the complexity that defines the modern marketing landscape.

**Our mission**

New platforms, new behaviours, new audiences, new trends, new technologies, new regulations—our clients’ worlds get more complex daily. Their agency partnerships shouldn’t. It’s our job to cut through the chaos, make the complex simple and navigate a clear path to growth for them.

That’s why we make it our mission to **capitalise on complexity** for our clients—across consultancy, capability and execution—by crafting dynamic digital solutions that outpace tomorrow’s challenges.

**Our values**

We’re a proudly diverse business comprised of deep specialists across social media, digital marketing and technology. Although our skills, backgrounds and beliefs may differ, we are united by four core shared values:

* **Bold Curiosity.**

We run at change and challenge convention because we love to push the boundaries of what the world thinks is possible. We champion discovery, go deep into our clients’ worlds and are always hungry to learn more about them, our specialisms and each other.

  

* **Connected Clarity.**

We are focused in our collaboration — joining the right dots between our clients, our partners and our herd of experts to deliver agile solutions at speed and scale. We set a shared ambition from the outset, are transparent at every stage and always strive to make the complex simple.

  

* **Positive Encouragement.**

We want to make working with us the best part of someone’s day. We lift one other up, find the fun in the day to day and are committed to ensuring everyone belongs.

  

* **Constant Impact.**

We believe in outcomes over outputs. We’re goal orientated, results driven and data led. We show up with passion every day. And we’re always honing our craft.

**Brave Bison Commerce**

With over 300 ecommerce projects and £2billion worth of transactions under our belt, we’ve designed and built hundreds of bespoke digital solutions for complex B2B, B2C, D2C and B2B2C companies.

Whether we’re modernising a monolith platform or building a fully composable solution, we ensure our clients are ready to meet customers anywhere – online, mobile, in-store or on social – unlocking a brave new world of possibility.

**Job Specification**

We are looking for a Technical Lead with deep expertise in PHP, Laravel and Adobe Commerce (Magento) to join Brave Bison Commerce. You will set the technical direction on client projects and lead the engineers who deliver them. This is a client-facing role: you will run discovery work, explain technical decisions to stakeholders at every level and confidently recommend improvements and upgrades that help our clients get more from their platforms. If you enjoy hands-on engineering as much as shaping solutions with clients, we would love to hear from you.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Technical leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of PHP developers, setting coding standards, reviewing code and supporting their professional growth.
* Own the technical design of Adobe Commerce and Laravel solutions, from architecture and integrations through to deployment.
* Stay hands-on, writing high-quality code and stepping into complex problems where your experience makes the biggest difference.
* Plan and estimate technical work with project managers, keeping delivery on track and raising risks early.
* Champion good engineering practice, including automated testing, CI/CD, performance optimisation and security.
* Oversee platform upgrades, patching and migrations, including Magento 2 version upgrades and third-party extension management.

  

**Clients and growth**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact for clients, joining calls and workshops and building trusted relationships.
* Lead technical discoveries: auditing existing platforms, gathering requirements and turning them into clear solution designs, estimates and roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve clients’ platforms, such as upgrades, performance work, new features or integrations, and present them as well-reasoned recommendations and proposals.
* Work with account and sales teams to scope and support upsell opportunities and new business pitches.
* Translate complex technical topics into plain language for non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Significant commercial experience as a PHP developer (typically 7+ years), including time in a lead or senior role.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Adobe Commerce / Magento 2, including custom module development, theming, checkout, performance tuning and upgrades.
* Strong Laravel experience, including building APIs, services and standalone applications that integrate with ecommerce platforms.
* Experience integrating ecommerce platforms with third-party systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, payment gateways and search.
* Proven experience leading development teams, including code review, mentoring and technical planning.
* Confidence in client-facing situations, with experience running discovery sessions, workshops or technical presentations.
* A commercial mindset, with the ability to spot improvements and upgrades and clearly explain their value to clients.
* Solid working knowledge of MySQL, Git, Composer and cloud or hosting environments (for example Adobe Commerce Cloud or AWS).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Power BI experience, for example building reports or dashboards.
* Adobe Commerce developer or architect certifications.
* Experience with Hyvä Themes or headless and composable frontends.
* Agency or consultancy experience working across multiple clients.
* Familiarity with other ecommerce platforms such as Shopify Plus or BigCommerce.

  

Finally, we’re proud and committed to being an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal opportunities for all and treating all existing employees and all job applicants in the same way, regardless of their age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity status and marital & civil partnership status

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading electronics hardware design and development activities, including analog and digital circuit design, PCB development, component selection, prototype testing, and technical validation.

title: LD&T Assistant Analyst
details:
Overview:

The key purpose of this role is to manage and coordinate export transportation planning and execution activities from KSA to Gulf and Levant markets, ensuring efficient shipment fulfillment and achievement of business requirements.

The role focuses on managing export shipment plans, coordinating transportation capacity, monitoring shipment execution, and ensuring effective alignment between Supply Chain Planning, Production, Warehousing, Commercial, Customer Service, Transportation teams, and destination markets.

The job holder will drive operational efficiency, optimize transportation utilization, ensure timely order dispatch, proactively manage operational risks, and support the achievement of customer service levels and overall logistics cost management.

Responsibilities:

### **1. Gulf & Levant Export Transportation Planning & Execution**

* Develop and manage export shipment plans for Gulf and Levant markets in alignment with market demand, confirmed orders, production plans, and available stock.
* Coordinate export order readiness and ensure timely shipment execution from KSA distribution centers and warehouses.
* Monitor daily shipped quantities, booked orders, pending shipments, and shipment projections to ensure achievement of export targets.
* Coordinate with warehouse and transportation teams to ensure sufficient truck availability and timely dispatch against confirmed shipment requirements.
* Manage shipment priorities based on destination market requirements, order commitments, product availability, and business priorities.
* Proactively identify shipment risks, delays, and operational constraints, ensuring timely escalation and resolution.
* Manage exceptional shipment requirements, including urgent orders, priority loads, and changes in shipment plans.

### **2. Warehouse & Transportation Capacity Management**

* Coordinate with RUH and DMM warehouses and transportation teams to secure the required truck capacity in line with export shipment plans.
* Monitor daily truck availability, loading capacity, warehouse utilization, and dispatch performance.
* Develop and communicate transportation capacity requirements and truck forecasts to relevant stakeholders and carriers.
* Follow up on truck allocation, loading schedules, and offloading status across destination markets.
* Ensure effective utilization of available transportation resources and warehouse loading capacity.

### **3. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Supply Chain Planning, Production, Warehousing, Commercial, Customer Service, and Transportation teams to ensure smooth export operations.
* Coordinate with Gulf and Levant destination markets to align shipment priorities, order requirements, and delivery expectations.
* Lead regular operational follow-ups to review shipment progress, pending orders, capacity constraints, and potential business risks.
* Ensure clear and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders regarding shipment updates, delays, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate the resolution of order-related issues, including credit holds, production constraints, stock shortages, and shipment readiness.

### **4. Export Performance Management & Reporting**

* Monitor and report daily export performance, including shipped quantities, booked orders, pending shipments, and projected month-end closure.
* Develop and maintain shipment tracking dashboards and performance reports to provide visibility on export operations.
* Monitor key transportation and export KPIs, including truck availability, dispatch performance, shipment execution, and order fulfillment.
* Prepare and communicate weekly and monthly performance updates to management and relevant stakeholders.
* Analyze performance gaps against shipment targets, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions.

### **5. Process Improvement, Automation & Analytics**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and operational processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and automated trackers using Power BI, Excel, and other available systems.
* Utilize data analytics to identify operational trends, shipment risks, and root causes of performance gaps.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline export transportation processes and enhance operational visibility.
* Support the standardization of reporting processes and performance monitoring across Gulf and Levant export operations.

Qualifications:

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transportation, or Export Operations (FMCG experience is preferred).
* Basic understanding of transportation planning, warehouse operations, and international export logistics.
* Knowledge of SAP and transportation management processes is preferred.

**Abilities & Competencies**
----------------------------

* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including automation and macro development.
* Experience with Power BI and data visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* High ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive operational efficiency.
* Strong planning, coordination, and follow-up capabilities.

details:

Setting the vision, governance, and commercial roadmap for all artificial‑intelligence capabilities that power the governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform being built by Allendevaux & Company.

Are you equally fluent in GPU cap‑ex spreadsheets and AI‑ethics scorecards? Do you inspire data‑scientists and reassure regulators in the same meeting? As Chief AI Officer you will:

* Craft and own the enterprise‑wide AI strategy, budget, and OKRs.
* Direct all AI model R&D—including Llama 3, Mixtral 8×7B and successor models—and decide make‑vs‑buy across open‑source and commercial LLMs.
* Chair the Responsible‑AI board, ensuring ISO 42001, EU AI Act, and other regulations trustworthiness requirements are met.
* Lead a growing team of AI Systems, ML/LLM, MLOps, and Prompt‑Engineering professionals, mentoring staff and hiring successors.
* Evangelise AI capabilities to investors, enterprise clients, and federal agencies, translating technical differentiators into business value.

  

BACKGROUND  
At Allendevaux & Company, we are combining deep regulatory expertise with advanced AI to build a governance, risk and compliance platform, automating data protection and AI governance. As CAIO, you will convert the AI R&D into secure, revenue‑generating services trusted by global enterprises.

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS & SKILLS

  

* Excellent spoken and written English proficiency.
* Board‑level communicator, able to translate GPU utilisation into ROI and risk posture.
* Visionary yet pragmatic—balances cutting‑edge research with product deadlines.
* Mentor and culture builder who scales diverse, cross‑disciplinary AI teams.
* Governance champion who instinctively aligns innovation with stdandards such as ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and regulations such as the EU GDPR and the EU AI Act.

  

RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Strategy & P/L**: Define the multi‑year AI roadmap, allocate GPU and cloud spend, and track ROI on AI‑driven revenue lines.

* Prior responsibility for ISO 42001 or comparable Responsible‑AI frameworks.

* Implement and control shift production operational activities of seven Ball Cement Mill and one Solid Fuel grinding mill in order to ensure highest and most effective performance for all team to keep optimum operation conditions for all production lines with highest equipment availability, maximum productivity and highest product quality to achieve the production objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Health & Safety:**

* Adhere to and enforce relevant legislation, as well as the Company's HSE Policies, Rules, and Standards.

* Follow all HSE Procedures, both Management and Operational.

* Commit to gain all HSE competencies and capabilities relevant to the job role, as outlined in the country HSE training matrix (mandatory for the position or required based on the individual's activities).

**Functional:**

* Receive and handover all production shift events, obstacles and achieve tasks and report all events in the production shift report to monitor production process.
* Execute and stick to the production plan in accordance with the required work standards and maintain the equipment proper condition to ensure production continuity with minimum down time.
* Plan and Stick to the preventive maintenance schedule and ensure the execution of the planned activities.
* Implement the protocol of new required trials of new products or enhance the current products.
* Reporting operation weak points and notes with providing creative solutions and implementing this solution during operation or shutdown according to its availability, to ensure continuous development.
* Follow up the required production plan in accordance with the required work standards and maintain the equipment proper condition to ensure production continuity with minimum down time.
* Ensure Reliability, output and full utilization of all sorting machines.
* Ensure quality of sorted balls to minimize wear parts cost.
* Report any noncompliance of ball quality to the supplier.
* Implement Holcim Safety Standards and Integrate safety into all shift operations and ensure working conditions and safety at work (Holcim employees and contractors).
* Implement Holcim environmental compliances regarding main stacks emissions and fugitive dust.
* Operate the production line with achieving the quality targets in all cement types.
* Reinforce the WBI implementation (quality and quantity ) through the shift team
* On- job training and coaching for the shift team
* Monitor, record, and validate all equipment stoppages in the Technical Information System (TIS) online stop log in real time. Ensure high accuracy in assigning standardized stoppage reasons, writing clear and detailed root-cause comments, and verifying downtime durations to support reliable plant performance analysis and maintenance follow-up.
* Consolidate operational and equipment issues across all five production lines ahead of the Daily Operations Meeting (DOM), take the lead in presenting these findings during the meeting, and align with the designated maintenance teams on action plans and resolution timelines.
* Ensure seamless 24/7 operational continuity by delivering a structured, comprehensive shift recap between night and day shifts (and vice versa) covering line status, unresolved issues, and pending maintenance actions.
* Maintain and update the online Shift Contingency Sheet in real time throughout the shift, logging emerging equipment defects, pending maintenance notifications/work orders, and opportunity-maintenance tasks across all five lines so maintenance teams can immediately execute priority interventions during planned or unplanned stoppages.
* Continuously optimize mill feed rates, separator speeds, circulating loads, and grinding aid / strength enhancer dosing to maximize throughput (tph) and achieve target Blaine/residue fineness at the lowest specific electrical energy consumption (kWh/t) during shift hours.
* Control throughout the shift responsible and shift operators the clinker, gypsum, and additive bin levels across all running lines to prevent mill starvation, and execute clean cement grade online changeovers and silo routing according to the dispatch and production schedule without product cross-contamination.

* **Independent & Accountable:** High level of self-direction, punctuality, and proactive problem-solving.

* Familiarity with market research tools (e.g., Helium 10, Amazon Brand Analytics, ChatGPT).
* Experience optimizing listings for European marketplaces (DE, FR, IT, ES)

title: Associate Consultant Intern, Summer 2027 – Egypt
details:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Associate Consultant Intern, Summer 2027 – EgyptWhy join Mastercard’s internship program?  
  
Mastercard's internship program offers more than hands-on work. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities.  
  
About the team  
  
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.  
  
What you’ll do  
  
As an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.  
  
You will:  
  
Work in small teams to support strategic consulting projects across industries  
  
Collaborate with colleagues across different areas of the organization and gain exposure to business development, account management, and product management  
  
Analyze data, identify trends, and help translate insights into recommendations  
  
Create clear and compelling presentations for internal teams and clients  
  
Support problem solving by structuring challenges and exploring solutions  
  
Build an understanding of how consulting engagements are delivered end to end  
  
Participate in volunteer and team building experiences  
  
Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series  
  
Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions  
  
Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management team  
  
Specialization Tracks  
  
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting five specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.  
  
Business Experimentation  
  
Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them.  
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:  
  
Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?  
  
What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly?  
  
Strategy & Transformation  
  
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.  
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer  
  
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?  
  
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?  
  
Performance Analytics  
  
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.  
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:  
  
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?  
  
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?  
  
Marketing  
  
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.  
  
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:  
  
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?  
  
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?  
  
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?  
  
Deploy  
  
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution.  
  
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments.  
  
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:  
  
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams?  
  
What governance structure, implementation roadmap, and stakeholder engagement plan will best position a client to deliver a large-scale transformation on time and within scope?  
  
How can a client accelerate adoption and maximize the value of a newly deployed platform, product, or technology investment across its organization?  
  
What we’re looking for  
  
Undergraduate or accelerated master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027-July 2028  
  
We recruit for and value the following core competencies:  
  
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.  
  
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks)  
  
.Business Interest:  
  
Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.  
  
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.  
  
Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.  
  
Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.  
  
Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.  
  
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
  
As an intern, you'll benefit from  
  
Mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals and leaders  
  
Networking opportunities with fellow interns, employees, and senior leaders  
  
Professional development experiences focused on career growth and skill-building  
  
Exposure to innovative technologies and global business challenges  
  
Volunteer, community engagement, and team-building activities  
  
Many of our interns continue building their careers with Mastercard through full-time opportunities, early career programs, or future internships  
  
[If applicable] Please submit your transcript with your application.  
  
To participate in our job simulation and experience what it’s like to work as a Consultant at Mastercard visit:  
  
https://www.theforage.com/simulations/mastercard/advisors-client-services-xvlw

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Junior Software Testing Engineer | Software Solutions | Egypt
details:

------------------------------------

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* Review and understand business and functional requirements with guidance from senior team members, identifying basic testing needs and clarifying unclear requirements.

* Use Jira or similar bug-tracking tools to log defects, update their status, and follow up with the testing and development teams.

* Explore and use Generative AI and AI-assisted tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies to support test case preparation, documentation, and basic automation tasks.

* Collaborate with senior testers, developers, business analysts, and project teams to clarify requirements, report testing progress, and support timely issue resolution.
* Follow established testing procedures, quality standards, and documentation practices, while continuously developing technical and testing skills.

title: Senior Managed Services Engineer - Database & Middleware
details:
The Senior Managed Services Engineer - Database & Middleware is responsible for keeping customer databases and application middleware available, fast and recoverable, as the expert engineer in the Database & Middleware (DBM) pod. The role resolves complex incidents escalated by L2, owns root-cause analysis and permanent fixes, carries out high-risk changes such as upgrades, migrations and high-availability work, and turns repeat work into runbooks and automation.

Working closely with the Technical Tower Lead, the Head of MSSO Operations, the NOC & Service Desk and the Cloud & Compute and Backup & DR pods, the Engineer supports customers across the GCC and helps build the new pod and its database bench.

Responsibilities:

Database Operations (L3)

* Own escalated P1 / P2 database incidents from diagnosis to confirmed fix, across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB.
* Diagnose and tune performance, including query plans, indexing, statistics, waits and locking, memory and I/O, and parameter and instance configuration.
* Design, run and test high availability and replication: SQL Server Always On, Oracle Data Guard, PostgreSQL streaming replication, MySQL replication and MongoDB replica sets.
* Plan and carry out patching, version upgrades and migrations (on-premises to cloud and between engines), with tested rollback.
* Own database-level backup and recovery design (RMAN, native backups, point-in-time recovery) with the Backup & DR pod, and run restore tests and DR drills.
* Manage capacity, storage and growth, and keep each database within its agreed baseline.
* Apply database security: users, roles and least privilege, auditing, encryption (TDE), and privileged access through PAM.

Middleware

* Support Oracle WebLogic, Apache Tomcat / HTTP and IIS, covering deployments, configuration, certificates, connection pools and performance issues escalated by L2.
* Work with Cloud & Compute on operating-system and VM issues that affect the database or middleware tier.

Monitoring, Automation & Standards

* Define database and middleware monitoring templates, thresholds and alerts with NOC & Service Desk.
* Write scripts and automation (SQL / T-SQL / PL-SQL, PowerShell, Bash; Python an advantage) for health checks, routine maintenance and bulk changes.
* Deliver at least one automation a year that measurably reduces manual work in the pod.
* Help the Technical Tower Lead write the pod’s baseline configurations, runbooks and the technical instructions L1 and L2 work from.

Problem, Change & Knowledge Management

* Write the technical RCA for every P1 database incident and drive problem records through to a permanent fix.
* Raise and run normal and emergency changes under the change process (CAB), and design standard-change templates for routine database work.
* Turn every repeat issue into a knowledge article or runbook update, and shift work left to L2 and L1.

Customers, Onboarding & Presales Support

* Assess new customer database estates during onboarding, set their baseline and accept the handover from professional services (build to run).
* Join customer technical reviews and escalations as the database expert.
* Give effort and feasibility input on RFPs, SOWs and change requests that include database or middleware services.

Team & Development

* Coach L2 engineers, review their work on complex tickets and run knowledge-transfer sessions.
* Take part in skills assessments and technical interview panels for the pod, with the Technical Tower Lead.
* Deputise for the Technical Tower Lead on technical decisions when needed.
* Take part in the on-call rota.

***Our Culture & Code of Conduct:***

*At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.*

 **Requirements**  

* 8+ years as a database administrator, including at least 4 years at senior / L3 level in a managed-services, multi-customer or large enterprise environment.

* Expert, hands-on production experience in at least one of Oracle Database or Microsoft SQL Server, and solid working experience in at least two of PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB.
* Experience designing and running high availability and disaster recovery for production databases (Data Guard, Always On, replication), including real recovery from failures.
* Performance tuning and troubleshooting under pressure in live customer environments.
* Managed database services in at least one public cloud (OCI, Azure SQL / Managed Instance or AWS RDS).
* Linux and Windows Server administration at the level a DBA needs, and scripting in SQL, PowerShell and Bash.
* Working to SLAs in a ticketing tool (ServiceNow preferred), with ITIL incident, problem and change practice.
* Middleware experience (WebLogic, Tomcat or IIS) is a strong advantage.
* Fluent English; Arabic preferred for GCC customers.
* Degree in IT, computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Required Certifications: Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or Microsoft Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300) at hire, and the second of OCP / DP-300 within 12 months of joining.
* Preferred Certifications: MongoDB Certified DBA Associate, EDB PostgreSQL Associate, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure database certifications, Oracle WebLogic, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Oracle WebLogic Senior Administrator
details:
**Job Description:**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle WebLogic Administrator with deep expertise in deploying, managing, and optimizing Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle Fusion Middleware across on-premises and OCI-hosted environments. This role owns the full middleware lifecycle from domain provisioning, clustering, and performance engineering to patching, security hardening, and cloud migration supporting mission-critical Oracle application stacks including E-Business Suite, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), and Oracle Integration middleware.

**Key Responsibilities**

**WebLogic Domain Administration**

* Install, configure, and manage Oracle WebLogic Server (12c, 14c) across development, staging, and production environments.
* Design and administer WebLogic domains including Admin Servers, Managed Servers, clusters, machine configurations, and Node Managers.
* Configure and manage JDBC data sources, connection pools, JMS resources (queues, topics, connection factories), and work managers.
* Administer WebLogic security realms authentication providers (LDAP, Active Directory, OAM), authorization policies, SSL/TLS certificates, and keystores.
* Manage WebLogic deployments EAR/WAR/JAR lifecycle, staged/nostage deployments, versioned deployments, and rollback procedures.
* Configure coherence clusters, session replication, and distributed caching where applicable.

**Oracle Fusion Middleware Administration**

* Administer Oracle SOA Suite SOA composites, BPEL processes, Mediator, Human Workflow, and Business Rules across SOA clusters.
* Manage Oracle Service Bus (OSB) proxy/business services, message pipelines, transformations, routing rules, and throttling configurations.
* Administer Oracle HTTP Server (OHS), Oracle Traffic Director (OTD), and Oracle Web Cache for web-tier load balancing and request routing.
* Manage Oracle Identity and Access Management (OAM, OIM, OUD, OID) middleware components on WebLogic.
* Administer Oracle Business Intelligence (OBIEE/OAS) and Oracle Forms/Reports middleware deployments.
* Manage Oracle Enterprise Manager Fusion Middleware Control (EM FMWC) for monitoring, diagnostics, and configuration management.

**Oracle Application Stack Support**

* Manage WebLogic and Fusion Middleware tiers underpinning **Oracle E-Business Suite** EBS WebLogic domains, Oracle HTTP Server, Forms/Reports services, and concurrent processing infrastructure.
* Administer middleware for **Siebel CRM** Siebel Application Interface (AI), Siebel Gateway, Siebel Server components, and WebLogic-hosted Siebel web services.
* Support **Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA** integration middleware composite deployment, fault management, adapter configurations (DB, File, FTP, JMS, REST), and endpoint lifecycle.
* Manage middleware for **Oracle BRM** BRM web services gateway, custom pipeline integration endpoints, and WebLogic-hosted billing APIs.

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Design and manage WebLogic clustering for horizontal scalability and active-active/active-passive HA topologies.
* Configure and maintain Oracle Global Load Balancer (GLB), Oracle Traffic Director, and hardware/software load balancers (F5, HAProxy) for WebLogic tier.
* Implement WebLogic whole-server migration, service migration, and singleton services for automatic failover.
* Design and execute DR runbooks for WebLogic/FMW environments including cross-site Data Guard integration, rsync-based replication, and OCI-based DR strategies.
* Manage and test failover/switchover procedures with documented RTO/RPO alignment.

**Performance Engineering & Tuning**

* Tune JVM parameters (heap sizing, garbage collection G1GC, ZGC), thread pools, work managers, and execute queues for optimal throughput.
* Monitor and optimize WebLogic performance using WLST, WLDF (WebLogic Diagnostic Framework), Flight Recorder, and thread dump analysis.
* Analyze and resolve stuck threads, memory leaks, connection pool exhaustion, and session management issues.
* Conduct capacity planning sizing WebLogic domains, JVM instances, and cluster node counts based on workload profiling.
* Integrate with enterprise monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, Datadog) for real-time WebLogic and FMW health observability.

**Patching & Lifecycle Management**

* Plan and execute WebLogic and Fusion Middleware patching (CPU/PSU/RU patches, one-off patches) using OPatch and BSU.
* Manage Oracle Middleware home structures, inventory management, and patch conflict resolution.
* Coordinate patching windows with application and database teams, ensuring rollback readiness.
* Execute WebLogic version upgrades (e.g., 12c to 14c) and Fusion Middleware stack upgrades with minimal downtime.

**Cloud Migration & OCI**

* Migrate WebLogic and Fusion Middleware workloads to OCI lift-and-shift to OCI Compute, re-platform to WebLogic for OCI (Marketplace/Terraform), or modernize to OKE.
* Provision and manage WebLogic on OCI using Marketplace images, Terraform stacks, and OCI Resource Manager.
* Administer Oracle WebLogic Suite for OCI, including integration with OCI Load Balancer, OCI DNS, and OCI WAF.
* Evaluate and implement containerization of WebLogic workloads using WebLogic Kubernetes Operator on OKE.
* Configure OCI-native monitoring and log aggregation for WebLogic workloads (OCI Logging, Logging Analytics, APM).

**Automation & Tooling**

* Develop and maintain automation using WLST (WebLogic Scripting Tool) for domain creation, configuration, deployment, and monitoring.
* Build Infrastructure as Code for WebLogic provisioning using Terraform and Ansible playbooks.
* Automate routine tasks log rotation, health checks, deployment pipelines, and certificate renewals.
* Administer Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) 13c Cloud Control for WebLogic/FMW target monitoring and compliance.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of progressive experience in Oracle middleware administration with deep expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server (12c/14c).
* Expert-level knowledge of WebLogic domain architecture clustering, JMS, JDBC, security realms, Node Manager, and deployment models.
* Strong experience administering Oracle Fusion Middleware: SOA Suite, OSB, OHS, OAM/OIM, and EM FMWC.
* Proven experience supporting WebLogic/FMW tiers for at least two of: Oracle EBS, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, or Oracle BRM.
* Deep proficiency in JVM tuning (G1GC, ZGC, heap/metaspace sizing) and WebLogic performance diagnostics (WLDF, thread dumps, heap dumps).
* Strong experience with WebLogic patching, upgrade lifecycles, and Oracle Middleware home management.
* Hands-on experience migrating WebLogic workloads to OCI (Compute, Marketplace, OKE).
* Proficiency in WLST scripting and at least one automation language: Python, Bash, or Ansible.
* Working knowledge of Linux system administration (Oracle Linux / RHEL).
* Strong understanding of load balancing, SSL/TLS, DNS, and web-tier architecture.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to produce clear operational documentation and engage with application and client stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle certifications: Oracle WebLogic Server 12c/14c Certified Administrator, Oracle SOA Suite Certified Implementation Specialist, OCI Architect Associate.
* Experience with WebLogic Kubernetes Operator and containerized WebLogic deployments on OKE.
* Familiarity with Terraform (OCI provider) for middleware infrastructure automation.
* Experience with Oracle Traffic Director (OTD) and Oracle Global Load Balancer (GLB).
* Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and hybrid middleware integration patterns.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Splunk integrated with WebLogic/FMW.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for middleware deployments (Jenkins, GitLab, ArgoCD).
* Experience with Oracle HTTP Server (OHS) and mod\_wl\_ohs configuration.
* Knowledge of OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and Oracle Access Manager (OAM) integration patterns.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management awareness.
* Experience working in managed services, telecom, or consulting delivery environments.

This role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Exadata environments from deployment, patching, and performance engineering to high availability, disaster recovery, and capacity management ensuring mission-critical Oracle database workloads run at peak performance and resilience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Exadata On-Premises Administration**

* Deploy, configure, and manage Exadata Database Machine racks (X8M, X9M, X10M) including compute nodes, storage servers, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, and ILOM.
* Perform quarterly and ad-hoc patching using dbaascli, exadcli, PatchMgr, and opatchauto across grid infrastructure, database homes, and storage cells.
* Manage Exadata storage (cell disks, grid disks, flash cache, PMEM) including cell-level administration using CellCLI and ExaCLI.
* Configure and tune Smart Scan, Storage Indexes, Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), and Smart Flash Cache for optimal offload performance.
* Manage ASM disk groups, rebalancing operations, and storage allocation across database workloads.
* Perform firmware and component upgrades for ILOM, switches, PDUs, and InfiniBand/RoCE switches.

**Exadata Cloud Service (ExaCS / ExaCC on OCI)**

* Provision and manage Exadata Cloud Infrastructure, VM Clusters, and database homes via OCI Console, CLI, Terraform, and REST APIs.
* Administer Exadata Cloud@Customer (ExaCC) deployments including infrastructure maintenance scheduling and VM cluster lifecycle.
* Manage OCI IAM policies, compartment structures, and network configurations (VCNs, subnets, NSGs) specific to ExaCS/ExaCC.
* Perform scaling operations (OCPU, storage, node additions) and manage elastic configurations.
* Automate provisioning and lifecycle operations using Terraform OCI provider and OCI Resource Manager stacks.

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Configure and manage Oracle RAC and RAC One Node across Exadata environments.
* Implement and maintain Oracle Data Guard (Active Data Guard) for HA/DR across on-premises and cloud.
Design and test switchover/failover procedures, including cross-platform DR (on-prem* ExaCS).
* Manage RMAN backup strategies including backup to OCI Object Storage, Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and local FRA.
* Implement and monitor Oracle Maximum Availability Architecture (MAA) best practices.

**Performance Engineering & Tuning**

* Monitor and optimize Exadata-specific performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, cell metrics, and Exadata Storage Server software utilities.
* Tune Smart Scan offload ratios, I/O Resource Management (IORM), and database resource plans.
* Analyse cell server statistics, flash cache hit rates, and storage index efficiency using ExaWatcher and OSWatcher.
* Conduct capacity planning and workload characterization to inform scaling and consolidation decisions.
* Leverage OCI Operations Insights and Database Management for cloud-hosted Exadata performance monitoring.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement Exadata security hardening following Oracle Maximum Security Architecture guidelines.
* Configure Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Oracle Key Vault integration, and network encryption.
* Manage Oracle Database Vault, Audit Vault, and Data Masking for compliance-driven environments.
* Apply CIS benchmarks and security patches in alignment with organizational change management processes.

**General**

* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, architecture documentation, and DR test plans.
* Collaborate with solution architects, DBA teams, and client stakeholders on capacity planning and platform roadmaps.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior administrators.
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, root cause analysis, and problem management.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7–8 years of progressive experience in Oracle Database and infrastructure administration with a minimum of 4 years focused on Exadata platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise with Exadata on-premises (X-series) including CellCLI, ExaCLI, dbaascli, ILOM, and InfiniBand/RoCE networking.
* Proven experience with Exadata Cloud Service (ExaCS) or Exadata Cloud@Customer (ExaCC) on OCI.
* Deep knowledge of Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and RMAN in Exadata contexts.
* Strong understanding of Exadata Smart software features: Smart Scan, Storage Indexes, HCC, Smart Flash Cache, PMEM.
* Proficiency in Exadata patching lifecycle and tooling (opatchauto, PatchMgr, dbaascli).
* Experience with Oracle Database versions 19c and 23ai on Exadata.
* Working knowledge of Linux administration (Oracle Linux / RHEL), shell scripting, and Python for automation.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts relevant to Exadata (InfiniBand, RoCE, client/backup networks, VLANs).
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to produce clear operational documentation and present to technical and client stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle certifications: Oracle Exadata Database Machine Administrator Certified Professional, Oracle Database Administration Certified Professional, OCI Architect Associate/Professional.
* Experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) 13c Cloud Control for Exadata monitoring and management.
* Familiarity with Terraform (OCI provider) for automating ExaCS/ExaCC provisioning.

title: Devops & SysOps Architect
details:
We are seeking an exceptional Senior Lead who combines deep hands-on SysOps/HPC expertise with the strategic vision of a solution architect. This is a rare dual-track role: you operate at the intersection of elite technical execution and client-facing presales, designing and running mission-critical GPU, HPC, and Kubernetes platforms while simultaneously co-creating opportunity with our commercial teams.

This role carries both SysOps, HPC depth and DevOps. You are expected to spend **at least 60% of your time on implementation and technical execution**

What You Will Do

**Presales & Business Development**

* Partner with sales and solution teams to identify and qualify new opportunities
* Lead or support technical presales activities: discovery workshops, RFP responses, architecture presentations
* Build and deliver proof-of-concepts (POCs) that demonstrate platform capabilities to prospective clients
* Prepare high-quality technical materials
* Act as a trusted technical advisor during client conversations, proposing solutions aligned to business goals

**In-Account Delivery — SysOps & DevOps Execution**

* Operate directly within client accounts as a senior SysOps/DevOps engineer
* Run, troubleshoot, and optimize production-grade Kubernetes clusters and GPU/HPC environments hands-on
* Own Linux system administration at a deep level: kernel tuning, storage, networking, performance profiling
* Implement and maintain IaC pipelines, GitOps workflows, and CI/CD systems
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex operational incidents within accounts

**Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design end-to-end platform architectures spanning cloud, hybrid, and on-premises HPC environments
* Define workload isolation models, networking architectures, and storage strategies for multi-tenant platforms
* Recommend and validate technology choices aligned to client scale, budget, and team maturity
* Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), solution blueprints, and technical runbooks

Technical Competencies & Requirements

**1. Architecture & System Design**

* Design production-grade multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms:
* RKE2, EKS (AWS), AKS (Azure) at enterprise scale
* GPU-aware clusters: NVIDIA H100 / A100 / B200 node pools
* Hybrid cloud + on-premises HPC infrastructure
* Define and document:
* Workload isolation: namespaces, MIG partitioning, multi-tenancy models
* Networking: BGP peering, Ingress controllers, service mesh (Istio / Cilium)
* Storage: Longhorn, Ceph, distributed and high-throughput file systems

**2. Platform Engineering & GitOps Strategy**

* Define and enforce platform standards across the delivery lifecycle
* GitOps tooling: ArgoCD, Fleet — declarative cluster management
* CI/CD pipelines: Azure DevOps, Jenkins — build, test, promote
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (modules, remote state, workspaces), Ansible
* Standardize cluster bootstrapping, app deployment lifecycle, environment promotion (Dev QA Prod)

**3. AI / GPU Infrastructure Architecture (Priority Competency)**

* Design and operate GPU compute platforms at scale:
* GPU Operator deployment and lifecycle management
* MIG (Multi-Instance GPU) partitioning for multi-tenant workloads
* Advanced scheduling: Run:AI, Kubernetes-native GPU scheduling (device plugins)
* Understand AI workload classes and their infrastructure implications:
* Distributed training workloads (data/model/pipeline parallelism)
* Inference pipelines — NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, TensorRT optimization
* Align infrastructure to the full AI stack:
* CUDA stack, cuDNN, NCCL collective communication libraries
* High-speed networking: InfiniBand (HDR/NDR), RoCE for RDMA
* GPUDirect RDMA / GPUDirect Storage for low-latency data paths

**4. Observability & Reliability Engineering**

* Define and implement full-stack observability:
* Metrics: Prometheus, Thanos (long-term retention, multi-cluster)
* Logs: Loki, Fluent Bit
* GPU telemetry: DCGM Exporter, NVIDIA Nsight Systems
* Build operational frameworks:
* SLO / SLA definitions and error budget tracking
* Alerting strategy — noise reduction, severity routing
* Incident response playbooks and on-call runbooks

**5. Security & Multi-Tenancy Architecture**

* Design zero-trust security postures for multi-tenant platforms
* Secret management: HashiCorp Vault, External Secrets Operator
* Identity and access: IAM, RBAC, SSO/OIDC integration
* Network isolation: NetworkPolicy, micro-segmentation, mTLS
* Secure GPU sharing: MIG isolation, VGPU licensing, tenant boundary enforcement

**6. HPC, Data & Storage Architecture (Priority Competency)**

* Understand the high-performance storage for AI/HPC workloads:
* GPUDirect Storage — bypassing CPU for GPU-native I/O
* Distributed file systems: Weka (high-throughput NFS/S3), Ceph (scalable object/block)
* Storage tiering, caching strategies, and data lifecycle management
* Size and validate storage architectures against workload I/O profiles

**7. Operational Leadership & Linux Systems**

* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical production issues
* Define upgrade strategies, change management procedures, and disaster recovery plans
* Write and maintain runbooks, operational playbooks, and knowledge base content
* Integrate organizational processes, compliance requirements, and security policies into operational frameworks
* Deep Linux expertise:
* Kernel tuning (CPU governor, NUMA, IRQ affinity, hugepages)
* Storage I/O scheduling, NVMe optimization
* Network stack tuning for RDMA / InfiniBand
* System performance profiling and bottleneck analysis

Candidate Profile — Who You Are

* you are comfortable running production systems.
* You have stronger SysOps and HPC depth than DevOps breadth, and you embrace that identity
* You can shift fluidly between running a live incident, presenting an architecture to a CTO, and reviewing a POC demo environment
* You communicate technical complexity clearly — to engineers and to C-level stakeholders
* You understand why specific tooling choices matter (not just how to configure them) and can articulate trade-offs in presales conversations
* You are comfortable owning outcomes across both commercial (presales) and delivery (operations) dimensions
* You thrive in ambiguity and can scope both short POCs and long-horizon platform programs

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Significant Linux systems administration experience — kernel, networking, storage at a low level

* Demonstrable presales or client-facing experience

**Strongly Preferred**

* Knowledge of distributed AI training infrastructure (PyTorch DDP, Horovod, DeepSpeed) from an infrastructure perspective
* Familiarity with NVIDIA Triton Inference Server or TensorRT deployment pipelines
* Experience with Weka, Ceph, or GPUDirect Storage in HPC/AI environments
* Hands-on experience with Vault, External Secrets, and zero-trust network architectures
* Exposure to bare-metal provisioning and HPC cluster management (Slurm, PBS, or equivalent)

**Certifications (Advantageous)**

hausverwalter.ai ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. title: Administrator (East Cairo)
details:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Administrator to join our Property Management team in Egypt. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the smooth execution of projects by managing documentation, maintaining property records, and implementing efficient document control procedures. You will work collaboratively with professional and technical staff to support property objectives while maintaining the highest standards of organization and accuracy.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
The Administrator will manage and organize documents throughout all phases of the property lifecycles, ensuring accessibility and proper categorization, while maintaining comprehensive project directories and filing systems that support efficient property operations. This includes filing and storing original documents, revisions, and reproduced materials in a manner that facilitates easy retrieval and reference.
  
  
The role involves developing and implementing property-specific filing structures and document control procedures tailored to property requirements, as well as configuring and utilizing electronic document management systems to streamline document workflows and enhance accessibility. The Administrator will also record, catalog, and store property photographs and visual documentation in organized systems.
  
  
The Administrator will interact professionally with property management team members and stakeholders to understand documentation needs and accomplish assigned objectives, while performing routine administrative duties with precision and attention to detail. This includes supporting property management teams by providing timely access to property records and documentation, and assisting in maintaining compliance with document control standards and organizational procedures.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3-5 years of administrative experience, with prior exposure to document control, property management administration, or records management within a project-based, malls management, or real estate environment considered an advantage. A relevant Undergraduate degree or diploma in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field is preferred, though equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  
  
The candidate should demonstrate strong organizational and document management skills, with the ability to develop and maintain structured filing systems and apply document control procedures across multiple concurrent projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) is required, and experience organizing and cataloging property records, revisions, and visual documentation.
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, as the role requires regular interfacing with property management teams, technical and professional staff, and stakeholders to understand and fulfill documentation needs. The candidate should exhibit a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, discretion in handling project and organizational records, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  
  
Qualification
  
  
3-5 years of administrative experience, ideally within document control, project administration, or records management in a project-based, mall management, operations, or real estate environment
  
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining structured filing systems and document control procedures across multiple concurrent projects
  
Experience organizing, cataloging, and storing property records, document revisions, and visual/photographic documentation
  
Working knowledge of document workflow processes
  
Preferably residing in East Cairo or around the area.

title: Junior System Administrator
details:
### **Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Application Support Engineer** to join our team and be responsible for providing technical application support during regular working hours as well as on-call support when required.

The role will focus on ensuring the availability, stability, security, and performance of business-critical applications. The successful candidate will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, support system upgrades and deployments, manage service restoration, and ensure seamless integration between applications and back-end systems.

The candidate will work closely with technical teams, application owners, infrastructure teams, and other stakeholders to identify root causes, implement effective solutions, and continuously improve system reliability.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide **application support during working hours and on-call**, ensuring timely resolution of technical incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot and resolve **global and individual application issues**, minimizing business impact and service downtime.
* Monitor application health, performance, and availability and take proactive actions to prevent potential incidents.
* Perform **technical reviews** of applications and proposed changes to ensure alignment with technical and operational standards.
* Support **system upgrades, patches, enhancements, and maintenance activities**.
* Perform **service restoration** activities and ensure applications are returned to normal operation within agreed SLAs.
* Troubleshoot application and integration issues across front-end, application, database, and back-end components.
* Support and maintain **integration with back-end systems**, APIs, databases, and other enterprise applications.
* Ensure application and system configurations comply with established **security and operational standards**.
* Participate in identifying security vulnerabilities and implementing appropriate corrective actions.
* Manage and support **application deployments** across relevant environments.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, DevOps, database, and other technical teams during deployments and production activities.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring and major incidents and recommend preventive solutions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, incident reports, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
* Provide clear and accurate **technical and analytical reports** to relevant stakeholders.
* Handle multiple incidents, priorities, and technical activities simultaneously while maintaining service quality.
* Take initiative in identifying operational improvements and proactively resolving potential system issues.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and support processes.
* Provide technical support for customer care systems and related business applications.

### **Application Experience**

Experience supporting one or more of the following applications is highly preferred:

* **Risk**
* **WinCash**
* **Extranet**
* **eShop**

### **Core Competencies**

* Strong **analytical and troubleshooting skills**.
* Excellent **problem-solving and decision-making abilities**.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, particularly during critical incidents and service outages.
* Strong communication and **stakeholder management skills**.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical issues.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
* Willingness and ability to provide **on-call support** when required.
* Strong documentation and technical reporting skills.
