title: Senior Systems Administrator, IT
details:
PopArabia was founded in 2011 by Canadian hip-hop pioneer, music executive and entrepreneur Spek, in partnership with twofour54 – the Abu Dhabi media zone that is home to the region’s entertainment industry. As a sub publisher, PopArabia represents the world’s leading music catalogs across the MENA territories and has pioneered music licensing in the region since inception. In 2020, PopArabia announced a partnership and joint venture with New York-headquartered Reservoir to sign and develop Arabic talent to export around the world. PopArabia also launched ESMAA later that year, a rights management entity working with the global community of music stakeholders licensing performance, mechanical and neighbouring rights in the Gulf states.

Today, PopArabia operates as a vertically integrated independent music company spanning label, publishing, distribution, music supervision and catalog ownership, with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Cairo. In 2026, PopArabia completed the acquisition of Egyptian label and distributor Viral Wave, deepening its presence in the Arab world's largest music market and cementing its position as the region's most comprehensive independent music rights company.

**The Position**

### **IT Operations & Systems Administration**

* Administer and support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and related services.
* Manage user accounts, licenses, groups, permissions, MFA, and access controls.
* Support Windows and macOS devices, including configuration, troubleshooting, software deployment, and lifecycle management.
* Manage endpoint management and monitoring tools such as Datto RMM, Intune, or equivalent platforms.
* Support networking infrastructure, including Wi-Fi, switches, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, and related services.
* Maintain IT systems, documentation, configurations, and asset records.
* Assist with server, cloud, and infrastructure projects as required.

### **End User Support**

* Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 technical support for hardware, software, networking, Microsoft 365, and business applications.
* Troubleshoot complex issues that cannot be resolved through standard helpdesk procedures.
* Support executives and senior leadership with a high level of professionalism and responsiveness.
* Assist users with onboarding, offboarding, device setup, application access, and account configuration.
* Provide remote and occasional onsite support.
* Develop and maintain internal knowledge base articles and technical documentation.

### **Cybersecurity**

* Assist with implementation and maintenance of IT security controls.
* Monitor and respond to security alerts and suspicious activity.
* Manage and troubleshoot MFA, conditional access, endpoint security, email security, and access controls.
* Support email security platforms such as Barracuda, Mimecast, or equivalent.
* Assist with phishing investigations, email quarantine, malware alerts, and security incidents.
* Help maintain security policies and ensure users follow IT security best practices.
* Participate in security awareness and cybersecurity training initiatives.

### **IT Projects**

* Participate in and lead technical projects from planning through implementation.
* Assist with Microsoft 365 migrations, tenant migrations, domain/DNS changes, application deployments, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Evaluate new technologies and make recommendations based on business requirements.
* Work with vendors, MSPs, software providers, and consultants.
* Create project documentation and ensure successful handover into IT operations.

### **Automation & Process Improvement**

* Identify repetitive IT tasks and opportunities for automation.
* Develop and maintain workflows using tools such as Power Automate, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
* Improve onboarding, offboarding, access management, software deployment, and IT support processes.
* Develop standardized procedures and documentation to improve operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, IT operations, or a related role.
* Strong experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
* Experience administering Windows environments and supporting macOS devices.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, networking, and cloud services.
* Experience with endpoint management/RMM platforms.
* Working knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, and firewalls.
* Experience with cybersecurity tools and best practices.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, MFA, and least-privilege principles.
* Experience with PowerShell or another scripting/automation language.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and prioritize competing requests.
* Fluent in English and Arabic.
* Experience managing a distributed team (30+ people), including UAE and Egypt, across different time zones (MENA, Europe, Asia).

PopArabia is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. title: Project Controls Manager - SCCT
details:
APM Terminals

**Purpose** :

As part of a project leadership team, APMT are looking for an individual to lead the project controls discipline for the SCTT Equipment Electrification Upgrade project on a contract basis, starting Q3 2026 . The role is the Project Controls Manager .

This position requires the Project Controls Manager to be based full-time on site in Port Said, Egypt. The role is highly hands-on and requires the successful candidate to actively perform detailed planning and scheduling activities, while also leading and overseeing the overall P roject C ntrols function across the project. The Project Controls Manager will be supported by a direct-report team member responsible for cost control and change management functions.

Project i mplementation is a key value driver in APM Terminals (APMT) . Our ability to build a container terminal, establish an operational organi s ation and secure commercial business delivers real NPV to APMT and the broader A.P. Møller – Mærsk (APMM) business . E qually , if we are able to improve on the original plans for a project , we may be able to secure incremental value for the entire APMM group and broader stakeholders .

To be success ful in this role , we need our Project Controls Manager to deliver in three areas :

* A source of one-truth on performance. T ransparent and purposeful communication is essential. This will include internal (the broader project team) and external (broader APMM and external) stakeholder communication. Building rapport, project-wide commitment (to accurate reporting and planning) and psychological trust will be critical to providing accurate information.

* A centre of excellence for project management knowledge to support decision making. Knowledge of project management best practice and tools, and an understanding of lean will be important. Success will be possible if the project can remain focusssed on customer value , even if this evolves from what it looks like today .

* A driving force for proactive and effective project management and leadership . To facilitate the management of project performance , projects need to be proactive. This means a strong knowledge and responsibility for reporting on leading and lagging indicators.

Project controls is a key technical function to deliver our project success criteria and ultimately the benefits back to the business. How this is led and delivered is just as essential as what is delivered. We believe it requires transparency on the results, great knowledge or experience to draw upon , and a mindset focussed on predicting and improving in the future .

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all project controls activities, including planning, scheduling, reporting, governance, change control, risk management, and performance monitoring.
* Develop, maintain, and consolidate project controls systems and deliverables, including Primavera P6 schedules, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Advanced Work Packaging (AWP), and the Project Execution Plan (PEP).
* Establish and maintain approved scope, schedule, cost, and quality baselines, and track project performance against them.
* Drive project reporting, providing accurate and timely performance updates, forecasts, KPIs, leading and lagging indicators, and executive-level reporting to project leadership, PMO, and corporate stakeholders.
* Facilitate and oversee change management, risk management, document control, and correspondence management processes.
* Act as the primary owner and administrator of project control systems (primarily PMWeb), including governance, user access management, system improvements, and integration with project controls processes.
* Proactively identify, manage, escalate, and resolve project control issues affecting construction, equipment delivery, IT, and automation workstreams.
* Ensure compliance with APMT project management standards, procedures, and ways of working, including governance, reporting, and project controls methodologies.
* Collaborate closely with project teams, global functions, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure alignment, consistency, and transparency across all project controls activities.
* Lead and mentor project controls resources where required.

**REPORTING AND SCOPE** :

* D irect reporting : Project Manager

* Functional reporting: Global Project Execution Senior P roject Management Officer (P MO )

* Geographical s cope: Port Said / Egypt

**CRITICAL QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE**

Must Have …

* Relevant professional experience :

* 7 years overall, including a minimum of 5 years within a project controls functional discipline

* Accountability in project delivery on at least one large-scale and complex capital infrastructure projects

* Workin g in a culturally and technical diverse team and environment, internally and externally to your organisation

* Confidently p resenting and effectively communicating to internal (project) and external (HQ) stakeholders in written and spoken English

* Coaching and/or mentoring others across a team or broader functional business

* Delivering a high-level of accuracy and quality

* Relevant (& hands on) technical experience and knowledge of :

* C omplet ion and been awarded a n advanced project management qualtification , for example APM PMQ , PMI PMP c ertificate or equivalent.

* P roject management platforms and systems ( for managing document controls, contract s , change, cost, communication and milestone s ) e .g. PMWeb , Proliance, PCM, Skire or similar.

* Project management tools including scheduling software e.g. Primavera, MS Project, etc.

* Managing through influence and creating team commitment to following a governance structure, including procedures, processes and project controls

* Proactive performance management through leading (predictive) measures

* Advanced planning and scheduling using Primavera P6, including schedule development, maintenance, progress monitoring, critical path analysis, WBS development, resource loading, and reporting.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering discipline is essential

Preferred (but not essential) …

* Experience of working in a matrix organisation

* Experience of supervision and line management of others in project controls or project management roles.

title: Technical Support Engineer III
details:
**Who is Forcepoint?**

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

**Job Description**

A Technical Support Engineer III is responsible for providing a world-class support experience to our enterprise customer base. Living our corporate values of being Trustworthy, Collaborative, Accountable, Respectful, Innovative, and Relentless, you will be responsible for assisting our customers with troubleshooting and resolving issues related to Forcepoint as well as associated third-party products, enabling our customers to stop the bad and free the good. You will utilize your knowledge and experience to interpret the customers’ needs and ensure they are achieving maximum value from Forcepoint. You will be seen as a technical advisor within the team and called upon to provide assistance to other team members on issues within your area of expertise. You will actively participate in product supportability programs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Respond to customer cases in line with Service Level Agreements.
* Proactively identify and resolve potential problems in an effort to prevent them from occurring and improve the overall customer experience.
* Approach each case with a goal of ensuring Forcepoint products are performing at an optimal level by addressing any underlying or additional problems uncovered during each customer engagement.
* Ensure full understanding of the issue, including impact to customer.
* Gather logs, configuration details and attempt to reproduce the reported issues.
* Research the issue in the Knowledge Base, documentation and with your team members as needed.
* Recommend solutions to customers and follow through to resolution or escalate the case in a timely manner if no resolution can be found.
* Prioritize workload based on severity and impact to customer and demonstrate a sense of urgency when handling cases.
* Be accountable for customer escalations and drive them internally to a speedy resolution while ensuring that customers are kept fully informed of progress throughout the escalation.
* Document all interactions and case details within the customer tracking database, including a detailed description of the issue and any resolutions recommended.
* Adhere to company policies and procedures regarding customer handling, case management and service entitlement verification.
* Participate in knowledge sharing via involvement in technical discussions and Knowledge Base documentation.
* Create and deliver formal mentoring programs to Technical Support Engineers
* Provide technical reviews of user documentation, product requirements documents and functional specifications.
* Act as subject matter expert with regard to specific product components and integrations.
* Provide in-depth training in areas of expertise, general product knowledge, and integration.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

**Person Specification:**

You demonstrate extreme levels of accountability and are results driven; you value teamwork and collaboration; you communicate transparently and with candour, while always being genuine; you act boldly, take initiative and are comfortable taking calculated risks to achieve successful outcomes; you execute with speed and integrity, delivering high quality work product which you are proud of.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Six or more years of experience supporting business to business customers
* Hands-on experience that demonstrate knowledge of:
* Networking fundamentals (Layer 2 and 3, TCP/IP, 3-way handshake, DNS etc.)
* HTTP protocol (Structure, status codes, authentication, etc.)
* Application Support Basics (Common troubleshooting methodology for Windows and Linux programs)
* SSL/TLS protocols (Structure, certificates, initial handshake, etc.)
* SMTP (Protocol, Routing, MX Records, commands, status/response codes etc.)
* Packet Capture/Analysis with tcpdump and Wireshark
* Diagnosing network latency and intermittent issues
* Reading and analysing log files
* Active Directory (Domains, structure, permissions, group policies, etc.)
* MSSQL fundamentals (Management interface, accessing logs, browsing databases, simple queries, permissions, jobs, etc.)
* Information Security Concepts
* Experience supporting the following applications:
* Red Hat Linux fundamentals (command line navigation and basic features, file system, permissions, networking, etc.)
* Windows (Permissions, services, file system, Event Viewer, etc.)

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

* Endpoint application stack diagnostics and analysis for Windows, Mac, and Linux Endpoints
* Windows and Linux memory dump capture and analysis

details:

In this role, you will implement and monitor physical security and safety policies, procedures and guidelines in line with the Global Security Manual (GSM), the company’s health and safety standards and client-specific directives (e.g., PCI DSS), and serve as the site’s Local Safety Officer.

* Implement company and client security and safety policies and procedures among employees, contractors, clients and other third parties.
* Enforce access control: badging, visitor management and escorts, key control, and restricted-zone access (e.g., production floor), with periodic access-rights reviews.

  + Performing Level 1 troubleshooting and escalating repairs to vendors;

**Work directly with the Global Health & Safety Manager to:**

* Monitor the site’s compliance with the company’s OHS policy and procedures.

* Training in first aid, fire safety and emergency management.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Working knowledge of CCTV, access control and visitor management, intrusion alarm and fire safety systems, including basic troubleshooting.

title: Information Security Manager (GRC)
details:
We are hiring a Security Manager to own our security and compliance program end to end. Most of the

role is Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC): building the framework, running audits, and keeping us

aligned with regulators and partners. The rest is hands-on assurance: you can scope and challenge a

penetration test, and you understand cloud and infrastructure security well enough to set direction for

engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

### **Governance, risk and compliance**

* Own the information security management system: policies, standards, procedures and the controls library.
* Lead certification and audit programs (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS where in scope), from gap assessment through external audit and continuous monitoring.
* Run our compliance automation platform (e.g. Vanta): control mapping, evidence collection, and keeping integrations accurate.
* Map and maintain compliance with Egyptian regulation, including FRA consumer finance requirements, Central Bank of Egypt guidance where applicable, and the Personal Data
* Protection Law (Law 151 of 2020).
* Maintain the enterprise risk register: identify, score and track security and technology risks, and report them to leadership and the board.
* Run third-party and vendor risk management, including security reviews of merchants, banks,
* KYC and cloud providers.
* Handle security questionnaires and due diligence from banks, card networks, partners and investors.
* Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning, and test it at least yearly.

**Security assurance and penetration testing**

* Define the yearly testing plan across web, mobile, API and cloud.
* Scope, procure and manage external penetration testers and red-team engagements; challenge findings and severity ratings.
* Run or validate internal testing where useful, using tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP or Nmap.
* Own the vulnerability management lifecycle: triage, SLAs by severity, remediation tracking and retesting.
* Embed secure SDLC practices with engineering: threat modelling, secure code review guidance,
* and SAST, DAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI/CD.

**Infrastructure and cloud security**

* Set the security baseline for cloud (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes and containers, networks and endpoints.
* Own identity and access management: least privilege, MFA, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver and periodic access reviews.
* Define encryption, key management and data protection standards, including handling of PII and payment data.
* Oversee logging, monitoring and detection (SIEM, cloud security posture management) together with engineering.
* Lead incident response: playbooks, on-call escalation, post-incident reviews, and regulator or partner notification when required.

**Leadership and culture**

* Build the security roadmap and budget, and present posture and risk to the CTO, leadership and board.
* Run security awareness training and phishing simulations for all staff.
* Act as the security partner to product and engineering, enabling delivery rather than blocking it.
* Grow the function over time through hires, contractors or managed services as the business scales.

  
**Requirements**  

* 8+ years in information security, with at least 3 years leading a GRC or security program.
* Hands-on experience taking a company through ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 certification, ideally as the owner rather than a contributor.
* Solid knowledge of PCI DSS and of security expectations in regulated financial services (fintech, banking, payments).
* Working knowledge of Egyptian regulation relevant to fintech and personal data, or a proven record of quickly mapping a new regulatory regime into controls.
* Practical penetration testing background: you have run tests yourself or managed testers closely, and can read a report critically. OWASP Top 10 (web, API and mobile) is familiar ground.
* Strong infrastructure and cloud security knowledge: AWS or GCP, IAM, network segmentation, Kubernetes and containers, encryption and key management.
* Experience leading incident response from detection to post-mortem
* Clear written and spoken English and Arabic. You can explain risk to a board and argue a fix with an engineer.

**Certifications (at least one expected):** CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor.  
**Technical certifications (a strong plus):** OSCP, CEH, or a cloud security certification (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP).

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Vanta, Drata or a similar compliance automation tool.
* Exposure to card-network or bank partner security assessments.
* Experience building a security function from scratch at a startup.

 **Benefits**  

* **Comprehensive Wellbeing:** Enjoy peace of mind with our **private medical insurance and life cover**, plus **extra days off for every year you're part of the team.**
* **Financial Growth:** Reap the rewards of your hard work with our **annual profit share** and competitive compensation packages.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Achieve optimal well-being with our **hybrid work environment**, generous **maternity and paternity benefits,** and regular **team-building events**.
* **Continuous Development:** Expand your horizons through our commitment to l**earning and development opportunities.**
* **Perks and Privileges:** Celebrate your journey with us through **birthday offs**, **mobile allowances**, **transportation support**, and a host of other employee-centric perks.

title: Information Security Compliance Officer
details:
***Envision Employment Solutions*** *is currently looking for an* ***Information Security Compliance Officer****for one of our partners, a leading Digital Bank!*

**THE ROLE**

A bank earns its license by proving, again and again, that its controls actually work. As Information Security Compliance Officer in the Security GRC team, you run the programmes that prove it, across PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and the Central Bank of Egypt’s cybersecurity regulations, including the Egypt Financial Cybersecurity Framework. You find the gaps before an auditor does, work with business and technology teams to close them, and keep the bank audit ready every day, not just the week before an inspection.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Manage end to end compliance programmes for PCI DSS (v4.0.x), SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and other applicable standards, from scoping through certification and ongoing maintenance
* Ensure ongoing compliance with the CBE Egypt Financial Cybersecurity Framework and related CBE cybersecurity regulations, circulars, and instructions (e.g., internet and digital banking, outsourcing and vendor management requirements)
* Conduct gap assessments and readiness reviews, and build and track remediation plans with control owners until closure
* Coordinate CBE cybersecurity maturity self-assessments and independent assessments, prepare evidence, and track regulatory findings and action plans
* Lead PCI DSS activities, including cardholder data environment (CDE) scoping, segmentation validation, Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs), Reports on Compliance (ROC), Attestations of Compliance (AOC), and quarterly ASV scan tracking
* Manage SOC 2 audits against the Trust Services Criteria, including control design, evidence collection, and auditor coordination
* Act as the main point of contact for external auditors, QSAs, certification bodies, and regulators during audits and inspections
* Maintain a unified control framework that maps requirements across PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SWIFT CSCF, and CBE regulations to reduce duplicated effort
* Monitor controls on an ongoing basis, carry out periodic compliance reviews and spot checks, and report on control effectiveness
* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, standards, and procedures in line with regulatory and standard requirements
* Track new and changing regulations (CBE circulars, Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020, card scheme requirements), assess their impact, and drive implementation
* Support third party and vendor security risk assessments to make sure outsourcing arrangements meet regulatory and contractual requirements
* Prepare compliance dashboards, metrics, and reports for management, risk committees, and the board
* Run security compliance awareness for staff and control owners on regulatory and standard obligations

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, IT, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 2 to 4 years of experience in information security, including at least 2 years hands-on managing compliance programmes
* Expert knowledge of CBE cybersecurity regulations and frameworks, including the Egypt Financial Cybersecurity Framework and its maturity assessment approach, plus experience dealing with CBE inspections and findings
* Hands-on experience with PCI DSS compliance, including scoping, SAQ/ROC preparation, and working with QSAs
* Hands-on experience with SOC 2 readiness and audits, and good knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002
* Familiarity with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, SWIFT CSCF, and COBIT
* Good understanding of security controls across IT infrastructure, applications, cloud, and identity management, to assess control design and evidence
* Experience with GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer, MetricStream) or similar tools to manage controls, evidence, and findings

Preferred certifications

* PCI Professional (PCIP) or PCI QSA training
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
* CRISC or CISM (an advantage)
* CompTIA Security+ or equivalent foundational security certification

Soft skills

* Strong attention to detail and a structured, organised way of working
* Clear written and verbal communication, including turning regulatory requirements into practical actions for technical and business teams
* Confident dealing with auditors, regulators, and senior management
* Ability to influence control owners and drive remediation without direct authority
* High integrity and sound judgement when handling sensitive and confidential information

**YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU**

* You’d rather map one control to five standards than document it five times
* You find the gap before the auditor does, and follow it until it’s closed
* You can turn a dense CBE circular into an action a control owner understands
* You can get remediation done without having authority over the people doing it
* You want the bank to be audit ready every day, not just before an inspection

**WHY THIS ROLE**

A digital bank is only as trusted as its controls are provable. You make sure every standard, every regulator, and every audit finds a bank that can show its work.

title: Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer
details:
UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction.

You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle.

A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure.

You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization.

**What You’ll Own**

**Identity, Access & Credential Security**

* Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems.
* Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, password vaults, API keys, SSH keys, recovery codes, and secrets.
* Own security controls around onboarding, role changes, temporary access, contractor access, and offboarding.
* Identify and remove shared, dormant, unnecessary, and excessively privileged accounts.
* Conduct regular access reviews and maintain approval and audit evidence.

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints.
* Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, malware, privilege abuse, insider risk, and unauthorized access.
* Collect evidence, contain threats, coordinate recovery, and drive corrective actions through closure.
* Maintain detection rules, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks.
* Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials.

**Internal Systems & Workforce Security**

* Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems.
* Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations.
* Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and credentials.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in internal security, IAM, SOC/security operations, incident response, IT security, or a closely related role.
* Practical experience with RBAC, MFA, SSO, PAM, identity providers, password management, account lifecycle management, and access auditing.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, centralized logging, authentication logs, alert triage, and case management.
* Proven ability to investigate compromised accounts, malware, credential leaks, suspicious authentication activity, insider risk, and unauthorized access.
* Strong understanding of Linux access, SSH, VPN, endpoints, cloud/SaaS administration, email security, and remote-workforce security.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to enforce security controls while collaborating with HR, IT, managers, and system owners.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in web hosting, cloud infrastructure, data centers, SaaS, fintech, MSSP, or another distributed technology environment is highly valuable. Preferred certifications include Security+, CySA+, GCIH, SC-200, IAM/PAM vendor certifications, CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise. Certifications are a plus — hands-on experience matters more.

**What Success Looks Like**

**You will help us improve:**

* MFA and privileged-access coverage
* Joiner/mover/leaver security and access-removal speed
* Control of shared, dormant, and excessive access
* Alert response and incident-resolution times
* Access-review coverage and security evidence
* Internal security standards, procedures, and playbooks

**Important**

We are not looking for a policy/compliance-only profile. The successful candidate must have real hands-on experience administering access controls, operating security tooling, investigating logs, and responding to security incidents.

You will work closely with our second cybersecurity specialist, the Product & Infrastructure Security Engineer, as well as DevOps, Network, Product, Engineering, Support, Abuse, HR, Finance, Legal, and executive management.

If you enjoy taking ownership, building security controls, investigating real incidents, and improving security in a large-scale technology environment, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer
details:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Rasan is looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Product & Design team. In this role, you will own the design of key product experiences end-to-end – from understanding the problem and the user, through flows, prototypes, and polished interfaces, to measuring the impact of what ships. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to design solutions that are both user-centred and commercially effective. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines strong product thinking with deep UX and UI craft, and who can lead design decisions within their product area while mentoring others.

**Job Objectives**
------------------

* Own the design of assigned product areas end to end, delivering intuitive, visually polished, and accessible experiences across web and mobile.
* Turn business goals, user research, and product data into clear problem statements, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that guide engineering delivery.
* Improve product outcomes – such as conversion, task completion, and user satisfaction – by defining success metrics up front and measuring the impact of shipped designs.
* Contribute to and help maintain Rasan’s design system, ensuring consistency, reusability, and scalability of components across all products.
* Act as a trusted design partner to product and engineering teams, shaping product decisions and delivering within Agile sprint cycles.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Discovery and Research**

* Partner with product managers to frame problems, define opportunities, and agree success metrics and design scope at the start of each initiative.
* Plan and run user research including interviews, usability tests, surveys, and competitive analysis to inform product decisions.
* Create and maintain research artifacts such as personas, customer journey maps, and service blueprints that reflect real user needs and behaviours.
* Combine qualitative insights with product analytics and experiment results to identify and prioritize UX problems by user and business impact.
* Translate findings into clear insights and recommendations that product and engineering teams can act on.

### **Product and Interaction Design**

* Design user flows, information architecture, and interaction patterns that solve real user problems across mobile and web platforms.
* Explore multiple solution directions through wireframes, low-fidelity concepts, and interactive prototypes, and validate them with users before committing to high-fidelity execution.
* Own design deliverables across the product lifecycle, from concept to launch, delivering sprint by sprint in an Agile process.
* Design for complex, regulated journeys such as onboarding, purchase, payment, and claims, balancing user needs, business rules, and technical constraints.
* Facilitate design thinking workshops and collaborative sessions with cross-functional teams to generate ideas and align on solutions.

### **UI Design and Prototyping**

* Design and deliver high-fidelity, pixel-perfect prototypes in Figma for all platforms and screen sizes.
* Apply platform conventions for iOS, Android, desktop, and mobile web so that designs feel native and intuitive on every surface.
* Design for Arabic and English, including right-to-left layouts, ensuring a consistent experience across both languages.
* Ensure every UI is accessible, responsive, and consistent with Rasan’s brand and design standards.
* Prepare clear specifications and handoff documentation so engineers can build designs accurately.

### **Design System and Quality**

* Contribute to and help evolve Rasan’s design system, ensuring components are documented, reusable, and adopted consistently across product teams.
* Build and maintain reusable components, libraries, and patterns that keep the system consistent and speed up delivery.
* Review implemented designs against specifications and give clear, actionable feedback to engineering to maintain design quality in production.
* Champion design quality across the product portfolio – raising issues early and advocating for the time needed to get details right.
* Stay current with product design trends, emerging tools, and platform guidelines, and bring relevant insights back to the team.

### **Collaboration and Communication**

* Work effectively in cross-functional teams with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders, turning abstract ideas into concrete design solutions.
* Present design concepts and decisions clearly to leadership and non-design stakeholders, explaining the rationale in terms of user needs and business goals.
* Mentor and give design direction and constructive feedback to junior and mid-level designers, helping raise the overall quality of design output.
* Communicate directly with customers and end users – gathering feedback, running sessions, and turning real user voices into product improvements.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

### **Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Visual Communication, Computer Science, or a related creative or technical field.

### **Licenses & Certifications**

* Certifications in UX or product design (Google UX Design Certificate, Nielsen Norman Group UX Certification, or equivalent) are a plus. Figma Advanced certification is advantageous.

### **Previous Work Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in a product, UX/UI, or digital design role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design work on digital products (mobile and web). Proven experience working within Agile product teams alongside engineers and product managers. A strong public portfolio on Behance, Dribbble, or a personal site is required, showing the problem, the process, and the outcome. Experience in fintech, insurtech, or consumer-facing digital platforms is a strong advantage.

### **Skills and Abilities**

* Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including components, auto-layout, prototyping, variables, and design system management.
* Strong product thinking – able to frame problems, weigh trade-offs, and tie design decisions to user value and business outcomes.
* Deep understanding of user-centred design principles, design thinking methodology, and interaction design patterns.
* Strong ability to create and communicate information architecture, user flows, wireframes, and navigation structures across complex products.
* Hands-on experience with research methods: user interviews, usability testing, surveys, card sorting, and heuristic evaluation.
* Comfortable using data – analytics, funnels, and A/B test results – to inform and evaluate design decisions.
* Clear understanding of iOS (Human Interface Guidelines) and Android (Material Design) conventions, and experience designing responsive web experiences.
* Strong visual design sensibility, with close attention to typography, spacing, colour, and detail. Experience designing bilingual Arabic/English and right-to-left interfaces is a plus.
* High-level knowledge of Agile software development and the ability to deliver design incrementally alongside engineering.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills – able to present design rationale clearly to customers, peers, and leadership.
* Passionate about using design to resolve real user pain points, with a track record of measurably improving product usability and user satisfaction.

title: Senior Product Designer
details:

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. As a Senior Product Designer at PF, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the design and user experience of our B2B products. You will drive the design process from discovery to delivery, taking ownership of projects and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

As a senior member of the design team, you will work alongside other designers, contribute to design strategy, and ensure that our products align with both customer needs and business goals. This role offers you the chance to lead complex design projects, work on strategic initiatives, and be a key player in achieving PF’s mission to become the most trusted partner in real estate across the MENA region.

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect user needs with business objectives and contribute to product and design strategy.

title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
details:
**Senior Product Designer**

**Role Summary**

We're looking for a hands-on, outcome-driven Senior Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience for a product area — from discovery through interaction design, visual craft, and launch. You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn ambiguous problems into polished, scalable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Thinking & Discovery**

* End-to-end ownership: own the design lifecycle for your product area, from problem discovery through engineering handoff and post-launch evaluation.

* Problem framing: go beyond stated requirements to understand users, Jobs to Be Done, business goals, and constraints — and challenge assumptions before designing solutions.

* Research & validation: run user interviews, usability testing, and other discovery methods to uncover needs and pain points.

* Solution exploration: explore multiple approaches, edge cases, and trade-offs before converging, and frame hypotheses to test.

* Impact & iteration: use product metrics and qualitative evidence to evaluate design impact and inform iteration.

**Interaction, Visual Craft & Prototyping**

* High-fidelity UI/UX: design user flows, information architecture, and production-ready interfaces for web and mobile.

* Data-dense workflows: architect dashboards and complex operational workflows that reduce cognitive load.

* Prototyping: build interactive prototypes to communicate interaction behaviors and component states.

* Edge cases: design for error states, empty states, loading patterns, and permissions.

* Iteration: respond well to critique and rapidly refine designs while holding a high quality bar. Design Systems & Scalability

* Design system contribution: help scale and govern a multi-platform design system (typography, spacing, grids, tokens).

* AI-assisted workflows: integrate AI design/workflow tools to speed up research, ideation, and documentation. Cross-Functional Execution

* Engineering partnership: work with front-end engineers through build and QA to ensure high-fidelity implementation.

* Specifications: maintain clear UI specs and documentation covering responsive breakpoints and component states.

* Stakeholder communication: present work confidently to executives and cross-functional partners, and stay open to technical trade-offs.

  
**Qualifications & Requirements:**  
  

* 5+ years in Product or UX Design, or equivalent senior-level experience shipping digital products end-to- end.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, from problem framing through polished, business- impacting solutions.
* Exceptional visual/UI craft: typography, layout, interaction design, and responsive design across breakpoints.
* Advanced Figma skills (variables, auto-layout, component architecture, prototyping).
* Hands-on experience contributing to and documenting design systems.
* Practical user research experience (interviews, usability testing, translating findings into iterations).
* Experience designing data-heavy applications or complex operational workflows.
* Solid grasp of front-end constraints and ability to collaborate pragmatically with engineers.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently across teams.

  
**Bonus Points**  

* Front-end coding or functional prototyping experience (HTML/CSS, React, or React Native).
* Fintech, payments, loyalty, or regulatory-heavy SaaS design experience.
* Motion design, micro-interactions, Lottie, or 3D asset experience.
* Experience creating public-facing reports, infographics, or product-marketing collateral.

title: Product Manager - Fintech
details:
**Who we are:**

Bayzat is at the forefront of transforming workplaces through innovative solutions in HR, Payroll, Finance, and Insurance. At Bayzat, culture is paramount. We are a principle-driven, merit-based organization where authenticity, collaboration, and unpretentiousness thrive. Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimize efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
As a Product Manager on our Fintech team, you will own a growing portfolio at the intersection of payroll, payments, corporate cards, benefits, and AI across the UAE and KSA.  
**Your portfolio includes**:  

* **Corporate Cards and Payments**, including payment flows, payment gateways, payment rails, and

orchestration across providers  

* **AI Reporting**, including AI-powered text-to-SQL that turns natural-language questions into accurate,

actionable insights  

* **Health Insurance**, covering policy management and claims workflows
* **Performance Management**, covering goals, reviews, and continuous feedback

  
Your goal is to deliver products that customers trust: explainable AI, reliable financial and insurance  
workflows, and full alignment with regional regulations. This role suits someone who has built or scaled fintech, payments, AI-driven analytics, or benefits  
products, and who understands both applied AI and the compliance landscape in the region.  
  
**Some high-impact responsibilities you will be entrusted with:**  
  
**Discover:**  

* Uncover customer pain points across payroll, payments, corporate cards, insurance operations, performance management, and reporting through interviews, data analysis, and competitive research
* Spot opportunities across the portfolio and validate them with cross-functional teams before committing

to build  
  
**Design:**  

* Define requirements, user journeys, edge cases, and business rules, especially around payment and card logic, payroll, insurance policies and claims, performance processes, and AI behavior
* Partner with designers and engineers to prototype, test, and refine, or build your own prototypes using AI
* Account for the systems and data dependencies behind every feature, including HRIS, payroll, banking, payment, and insurance platforms

  
**Integrate:**  

* Lead end-to-end scoping, design, and delivery of integrations with banks, payment gateways, payment rail providers, payment orchestration providers, card issuers and processors, insurance platforms, and HRIS and payroll systems
* Own the data pipelines that power AI Reporting and the AI Knowledge Hub, working with data,

compliance, risk, and engineering to ensure reliable sync logic, secure transactions, and trustworthy AI outputs  

* Track fintech, payments, and AI innovations and identify where they can improve our products

  
**Deliver:**  

* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and give engineering deep context on workflows and on AI capabilities and limitations
* Ship with high quality, security, and measurable business impact
* Monitor usage, transaction success rates, and reliability to drive continuous iteration

  
**Lead:**  

* Partner with compliance and legal to align products with regional regulations, including wage protection, payments and financial services rules, data protection, and insurance requirements in the UAE and KSA
* Manage relationships with strategic partners and vendors (banks, payment gateways, payment rail and orchestration providers, card program partners, insurance carriers and underwriters, HR data providers,AI/ML tooling vendors)
* Coordinate across engineering, design, operations, risk, and customer success for a successful go-to-market

  

**What you will need to have:**  
  
**Must have**  

* 2+ years of Product Management experience
* Experience with corporate cards, payments, payment gateways, payment rail providers, or payment orchestration providers; and/or payroll, insurance platforms, HR or performance management systems, or AI-powered products
* Strong stakeholder management skills
* An analytical mindset: you gather, analyze, and interpret data to make sound business decisions
* Critical thinking and a growth mindset, with a drive to build new products

  
**Nice to have**  

* Familiarity with financial and payments regulation and compliance in the UAE and/or KSA

  

**What’s in it for You**

At Bayzat, we don’t sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture — we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You’ll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you’ll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Meritocracy at its core:** Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.
* **Freedom to shape your path:** We support cross-functional moves and growth transitions when you drive value.
* **Real feedback culture:** Feedback is coaching — empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
* **Barrier-free collaboration:** Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you’ll have a seat at the table — even with the CEO.
* **Accelerated growth:** Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
* **Flexible work setup:** Remote and hybrid options designed around performance.
* **Inclusive culture:** Regular company-wide all-hands, OKR tribe meetings, and annual awards that celebrate real impact.

This isn’t for everyone — but if you want to be pushed, inspired, and rewarded for what you deliver, **welcome to Bayzat.**

At Bayzat, culture is paramount. We are a principle-driven, merit-based organization where authenticity, collaboration, and unpretentiousness thrive. Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimize efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.  

**About the Role**  

We're looking for an experienced **Product Manager** to join our **AI and Talent team**, focused on solving critical challenges in workforce intelligence, employee benefits, and talent development across the UAE and KSA. You'll own a growing portfolio spanning AI Reporting — including AI-powered text-to-SQL that turns natural language questions into accurate, actionable insights — as well as our Health Insurance and Performance Management modules.  
  
You'll drive reliable, explainable AI experiences that customers trust, streamline insurance policy management and claims workflows in line with regional regulations, and build performance tools for goals, reviews, and continuous feedback.
  
  
This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who has built or scaled AI-driven analytics, benefits, or talent products, and who understands applied AI in HR and the region's compliance landscape.

**Some high-impact responsibilities you will be entrusted with:**

**Product Discovery**

* Understand customer workflows and pain points across insurance operations, performance management, reporting and knowledge base through interviews, data analysis, and competitive research
* Identify opportunities across the portfolio of products to streamline how customers work
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to define and validate high-impact solutions

**Product Design**

* Define product requirements, user journeys, edge cases, and business rules — especially around insurance logic, performance management processes, and AI
* Collaborate with product designers and engineers to prototype, test, and refine features, or build your own prototypes using AI
* Ensure product designs account for different systems, HR/performance systems, and the data and integration requirements that feed AI features

**AI & Systems Integrations**

* Lead end-to-end scoping, design, and delivery of integrations with insurance platforms, HRIS/performance systems, and the data pipelines that power AI reporting and the AI Knowledge Hub
* Stay up to date on the latest AI innovations and understand how we can use them to improve our products
* Work closely with data, compliance, and engineering teams to build reliable and scalable sync logic and trustworthy AI outputs

**Product Delivery**

* Define clear user stories and acceptance criteria for engineering teams
* Provide deep context around insurance workflows, performance management processes, and AI capabilities and limitations
* Collaborate with all stakeholders to ensure features are shipped with high quality and business impact
* Monitor product usage and performance to inform iteration and improvements

**Cross-functional Leadership**

* Work with strategic partners and vendors where needed (e.g., insurance carriers/underwriters, HR data providers, AI/ML tooling vendors)
* Coordinate across engineering, design, operations, and customer success to ensure successful go-to-market

**What you will need to have:**

* A minimum of 2 years of Product Management experience
* You must be a native Arabic speaker
* Experience working with Insurance platforms, HR/Performance Management systems, and/or AI-powered products
* Strong stakeholder management skills
* Analytical mindset: you understand how to gather the data, how to analyze the data, how to interpret the data to make business decisions
* Growth mindset, desire to build new products
* Critical thinking

**What’s in it for You**

At Bayzat, we don’t sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture — we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You’ll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you’ll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Meritocracy at its core:** Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.

* **Real feedback culture:** Feedback is coaching — empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
* **Barrier-free collaboration:** Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you’ll have a seat at the table — even with the CEO.
* **Accelerated growth:** Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
* **Flexible work setup:** Remote and hybrid options designed around performance.
* **Inclusive culture:** Regular company-wide all-hands, OKR tribe meetings, and annual awards that celebrate real impact.

This isn’t for everyone — but if you want to be pushed, inspired, and rewarded for what you deliver, **welcome to Bayzat.**

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through delivery and operational handover. The successful candidate will apply project management practices across the full project life cycle, adapt delivery approaches to suit the work, and coordinate teams, stakeholders, suppliers, and technology partners.

The role requires practical knowledge of **PMI/PMP project management principles**, **Agile and Scrum**, **Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and GenAI LLM** . It also calls for familiarity with cloud platforms and certifications, AI literacy—including agentic AI—and workflow orchestration .

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Project life-cycle leadership**

* Lead work across the full project life cycle:
  + **Initiation:** clarify the business need, objectives, expected benefits, stakeholders, assumptions, constraints, and high-level scope.
  + **Planning:** develop and maintain the integrated project management plan, scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, quality, communications, procurement, risk, and stakeholder engagement plans.
  + **Execution:** coordinate delivery teams, manage dependencies and suppliers, facilitate decisions, and support effective communication and collaboration.
  + **Monitoring and controlling:** track progress against baselines, manage forecasts and performance measures, assess risks and issues, control changes, and report status transparently.
  + **Closing and transition:** confirm acceptance, complete handover to operations, close contracts and documentation, capture lessons learned, and support benefits tracking.
* Define project governance, decision rights, escalation paths, tolerances, and reporting cadence.
* Establish and maintain scope, schedule, cost, resource, risk, issue, dependency, assumption, and change controls.
* Manage integrated plans and dependencies across business, product, technology, data, security, and operations teams.
* Use appropriate project controls and reporting methods, including milestone tracking, forecasts, dashboards, and earned-value concepts where relevant.
* Identify delivery risks early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans.
* Manage changes through impact assessment, approval, communication, and baseline updates.
* Ensure quality planning, assurance, acceptance criteria, testing coordination, and readiness for release.
* Coordinate procurement, vendors, contracts, and third-party delivery commitments as required.
* Lead project reviews, steering committee meetings, decision forums, and executive updates.
* Support benefits realization by aligning delivery outcomes with business objectives and tracking agreed measures after implementation.

### **Agile, Scrum, and SAFe delivery**

* Select and tailor predictive, iterative, Agile, or hybrid approaches to fit project context, uncertainty, governance, and organizational needs.
* Apply Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, and increment delivery.
* Work effectively with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, engineering teams, and business stakeholders while respecting their accountabilities.
* Support backlog visibility, prioritization, acceptance criteria, release planning, and delivery forecasting.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of SAFe concepts and terminology, including Agile Release Trains, PI Planning, team and program backlogs, dependencies, and Inspect and Adapt events.
* Coordinate across teams and delivery trains, escalating impediments and managing cross-team risks and dependencies.
* Help teams improve delivery flow, transparency, predictability, and continuous learning.

### **Cloud, AI, and automation**

* Demonstrate an understanding of cloud delivery considerations, such as shared-responsibility models, security, privacy, resilience, cost management, and migration or modernization dependencies.
* Coordinate cloud-related initiatives with architecture, engineering, security, data, and operations teams.
* Maintain relevant cloud knowledge or certifications, such as:
  + **AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner** or an equivalent AWS certification.
  + **Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)** or an equivalent Azure certification.
  + **Google Cloud Digital Leader** or an equivalent Google Cloud certification.
* Apply sound AI literacy to project planning and delivery, including awareness of generative AI, data quality, model limitations, evaluation, human oversight, privacy, security, and responsible-use considerations.
* Understand agentic AI at a practical level, including AI agents’ goals, tools, permissions, context, monitoring, escalation, and human approval points.
* Assess AI use cases for suitability, risks, governance requirements, value, and operational readiness; do not treat autonomous outputs as inherently reliable.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable workflows and coordinate automation initiatives with relevant technical and business owners.
* Demonstrate familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms such as **n8n**, including triggers, workflows, integrations, error handling, access controls, and monitoring.
* Coordinate safe integration of AI agents and automations with enterprise systems, including testing, auditability, fallback procedures, and appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in project management, business, technology, or a related field.
* Significant experience managing complex, cross-functional projects or programs, including ownership of plans, governance, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
* **PMP certification** or equivalent demonstrable knowledge of PMI project management practices.

* Architect, implement, and maintain modular automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright with Java (Maven/Gradle, TestNG/JUnit) and Playwright with C# (.NET, NUnit/xUnit).
* Implement design patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Screenplay pattern, dynamic fixtures, and Playwright auto-waiting to achieve reliable, zero-flake test suites.
* Performance & Load Testing: Design, build, and maintain realistic performance testing workloads in Apache JMeter (load, stress, spike, endurance, and capacity testing).
* Analyze JMeter KPIs (throughput, latency, response time percentiles 90th/95th/99th, error rates) and correlate findings with backend metrics via APM tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace).
* Integrate Playwright suites and headless JMeter test runs into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) with automated pass/fail thresholds and artifact reporting.
* Combine Playwright API testing and JMeter HTTP/REST samplers to execute contract, integration, and load testing against backend microservices.
* Establish coding standards for automation, conduct code reviews, and mentor engineers across quality engineering best practices.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Quality Assurance Automation / SDET roles, with demonstrated ownership of both web UI automation and backend performance testing.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong production experience writing end-to-end web automation tests using Playwright.
* Solid proficiency in Java (JDK 11+, OOP, Maven/Gradle, TestNG/JUnit) and C# (.NET 6+, LINQ, async/await, NUnit/xUnit).
* Proven track record with Apache JMeter, including dynamic parameterization, correlation (regular expressions, JSON extractors), distributed testing (master/slave architecture), and Groovy/JSR223 scripting.
* Experience running headless test suites and JMeter CLI in pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and containerized runners (Docker).
* Deep understanding of the DOM, browser DevTools, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, RESTful APIs, caching mechanisms, and web sockets.

title: Software Quality Control Engineer
details:
### **Description**

**Money Fellows** is transforming how people save, borrow, and invest. As the world’s first and largest Money Circles app, we’ve digitized the traditional **ROSCA** model to make it smarter, safer, and more accessible.
  
  
Since **2018**, we’ve empowered over **7 million users** to take control of their financial futures with confidence.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Collaborate with stakeholders, including product managers, software engineers, and business analysts, to understand project requirements and define test objectives.

* Conduct various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, performance, and security testing.
* Report and track software defects using defect tracking tools, ensuring timely resolution and closure.

* Experience with tools. Understanding of various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, performance, and security testing.
* Knowledge of test automation frameworks and experience in writing automated test scripts. Familiarity with agile development methodologies and CI/CD processes.
* Understanding of the fintech industry, its regulations, compliance requirements, and security best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and troubleshoot software defects.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented mindset focused on delivering high-quality software solutions.

  

### **Job Benefits**

We care about your well-being from day one, whether you’re a candidate or a team member, by actively fostering a culture of psychological safety where you feel respected, heard, and supported.

* **Mental Well-being:** We prioritize your mental health through open-door policies, skip-level meetings, and thoughtfully designed workspaces that encourage trust and transparency.

Join us and be part of a community that supports every aspect of your well-being and growth.

Money Fellows is revolutionizing the way people save, borrow, and invest! As the world's first and largest Money Circles app, we've digitized the traditional ROSCA model, making it smarter, safer, and more accessible for over 7 million users since 2018.  
  
Backed by $45M+ in funding and gearing up for $100M Series C, we’re scaling fast—expanding beyond Egypt and launching game-changing financial products. Regulated by the Central Bank of Egypt, we blend community-driven finance with cutting-edge tech to empower users with seamless, secure, and trusted financial solutions.  
  
And now, we’ve taken it a step further with the launch of the Money Fellows Card—unlocking even more financial freedom and flexibility for our users!
  
  
We’re always on the lookout for trailblazers ready to shape the future of fintech with us!

title: Diesel Shop Lead
details:
Amentum is actively seeking a Diesel Shop Lead for International Fleet Support under the Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) PMS 326 Follow-On Technical Support (FOTS) contract. **The work location will be at the Egyptian Naval Base in the port of Alexandria, Egypt.** This position includes a competitive benefits package.

  

**Essential responsibilities and daily duties include:**

* Conduct system start-up and performance testing to ensure proper functioning before full-scale operations.
* Perform regular engine performance tests and diagnostics to identify potential issues before they lead to failure, ensuring engines are always ready for deployment.
* Plan and execute major engine overhauls and rebuilds, working closely with ship engineers and outside vendors to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
* Manage day-to-day shop operations, including work scheduling, parts inventory, and tool management, ensuring the shop runs efficiently.
* Lead a team of diesel mechanics and technicians, providing guidance on complex repairs, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance procedures.
* Oversee the repair, maintenance, and overhaul of diesel engines aboard naval surface ships, ensuring that all work is performed to NAVSEA and military standards.
* Proven ability to lead a team of diesel mechanics, technicians, and apprentices, delegating tasks efficiently and ensuring quality control.
* Oversee daily shop operations, scheduling, and manpower allocation to ensure projects are completed on time and to standards.
* Responsible for training and mentoring junior diesel mechanics, providing hands-on instruction in maintenance, troubleshooting, and safety protocols.
* Ensure that all team members are up to date on the latest techniques, tools, and technologies in diesel engine maintenance.
* Make critical decisions regarding engine repairs or replacements, especially in time-sensitive situations aboard naval vessels.
* Plan and execute major engine repairs, overhauls, and replacements, including coordinating with other departments (e.g., electrical, plumbing) and outside vendors.
* Track project progress and manage parts inventory, ensuring necessary tools and parts are on hand for repair and maintenance tasks.
* Provide timely and comprehensive inputs for the Monthly Status Report.

**Minimum Requirements**

* High School diploma or GED.
* 7 years of experience working with diesel engines, particularly marine diesel engines used aboard naval surface ships.
* 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience in a diesel shop, marine maintenance facility, or similar environment.
* Ability to solve problems and address unexpected engine issues, system malfunctions, or parts shortages.
* Working knowledge with naval diesel engines, including high-power engines used for propulsion, auxiliary power, and ship systems.
* Working knowledge of various types of marine diesel engines used on naval surface ships, such as main propulsion engines, diesel generators, and auxiliary engines.
* Working knowledge of both two-stroke and four-stroke engines, as well as turbocharged and naturally aspirated systems.
* Working knowledge of marine diesel fuel injection systems, including common shipboard fuel systems, unit injectors, and fuel pumps.
* Working knowledge of diesel engine cooling systems, including seawater and freshwater cooling loops, heat exchangers, and coolant pumps.
* Ability to troubleshoot and maintain cooling systems to prevent overheating and ensure optimal engine performance.
* Working experience maintaining lubrication systems, including oil pumps, filters, and coolers for high-power marine diesel engines.
* Ability to monitor and analyze engine oil to identify signs of wear, contamination, or system malfunction.

* Familiarity with diesel engine exhaust systems, including turbochargers, after coolers, and exhaust manifolds.
* Working experience in performing preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and major overhauls on marine diesel engines.
* Ability to disassemble, repair, and reassemble engine components, including pistons, cylinder heads, crankshafts, and valve trains.
* Proficiency in performing top-end and bottom-end overhauls, as well as in-frame and out-of-frame repairs.
* Ability to apply diagnostic skills using engine diagnostic tools, compression testers, and engine analyzers to identify mechanical, electrical, and performance issues.
* Expertise in troubleshooting diesel engine failures, including fuel system issues, compression loss, turbocharger failure, and cooling system malfunctions.
* Knowledge of engine control systems, including engine management systems (EMS), start/stop systems, and engine diagnostics software.
* Working knowledge of how diesel engines integrate with shipboard electrical systems, including generators, and automation controls.

* Working experience in diagnosing and repairing turbocharger issues, such as oil leaks, boost pressure problems, and turbine damage.
* Working experience in troubleshooting and maintaining fuel filtration systems, fuel injectors, and fuel pumps to ensure proper engine performance.
* Working experience in running engine load tests and performance evaluations using dynamometers or shipboard testing equipment.
* Ability to calibrate fuel injectors, adjust valve clearances, and fine-tune engine performance to meet operational requirements.
* Familiarity with NAVSEA standards and maintenance procedures for naval surface ships, ensuring all engine work meets military specifications and safety requirements.
* Working knowledge of environmental regulations related to diesel engine emissions, fuel systems, and oily water separation aboard ships.
* Ability to ensure compliance with IMO Tier II or III standards for marine diesel engines where applicable.
* Working knowledge of shipboard safety protocols, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, confined space entry, and fire safety when working with diesel engines and fuel systems.
* Ability to ensure all team members follow safety regulations and always wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Ability to communicate well skills for interacting with naval officers, engineers, and shipyard personnel to ensure smooth coordination of repairs and maintenance tasks.
* Ability to provide key attention to detail when performing inspections, adjustments, and repairs on critical diesel engine components.
* Ability to motivate and lead a team in a high-pressure environment, particularly during emergency repairs or ship deployments.
* Ability to work in confined spaces aboard naval vessels, such as engine rooms and mechanical spaces.
* Ability to perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting heavy engine parts and tools.
* Ability to work in hot or noisy environments typical of diesel engine rooms aboard ships.
* Ability to obtain a Country Clearance and Base Pass authorization.
* Possess a current passport at least two years before expiration after arrival in Egypt.
* Ability to travel CONUS and OCONUS.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Propulsion Systems Integration: Knowledge of how diesel engines integrate with ship propulsion systems, including gearboxes, shafts, and propellers.
* Technical or vocational training in diesel engine repair, marine diesel mechanics, or mechanical engineering.
* Certifications such as Marine Diesel Technician, ASE Diesel Certification, or OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) certifications for diesel engines (e.g., Caterpillar, MTU, or Detroit Diesel).
* Hybrid Diesel-Electric Systems: Experience working with newer diesel-electric propulsion systems or hybrid systems that combine diesel engines with electric motors for improved efficiency.
* Experience working in an Arab country for long periods.
