title: Incident and Problem Management Leader
details:
Egypt (New Cairo)

Information Technology

Experienced Professionals

**Department:** Enabling Technology, Digital & Technology Platform Services

**Location:** Egypt, New Cairo

  

The **Incident & Problem Management Leader** within the Service Integration & Management (SIAM) organization is a hands-on team member responsible for coordinating end-to-end incident, major incident and problem management across product teams, internal IT functions and external service providers. The role restores service quickly, prevents recurrence, strengthens operational discipline and ensures clear ownership in a complex, global, multi-provider environment. Reporting to the SIAM Manager, the position combines daily operational coordination with governance, analytics, service activation support and continuous improvement, while working collaboratively with SIAM colleagues and senior business stakeholders.

  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Incident Management:**

* Coordinate and manage the incident management process end-to-end across the Service Desk, external service providers, product, and platform teams.
* Own and manage major incidents end-to-end within the SIAM team, including declaration and mobilization, crisis bridge leadership, impact assessment, resolver and supplier coordination, stakeholder and executive communications, recovery tracking, service validation, closure and post-incident follow-up. The role also includes 24\*7 support on rotational basis for managing major incidents.
* Ensure all incidents are accurately logged, prioritized, progressed and resolved within agreed service levels, with timely, consistent and audience-appropriate stakeholder communication.
* Facilitate incident and problem swarms to enable effective cross-provider collaboration, remove ownership barriers and accelerate diagnosis and service restoration.
* Lead post-incident reviews for major and recurring incidents, clearly separating symptoms, business impact, workaround, recovery, confirmed failure mechanism and root cause, while ensuring agreed actions are tracked through completion.
* Monitor incident trends, SLA performance, MTTR, incident ageing, reassignment levels and recurring failures to identify operational risks and improvement opportunities.

**Problem Management:**

* Manage the problem lifecycle from identification and prioritization through root cause analysis, known error, corrective action and closure.
* Facilitate evidence-based root cause analysis using methods such as 5 Whys, cause-and-effect analysis and timeline reconstruction, while avoiding premature conclusions.
* Maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB), ensuring known issues, reusable workarounds and related knowledge articles remain accurate, accessible and current.
* Proactively identify problems through recurring incidents, SLA and MTTR trends, major incident learnings, operational risk signals and supplier performance data.
* Maintain a healthy problem backlog and ensure corrective actions have accountable owners, target dates, supporting evidence and timely escalation when overdue.
* Work closely with Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams and other technical owners to maintain effective problem progression, remove blockers and drive permanent resolution at an acceptable pace.

**Collaboration and Communication:**

* Coordinate multiple service providers and internal teams against agreed responsibilities, SLAs, OLAs, escalation paths and operational procedures.
* Facilitate communication across providers and resolver teams, remaining collaborative while firmly challenging unclear ownership, ticket bouncing and stalled investigations.
* Organize and lead incident, problem and service-performance reviews, converting operational data into clear decisions, actions, owners and deadlines.
* Lead monthly portfolio reviews for key business stakeholders, presenting service performance, risks, major incident themes, problem progress and improvement priorities with confidence and sound judgment, including participation in challenging discussions

**Process Improvement:**

* Continuously improve incident and problem management practices in line with ITIL 5, SIAM and IT4IT principles.
* Identify automation and optimization opportunities using ServiceNow data, operational evidence and recurring process pain points.
* Analyze trends, recurring issues, backlog health, supplier responsiveness and control gaps to support informed decisions and measurable continual improvement.
* Support service activations by validating support groups, routing, priorities, SLAs/OLAs, monitoring, knowledge, escalation, contingency and hypercare readiness.
* Act as the operational process owner for Incident Management, Problem Management, Service Request Management and Major Incident Management, maintaining clear governance, documentation, progress reporting and improvement roadmaps.

**Compliance and Governance:**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, process controls, documentation standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support annual audits and maintain audit readiness by ensuring the availability of required process documentation, governance records and supporting evidence.
* Ensure suppliers and internal teams meet agreed operational responsibilities, and transparently escalate material risks, overdue actions and unresolved gaps.

  

**ARE THESE YOUR SECRET INGREDIENTS?**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ITILv5 Foundation is required or must be obtained within the agreed onboarding period; SIAM, IT4IT, ServiceNow or problem-solving certifications are advantageous.
* 5+ years or more of practical experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Major Incident Management, IT Service Management or a comparable service-operations role.
* Proven experience coordinating internal teams and external service providers in a complex enterprise or SIAM environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with evidence-based thinking and attention to operational detail.
* Clear leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to challenge diplomatically and maintain collaboration under pressure.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform; knowledge of Service Operations Workspace and CSDM is advantageous.

**Skills**

* Working knowledge of ITILv5 Incident Management, Problem Management, Service Level Management, Change Enablement and Continual Improvement practices.
* Strong understanding of incident, problem and major incident management, including IMCR governance, crisis bridge leadership and multi-provider operating models.
* Proficiency in structured root cause analysis, corrective-action tracking and proactive problem identification.
* Ability to lead major incidents end-to-end, remain calm and structured under pressure, manage shifting priorities and coordinate cross-functional teams and service providers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including operational updates, executive summaries, resolution communications and regular performance reporting.
* Strong collaboration, personal accountability, curiosity and follow-through, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams, suppliers and senior stakeholder groups.

**What you will do**

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams mainly commercial, marketing, operations and regulatory. You will manage forecasting systems, and analyze data to improve forecast accuracy and support strategic and operational planning.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain comprehensive demand forecasts and to optimize inventory levels, reduce stockouts, and enhance forecast accuracy.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, operations, customer service, finance, and other teams to facilitate interim forecast discussions, and ensure alignment with internal customer needs, business objectives, and dynamic market trends.

* Manage and coordinate import planning activities for Egypt, ensuring supply continuity, inventory optimization, and stable warehouse operations.

* Lead end-to-end local co-packing activities with external suppliers, ensuring timely planning and execution to support product availability and prevent loss of sales.

* Maintain and govern planning master data, ensuring data accuracy, process compliance, and reliable system inputs to support effective supply chain planning.

Winning teams will be in for a token of appreciation from P&G.

***Date & Time****:* Week One November

Top performing talents will be invited to continue their interviews.

***Place****:* P&G Head Office

**Get started on the path to your own #PGDay1.**

Do you want to transform materials for winning consumer experiences?

Then an Internship as Manufacturing/Engineering Intern in one of our plants might be the right place for you to gain this  
experience!

In our Manufacturing department, we produce consumer goods to supply the market in conformity with the expectations of our customers in terms of quality, time and at the lowest cost. In an increasingly innovative environment to ensure our leading position, our fully automated plants are constantly renewed so that we ensure the development and use of most advanced technologies. We will value your creativity and your ability to analyze and solve problems.

Your Role as an Intern in Manufacturing/Engineering:

In this internship role, you will have the opportunity to be on the floor to meet different challenges, make decisions and see quickly the results. You will discover P&G's technologies who are worldly recognized. You will also discover the P&G's standards and methods. In the end you will build your own capabilities through the job experience, mentoring and training.

Are you ready to take the challenge?

You are likely to be placed in one of the following functions:

Production - Packing

This function packs our product in its final packaging, set up in palets. Three priorities for packing departments: Safety, Quality, Productivity. The heart of the engineering profession in packing is the constant improvement of the production lines in order to increase its effectiveness (reducing timing of changeover, decrease downtime etc.)

Your missions will be to:

* Make studies on performance loss (on equipment, skills, organization)
* Identify one or more key projects to achieve the performance targets of the packing line
* Establish methods for solving technical problems
* Systematize tools for maintenance and implement production management tools
* Work on the installation and start up of new equipment

Production - Making

This is the department that mixes our products, from recipes sent by R & D. Priority for making is to produce in large quantities and with flexibility, a product according to the original recipe, to deliver the packing lines in time . The top priority of the making teams is the continuous improvement of the manufacturing process to eliminate any loss in different stages  
(formula change time reduction, decrease downtime, operator training on chemical process, development of maintenance  
plans...).

In this department, you will:

* Make the study and analysis of performance loss (equipment, organization, skills)
* Ensure the communication between different departments (logistics, packing, projects etc.)
* Create learning programs for operators and team leader to help them to develop their skills
* Establish systematization tools, simplify process and standardize work

Quality

The Quality department handles the quality assurance of our products, that is to say all the systems that ensure that we produce a consistent quality in line with consumer expectations and in accordance with local laws and P&G rules. It validates all the formulas and equipment prior to production, and is also responsible for the study of “non-standards” to improve our processes and training of the entire plant to quality principles. You will ensure that the quality of the products is optimal.

For this, you will:

* Develop the quality indicators and audits
* Support the production (especially on equipment validation, process etc.)
* Investigate " non-standard " and establish an action plan
* Participate in workshops within a multifunctional team

Health Safety & Environment

This team handles the environmental issues of the site, including working on our waste, destruction of defective products, water management and energy ...

You will work on:

* Environmental Management Site (destruction of products, waste management ...)
* Conducting a study on the consumption of energy and water at the site and propose practical and sustainable solutions for improving and reducing energy consumption across our processes

What we offer:

* Responsibilities as of Day 1 – you will feel the ownership of your project from the beginning, and you will be given specific projects and responsibilities
* Continuous coaching & mentoring– you will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day to day mentoring from your manager
* Dynamic and respectful work environment - employees are at the core; we value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work/life balance

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. title: Solutions Lead, Programs
details:
**Role summary**
----------------

**Reports to:** Director of Programs and Customer Success **Location:** Cairo, Egypt (hybrid), with regular travel across the GCC **Works closely with:** Commercial team, Program Managers, Costing and Pricing, Strategic Partnerships

**The role.** The Solutions Lead is the bridge between what partners need and what Manara can deliver. You will research ecosystems and prospective partners, build a deep working knowledge of our delivery capabilities, and turn that into proposals and concept notes that win. You will pitch alongside the commercial team as the owner of the solution, then hand over cleanly to Programs for delivery.

**What you will do**
--------------------

### **Ecosystem and partner research**

* Map target ecosystems across MENA (governments, foundations, tech companies, development organizations), with priority on KSA, UAE, Qatar, and Egypt.
* Build partner briefs covering strategic priorities, funding cycles, workforce agendas, and decision makers.
* Track national strategies, labor market data, and policy shifts, and turn them into the evidence base for each proposal.

### **Delivery capability mastery**

* Learn Manara's program models, curricula, delivery partners, certification pathways, outcomes data, and operational constraints in detail.
* Own a living capability library: case studies, program archetypes, impact metrics, and reusable proposal modules.
* Work with Program Managers to keep the library accurate and grounded in what we can actually deliver.

### **Proposal and concept note design**

* Lead concept notes, proposals, and pitch decks from first brief to final submission.
* Design program architecture: target cohorts, learning journeys, delivery model, timelines, KPIs, and MEL frameworks.
* Build realistic delivery budgets with Costing, and align on pricing and terms with the commercial team.
* Run feasibility checks before we commit, and flag delivery risks early.

### **Pitching and stakeholder engagement**

* Co-present with the commercial team, owning the solution narrative and answering technical and design questions.
* Lead discovery conversations to sharpen requirements and tailor the offer.
* Manage revisions and follow-ups through to contracting.

### **Handover and continuous improvement**

* Produce structured handover packs so Programs can launch without re-scoping.
* Run win/loss reviews and feed lessons into templates, positioning, and the capability library.

**What success looks like in the first 6 months**
-------------------------------------------------

* Owns end-to-end pre-sales on at least 5 active opportunities with minimal Director involvement.
* Capability library and proposal template set are live and used by the commercial team.
* Average proposal turnaround is shorter, and every submission passes a feasibility and costing check.
* No major re-scoping after handover on newly won programs.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Must have**

* 5+ years in pre-sales, solution design, proposal development, or program design, ideally in education, workforce development, consulting, or tech.
* A track record of winning proposals or concept notes for government, foundation, or corporate funders.
* Strong research and synthesis: you can turn a national strategy and a labor market report into a sharp program rationale.
* Excellent written and spoken English and Arabic.
* Confidence presenting to senior stakeholders and defending design choices.
* Commercial awareness: you understand margins, cost drivers, and how scope shapes price.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with GCC government entities or development organizations.
* Familiarity with cloud, AI, or digital skills ecosystems (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Adobe).
* Background in MEL or outcomes-based program design.

details:
**A Snapshot of your day**

Your day involves leading the mechanical maintenance of critical power plant equipment to ensure maximum reliability, availability, and operational performance, while driving preventative and corrective maintenance activities across the site. * Lead and execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities for gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, and other critical mechanical equipment to ensure high plant reliability and availability.
* Manage and oversee major outages, overhauls, and shutdowns, ensuring all maintenance work is completed safely, on schedule, and within budget.
* Analyze equipment performance and failure trends to develop optimized maintenance strategies and drive continuous improvement in asset reliability.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate mechanical maintenance teams and third-party contractors, while collaborating with Operations, Electrical, and I&C teams to minimize downtime and maximize plant performance.
* Ensure full compliance with EHS, quality, and documentation standards, while managing spare parts inventory and procurement activities to maintain operational readiness.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (or related field) with 8-10 years of mechanical maintenance experience in utility-scale power plants, preferably combined cycle plants.

* Professional certifications such as CMRP and HSE/OSHA Safety Certification are preferred; PMP certification is an advantage.
* Strong technical expertise in gas and steam turbine maintenance, rotating equipment troubleshooting, predictive maintenance technologies, and hydraulic/pneumatic systems.

details:
**Job details**
---------------

### **Category**

G - PROJECT MANAGEMENT - G1 - Project Management  

### **Job Opening Title**

Non fixed term

### **BU description**

Energise Your Career with Framatome UK – Powering a Safer, Smarter Nuclear Future  
Framatome is a global leader in nuclear energy, recognised for delivering innovative, value-added technologies that design, build, maintain, and advance the world's nuclear fleet. With 20,000 employees in over 70 locations worldwide, we provide components, fuel, and control systems for nuclear power plants, along with a full suite of reactor services — all focused on improving safety, performance, and sustainability.  
Backed by EDF Group (80.5%) and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (19.5%), we're driving the future of clean energy. Here in the UK, our team is already 400 strong — and growing. As we expand our service offerings across the UK nuclear industry, we're aiming to reach 600 dedicated professionals in 2026.  
Now's your chance to join a company that's shaping the energy transition — where your expertise will matter, your growth will be supported, and your work will help power generations to come.

### **Job description**

The key objective of the Project Manager will be to ensure assigned projects or work packages are planned and delivered in line with agreed contractual obligations. The PM leads the delivery of projects or work packages in a larger project, ensuring compliance with strict safety, regulatory, and quality standards. The PM is accountable for the planning, execution, and completion of projects or work packages within scope, time, and budget. They act as the key interface between customers, internal stakeholders, and contractors to ensure successful project delivery.

The role of the Project Manager includes, but is not limited to, the following aspects:  

* Ensure projects or work packages are executed and controlled to meet customer requirements and minimise risks for the business.
* Ensure full compliance with nuclear safety, quality and environmental standards.
* Take responsibility for executing the project management processes on assigned projects.
* Develop, maintain and manage project plans, schedules, risk registers and budgets.
* Lead hazard identification and risk assessments relevant to project activities.
* Manage contracts and procurement processes in line with business processes to deliver project objectives.
* Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders including third parties/vendors.
* Manage and coordinate multi-disciplinary teams including engineering, QSHE, commercial, project controls and operations to ensure successful project delivery.
* Monitor project performance, conduct regular reporting, and implement corrective actions where necessary.
* Provide input regarding project resource needs based on assessment of their projects future workload.
* Conduct lessons learned and continuous improvement processes to drive efficient project delivery.
* Execute project governance, quality assurance, and change control processes.
* Promote a culture of safety, continuous improvement, and innovation.

* Successfully delivered projects or work packages within agreed timeframes, cost, scope, and quality metrics.
* Delivery against Customer requirements with high safety and quality performance, strong OTIF delivery and minimum risk.
* Project documentation including project plans, schedules, risk registers etc.
* Accurate and timely reporting to the leadership team and other key stakeholders.
* Strong leadership of the integrated project delivery team.
* Effective stakeholder and interface management across multiple functions and organisations, including subcontractors and suppliers.
* Strong customer and stakeholder relationships with trust between parties.
* Lessons learned captured, communicated and applied to future project delivery.

### **Profile**

To be considered, we are looking for the following qualifications, skills and experience:  

* Strong understanding of project management principles and methodologies.
* Good leadership skills with the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams, ensuring project goals are met efficiently and effectively.
* Demonstrable experience in planning. budgeting and risk management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels and ensure that complex information is conveyed clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions based on data and project requirements.
* Effective time management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and budget targets are met.
* High attention to detail, particularly in the review and interpretation of technical documents, financial data, and project specifications.
* A working knowledge of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera for project planning and reporting.

Behaviours:  

* A strong commitment to safety, quality and compliance.
* A proactive approach to managing projects, anticipating potential issues, and taking the initiative to resolve problems before they escalate.
* Ability to adapt to changing project requirements, timelines, and environments, maintaining a calm and structured approach under pressure.
* A commitment to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement in both personal skills and project outcomes.
* Strong ethical values, ensuring that all project decisions are made with integrity, transparency, and in line with organizational policies.

Project Managers would be expected to already hold the following (or demonstrate capability to the level of):
  

* Degree in Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
* APM PMQ or equivalent, working towards PPQ.
* Member of a recognised project professional body (e.g., APM, PMI).
* IOSH or NEBOSH Managing Safely (highly desirable).
* Knowledge of ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 19443) and working knowledge of IMS systems.
* Knowledge of the key attributes of nuclear safety culture.

And would be expected to gain the following within 3 years:  

* APM PPQ
* A recognised qualification in leadership.

* 25 days annual leave per year rising by 1 day for every 2 years worked (max 30 days) + Bank Holidays

At **Future Group**, we specialise in translation and localisation services that bring people, businesses, and ideas together across borders. Since 1994, we’ve grown into a global team, and we’re looking for a proactive Project Manager who is customer-focused, technically aware, and skilled at leading collaborative teams to deliver high-quality results.

**About the Role: Project Management in Translation and Localisation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

As a Project Manager, you will oversee end-to-end delivery of translation and localisation projects, ensuring they run on time, within scope, and meet client expectations. You will coordinate internal teams, external linguists, and technology resources, applying strong time-management, communication, and technical skills to keep projects on track.

### **Key Responsibilities: Delivery, Communication & Collaboration**

* Own project delivery from initiation to closure, ensuring milestones and deadlines are met while maintaining quality and budgetary targets.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders—providing clear, professional, and timely updates.
* Plan and allocate resources effectively, scheduling linguists and reviewers, and matching skills to project needs.
* Use project management and CAT tools to set up projects, manage files, track progress, and record accurate project data.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate risks and bottlenecks proactively to avoid delays and safeguard quality.
* Coordinate quality assurance activities, including linguistic QA and technical checks within CAT environments when required.
* Prepare proposals, costings, reports, and post-project reviews to support continuous improvement and client retention.

#### **Essential Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven technical experience working with CAT tools (e.g., Trados), project management platforms, and the MS Office suite.
* Excellent command of English (written and spoken); additional languages are advantageous.
* Strong teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate across time zones and with diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Exceptional time-management and organisational ability—able to prioritise competing tasks under tight deadlines.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes and building lasting client relationships.
* Clear and professional communicator, comfortable handling client queries, feedback, and escalations.
* 1–3 years’ experience in project management or coordination, preferably within localisation, translation, or tech-enabled services.

##### **What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Projects consistently delivered on schedule, within scope, and to the client’s satisfaction.
* Strong, trust-based relationships with clients, suppliers, and colleagues that enable smooth cooperation.
* Efficient, well-documented project processes and accurate use of PM tools and CAT systems.
* Regular contributions to process improvements that enhance productivity and client experience.

#### **What You’ll Gain: Development, Impact & Community**

* Opportunities for professional growth and career progression in a global, fast-growing company.
* Hands-on experience managing projects that enable cross-cultural communication and international business.
* A supportive, diverse team environment that values initiative and collaboration.
* The chance to shape project management practices and have a direct impact on client satisfaction.

### **Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you are organised, technically literate, customer-oriented, and excel at communicating with diverse teams and clients, we’d love to hear from you. Join **Future Group** and help us continue to connect the world—one project at a time.

**Apply now to be part of our team and grow your career with Future Group.**

title: AI Solution Architect
details:
**Description**
---------------

JOB PURPOSE:  
To design and architect end-to-end AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with CIB’s enterprise architecture standards. The role is responsible for translating complex business and data requirements into robust AI solution blueprints, ensuring technical coherence across the full AI development lifecycle from experimentation through production deployment.  
The AI Solution Architect serves as the technical authority for AI solution design within the AI Engineering function, establishing patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks that accelerate delivery quality and consistency across AI initiatives.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:  
  
Roles and Responsibilities  
1. Design and document end-to-end AI solution architectures, including data flows, model integration patterns, APIs, and deployment topologies, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and security standards.  
2. Translate business requirements and AI use cases into detailed technical specifications, solution blueprints, and architectural decision records that guide development and engineering teams.  
3. Define and maintain AI architecture standards, design patterns, and reusable component libraries to accelerate delivery and ensure consistency across AI initiatives.  
4. Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, platforms, infrastructure components, and third-party tools, conducting proof-of-concept assessments to validate architectural choices before broader adoption.  
5. Collaborate with Data and AI Engineering teams to ensure that solution designs are implementable, scalable, and operationally sustainable in production environments.  
6. Work with Enterprise Data & AI Governance and Risk functions to embed explainability, fairness, auditability, and regulatory compliance requirements into solution designs from the outset.  
7. Coordinate with IT infrastructure, security, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure AI solutions are designed within approved infrastructure boundaries and meet applicable security control requirements.  
8. Assess and manage technical risks associated with AI solution designs, including scalability constraints, model performance degradation, integration complexity, and vendor dependencies.  
9. Support the AI Engineering Manager and Head of AI Engineering in scoping, estimating, and planning AI initiatives, providing architectural input into project proposals and roadmap prioritization.  
10. Maintain awareness of emerging AI architectures, LLM integration patterns, RAG frameworks, and agentic AI design paradigms, and evaluate their applicability within the bank’s on-premises and hybrid infrastructure context.  
11. Conduct architectural reviews of AI solutions developed by engineering teams, ensuring adherence to approved standards, patterns, and governance requirements prior to production deployment.  
12. Contribute to the formulation and execution of the AI Engineering strategy, ensuring architectural decisions are aligned with CIB’s overall technology roadmap and strategic objectives.  
13. Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal CIB policies and code of conduct in order to maintain CIB’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks  
14. Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal CIB policies and code of conduct in order to maintain CIB’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks.

 8+ years of progressive experience in solution architecture, AI/ML engineering, or advanced analytics, with demonstrated expertise in designing and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions into production environments.  
 Minimum 3 years of dedicated AI solution architecture experience, including model deployment architectures, API integration patterns, and production-grade AI infrastructure design.  
 Proven experience designing LLM-based solutions, including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering frameworks, agentic architectures, and integration patterns for large language model deployment.  
 Experience in financial services or similarly regulated industries, with understanding of architecture governance, risk management frameworks, and regulatory compliance requirements for AI systems.  
 Solid grasp of distributed systems, containerization, API design, and on-premises or hybrid infrastructure principles relevant to AI solution deployment.  
**Skills:**

 Strong knowledge of AI/ML modelling approaches, deep learning frameworks, and model serving technologies, with the ability to assess technical trade-offs objectively.  
 Solid understanding of data architecture principles, including data pipelines, feature stores, vector databases, and integration with enterprise data platforms.  
 Effective communicator capable of presenting architectural designs and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders, governance forums, and executive management.  
 Collaborative working style with the ability to build consensus across Data, IT, Risk, and business teams on architectural choices.

title: Operations & Offices Manager
details:

------------------------

* **Payroll Inputs:** Review and approve all Operations-originated payroll inputs (expense additions, deductions, reimbursements) submitted by country coordinators before the HR payroll cycle.
* **Accuracy & Timeliness:** Ensure country-level payroll and expense submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered on time monthly.
* **Variance Resolution:** Coordinate with HR Payroll to resolve variances or exceptions prior to Finance submission.

### **4. Office & Facilities Management**

* **Team Supervision:** Supervise country Operations coordinators and support staff across regional offices to maintain consistent operational standards.
* **Facilities & Vendors:** Manage office leases, facilities, utilities, maintenance, and vendor contracts across all locations.
* **Logistics & Budgets:** Oversee travel, accommodation, and transportation logistics, manage medical insurance renewals and provider relationships, and monitor administrative/facilities budgets for cost savings.

* **Standardization:** Document, standardize, and continuously improve operational processes across all geographies.
* **Optimization:** Identify operational gaps, manual workarounds, and automation opportunities, presenting recommendations with clear rationale to the CPO.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* **Distributed Leadership:** Proven track record managing a distributed team across multiple geographies and time zones.
* **Immigration Expertise:** Hands-on experience with visa, immigration, and government liaison processes in KSA, UAE, and/or Jordan.
* **Program Management:** Experience managing medical insurance programs and vendor contracts.
* **Process Building:** Demonstrated ability to build and enforce operational procedures in environments with inconsistent or absent processes.
* **Compliance Knowledge:** Strong working knowledge of regional labor and compliance frameworks across KSA, UAE, Jordan, and Egypt.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficiency in MS Office and experience working with ERP or operational management systems.
* **Schedule Flexibility:** Flexible to work across multiple time zones and working week structures (Saturday–Wednesday for KSA; Monday–Friday for Egypt and Jordan).

### **Skills & Competencies**

* **Diverse Team Leadership:** Experienced in managing mixed-capability teams (from qualified coordinators to support staff), adapting communication styles and performance management accordingly.

title: Senior ERP Finance Consultant
details:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior ERP Finance Consultant leads the design, implementation, and ongoing support of Finance modules within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). This role sits at the intersection of deep accounting expertise and ERP delivery – requiring the ability to translate complex financial business requirements into scalable, best-practice D365 solutions. The successful candidate will own Finance workstreams end-to-end, from requirements workshops through go-live and post-implementation support, working closely with technical consultants, solution architects, and client stakeholders across financial services and fintech environments.

**Job Objectives**
------------------

* Lead end-to-end Finance workstream delivery on D365 F&O implementations, ensuring solutions are designed to Microsoft best practices and meet client business requirements.
* Translate complex financial and accounting processes into scalable D365 F&O configurations that improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance for the client.
* Drive high-quality project outcomes by owning data migration, testing, training, and go-live activities within the Finance modules.
* Act as the primary Finance functional authority on projects – bridging the gap between business stakeholders and the technical delivery team.
* Build internal capability by mentoring junior consultants and contributing to the practice’s methodology and knowledge base.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **ERP Implementation and Delivery**

* Lead Finance workstreams across full lifecycle D365 F&O implementations, from initial scoping through go-live and hypercare.
* Conduct Fit-Gap workshops with client stakeholders to identify business requirements, document gaps, and propose best-practice D365 solutions.
* Prepare and maintain Functional Design Documents (FDDs), configuration workbooks, test scripts, and all required project documentation.
* Lead financial data migration planning and execution, including data cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Manage System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring Finance module functionality meets agreed requirements before go-live.
* Deliver end-user training programs and support change management activities to ensure smooth adoption of the new ERP solution.

### **Finance Module Configuration**

* Configure and implement all core Finance modules in D365 F&O, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash & Bank Management, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, Budgeting, Cost Accounting, Credit & Collections, and Financial Reporting.
* Design and configure financial dimensions, account structures, posting profiles, chart of accounts, and period close processes aligned with client requirements.
* Set up intercompany accounting, consolidation, allocations, and multi-currency configurations where required.
* Configure D365 workflows, approval hierarchies, and automation rules within Finance modules to streamline client processes.
* Support Electronic Reporting (ER) configuration and Financial Reporting (Management Reporter) setup for client-specific reporting needs.

### **Compliance, Localization and Integration**

* Support localization requirements, VAT and tax compliance, e-Invoicing setup, and regulatory reporting configurations within D365 F&O.
* Collaborate with technical consultants on integration design, customization requirements, and reporting specifications – providing clear functional direction.
* Ensure all Finance solutions comply with IFRS standards and the client’s internal financial policies and controls.
* Advise clients on best practices for period-end close, audit readiness, and financial control frameworks within D365.

### **Stakeholder Management and Team Leadership**

* Serve as the primary Finance functional point of contact for client stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Present solution designs, project progress, and go-live readiness to senior client and internal stakeholders clearly and confidently.
* Mentor junior functional consultants, guiding D365 Finance configuration, documentation standards, and delivery best practices.
* Provide reliable post-go-live functional support, triaging issues, coordinating fixes, and ensuring client satisfaction after implementation.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

### **Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

### **Licenses & Certifications**

* Professional accounting certification (CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent) is preferred. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate certification is preferred.

### **Previous Work Experience**

title: Oracle Fusion Finance Consultant
details:
**Senior functional expert for solution quality, knowledge transfer and internally led Finance delivery**

**Entity:** Oracle ERP Centre of Excellence  
**Programme:** Oracle Cloud ERP transformation — multi-entity, multi-country rollout  
**Reporting line:** Solution Architect — coordination with Finance Lead, Programme Manager and Programme Director  
**Contract:** 24-month contract  
**Mobilisation:** September 2026

**Purpose of the Role**

Provide senior Oracle Fusion Financials expertise to protect the quality of the Group ERP template, review and challenge the implementation partner's work, and progressively support internal ownership of Finance configuration and country rollouts. The role transfers design decisions, configurations, testing assets and operating knowledge to the internal Finance Lead and academy resources. Functional scope: General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Tax, Lease Accounting, intercompany and related financial controls.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Design and solution quality:** review and challenge the Financials Global Design; validate the Group Finance template (Chart of Accounts, ledgers, legal entities, business units, calendars, intercompany, workflows, tax, closing); assess country statutory and tax requirements and recommend standard configuration, localisation or formal deviation.
* **Partner delivery supervision:** review configuration workbooks, functional designs and deliverables; peer-review configurations before SIT, UAT and production; provide an independent internal opinion at quality gates and on Finance change requests.
* **Configuration and internal delivery:** configure Oracle Fusion Financials directly as delivery responsibility transfers in-house — from review and supervision, through shadowing, to joint and internally led delivery; maintain workbooks and support defect analysis, regression, cutover readiness and go-live assessments.
* **Process design:** design and optimise Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Asset-to-Retire, Cash, Tax and closing processes; define standard controls, reconciliations and approval workflows aligned with Group Finance policies.
* **Data migration and testing:** support Finance mapping, transformation rules and validation (suppliers, customers, banks, assets, opening balances, open AR / AP, tax, master data); mock and cutover loads, reconciliation and sign-off; prepare and review test scenarios, SIT execution, defect triage and UAT preparation; validate OTBI / BI Publisher outputs and Finance interfaces (OIC).
* **Knowledge transfer:** maintain design decisions and the Design Deviation Log; produce reusable Finance playbooks, testing packs, cutover checklists and runbooks; mentor the internal Finance Lead and academy resources and support their Oracle certification readiness.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (Finance, Accounting, IS, Business or Engineering); significant Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation experience with at least two complete lifecycles, in multi-entity, multi-ledger or multi-country environments.
* Strong knowledge of several Financials modules (GL, AP, AR, Cash, FA, Expenses, Tax, Lease Accounting, intercompany); hands-on Functional Setup Manager configuration, fit-to-standard workshops and configuration workbooks.
* Finance data migration and FBDI; SIT / UAT / regression and defect management; roles, access and segregation-of-duties awareness; integration mapping, OTBI / BI Publisher requirements, cutover and reconciliation.
* Experience quality-assuring an implementation partner's work, with the credibility to challenge constructively and protect template integrity; strong documentation discipline and a coaching mindset; English fluent, working French a strong advantage.
* **Certifications:** at least one active Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Certified Implementation Professional credential aligned with the assigned modules; General Ledger certification mandatory for the lead GL profile; Payables, Receivables or Accounting Hub credentials strongly preferred.

**Success Indicators**

Quality and completeness of Financials design reviews; material gaps caught before production; configurations compliant with the approved Group template; fewer unresolved defects at SIT / UAT entry; quality of data mapping, migration and reconciliation; internal Finance Lead and academy resources ready to work independently; usable Finance playbooks and reduced dependency on external consulting.

title: Junior Customer Support Associate - Egypt
details:
**Junior Customer Support Associate**
-------------------------------------

**About FMP**
-------------

FMP is a leading Financial Market Data as a Service (DaaS) provider, delivering comprehensive financial data, market information, and analytics to businesses, developers, investors, and financial institutions worldwide.

Our mission is to make institutional-grade financial market data accessible to everyone. Through our APIs and data solutions, we empower clients to build powerful financial applications, develop investment models, and make informed, data-driven decisions.

At FMP, we combine technology, data, and innovation to simplify access to financial information. We are a fast-growing, globally connected team that values curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Your Opportunity**
--------------------

We are looking for a **Customer Service Support Specialist with FinTech experience** who understands the financial services environment and enjoys helping clients solve problems, navigate data-driven products, and get the most value from our platform.

In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact for our clients, helping troubleshoot technical and data-related inquiries, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience. You will work closely with internal teams to identify recurring issues, improve support processes, and contribute to client retention and business growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Support:** Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally, providing clear, accurate, and practical solutions to product, platform, API, and financial data questions.
* **Issue Resolution:** Log, investigate, track, and follow up on client issues, coordinating with technical and data teams when additional support is required.
* **Financial Data Support:** Develop a strong understanding of FMP's financial market data products, APIs, and services to help clients understand and use our offerings effectively.
* **Account Management:** Monitor client needs, maintain strong customer relationships, and proactively address concerns to support satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* **Client Onboarding:** Assist new customers with getting started on the platform, understanding available data solutions, and navigating documentation and support resources.
* **Data Quality and Feedback:** Identify recurring data questions, usage challenges, and product issues, sharing actionable feedback with the appropriate internal teams.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with product, engineering, data, sales, and leadership teams to resolve client concerns and improve the overall customer experience.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to streamline support workflows, improve response times, and enhance customer service practices.
* **Customer Growth:** Recognize opportunities to introduce clients to relevant products and features, support account expansion, and contribute to customer retention and revenue growth.
* **Documentation and Reporting:** Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, issues, resolutions, and recurring trends to support reporting and continuous improvement.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **FinTech Experience:** You have previous experience working in FinTech, financial services, financial technology, market data, or a related industry and understand the expectations of customers operating in this environment.
* **Customer-Focused:** You enjoy helping people, take ownership of customer issues, and are committed to delivering timely, high-quality support.
* **Technologically Curious:** You are comfortable learning new platforms, software tools, APIs, and data products. Familiarity with financial data APIs or technical documentation is an asset.
* **Strong Communicator:** You have excellent written and verbal English communication skills and can explain complex information clearly to customers with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* **Analytical and Resourceful:** You can investigate problems, identify patterns, ask the right questions, and work toward practical solutions.
* **Organized and Accountable:** You manage multiple inquiries and priorities effectively, maintain accurate records, and follow through on commitments.
* **Collaborative:** You work well across teams, communicate proactively, and know when to escalate an issue.
* **Adaptable:** You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are comfortable taking initiative without waiting for step-by-step direction.
* **Growth-Oriented:** You are interested in developing your career at the intersection of customer success, financial technology, and data services.

### **Qualifications**

* Previous experience in customer support, customer success, account management, or a similar client-facing role within FinTech or financial services.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial markets, investment products, financial data, or related technology.
* Strong written communication, problem-solving, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with customer support platforms, CRM systems, or similar business tools.
* Ability to learn technical products and communicate solutions clearly.
* A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Information Technology, or a related field is an asset; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
* Experience supporting API-based products, SaaS platforms, or technical customers is an advantage.
* Additional language skills are an asset, particularly when supporting international customers.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* An agile, fast-growing work environment where initiative and new ideas are encouraged.
* The opportunity to work with financial technology, market data, and innovative data solutions.
* A diverse, international team with opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and flexible work arrangements.
* A collaborative culture that values accountability, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the customer experience of a growing global FinTech business.

**Why Join FMP?**
-----------------

At FMP, you will help customers navigate the financial data that powers investment research, financial applications, and business decisions around the world. You will work at the intersection of customer service, financial markets, and technology, with opportunities to expand your knowledge, take ownership of meaningful work, and grow alongside a rapidly evolving company.

If you have FinTech experience, enjoy solving customer problems, and want to help make financial market data more accessible, we would love to hear from you.

### **Company Overview**

Please visit https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/ for more information

title: Customer Relations Executive I Real Estate I Asset Management
details:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182849

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

**Overview of the role:**

To deliver a seamless customer experience within the community by managing customer inquiries, complaints, and requests, conducting daily site inspections, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure high service standards, customer satisfaction, and community compliance.

**What you will do:**

* Conduct daily site inspections and report findings with recommended corrective actions.
* Conduct on-site inspections, including evening or night shifts when required, and follow up on corrective actions.
* Monitor community facilities and common areas to ensure compliance with service standards.
* Handle customer inquiries, complaints, requests, and feedback professionally.
* Coordinate with internal departments and contractors to resolve customer issues.
* Track and follow up customer cases until closure.
* Maintain accurate customer records in CRM systems.
* Use CRM/ticketing systems to log, track and close customer requests, monitoring response times, service-level agreements and complaint resolution.
* Prepare customer experience and site inspection reports.
* Support community engagement activities and events.
* Escalate critical issues and potential risks to management.
* Monitor customer feedback trends and identify improvement opportunities.

**Required Skills to be successful:**

* 2–5 years of experience in community relations, residential community operations or customer service.
* Experience handling customer complaints and service requests.
* Site inspection and reporting skills.
* Customer centricity, communication, accountability, teamwork, collaboration, and attention to detail.
* Professional, articulate and customer-facing, with flexibility to support community events and resident needs.

**What equips you for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

title: Duty Manager
details:
**Job Requisition ID:** 181004

Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Commercial Department Manager (CDM) is responsible for managing one or more retail departments within Marks and Spencer, ensuring efficient day-to-day operational management, and delivering excellent customer service. The role requires oversight of merchandising, stock availability, and profit protection, as well as delivering sales targets. A crucial part of the role involves training and developing team members, managing appraisals and performance, and ensuring the adherence to company policies and procedures. The CDM plays a supportive role in enhancing the store's reputation through diligent service management and customer interaction.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Customer Service**

  
  

* Daily coaching of colleagues to maximize impact at department level and developing all employees to deliver world-class service.
* Responsible for protecting the Customer Journey while duty managing, prioritizing and coordinating the store objectives to maximize the customer experience.
* React to all customer feedback and follow up with actions within the department on a daily basis.
* Deliver friendly, knowledgeable, and efficient service within the department including sight lines, sizing, and one-to-one customer interaction.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through the implementation of Customer Service Index and Mystery Shopper programs.
  

  

#### **Store Operations**

  
  

* Ensure store opening and closing procedures are adhered to.
* Plan and implement store coverage properly.
* Implement company visual guidelines, layouts, and timescales within your department ensuring clear navigation and sight lines.
* Conduct daily floor walks generating positive sale-driving actions and coaching colleagues on conversion, basket drivers, and profit optimization.
* Ensure that cash line procedures are adhered to and controls are implemented for employee purchases, returns, and damages.
* Implement safety procedures in line with company policy to maintain a zero-accident environment.
  

  

#### **People Management**

  
  

* Properly induct and train newcomers and staff.
* Manage department colleague appraisals and reviews, performance management, and timely handling of HR issues according to company policies.
* Assist in succession planning and contribute to reducing attrition.
* Engage in Employee Engagement Surveys (EES) to assess staff satisfaction and areas for improvement.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Exceptional customer service skills with a focus on maximizing employee productivity.
* Strong leadership abilities to motivate and manage a team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking capabilities.
* Proficient in analyzing sales figures and implementing strategies for improvement.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* High School diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Senior Sales Associate.
* Proficiency in verbal and written communication, alongside good MS Excel and Word skills.
* Ability to lead and motivate a team effectively.
  

  

**About Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
  
The real estate development and operations arm of Al-Futtaim, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi-billion-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
  
Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
  
AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

**About Al-Futtaim Malls**
  
Al-Futtaim Malls provides development and asset management expertise, specializing in building retail-led super regional malls in prime locations across MENA and beyond. With a proven track record of creating both sustainable revenue growth and value enhancement for tenants, Al-Futtaim Malls delivers exceptional experiences and exciting shopping environments for customers.

Part of the Al-Futtaim Group, Al-Futtaim Malls leadership team brings more than 30 years of experience and a deep understanding and knowledge of the retail sector, both from a shopper’s point of view but as curators of space or landlords to other brands. The company has a directly managed portfolio including over 9 million sqft of retail space across four malls in the MENA region and two under development. Malls under the Al-Futtaim Malls portfolio include Dubai Festival City Mall and Festival Plaza in the UAE, Cairo Festival City Mall in Egypt, Doha Festival City in Qatar and Zenata Mall, Morocco.

Leveraging on the expertise of its parent company, Al-Futtaim Malls established PLEX Management Services offering a full array of services including asset management and development, leasing, and brand experience expertise to shopping mall landlords and retail organizations globally. Implementing global best practice and deploying Al-Futtaim Mall’s deep understanding of mall management and retail dynamics, PLEX promises to deliver continuous growth and long-term value for its partners.

For more information on Al-Futtaim Malls, please visit https://www.al-futtaimmalls.com/

**About Al-Futtaim Engineering & Technologies**
  
Al-Futtaim Engineering & Technologies offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
  
  
The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
  
  
The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio-visual solutions and managed services.
  
  
These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after-sales maintenance contracts.

title: Data Quality Engineer
details:
**Summary**  
**Location: UAE (Abu Dhabi)**  
**Contract: 6 months**  
  
**DQ Engineer**

The organization's analytics, reporting and AI ambitions depend on data that decisionmakers can trust, and the Senior Data Quality Engineer is accountable for making that trust measurable. They own the enterprise Data Quality (DQ) framework and embed automated controls at every layer of the lake house, from ingestion through to curated and analytical data, while ensuring that every quality issue is traced, owned and resolved at its root cause. The role works alongside Data Owners, Data Stewards and the data engineering team, turning business rules into enforceable technical controls and using the Microsoft Purview investment as the governance and master data backbone.

**Responsibilities**

* Define, operationalize and maintain the enterprise DQ framework, including standards, dimensions, KPIs, thresholds and controls, aligned to ISO 8000 and DAMA-DMBOK2 and to the Dubai Data Law data quality expectations.
* Conduct source-data profiling and DQ assessments during Mobilization & Discovery to establish the quality baseline that all improvement KPIs are measured against.
* Design and implement DQ checks at the Bronze (ingestion), Silver (transformation/conformance), Gold (curated) and analytical layers.
* Build validation, rejection/quarantine, exception-handling and remediation rules directly into data pipelines so that poor-quality data never reaches reporting consumers unflagged.
* Establish source-to-target reconciliation controls that evidence completeness, accuracy and consistency for every critical data flow.
* Monitor accuracy, completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness and referential integrity through dashboards visible to data owners and the Data Governance Council.
* Lead investigation of DQ incidents and drive remediation with data engineers, Data Owners and source-system teams through a governed issue workflow.
* Convert business rules, keys, reference data, constraints and historical requirements into executable technical DQ controls.
* Support Microsoft Purview and the MDM platform, including Critical Data Element (CDE) identification, DQ scoring, duplicate detection, master/reference data validation and golden-record quality assurance.
* Maintain traceability between DQ rules, business requirements, metadata, data models and source-to-target mappings, so that every control is auditable.
* Coach counterparts and data stewards in DQ practices and tooling, so that data quality can be sustained independently after handover.

**Must Have**

* 4+ years in Data Quality, Data Engineering, Data Management or Data Governance, preferably within UAE government or regulated-sector environments.
* Proven hands-on delivery of data profiling, DQ rules, validation, reconciliation, monitoring and remediation.
* Advanced SQL, with practical Python, PySpark or Spark experience.
* Strong grounding in relational and dimensional modelling, including business and surrogate keys, normalization, referential integrity and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD).
* Experience with cloud data platforms and Lakehouse/Medallion architecture (Azure / Microsoft Fabric preferred).
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview and MDM platforms.
* Familiarity with UAE data regulation, including UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
* Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

title: Sales Operations & Excellence Lead
details:
The Sales Operations & Excellence Lead is a key member of ZainTech's Sales Operations and Excellence function, responsible for the planning, forecasting, pipeline governance, CRM effectiveness, and analytical insight required to drive predictable and profitable growth across the regional, multi-country sales organization. The role partners closely with country leadership and sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, systems, finance, and execution, translating business requirements into a consistent operating rhythm, trusted reporting, and practical Salesforce solutions.

The successful candidate will not only identify gaps, but will design the process, establish the rule, embed it into the system where appropriate, measure adoption, and work with senior commercial stakeholders across countries to sustain the change.

Responsibilities:

Forecasting & Forecast Governance

* Own the regional forecast process and cadence (weekly forecast calls, monthly and quarterly roll-ups) across all countries
* Consolidate country forecasts into a single regional view; challenge assumptions and govern commit, best-case, and pipeline categories
* Measure and improve forecast accuracy by country, segment, and account manager, and explain variances to leadership
* Partner with Finance to align bookings, revenue, and gross-profit forecasts with budgets and targets

Pipeline Management

* Define and govern pipeline standards, including stage definitions, exit criteria, coverage ratios, conversion, and velocity metrics
* Run structured pipeline reviews with country leaders to surface gaps, at-risk deals, and slippage early
* Set pipeline generation targets with Sales and Marketing and track conversion through the funnel

Sales Planning & Strategy

* Lead the annual and quarterly sales planning cycle, including market sizing, target setting, quota allocation, and capacity and headcount planning
* Design territory, segment, and account coverage models across countries
* Support go-to-market strategy and sales incentive design in partnership with Finance and HR
* Run quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and track country performance against plan

Salesforce / CRM Ownership & Hygiene

* Act as a business owner and subject-matter lead for Salesforce sales processes
* Translate commercial requirements into scalable CRM design, including fields, validation rules, workflows/flows, approvals, reports, dashboards, user stories, and adoption
* Set and enforce CRM data standards (mandatory fields, opportunity stages, close dates, amounts, account ownership) and drive regular hygiene reviews with country teams
* Identify CRM data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinate cleansing and remediation, and improve completeness, accuracy, and consistency of sales data

Analytics & Insights

* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, datasets, and KPI frameworks covering forecast, pipeline, sales performance, productivity, conversion, activity, and operational metrics
* Turn data into clear insights, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for regional and country leadership

Process Design, Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Map end-to-end sales processes, identify root causes, bottlenecks, duplication, and manual work, and redesign processes for simplicity and scale
* Apply the principle: eliminate first, then automate, then optimize
* Identify and implement reporting and workflow automation opportunities with IT, data, and business teams, reducing manual effort and improving control, speed, and user experience

Commercial & Cross-Functional Alignment

* Partner with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Delivery, and other functions to reconcile business requirements, commercial metrics, and system/process dependencies
* Understand revenue, gross profit, margin, pricing, and other commercial drivers sufficiently to challenge and validate the numbers

  
**Requirements**  

* 4+ years of relevant experience across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Planning, Sales Excellence, Commercial Operations, or related roles, including at least 3 years in a lead or senior capacity
* Proven hands-on ownership of sales forecasting and pipeline governance in a multi-country or regional sales organization, with a track record of improving forecast accuracy
* Demonstrated experience leading annual sales planning, including target setting, quota allocation, territory design, and capacity planning
* Strong Salesforce experience, ideally spanning administration, business analysis, Sales Cloud process design, reporting, automation, data quality, UAT, and user adoption
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, Power Query, lookups, and advanced formulas
* Strong proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Salesforce analytics, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms
* Experience working with CRM data alongside ERP, finance, delivery, or other enterprise systems; familiarity with platforms such as Oracle or SAP is advantageous
* Demonstrated ability to build management reporting, dashboards, KPI frameworks, and actionable performance insights
* Strong requirements-gathering, process-mapping, gap-analysis, documentation, UAT, and solution-validation skills
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior sales, country, and functional leaders
* Experience supporting regional or multi-country sales organizations
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Technology, Information Systems, or a related field

Teradata is the connected multi-cloud data platform for enterprise analytics company. Our enterprise analytics solve business challenges from start to scale. Only Teradata gives you the flexibility to handle the massive and mixed data workloads of the future, today.

The Teradata Vantage architecture is cloud native, delivered as-a-service, and built on an open ecosystem. These design features make Vantage the ideal platform to optimize price performance in a multi-cloud environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* **What the role is about:** As a Principal/Staff Data Scientist at Teradata, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for defining analytical approaches, scoping complex data science projects, and delivering high-impact solutions across multiple industries. You will tackle highly complex and ambiguous problems, architect end-to-end data science workflows, and provide deep technical guidance to cross-functional teams—without direct people management responsibilities.

* **What impact this role has:**Your expertise will shape the technical direction of data science initiatives, influence solution design across teams, and help internal and external stakeholders make well-informed decisions. By leveraging advanced modeling, statistical rigor, and deep domain insight, you will ensure that Teradata delivers scalable, high-quality analytical solutions that drive measurable business value for our clients.

* **What success might look like:**Success in this role means independently leading the most challenging parts of data science engagements, producing reliable and scalable solutions, and serving as a trusted technical advisor to product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders. You will be recognized for your ability to translate complex business problems into well-scoped analytical strategies, and for consistently raising the technical bar across the team.

**Who You’ll Work With**

* **An outline of the team:** You will be part of a collaborative and dynamic data science team that works closely with data engineers, project managers, solution architects, and business stakeholders. You will contribute as a high-level technical expert, helping teams navigate complexity and ensuring that analytical solutions are sound, scalable, and aligned with business needs.

* **The role and the team play at Teradata:** The data science team at Teradata plays a crucial role in transforming data into strategic assets. As a Principal/Staff Data Scientist, you will influence the technical direction of projects, contribute reusable methodologies, and help shape best practices for developing advanced analytical solutions across multiple engagements.

* **Who the position reports to:** This position reports to the Data Science Team Manager.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

Non-negotiable qualifications:

* Minimum of 8 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied analytics.

* Expertise in programming languages such as Python and SQL.

* Strong understanding of advanced statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, and GenAI techniques.

* Proven ability to scope, architect, and technically lead complex data science projects without direct management responsibilities.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Advanced Data Analysis and Modeling:** Perform highly complex data analysis and build sophisticated predictive and prescriptive models using advanced statistical, machine learning, and deep learning techniques.
