title: Senior AI Engineer
details:
**About The Role**
------------------

Alpha isn’t a chatbot sitting on top of a product. It’s an agent that reads a customer’s account, reasons about their plan, and prepares real orders for them to confirm. The model is the easy part. The hard part is everything around it: the tools it calls, the context it sees, how a request gets routed, the guardrails that keep it away from anything that must be exact, and the deterministic systems underneath that place orders, move money and consume events.

You’ll own parts of that system end to end, from spec to production. When something goes wrong in a conversation, you’ll be the one who opens the traces and finds where the run went wrong. You’ll decide whether the fix belongs in a tool, a prompt, the routing, the backend or the model, and prove it with an eval. Then you’ll explain it so product, design and other squads can act on it.

Much of the work crosses squads. Alpha integrates with Thndr’s order, funding, savings and market-data services, so you’ll write proposals other teams adopt as well as code. We also work with served models beyond Alpha, so some of the work goes below the API: choosing, evaluating, fine-tuning and serving models for other Thndr products.

We work through coding agents every day. We expect you to be very good at running your own and at helping others fix their workflows.

This is an R&D role, and we hire for breadth on purpose. Most of your time goes to Alpha, but the same person who fixes a routing failure on Monday might be benchmarking an open model, prototyping an agent for another squad, or testing whether a new technique is worth adopting by Friday. We expect you to pick up unfamiliar problems quickly, take them from research to something running in production, and know when an experiment should stop.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own parts of Alpha end to end. Take a module, such as a tool family, the evaluation pipeline or an integration, and be accountable for how it behaves, its quality in production, and its long-term health. Don’t just follow the design we have: change it when it’s wrong.

* Design the harness. Tool contracts that read as the model’s instructions, context the model can use, routing between capabilities, and guardrails that move must-have rules out of prompt text and into code. Start from the behaviour a customer needs and work back to the component.

* Build observability and evaluation that people trust. Read traces before building dashboards. Categorise real failures and fix the most upstream one first. Build evals that check the resulting state, not just the final message. Validate LLM judges against human labels. Know the noise floor before calling something a win or a regression.

* Run Alpha like a production service. Own latency, reliability and cost for your area: time to first token, end-to-end turn latency, streaming, provider rate limits and fallbacks, and cost per conversation. Set the budgets, monitor them, and get paged when they break.

* Engineer the deterministic parts properly. Retrieval, event consumers that drive automated execution, planning and allocation logic, and integrations with money-moving services, with idempotency, retries and reconciliation. Keep the LLM away from anything that has to be exact.

* Work below the API when it pays off. Evaluate, fine-tune and serve transformer models for Alpha and other Thndr products. Run the model lifecycle like software: versioned data and evals, reproducible training, safe rollout and rollback.

* Turn questions into decisions. Take a vague “is this working?” and answer it with data: SQL over production traces, experiment design, and choosing between prompting, routing, fine-tuning or a different model. Then communicate the answer so non-specialists act on it.

* Lead cross-squad proposals. Write designs that other squads adopt for integrating Alpha with their systems, and take them from proposal to shipped.

* Raise the team’s bar. Review other engineers’ designs and evals, and help teammates improve how they work with coding agents: instructions, verification, review discipline.

* Take R&D beyond Alpha. Prototype and evaluate AI solutions for other Thndr products and squads, research new models and techniques, and turn the ones that earn it into production systems. Write up what you learned whether the experiment worked or not.

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------

* Strong software engineering in production. You’ve built and run backend systems, ideally in Python with FastAPI, PostgreSQL and queues, and you understand how they behave under failure: slow dependencies, retries, duplicate events, deploys mid-flight.

* You’ve shipped an LLM agent or tool-calling system to real users, and you can explain the design choices: what went into the context, how tools were described, how you handled routing and failure, and what you’d change.

* You’ve owned the operations of an LLM-backed service: latency budgets including time to first token, streaming, timeouts and fallbacks, cost, and incidents.

* Measurement discipline. You’ve built evals from real traces, you know why one green run proves little, and you’ve caught a metric that looked good while the product was wrong.

* Hands-on with transformers and MLOps. You’ve fine-tuned and evaluated transformer models (SFT or LoRA) and taken a model from training to serving, with versioning and monitoring.

* Data fluency. You’re comfortable in SQL and Python analysis, and you can design an experiment and defend its conclusion.

* Ownership across the full stack. You own outcomes, not tickets: production incidents, monitoring, and the follow-up fix. You push back on the brief when it’s wrong.

* Agentic coding fluency. You work through coding agents daily, verify what they produce, and can explain how you structure that work.

* Clear written communication. Your design docs and findings get read and acted on by people outside engineering.

* Breadth and speed of learning. You’ve worked across more than one kind of problem, such as agents, retrieval, models, data or backend, and you can get productive in an unfamiliar area fast. You’re comfortable deciding what to explore and when to stop.

* Statistical analysis and evaluation of test data related to Mechanical works.
* Prepares, files, maintains test/inspection records and any other quality records generated related to Mechanical works.
* Assisting construction personnel to identify and resolve problems and potential or actual non-conformances related to Mechanical works.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

* Has strong communication skills.
* Has excellent command of English (written and spoken).

Expat package is on the shelf, yet the real joy comes from being a member of smart and passionate teams, within an international leading EPC Group on a mission that matters. title: Regional Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (PSEAH) Officer (P)
details:
**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process.

For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates:

* Internal candidates

Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu

Second tier candidates include:
  
All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM.

**Organizational Context and Scope**

Established in 1951, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) is the leading global organization in the field of migration. In line with IOM’s prioritization of protection-centred approaches and integrity, transparency and accountability, IOM is committed to the prevention of and response to Protection from Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH) across all its operations.

As part of the Office of Ethics and PSEAH (OEP), the PSEAH Unit leads IOM’s work to combat sexual exploitation and abuse and sexual harassment in coordination with offices and missions across IOM and counterparts throughout the UN, Interagency Standing Committee ( IASC [JG1] ), and humanitarian community. The PSEAH Unit’s strategy focuses on strengthening leadership and organizational culture; institutional accountability and transparency; training and outreach; victim assistance; and partnership and coordination.

Under the direct supervision of the Senior Coordinator, PSEAH, the Regional Protection from Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH) Officer candidate will hold the following responsibilities.

  

RESPONSIBILITIES  
Lead and coordinate regional implementation of PSEAH: Oversee and manage the overall implementation of IOM’s PSEAH response across the region and ensure alignment with institutional policies, procedures and donor requirements.  



* Contribute to global PSEAH initiatives: Support global-level PSEAH priorities in close coordination with the global IOM PSEAH Unit lead. This includes contributing to efforts to strengthen leadership and organizational culture, strengthen capacity building of key stakeholders, and enhance partnerships and inter-agency coordination.

* Provide technical support and guidance to country teams: Deliver ongoing technical guidance and support to IOM PSEAH Officers, Focal Points, Programme and Project staff and Regional Thematic Specialists to strengthen PSEAH integration at all levels.

* Support integration of PSEAH and resource mobilization: Ensure PSEAH components are embedded in project proposals, budgets and reports, and actively contribute to fundraising and donor engagement efforts across the region.

* Strengthen strategic planning and reporting on PSEAH: Contribute to regional and country-level strategic frameworks and response plans by ensuring PSEAH is systematically integrated; lead regional data collection, management and reporting to show scope and impact of PSEAH work.

* Engage and support IOM partners: In collaboration with the global PSEAH Unit and country missions, help strengthen partnerships with implementing organizations, third party contractors (TPCs) and other partners, identify capacity gaps, and provide tailored technical guidance.

* Lead regional training and awareness-raising efforts: Design, coordinate, and deliver regional capacity-building initiatives on PSEAH, including staff training, development of tools and implementation of awareness and communication strategies.

* Strengthen prevention and response mechanisms: Support country offices and sectoral units in conducting SEAH risk assessments and implementing risk mitigation measures; enhance existing/new complaint and feedback mechanisms to ensure these can receive sensitive complaints; and ensure victim-centered assistance in collaboration with protection, child protection (CP) and gender-based violence (GBV) actors.

* Foster coordination and represent IOM: Represent IOM in regional inter-agency fora, foster collaboration and knowledge exchange with UN partners and stakeholders, and support outreach to promote PSEAH integration across humanitarian and development efforts.

* Perform other duties and tasks as may be assigned in support of the design and delivery of an effective work program.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS  
Required Qualifications and Experience**

**Education**

* Master’s degree in Law, International Relations, Psychology, Social Sciences, Development Studies and Planning or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,
* University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.
Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.  

**Experience**

* Professional experience in the fields of sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, protection, child protection, gender-based violence, accountability to affected populations (AAP), gender mainstreaming and/or humanitarian affairs;
* Experience in management of sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, child protection or gender-based violence cases;
* Strong coordination experience within the UN system and amongst interagency partners, including governments, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), and communities;
* Experience in developing and facilitating PSEAH trainings, in particular capacity-building, and communication materials to promote behavior change;
* Experience undertaking PSEAH risk assessments, in coordination with relevant offices, communities, partners, and UN and other key stakeholders;
* Experience in proposal development and the creation of standard operating procedures and tools; and,
Experience in mainstreaming PSEAH, gender-based violence, child protection, protection, gender or accountability to affected populations.  

**Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to work across a wide variety of sectors/teams on cross-cutting themes;
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, effective in representation and liaison with external partners;
* Ability to organize work, work independently and prioritize work under pressure, coordinate multiple tasks, maintain attention to detail, and coordination with a variety of stakeholders;
* Ability to work with affected individuals with empathy, sensitivity and a victim-centred approach;
* Knowledge and understanding of IOM’s institutional approach on PSEAH and Ethics and related strategies, policies, rules and regulations; and,
Ability to work with and maintain strict confidentiality, when necessary .  

**Languages**

title: HPC Services Specialist
details:
Viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

  

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated candidate to join our global HPC team. This is an opportunity to strengthen practical experience across Linux, high-performance computing, cloud technologies, automation and modern IT operations while working alongside experienced HPC specialists.

  

Your main role involves providing applications support to external clients. This includes tasks like installing, configuring, troubleshooting, patching, and upgrading Viridien software solutions and the underlying infrastructure services. Additionally, you'll need to be mobile for around 25% of your time, with assignments ranging from one week to one month. Alongside software support, you'll also handle hardware and operating system installations, troubleshooting, and support, specifically within a Linux environment.

  

You will also be expected to participate in the innovation and development of new technologies, work with other team members to implement new features, and to help automate and analyze problem resolution.

  

As a HPC Services Specialist, you will collaborate with like-minded individuals who are passionate about cutting-edge technology and innovation to solve the world's most complex challenges.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and validate Viridien software and HPC solutions, including onsite installation and integration for external clients' on-prem environments, as well as Viridien SaaS platform solutions.
* Support the day-to-day monitoring, troubleshooting and resolution of support tickets, providing remote application support and HPC assistance to external clients.
* Participate in Viridien software release building and validation.
* Engage with clients to understand their technical requirements and propose suitable Linux & HPC solutions.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation, knowledge articles, operating procedures and handover notes.
* Contribute to system improvements, automation and the development of efficient operational tools and processes.
* Follow IT service management, change control, health and safety, security and quality processes.
Supporting the Sales team's activities, including assisting with RFPs and client proposals as required.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Degree in any of the following disciplines: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems or related computing subjects.
1-3 years of experience in relevant fields is preferred.  

  

**Skills and Competencies**

Essential

* Good working knowledge and hands-on experience in installing, configuring, and administering Linux operating systems, preferably in an HPC environment.
* Practical experience in installing and supporting Linux-based applications.
* Experience with Linux scripting languages (e.g., Bash, csh, Python).
* Experience with virtualization and containerization technologies on Linux (e.g., KVM, Proxmox, Docker, Singularity).
* Good understanding of IP networking, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, PXE, and firewalling concepts.
* Flexibility to travel and work on assignments abroad as required.
* Fast and effective problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to work.
* An enthusiastic attitude towards learning and flexibility to adapt to new challenges or changes in direction.
* Good time-management skills, with the ability to plan and meet project deadlines.
Effective communication.  

  

Desirable

* Experience with HPC hardware installation and maintenance (Servers/Storage/CPU/GPU).
* Experience with job scheduling solutions (e.g., Slurm, PBSPro).
* Knowledge of database installation and administration (e.g., MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Knowledge of some of the following: Puppet, GitLab, OpenStack, Kickstart, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Zabbix, etc.
* Knowledge of license manager under Linux.
* Advanced scripting and automation (e.g., Perl, Terraform, Ansible).
Certifications (e.g., LPIC-1/2, CompTIA Linux+, ITIL Foundation) or equivalent.  

  

**Why work with us?**

* Learning and development: A range of technical training is provided throughout your career journey with us. Continuously develop professional and leadership skills
* Initial 21 days of annual leaves
* Hybrid work arrangement
Confidential employee assistance program to support our staff covering mental health, counselling, wellbeing, legal & financial issues  

  

#LI-JC

title: Head of Partner Support
details:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

**Position Summary**

The Head of Partner Support owns how Property Finder supports its partners across the region. You’ll lead the frontline, back office and Tech Operations teams, run a disciplined, high-performing operation every day, and make sure partners get fast, accurate and effortless support, delivered in a way that exceeds their expectations.

At the same time, you’ll transform Partner Support into an AI-powered operation that combines intelligent automation, expert people and strong knowledge. You’ll turn every partner contact into a source of insight that helps us improve our products and retain our partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1) Run The Operations**

* Build and execute the Partner Support plan and operating model, balancing AI-powered operations with human expertise, keeping people in charge of complex issues and building partner relationships that drive retention.
* Own end-to-end operational performance across frontline, back office and Technical Operations, in every market and channel.
* Own forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling and real-time management, optimising service level, occupancy and schedule adherence.
* Build the performance management system, including KPIs, dashboards, benchmarking and executive reporting.
* Drive SLA, first-contact resolution, resolution time, automated resolution, CSAT, quality, productivity and cost-per-resolution.
* Run the operational cadence: daily huddles, weekly operations reviews, monthly business reviews and real-time management standards.
* Own workflows, SOPs and controls, and ensure operational readiness for every product launch and campaign.
* Own quality results with the Quality team, turning QA insights into coaching and performance improvements.
* Own incident management end to end, leading Tech Operations to triage complex platform issues, coordinate fixes with Engineering and keep partners informed until resolution.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical and reputation-sensitive issues.
* Hire, lead and develop Team Leaders through clear standards, playbooks, peer calibration and succession planning, and build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Present performance, insights and business cases to senior leadership.

**2) Elevate the partner experience**

* Define and embed the Partner Support service standard and tone of voice across every channel, in English and Arabic, with differentiated support models by partner segment.
* Shift the team from reactive to proactive support, and from resolving issues to exceeding partner expectations, through personal and empathetic service.

**3) Transform the operation**

* Drive automated resolution, deflection and seamless AI-to-human handoffs across chat, email, voice, WhatsApp and self-service.
* Increase partner adoption of self-service and digital channels, reducing reliance on manual support.
* Own the technology and AI roadmap, with clear pilots, success measures and scaling criteria.
* Establish AI quality, risk and governance frameworks, including response standards and hallucination mitigation.
* Build feedback loops that turn resolution failures and escalation patterns into improvements to AI, workflows and knowledge.
* Evolve from volume-based to complexity-based, specialist-led resolution, with competency frameworks and career paths for an AI-augmented workforce.
* Use predictive analytics and Voice of the Partner to identify emerging issues and partner risks, quantify their business impact and find opportunities for proactive resolution.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to remove root causes and inform AI and product roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Commercial and Customer Success to connect support performance to partner satisfaction, retention and growth.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management or a related field.
* **10+ years** in Customer Support or Customer Operations, including **5+ years leading managers or team leaders**, ideally in B2B tech, SaaS or marketplace businesses.
* Proven track record of **running and improving multi-channel support operations** to SLA, quality and cost targets.
* Strong **workforce management** expertise: forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling and budgeting.
* Proven experience **transforming support with AI at scale**: automated resolution, AI-to-human handoffs, AI quality governance and knowledge operations, with measurable results.
* Highly analytical, with strong **stakeholder management and presentation** skills at senior level.
* Proficient with CRM, ticketing and productivity tools; Salesforce and Zendesk preferred.
* Fluent English and Arabic speaker
* Real estate knowledge is an advantage

**Other Capabilities**

* **Bias for impact:** Focuses on measurable outcomes rather than activity and is comfortable challenging processes that do not create value.
* **Customer obsessed:** Understands the operational realities of our Real Estate partners and advocates for solutions that genuinely make it easier for them to do business with Property Finder.
* **Technology curious:** Actively experiments with AI and emerging technologies rather than waiting for solutions to be provided.
* **Commercially minded:** Understands the relationship between support quality, partner satisfaction, retention, revenue and cost-to-serve.
* **Data driven:** Uses evidence to identify problems, prioritise opportunities and measure success.
* **Systems thinker:** Looks beyond individual tickets to identify patterns, root causes and opportunities to permanently remove friction.
* **Builder mentality:** Comfortable designing new processes, operating models and capabilities rather than simply managing existing ones.
* **Cross-functional influencer:** Able to turn Partner Support insight into action across Product, Engineering, Commercial and Customer Experience.
* **High ownership:** Takes accountability for outcomes end-to-end and operates effectively in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

### **Our promise to talent**

At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.

**Property Finder Guiding Principles**
--------------------------------------

* Think Future First
* Data Beats Opinions, Speed Beats Perfection
* Optimise for Impact
* Act Like An Owner
* The Biggest Risk is Taking no Risk at All

JOB TITLE: IT Operations Associate (AidHotline)

TYPE OF CONTRACT: SC-6

UNIT/DIVISION: TEC

DUTY STATION (City, Country):MENAEERO, CAIRO, EGYPT

DURATION:12 months

**BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:**

Assisting more than 115.5 million people in 120 + countries each year, the World Food Program (WFP) is the leading humanitarian organization saving lives and changing lives, delivering food assistance in emergencies, and working with communities to improve nutrition and build resilience. As the international community has committed to end hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition by 2030, one in nine people worldwide still do not have enough to eat. Food and food-related assistance lie at the heart of the struggle to break the cycle of hunger and poverty.

WFP Technology Division (TEC) is the digital business engine of the World Food Programme, providing the business with multi-pronged and resilient technical capabilities able to respond with the agility required in humanitarian operations. Technology and connectivity are rapidly reaching some of the most vulnerable people and places affected by crisis, but they are also increasingly expanding to the services responding to those same crises. As one of the main humanitarian actors, WFP has the opportunity and the obligation to leverage data and technology to better know and serve those in need by digitally transforming the way it works.

AidHotline is WFP’s contact centre platform. It provisions technological and communication services through voice, SMS, email, web chat, Internet calls, chatbots, self-service forms and other supported channels. AidHotline enables inbound and outbound communications to be routed, monitored, recorded, analysed and, where applicable, transferred to relevant business processes or enterprise systems.

This position is located within the Technology function and forms part of the centrally managed AidHotline team supporting multiple WFP Country Offices. AidHotline is WFP’s cloud-based omnichannel communication platform, enabling beneficiary and stakeholder engagement through voice, SMS, web calls, live chat, chatbots and other supported digital channels. The central team is responsible for maintaining common technical standards, system availability, security and service performance, while supporting Country Offices in managing their local operational requirements.

The incumbent will support the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of AidHotline services, working closely with Country Office technology and business teams, corporate technical units and external service providers. The role includes monitoring platform performance, resolving and escalating incidents, supporting configuration and user administration, and contributing to testing, onboarding, migrations, training and operational documentation, with particular emphasis on maintaining reliable and continuous beneficiary-facing communication services.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

1. Carry out system and hardware maintenance tasks, such as running specialised network monitoring and system protection, to ensure technology is running effectively.

2.Monitor technology reliability, identify user needs, analyse data and produce accurate reports in order to recommend IT solutions to support informative decision-making.

3. Resolve queries independently, escalating if required, to ensure that standard IT questions are answered and accurate information is provided to staff.

4. Provide standard technical training to end users of commonly used technology and systems, in order to assist WFP staff in conducting their work.

5. Provide guidance and training to junior colleagues in the delivery of IT support services to support the capability building of staff.

6. Support the co-ordination of new application implementation in order to provide WFP staff with the tools they need to perform effectively.

7. Draft standard material such as end-user and technical documentation to ensure staff have access to required information about IT services and products.

8.Implement improvements to methods and processes within the IT division in order to support the continuous improvement of IT services provided.

9. Coordinate installation and maintenance of telecommunications systems and equipment, to ensure optimal services in compliance with standard operations procedures.

10.Coordinate a team of IT staff to ensure individual and team objectives are met in compliance with all relevant regulations and policies.

11.Follow set emergency response processes and procedure

**Other POST REQUIREMENTS**

Reporting to the AidHotline Digital Lead in MENAEERO TEC, the incumbent will be responsible for provision of the following services in support of the AidHotline operations:

1. Manage the day-to-day technical operation of AidHotline, monitoring platform availability, telecommunications services, integrations and performance indicators to ensure reliable services across supported Country Offices.

2. Independently investigate and resolve AidHotline incidents and service requests, applying technical judgment, coordinating troubleshooting activities and escalating complex or high-impact issues to the appropriate internal teams or contracted service providers.

3. Oversee AidHotline configuration activities, including the setup and modification of communication channels, call flows, queues, routing rules, user profiles, access permissions and other platform components, ensuring compliance with approved technical and operational standards.

4. Monitor service levels and vendor performance, review incidents against agreed service-level targets, follow up on outstanding technical cases and support the identification and escalation of recurring service-quality issues.

5. Coordinate the technical onboarding and transition of Country Offices to AidHotline, including requirements review, environment preparation, configuration, testing, user acceptance,

migration, deployment and post-implementation support.

6. Analyze platform performance, incident trends and operational data, producing regular service reports and recommending corrective actions, capacity improvements and longer-term solutions to recurring technical or operational issues.

7. Support technical testing of AidHotline releases, upgrades, integrations and configuration changes, ensuring that changes are properly documented, validated and implemented without causing unacceptable disruption to beneficiary-facing services.

8. Develop and maintain AidHotline technical and operational documentation, including standard operating procedures, support guides, configuration records, escalation procedures, knowledge articles and business-continuity instructions.

9. Provide technical guidance, coaching and training to IT Operations Assistants, Country Office technology teams, supervisors and other AidHotline users, strengthening local support capacity and promoting consistent application of platform standards.

10. Support AidHotline service continuity, information security and continuous improvement, ensuring that access controls, data-protection requirements, backup arrangements and emergency-support procedures are followed and that identified risks are appropriately addressed.

11. Other tasks as required.

details:

**Process & Knowledge Management**

  

* Maintain up-to-date IT documentation including runbooks, knowledge base articles, and configuration records

* Participate in the on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend critical support
* Assist in handling MAC (move, add, change) requests submitted by line managers

**Qualifications**

  

* College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* **3–5 years of hands-on experience** in an IT support or systems administration role
* Proficient in **Microsoft 365 administration** — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune
* Experience with **endpoint management tools** (Microsoft Intune, Snipe-IT, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of **VPN technologies** (OpenVPN or similar)
* Familiarity with **cloud platforms** such as AWS or GCP (basic administration and access management)
* Understanding of IT security fundamentals and exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS Controls)
* Sound knowledge of PC hardware, networking concepts, and mobile device management
* Experience with ticketing systems and ITSM processes
* Able to read and understand technical manuals, procedural documentation, and OEM guides

**Personal Attributes**

  

* Technically strong and self-sufficient — can troubleshoot and resolve complex issues independently
* Clear and professional communicator in English, both written and verbal
* Team player who actively supports colleagues and contributes to shared goals
* Proactive and organized — identifies problems before they escalate
* Reliable and accountable with a high attention to detail
* Adaptable in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Curious and self-driven — stays current on relevant technologies and best practices

**Working Conditions**

title: Network Lead
details:
**Job Description:**

**Job Purpose:**
----------------

**The Network & Network Security Lead will play a major role in ensuring the integrity, performance, and security of the organization’s networking environment. This role goes beyond operations, demanding an expert-level understanding of complex network and security architectures, a hands-on ability to troubleshoot high-impact issues, and the capability to lead cross-functional teams in delivering secure and resilient infrastructure for a regulated financial environment.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities & Duties:**
----------------------------------

* Architecture & Design Leadership:
* Lead the design and evolution of enterprise network and security architecture aligned with business and compliance requirements.
* Ensure integration of network security principles in all architectural decisions.
* Collaborate with the design & architect team for the new project or new initiative
* Advanced Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution:
* Own and resolve high-severity incidents by diving deep into Layer 1–7 issues spanning networking, firewalls, routing, DNS, proxies, and cloud networking.
* Lead root cause analysis and implement long-term preventive measures.
* Multiskilling & Cross-Functional Expertise:
* Provide mentorship across routing, switching, firewalls (NGFW), load balancers, VPNs, SD-WAN, ACI, SD-Access, and network access control (NAC).
* Encourage skill development across multiple technology domains within the team.

* Security Posture & Threat Management:
* Implement and maintain network segmentation, access control, and zero-trust strategies.
* Collaborate with the cross-departmental teams on incident response and threat mitigation.
* Operations Oversight & Optimization:
* Oversee the performance, availability, and efficiency of the network and its security services.
* Develop and enforce network operations procedures, ensuring compliance with industry and regulatory standards.
* Project Leadership:
* Lead critical infrastructure projects, including migrations, upgrades, and partner connectivity.
* Coordinate cross-departmentally to ensure secure rollout of new services and systems.
* Vendor & Contract Management:
* Evaluate, select, and manage vendors and service providers.
* Ensure SLA compliance and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Compliance & Audit Readiness:
* Maintain documentation and policies to meet the requirements of financial sector audits and compliance checks (e.g., PCI-DSS, ISO 27001).
* Monitoring & Incident Detection:
* Experience with proactive monitoring for performance and threats using tools like SIEM, NMS, and flow analysis.
* Define thresholds, alerts, and escalation workflows for operational and security incidents.
* Team Development:
* Provide coaching, conduct regular performance reviews, and build development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Documentation:
* Strong experience using documentation tools (Microsoft Office 365, Visio, Lucid chart).
* Ensure all documentation aligns with compliance, audit, and organization standards.
* Strong presentation skills.

Skills & Qualifications:

* Typically, 7+ years of relevant work experience in industry, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar role
* Deep hands-on expertise in enterprise networking, SDN solutions, network security, and firewall administration (Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.).
* Full-stack network knowledge (routing, switching, DNS, VPN, proxies, load balancers, SD-WAN, NAC, Wi-Fi, ACI, SD-Access).
* Strong experience designing and managing secure, scalable, and high-performance networks.
* Proficient in troubleshooting complex multi-vendor, multi-layer issues under pressure.
* Understanding of secure cloud networking (Azure/AWS) and hybrid environments.
* Familiar with compliance frameworks such as Cybersecurity Framework, NCA, ISO 27001, NIST.

**Education & Certifications:**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Network Engineering, or a related field.
* Preferred certifications:
* Cisco CCIE (DC, Enterprise, Security) preferred Enterprise.
* **CISSP / CISM** (a plus for security leadership)
* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure Network Specialty)

**Working Conditions:**
-----------------------

* Based in Saudi Arabia with on-site visits to data centers and site offices.
* Availability for critical incidents and changes outside of normal working hours.
* Hybrid collaboration with global teams, regulators, and auditors.

**Platform Proficiency (Required)**
-----------------------------------

* SolarWinds NPM (performance monitoring), NTA (traffic analysis), NCM (configuration governance — golden baselines, drift detection, scheduled backups, rollback)
* Dynatrace with Davis AI for full-stack observability and AIOps-driven root cause analysis
* Bridge AIOps for event correlation and alert noise reduction
* ServiceNow as the system of record for all ITSM workflows (incidents, changes, CMDB, approval gates)
* Palo Alto NGFW and Cisco ASA/FTD for firewall administration
* Cisco ISE for Network Access Control (posture, guest, BYOD workflows)
* Cisco SD-WAN (controller-based) with MPLS underlay across all sites
* Citrix NetScaler for load balancing (diagnostic-first approach)

**Delivery Model Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead the on-site KSA network team (Network Tower Lead/Architect + L3 engineer) while overseeing 24×7 offshore NOC teams (Egypt & India) responsible for monitoring, incident response, and change execution.
* Coordinate with ISPs for MPLS/Internet underlay circuit management.
* Ensure bilingual (Arabic and English) communication across all network touchpoints.

* Automation pattern: SolarWinds events ServiceNow workflows Ansible playbooks

---------------------------

* NCA (National Cybersecurity Authority) — Saudi regulatory framework
* NDMO (National Data Management Office) — Saudi data governance
* ISO 27001, NIST, CIS hardening baselines

title: Senior Information Security Specialist - GRC
details:
**About the Role:**

Thndr is a fast-moving, highly regulated fintech. You’ll join the Information Security team as a senior information security specialist and work closely with the Information Security Manager. You’ll pick up a large share of the day-to-day compliance work, and just as importantly you’ll help us rethink how it’s done: finding what’s repetitive and automating it, tightening processes, and bringing ideas from your own experience on how GRC should work somewhere that changes quickly. We’re looking for someone who has done this before, works independently and isn’t shy about suggesting a better way.

**What You'll Do:**

* Turn raw evidence into audit-ready documents and file it requirement by requirement, with the ability to tie down different regulations into one fabric of compliant controls.
* Ability to do gap assessment for different compliance frameworks to identify gaps early and work on introducing and adjusting controls to mitigate gaps.
* Keep policies current: update them to close gaps, manage versions, and make sure policies are aligned with the targeted compliance framework and the regulatory fabric.
* Maintain the scope picture (system description, data flow and network diagrams, asset inventory) and keep it in line with what is actually deployed.
* Pull technical evidence from live systems with engineering, such as access reviews, backups, patching, scans and change records, without disrupting production.
* Run third-party risk: vendor attestations, shared responsibilities and the service provider inventory.
* Run the people side of compliance: access reviews, training and policy acknowledgement follow-ups, and joiner and leaver checks.
* Keep trackers and status reporting accurate, and prepare walkthroughs and answers for audit sessions.
* Automate the repetitive parts: evidence templates and exports, tracker updates, recurring evidence pulls, reminders, and checks before anything goes to an auditor.
* Bring ideas on how to structure and mature GRC as the company grows.

**What You'll Need:**

* 5+ years in GRC, IT audit or security compliance, ideally in fintech, banking or payments, with hands-on PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the company side.
* Reads requirements precisely and gives auditors exactly what was asked, no more and no less.
* Strictly factual, with evidence that is accurate and consistent across every document.
* Good judgment on scope, and the confidence to push back on an auditor with a well-argued position.
* Enough technical depth in cloud, networking, Kubernetes, firewalls and logging to pull and judge evidence yourself.
* Writes short, clear policies and documents that stay general but match how things really work.
* Works easily with engineering, HR, vendors and leadership, in plain language.
* Automates by default, with a GRC platform, scripts or AI tools.

**Who Are We?**

**Thndr** was founded on a **bold dream** to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before **Thndr**, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

* High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.
* Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.
* Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

* **5.5 million** app downloads
* **EGP 1B+ average daily traded value** across 2025
* **#1 digital investing platform** in Egypt for the **third consecutive year**
* **76% of users are first-time investors**
* **40%** of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching **Rumble**, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

**Rumble** was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At **Thndr**, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

title: IT Security Lead
details:
Integrant is looking for a highly experienced, hands-on IT Security Lead to own and continuously improve our IT infrastructure, enterprise technology environment, cybersecurity, and information security practices.

This is a highly technical role for someone who combines strong infrastructure and IT operations expertise with solid cybersecurity and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) capabilities.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between strategy and execution—designing technical solutions, troubleshooting complex issues, strengthening security controls, driving infrastructure improvements, supporting compliance initiatives, and leading strategic projects such as ISO 27001

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity**

Strengthen security across Integrant's infrastructure, cloud services, endpoints, identities, and corporate technology ecosystem.

* Continuously assess the organization's cybersecurity posture and identify vulnerabilities and control gaps.
* Design and implement appropriate preventive, detective, and corrective security controls.
* Own vulnerability management, security hardening, remediation, and patching priorities.
* Strengthen endpoint, network, identity, email, and cloud security.
* Implement security principles including Zero Trust, least privilege, defense in depth, and secure-by-default configurations.
* Improve security monitoring, detection, investigation, and response capabilities.
* Lead or support cybersecurity incident investigation, containment, root-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Evaluate cybersecurity technologies and recommend improvements to the organization's security architecture.

**Information Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)**

Ensure Integrant maintains effective information security governance while meeting business, customer, and compliance expectations.

* Support and continuously mature Integrant's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Lead or support ISO 27001 activities, SOC || including risk assessments, control implementation, audits, remediation, and continuous improvement.
* Maintain and improve information security policies, standards, procedures, and technical controls.
* Conduct information security risk assessments and drive appropriate risk-treatment plans.
* Maintain visibility of security risks, control gaps, remediation actions, and exceptions.
* Support internal and external security audits.
* Participate in customer security assessments and security questionnaires when required.
* Assess security risks associated with vendors, SaaS platforms, and third-party technology providers.
* Establish meaningful security metrics and provide management with visibility into key risks and improvements.

**Cloud & SaaS Security**

Ensure that Integrant's cloud and SaaS environments remain secure, well-governed, and appropriately monitored.

* Establish and maintain secure configurations across Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365, and other SaaS platforms.
* Strengthen cloud identity, privileged access, workload, data, and configuration security.
* Improve logging, monitoring, and visibility across cloud services.
* Identify cloud misconfigurations and security gaps and drive remediation.
* Evaluate the security implications of new cloud services and integrations before adoption.
* Implement appropriate secrets, keys, and privileged access management practices.

**Identity & Access Management**

Drive a strong identity-first security model across the organization.

* Own and continuously improve Identity & Access Management practices.
* Strengthen authentication, authorization, MFA, Conditional Access, and privileged access.
* Apply least-privilege principles across users, administrators, systems, and services.
* Improve joiner, mover, and leaver access processes.
* Regularly review privileged and sensitive access.
* Support the organization's evolution toward Zero Trust principles.

**Security Operations & Resilience**

Build effective capabilities for detecting, responding to, and recovering from technology and security incidents.

* Maintain appropriate SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, and alerting capabilities.
* Define and continuously improve incident response processes and playbooks.
* Ensure security events are appropriately investigated, documented, and remediated.
* Conduct root-cause analysis following major incidents.
* Strengthen backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity readiness.
* Periodically test recovery and incident-response capabilities.

**AI & Emerging Technology Security**

Support Integrant's adoption of AI technologies while ensuring appropriate security and governance.

* Evaluate security risks associated with Generative AI and emerging technologies.
* Establish appropriate security controls and guidelines for corporate AI usage.
* Address risks related to sensitive data exposure, unauthorized AI tools, third-party AI platforms, and insecure integrations.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to enable innovation while maintaining appropriate security safeguards.

**Application Security – Future Growth Area**

As Integrant's security maturity evolves, the role will partner with Engineering teams to expand security practices into the software development lifecycle.

Potential areas include:

* Secure SDLC
* DevSecOps
* Threat modeling
* SAST / DAST
* CI/CD security
* Container and Kubernetes security
* Secure coding practices

Deep application security expertise is not a core requirement for joining the role, but previous exposure would be a strong advantage.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Act as a senior technical reference point for security topics.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to IT team members.
* Lead complex infrastructure, security, compliance, and technology projects.
* Collaborate with Engineering, HR, Operations, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate technology and security risks clearly to senior management.
* Drive accountability for technical improvements and remediation initiatives.

Formal people-management experience is considered a nice-to-have rather than a core requirement.

 **Requirements**  

* 8+ years of progressive experience across IT Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, Cloud, Cybersecurity, or related technology functions.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and enterprise security controls.
* Experience with Information Security, risk management, and GRC practices.
* Practical exposure to ISO 27001 or similar information security frameworks.
* Strong understanding networking, firewalls, VPNs, endpoints, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Experience securing cloud environments, preferably Azure and/or AWS.
* Strong knowledge of IAM, privileged access, MFA, Conditional Access, and least-privilege principles.
* Experience with vulnerability management, endpoint security, monitoring, and incident response.
* Ability to independently investigate complex infrastructure and security problems and drive them through resolution.
* Strong project ownership and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience technically mentoring or supervising an IT team.
* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Intune, Purview, or similar platforms.
* Application Security or DevSecOps exposure.
* AI security/governance experience.
* Automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
* Infrastructure as Code exposure.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001, SC-100, AZ-500, or equivalent.

  
**Benefits**

title: Railway Safety Expert
details:
Posting Date: 21 Nov 2026

City: Cairo

Location:

Cairo, EG, P.O.Box150

Contract Type: Fixed-Term

Division: Electronics and System Engineering

Level of experience: Intermediate

RINA is currently recruiting for a **Railway Safety Expert** to join its office in Cairo within the **Electronics and System Engineering** Division.

**Mission**
-----------

RINA is currently recruiting for a **Safety Expert** to join its office in Cairo.

We are seeking an experienced **Railway Safety Expert / Safety Manager** to support safety assurance activities for **high‑speed railway projects**.
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete **EN****50126‑based safety lifecycle** at **subsystem level**, ensuring the safe, compliant, and timely authorization for **placing into service**.

The role requires strong technical expertise, autonomy in managing safety processes, and the ability to coordinate interfaces across multidisciplinary engineering teams, the system integrator, other subsystems, the final client, and the Independent Safety Assessor (ISA).

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

**Safety Lifecycle Management (EN 50126 / EN 50129 / EN 50716)**
  
Lead safety activities for the assigned subsystem across all lifecycle phases, from Concept to Validation.
  
Develop and maintain safety plans, subsystem Safety Case, compliance matrices, and safety evidence.
  
Ensure alignment with EN 50126‑1/‑2 (RAMS), EN 50129 (Safety Case), EN 50716 (software, where applicable), CSM-RA and project‑specific standards.
  
Manage safety requirements, including capture, allocation, verification, and validation across subsystem functions.
  
Guarantee the completeness and consistency of the safety argumentation supporting authorization to operate.
  
**Hazard Analysis & Risk Assessment**
  
Lead and perform hazard identification and risk analyses (HAZID, HAZOP, FMEA, FTA) at subsystem level.
  
Maintain the Subsystem Hazard Log in line with project and integrator requirements.
  
Ensure hazards are addressed and mitigated to ALARP, gathering evidence from design, construction, and testing teams.
  
Coordinate with the System Integrator for correct classification and integration of subsystem hazards.
  
**Interface Management (Internal & External)**

Work closely with design, construction, RAM, quality, and testing & commissioning teams to ensure safety requirements are implemented and verified.
  
Coordinate safety inputs and outputs with the System Integrator, ensuring coherent safety interfaces across all subsystems.
  
Collaborate with other subsystem contractors to address interface hazards and shared responsibilities.
  
Act as a key safety contact with the final client, authorities, and Independent Safety Assessor (ISA).
  
**Safety Assurance During Design, Construction & Testing**
  
Review and approve subsystem design deliverables, technical documentation, and test procedures from a safety standpoint.
  
Monitor safety‑related implementation on site (when needed), ensuring design intent is preserved.
  
Support Test & Commissioning teams to ensure safety‑related tests, validations, and verifications are properly executed and recorded.
  
Provide safety readiness inputs for key milestones, including subsystem integration, system integration, trial running, and authorization to operate.
  
**Documentation & Authorization for Placing Into Service**
  
Consolidate all required evidence for subsystem acceptance and safety certification.
  
Ensure continuous alignment with project‑specific authorization frameworks (e.g., national railway authorities).
  
Prepare and defend safety submissions in front of assessor, client, and authorities.

* Prepare RAMS and system assurance deliverables and support their review and acceptance, ensuring compliance with project, client, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary rail systems and civil engineering teams, including rolling stock, signalling and train control, traction power, track works, platform screen doors, automatic fare collection, depot equipment, operations control centre, MEP, civil, structural, and architectural disciplines.
* Support requirements management, configuration management, safety assurance, and interface coordination activities in line with the overall system assurance process.
* Assist in preparing assurance status reports, technical summaries, risks, actions, and progress updates for project leadership, clients, and relevant stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with client representatives and project teams, while maintaining the flexibility required to complete RAMS and system assurance tasks within tight delivery timelines.
* Travel across the Middle East and India where required for project coordination, meetings, reviews, and delivery support.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. Membership of an appropriate professional institution is preferred.
* Overall experience of 5 to 7 years, including at least 3 years of full-time experience performing RAMS and systems assurance works on rail transportation systems.
* Experience in mainline freight railway, passenger railway, metro, LRT, or other rail transportation environments.
* Working knowledge of systems assurance, RAMS, system safety, safety management, quality assurance, verification and validation, and assurance lifecycle processes.
* Exposure to the application of systems assurance standards such as EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129, EN 50176, IEC 61508, and equivalent standards.
* Exposure to Safety Case development within a railway environment.
* Familiarity with the Independent Safety Assessor (ISA) process and supporting ISA-related reviews, comments, evidence, and close-out actions.
* Hands-on experience with system assurance and systems engineering tools such as Isograph Reliability Workbench (RWB), Isograph Availability Workbench (AVSim+), DOORS, ComplyPro, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with SA tools such as DOORS and/or ComplyPro is required.

title: Business Resilience Sr. Lead
details:
**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

**Role Purpose**
----------------

To strengthen Vodafone Egypt’s enterprise-wide Business Resilience capabilities by implementing and continuously improving Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Crisis Management (CM) frameworks, ensuring organizational preparedness, effective incident response, and timely recovery from significant disruptions.

The role will work cross-functionally with Business, Technology, Corporate Functions, Commercial, Financial and relevant Group stakeholders to protect critical services, minimize operational and customer impact, and maintain alignment with Vodafone Group standards, ISO 22301, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge with hands-on execution, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple organizational levels during business-as-usual activities and high-pressure crisis situations.

**Key Accountabilities & Decision Ownership**
---------------------------------------------

**A. Business Continuity Management (BCM)**

* Implement and maintain the Business Continuity Management System (BCMS), including policies, standards, procedures, governance, and supporting documentation, aligned with ISO 22301 and Vodafone Group requirements.
* Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) and business continuity risk assessments to identify critical activities, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and recovery priorities.
* Develop, review, and validate Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Defining recovery strategies, Minimum Business Continuity Objectives (MBCOs), Maximum Tolerable Periods of Disruption (MTPDs), Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs), and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs), as applicable.
* Coordinate continuity planning across business functions, Technology, infrastructure, critical suppliers, and other interdependent services to ensure end-to-end recovery readiness.
* Monitor continuity plan effectiveness, remediation actions, outstanding risks, and readiness indicators, ensuring appropriate stakeholder ownership and management visibility.

**B. Crisis Management & Major Incident Coordination**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Crisis Management Plan (CMP), including crisis governance, escalation criteria, activation protocols, command structures, roles, responsibilities, and communication workflows.
* Support the effective activation and coordination of Crisis Management Teams (CMTs), deputies, and relevant stakeholders across operational, tactical, and strategic levels.
* Assess and communicate the potential business impact and severity of significant incidents using established severity classification and escalation frameworks.
* Coordinate crisis communications and crisis tools logistics, situation reports, management updates, stakeholder notifications, and escalation to relevant Vodafone Group and external stakeholders, as required.
* Support crisis leadership through structured incident assessment, impact analysis, response coordination, decision tracking, and recovery monitoring.
* Coordinate post-incident reviews and lessons-learned activities, translating findings into measurable improvements in organizational preparedness and response effectiveness.

**.**
-----

**C. Resilience Testing, Exercises & Awareness**

* Design, coordinate, and execute BCP tests, tabletop exercises, crisis simulations, and scenario-based assessments to validate preparedness, decision-making, escalation, and recovery capabilities.
* Develop realistic scenarios reflecting telecommunications business risks, including service disruptions, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, power outages, supplier failures, and other significant operational threats.
* Evaluate exercise and test outcomes, document gaps, assign corrective actions, and track closure with accountable stakeholders.
* Deliver BCM and CM training and awareness initiatives to improve organizational understanding, crisis readiness, and compliance with established procedures.

**D. Governance, Compliance & Stakeholder Management**

* Support internal and external audits, compliance assessments, management reviews, and regulatory requests relating to business continuity and crisis management.
* Maintain accurate BCCM documentation, risk registers, action trackers, readiness dashboards, and management reporting.
* Collaborate with Technology Resilience, Information Security, Corporate Security, Risk, Legal, Public Policy, Operations, and other relevant functions to strengthen integrated resilience.
* Coordinate with Vodafone Group and relevant external entities on resilience standards, reporting, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, digitize, and improve BCCM processes, reporting, and operational effectiveness.

**Core Competencies, Knowledge, and Experience**
------------------------------------------------

**Experience**

* 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3 years in Business Continuity Management, Crisis Management, Operational Resilience, or a closely related discipline.
* Experience in telecommunications, technology, critical infrastructure, or another complex, business-critical operating environment is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, or maintaining BCM frameworks, BIAs, BCPs, crisis management procedures, and resilience exercises.
* Practical experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing time-sensitive deliverables, incidents, or recovery activities.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Good working knowledge of ISO 22301 and Business Continuity Management System principles.
* Practical understanding of BIA methodologies, continuity risk assessments, recovery strategies, RTOs, RPOs, and MBCOs.
* Knowledge of crisis management governance, incident severity assessment, escalation protocols, CMT coordination, and crisis communications.
* Understanding of operational and technology dependencies, disaster recovery concepts, third-party risks, and business-critical service continuity.
* Familiarity with audit requirements, compliance evidence, management reporting, and corrective action tracking.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to develop clear reports, dashboards, and executive-ready presentations.

**Education & Professional Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
* A recognized Business Continuity certification, such as CBCI, or relevant ISO 22301 training is preferred.
* ISO 22301 Lead Implementer, Lead Auditor, or equivalent professional qualifications are an advantage.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking, risk assessment, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent coordination, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate technical and operational risks into clear business impacts, recovery priorities, and management actions.
* Strong planning, organization, documentation, and follow-up capabilities.
* Sound judgment, composure, adaptability, and prioritization under pressure.
* A proactive, accountable, and continuous-improvement mindset.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple teams and organizational levels.

**Who we are**
--------------

We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.

Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. ;We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance.

Together we can.

title: Head of Identity & Access Management (IAM)
details:
***Envision Employment Solutions*** *is currently looking for a* ***Head of Identity & Access Management (IAM)*** *for one of our partners, a leading Digital Bank!*

**THE ROLE**

Every login, every customer authentication, every privileged access request runs through the architecture you design, from a blank page. You're building both sides of identity at once, the customer-facing experience that has to feel invisible and secure at the same time, and the workforce controls that keep the bank's critical infrastructure locked down. Get it right, and identity becomes the thing nobody thinks about because it just works, safely, every time.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Design and build the enterprise IAM and CIAM framework entirely from scratch, defining modern identity lifecycle workflows, authentication standards, and authorization models
* Partner with the Product team to architect secure, high-availability, low-friction consumer authentication experiences, including multi-factor authentication, biometric integration, and passwordless options, balancing rigorous bank security with a seamless digital banking experience
* Implement robust workforce identity controls, Single Sign-On (SSO), Enterprise Directory services, and automated Privileged Access Management (PAM) workflows to protect critical infrastructure and cloud environments
* Partner with cloud security and network engineering to enforce continuous identity verification, least-privilege access, and conditional access policies across cloud-native microservices
* Automate user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role-based access control (RBAC) to eliminate identity sprawl and streamline internal HR-to-IT workflows
* Establish regular access recertification campaigns, audit logging, and reporting mechanisms to satisfy internal reviews and CBE regulatory examinations

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 10+ years of cumulative IT and information security experience, including 4 to 5 years specializing in IAM, CIAM, and PAM architecture and leadership within banking, financial services, or advanced fintech environments
* Hands-on expertise with modern identity protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML), cloud identity providers (e.g., Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity), and modern CIAM architectures
* Solid understanding of Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) cybersecurity circulars, authentication requirements, and data privacy guidelines
* Professional credentials such as CISSP, Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM), or vendor-specific expert certifications are strongly preferred
* A builder mindset, thriving in a fast-paced, from-scratch environment, able to balance extreme security rigor for financial data with rapid, agile product delivery
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, bridging product engineering, security operations, and executive stakeholders

**YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU**

* You'd rather architect identity from first principles than patch together an inherited mess of directories and permissions
* You believe a login should feel effortless to the customer and be uncompromising underneath
* You treat least-privilege access as a default, not an exception you get to when there's time
* You can translate an identity architecture decision into something both a regulator and a product team understand
* You want to build the layer that every other system in the bank ultimately trusts

title: AI GOVERNANCE LEAD (ISO 42001 IMPLEMENTER & AUDITOR)
details:
**AI GOVERNANCE LEAD** **(ISO 42001 IMPLEMENTER & AUDITOR)**  
Standing up and stewarding AI Management Systems (AIMS) certified to ISO/IEC 42001—and helping our clients do the same.

Are you an ISO 42001 practitioner who can turn responsible-AI principles into auditable practice? Do you enjoy building management systems, running internal audits, and defending them before external assessors? We are hiring an AI Governance Lead (ISO 42001 Implementer & Auditor) to design, implement, and maintain Allendevaux & Company’s AIMS and to advise client teams on obtaining and sustaining ISO 42001 certification.

You will partner with the AI Systems Architect, ML/MLOps, Prompt Engineering, Security, and Legal to embed governance controls throughout the model lifecycle—so our AI services are trustworthy, compliant, and ready for external scrutiny.

BACKGROUND

Allendevaux & Company is building Digital Trustify, a 25-module GRC platform that embeds AI at its core. Our mission is to make advanced compliance effortless for enterprises. Your role ensures that the way we build and operate AI is itself governed to the highest standard—internally and for our clients.

Must have a laptop that supports documentation work and Microsoft Teams meetings. Company will provide all software.

EXPERIENCE

The ideal candidate has implemented one or more management systems in practice (ISO 42001, and/or ISO 27001/27701), led internal audits, and guided teams through external certification. You should be comfortable translating standards into policies, controls, records, and metrics across AI data pipelines and model operations. The ideal candidate must hold ISO 42001 implementer certification and auditor certification.

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS & SKILLS

* Excellent communicator in English, able to brief executives and engineers with equal clarity.
* Methodical and evidence-driven; insists on traceability, version control, and audit-ready artefacts.
* Collaborative and pragmatic—balances governance with delivery timelines.
* Strong facilitator capable of running workshops and corrective-action reviews.
* Ethically minded, with a firm grasp of risk, bias, security, and privacy implications of AI.

  

RESPONSIBILITIES

* AIMS build-out: Establish and maintain the ISO 42001-aligned AI Management System (policies, procedures, control catalogue, metrics, records, and governance forums).
* Risk & impact management: Operationalise AI risk assessment in line with ISO 23894; coordinate model/AI impact assessments; maintain risk registers and treatment plans.
* Lifecycle gates: Define and enforce model-lifecycle checkpoints (data governance, training/finetuning approval, evaluation/guard-rails, release/rollback criteria) in collaboration with AI Engineering and MLOps.
* Assurance & audits: Plan and run internal audits; manage management-review meetings; coordinate external audits; draft and track CAPA for non-conformities.
* Cross-standard mapping: Maintain crosswalks to ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2, NIST AI RMF 1.0, and (as applicable) EU AI Act readiness; align with privacy and security requirements.
* Client enablement: Lead workshops and readiness engagements to help client teams implement ISO 42001; prepare evidence packs and defend audits with external assessors.
* Training & culture: Develop role-based training for engineers, product, and leadership; champion responsible-AI practices and continuous improvement.
* Records & reporting: Keep audit-ready documentation (policies, model cards, data sheets, evaluation reports, change logs) and report governance KPIs to the CAIO.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Data/AI, or related field.
* ISO 42001 Lead Implementer certification and ISO 42001 Lead Auditor certification.
* 5+ years in governance, assurance, or compliance for technology products, including hands-on experience with management systems (e.g., ISO 42001, ISO 27001, 27701).
* Practical familiarity with AI/ML delivery (MLOps, dataset governance, evaluation/guard-rails) and with security/privacy control design.

  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Master’s degree in Law/Policy, Information Security, or Computer Science.
* Additional certifications (ISO 27001 LI/LA, CIPP/CIPT/CIPM, or NIST-focused credentials).
* Experience preparing organisations for public-sector or federal compliance.
* Working knowledge of bias/fairness testing, model documentation (model cards, data sheets), and AI incident response.
* Prior consulting experience leading external ISO readiness projects.

  

If you are excited to operationalise responsible AI—so that models clear audits without slowing innovation—we’d love to hear from you.
