* when they browse for your product on the internet,
* when they choose to buy our product in the store and
* when they use it at home.

These are what we call the ‘3 moments of truth’. The first two moments is what we focus on when we market products.

title: Signaling Maintenance Engineer @Siemens Mobility Egypt
details:

Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services.

Today, we are recruiting for a **Signaling Maintenance Engineer** to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals who want to join a truly international team on one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility.

### **What are my responsibilities?**

* Provide technical support for preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance of assigned signalling and train control assets.
* Diagnose complex faults, investigate recurring failures, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor system condition, reliability, and availability, and identify trends and technical improvement opportunities.
* Review maintenance plans, work instructions, and inspection and testing procedures using field experience.
* Support maintenance execution with technical requirements, tools, spares, testing, and restoration guidance.

* Provide technical guidance to supervisors and technicians.
* Provide technical input to forecasts, procurement needs, and improvement proposals.

### **What do I need to qualify for this job?**

* A bachelor's degree in electrical, electronics, telecommunications, railway engineering, or a comparable discipline.
* 7 to 10 years of relevant signalling, train control, automation, or safety-critical systems maintenance experience.
* Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance, fault diagnosis, testing, and technical documentation.
* A good knowledge of signalling principles, interfaces, and safety-critical maintenance practices.
* Ability to interpret circuit diagrams, system schematics, test results, and technical manuals.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills.

title: Commercial Director - Four Seasons Hotel Luxor, Egypt
details:
Job ID: REQ10397377

Luxor

Location: Luxor, Luxor, Egypt

widget: Full time

  

**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.
  
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Perched along the banks of the Nile in the heart of Egypt's legendary ancient city of Thebes, Four Seasons Hotel Luxor will bring world-class hospitality to one of the world's most remarkable destinations. Set to open in 2027, the hotel will feature 200 guest rooms and suites with views of the Nile, exceptional dining experiences, a luxurious spa and wellness offering, family-focused amenities, and event spaces. Located moments from the iconic Luxor Temple and the Valley of the Kings, Four Seasons Hotel Luxor offers a unique opportunity to be part of a landmark opening and help shape the future of luxury hospitality in one of the world's most captivating cultural destinations.

**The Role of Commercial Director:**

Four Seasons Hotel Luxor is anticipated to open in 2027, and we are seeking an exceptional Commercial Director to join the pre-opening leadership team and play a pivotal role in defining the hotel’s commercial strategy, digital presence, market positioning and successful launch.

Reporting to the General Manager and serving as a key member of the Hotel Leadership Team, the Commercial Director will lead the hotel’s integrated commercial strategy across Sales, Revenue Management, Reservations, Marketing, Digital, Distribution, Communications and Public Relations.

This is a highly strategic role, responsible for creating a connected commercial ecosystem that translates customer and market insights into demand, revenue growth, market share and long-term brand value.

You will:

* Define the hotel’s overall commercial strategy, establishing its positioning, priority customer segments, source markets, channel strategy and competitive differentiation.
* Develop and execute the pre-opening commercial roadmap, from market entry and positioning through launch, ramp-up and stabilization.
* Lead the annual Commercial Plan, budget and forecasting process, establishing measurable objectives and ensuring resources are deployed against the greatest commercial opportunities.
* Build an integrated digital strategy across direct channels, paid media, search, social, content, CRM and other relevant digital touchpoints, with a clear focus on customer acquisition, engagement and conversion.
* Champion a digital-first approach to demand generation, continuously evaluating how customers discover, research, select and book luxury travel.
* Optimize the hotel's digital presence and content, ensuring its positioning and experiences are compelling, differentiated and consistent throughout the customer journey.
* Lead distribution and channel strategy, balancing direct and indirect business while optimizing channel mix, acquisition cost and commercial value.
* Provide strategic leadership for pricing and revenue management, ensuring pricing, inventory, segmentation and demand-generation strategies operate as one integrated commercial approach.
* Develop the hotel’s Sales strategy across luxury leisure, travel trade, groups and other relevant segments, establishing high-value partnerships and relationships.
* Shape the Marketing, Communications, PR, Social Media and content strategy, building awareness and establishing the hotel as a compelling luxury destination internationally.
* Build, lead, coach and develop a high-performing commercial team, creating an environment where employees feel supported, empowered and accountable for delivering exceptional results.
* Work closely with the General Manager and Hotel Leadership Team to ensure commercial priorities are fully integrated into the broader hotel strategy and guest experience.

**Our Ideal candidate:**

Strategic, digitally fluent and commercially sophisticated leader with significant luxury hospitality experience and a track record of translating insight and creativity into measurable commercial outcomes.

The successful candidate will bring:

* Strong strategic and financial acumen, with expertise in commercial planning, sales and revenue optimization, budgeting and forecasting.
* Demonstrated understanding of digital commerce, performance marketing, distribution, CRM, customer acquisition and conversion.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to turn data and customer insights into commercial decisions.
* The ability to challenge established thinking, identify new growth opportunities and prioritize investment based on commercial impact and ROI.
* Exceptional leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to align multiple disciplines behind a single commercial strategy.
* Creativity, entrepreneurial thinking and the ambition to establish a new hotel and destination in the global luxury marketplace.
* Pre-opening luxury hospitality experience is required, with international hospitality exposure highly preferred. Experience within the Middle East region will be considered a strong advantage.

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts can offer what many hospitality professionals dream of; the opportunity to build a life-long career with global potential and a real sense of pride in work well done. We look for talent who share the Golden Rule – people who, by nature, believe in treating others as we would have them treat us. As Four Seasons works towards phenomenal growth in the next decade, our most valuable partners continue to be our talent, with whom we have a strong relationship based on the Golden Rule. This relationship is made tangible by the awards received year after year by Four Seasons on a corporate level, as well as by our hotels, resorts and residences around the world, making us an undisputed “employer of choice.”

title: R&D Specialist
details:
**TRANSFORM | CONNECT | EMPOWER**

Macro is where transformation is lived, leadership is close, and talent is stretched into its fullest potential. #Crew\_Not\_Passengers

**Ready To Take The Lead & Leave Your Mark!**

**What you'll be doing**

At Macro Group, we believe innovation starts with curiosity and precision. We are looking for a **Research & Development Specialist** to join our growth-driven R&D team. In this role, you will help bring new cosmeceutical and pharmaceutical formulations to life, scale existing products, and conduct hands-on lab trials in a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.

* **Execute Comprehensive Market & Technical Research:** Conduct in-depth literature and database searches (Internet, IMS, scientific references) to evaluate new products, delivering clear feasibility insights for innovative product pipelines.
* **Implement Standard R&D Lab Procedures:** Execute end-to-end R&D formulation procedures under senior mentorship to ensure seamless step-by-step progress through each development phase.
* **Formulate & Conduct Lab Trials:** Conduct lab trials and formulation tests using precise supportive analytical measures to verify product success and stability metrics.
* **Gather Master Product Documentation:** Assemble and update comprehensive product records and files, submitting finalized documentation to the R&D Manager within target project deadlines.
* **Source Quality Ingredients:** Partner directly with raw material suppliers to procure high-spec ingredients and cost-effective substitutes that meet corporate quality standards.
* **Ensure Product Efficacy & Stability:** Engage with external certified laboratories to perform specialized testing, verifying product quality, efficacy, and shelf-life stability.
* **Uphold Lab Safety & Excellence:** Build and maintain detailed reference databases for raw materials, chemicals, equipment, and lab samples to reinforce lab safety and hazard awareness.
* **Drive Quality & Cost Improvements:** Propose innovative quality enhancements, formula optimization ideas, and raw material substitution strategies to reduce unit costs while maintaining superior product performance.
* **Deliver Export Scientific Documentation:** Collaborate with the Export Department to supply complete technical and scientific documentation required for overseas product registrations and regulatory compliance.

**What you'll need to succeed**

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences.
* At least 2 - 3 years of hands-on experience as an R&D Specialist in pharmaceutical or cosmeceutical product formulation.
* Proven capability in product innovation with a track record of formulating and delivering market-ready products.
* Solid technical understanding of active ingredients, excipients, packaging specifications, and stability testing standards.
* Strong supplier management skills and problem-solving mindset to evaluate cost-efficient raw material substitutes.
* High level of data accuracy, analytical thinking, time management, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written and spoken Arabic and English communication skills, with proficiency in MS Office and scientific research tools.

title: Sr. Bidding Specialist
details:
**Role**

Leads and coordinates the end-to-end bid management process from opportunity qualification and RFP review through proposal development and submission, ensuring that bids are compliant, commercially sound, well-structured, compelling, and delivered within agreed timelines. The role acts as a central point across Sales, Commercial, Technical, Finance, and other stakeholders, while providing structured analysis, management reporting, and presentation of bid and pipeline insights to support informed decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and analyze RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, and related bid documents to understand scope, requirements, evaluation criteria, commercial conditions, timelines, and submission instructions.
* Conduct structured RFP reviews and prepare requirements summaries, compliance matrices, key deliverables, mandatory requirements, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and clarification points.
* Support bid qualification and feasibility assessment by analyzing opportunity scope, strategic fit, delivery requirements, available capabilities, commercial considerations, and key bid risks.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, conflicts, and potential compliance issues in bid documents and coordinate clarification requirements with the relevant stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain bid plans, submission timelines, milestones, responsibilities matrices, action trackers, and governance checkpoints.
* Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and ensure timely receipt, review, consolidation, and quality control of technical and commercial inputs.
* Track opportunity progress, identify bottlenecks and dependencies, escalate critical issues, and follow up until resolution.
* Review proposal content for completeness, consistency, compliance, formatting, and alignment with the RFP requirements before submission.
* Validate pricing inputs and supporting commercial information to ensure consistency between the technical scope, resource assumptions, pricing structure, and financial offer.
* Validate Sales Orders and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure commercial information is accurately reflected.
* Conduct pipeline and opportunity data quality checks, ensuring alignment between CRM, pipeline trackers, and supporting records.
* Prepare recurring pipeline, bid performance, and commercial reports covering opportunity status, bid progress, win/loss performance, pipeline trends, and key management indicators.
* Perform bid and pipeline analytics to identify trends, variances, bottlenecks, conversion patterns, win/loss drivers, and areas requiring management attention.
* Develop win/loss analysis and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations to improve future bidding performance.
* Prepare monthly reports for Finance covering won and expected-to-be-won projects, including detailed revenue breakdowns and relevant commercial information.
* Prepare management-ready presentations and executive summaries that convert complex bid, pipeline, and commercial data into clear insights, key messages, and recommended actions.
* Present bid status, analytical findings, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to management and relevant stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
* Manage weekly Sales Review meetings with regional teams, consolidate opportunity updates, highlight changes and risks, and document agreed actions and follow-ups.
* Support continuous improvement of bid management processes, templates, dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and knowledge repositories.

**RFP Review & Bid Analysis – Core Expectations**

* Demonstrate the ability to read and interpret complex RFP/RFI/RFQ documentation and convert requirements into clear, actionable bid workstreams.
* Distinguish between mandatory, scored, commercial, technical, contractual, and administrative requirements and highlight their impact on the bid.
* Assess bid risks, dependencies, resource requirements, delivery constraints, and information gaps and escalate issues appropriately.
* Use structured analysis to support bid/no-bid discussions and provide fact-based inputs rather than relying solely on qualitative assumptions.
* Ensure traceability between RFP requirements, proposal responses, supporting evidence, and internal ownership.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Analyze pipeline and bid data to identify trends, anomalies, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical reports covering pipeline status, bid funnel, win rate, bid value, service line/country performance, forecast, and other relevant KPIs.
* Validate data quality and reconcile CRM, pipeline, commercial, and reporting sources before presenting findings.
* Translate analysis into concise management insights, clearly explaining what changed, why it matters, and what action is recommended.
* Use Excel and data visualization tools to present information in a structured, decision-oriented format.

**Presentation & Communication**

* Create professional PowerPoint presentations, executive summaries, dashboards, and visual reports suitable for management and stakeholder reviews.
* Present complex information clearly and logically, adapting the level of detail to technical, commercial, sales, and executive audiences.
* Communicate key messages, risks, decisions required, and recommendations with confidence and strong attention to business context.
* Facilitate meetings effectively, document decisions and actions, and ensure follow-up on agreed commitments.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal English communication skills.

details:

title: Senior Power BI Developer - Remote - Octopus by RTG
details:
The role focuses primarily on Power BI development and platform administration, alongside a strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and ETL/ELT processes. You will collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver maintainable reporting solutions and support the evolution of the company's data architecture.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports using DAX and Power Query (M).
* Build and optimize data models to ensure reporting accuracy and performance.
* Administer the Power BI environment, including datasets, workspaces, gateways, and service accounts.
* Manage Power BI access, licensing, refresh failures, and platform-related issues.
* Implement and maintain Row-Level Security (RLS) and data governance controls to meet security and audit requirements.
* Document dashboard logic, data sources, business definitions, and reporting processes.
* Gather and clarify reporting requirements with business stakeholders and translate them into maintainable BI solutions.
* Work with SQL and relational databases to support reporting and data analysis.
* Apply data warehouse concepts and dimensional modeling principles, including star and snowflake schemas.
* Understand ETL/ELT processes and how data pipelines feed BI reporting layers.
* Support the evolution of Power BI architecture as new data sources and semantic models are introduced through the Data Warehouse initiative.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience.
* Strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M), and data modeling.
* Strong SQL and Advanced SQL skills, with experience working with relational databases.
* Solid understanding of data warehouse concepts and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas.
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and their integration with BI reporting.
* Practical experience implementing Row-Level Security (RLS) and data governance practices.
* Experience with Power BI platform administration, including workspaces, datasets, gateways, and refresh management.
* Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English, spoken and written.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst certification (PL-300) or equivalent.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure or Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience working in a BI environment undergoing a Data Warehouse implementation or platform migration.

title: Lab Analyst - Microbiology - Alcoholic beverage
details:
A leading company in the alcoholic beverage **industry** is seeking a **Lab Analyst – Microbiology** to join their Quality Control team. The successful candidate will be responsible for performing microbiological analysis of raw materials, water, in-process samples, and finished products to ensure compliance with quality, food safety, and regulatory requirements. The role involves maintaining accurate laboratory records, following Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), and supporting the implementation of effective quality and hygiene standards.

Responsibilities:

1. Collect and handle samples aseptically according to approved plans; maintain sample identification, traceability, storage conditions and testing timelines.

2. Perform microbial counts, yeast and mold enumeration, coliform/E. coli and beverage spoilage testing as

specified by approved methods and product risk assessments.

3. Prepare media, diluents and reagents; document preparation, expiry, sterility and growth-promotion checks, with

appropriate test controls.

4. Execute environmental and hygiene monitoring of equipment, food-contact surfaces, personnel and production

areas; trend results and flag adverse patterns.

5. Sample process water and CIP/rinse water; support cleaning and sanitation verification. Perform ATP checks

where included in the approved hygiene program.

6. Conduct assigned GMP inspections, document hygiene deficiencies and follow up agreed actions with Production

and QA.

7. Operate and check incubators, autoclaves, balances, pH meters and filtration equipment; maintain records and report faults or overdue calibration.

8. Record raw data and results contemporaneously; promptly escalate atypical or out-of-specification findings and support investigations and CAPA.

9. Maintain laboratory cleanliness, safe handling, sterilization and waste disposal; control media, reagent and

consumable stock and expiry dates.

10. Support SOP updates, method verification, training, external laboratory sample dispatch, HACCP/FSSC 22000

activities and audit preparation.

11. Authority: stop affected testing when controls or equipment are unsuitable; escalate contamination risks and

recommend product hold. Final release/rejection is reserved for authorized quality personnel.

 **Requirements**

. Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Science, Biotechnology, Food Science, Agriculture or a relevant discipline.

. Training in food/beverage microbiology, GMP, aseptic techniques and laboratory safety.

. Training in HACCP, FSSC 22000 and ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory competence principles.

* Aseptic sampling, serial dilution, plating, membrane filtration and colony counting. Required X Preferred
* Media preparation and quality control; correct use

of positive and negative controls. Required X Preferred

* Environmental monitoring and interpretation of

microbiological results. Required X Preferred

* Accurate documentation, traceability and timely

escalation of abnormal findings. Required X Preferred

* Operation and routine checks of microbiology

laboratory equipment. Required X Preferred

* Microsoft Excel for result tracking, trending and

laboratory reports. Required X Preferred

* Organization, teamwork, communication and

practical problem-solving.

title: Senior Analyst - FP&A I Real Estate I Finance
details:
**Job Requisition ID:** 181403

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

**Overview of the role**

Support the Financial Planning & Analysis function for Cairo Festival City Mall by providing financial analysis, reporting and insights that support management decision-making. The role supports the full planning and analysis cycle, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, variance analysis and performance monitoring across mall revenues, occupancy, leasing and operating costs. Working closely with Leasing, Marketing, Operations, Development, Treasury and Finance teams, the position helps ensure accurate financial information, effective business partnering and commercially focused decision support.

**What you will do**

* Support the monthly financial close for the Mall business, including review of accruals and accounting entries such as service charges, utilities, marketing and maintenance costs, and support balance sheet reconciliations.
* Prepare monthly management reporting packs and performance dashboards to support Cairo Festival City Mall business reviews.
* Analyze Mall P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance against budget, forecast and prior year, highlighting key drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Support the preparation of the annual budget, quarterly forecasts and 5-Year business plan, covering leasing and rental income, service charges, OPEX and CAPEX.
* Develop and maintain financial models for budgeting, rolling forecasts and scenario analysis using updated leasing, occupancy and operational assumptions.

* Strong understanding of shopping mall business drivers and KPIs, including tenant sales, occupancy cost ratio, occupancy, footfall, turnover rent and service charges.
* Knowledge of accounting standards and financial statement preparation, with strong understanding of EAS / IAS / IFRS.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to translate financial information into clear business insights.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with finance and non-finance stakeholders.
* Knowledge of ERP financial software is required; SAP and Yardi experience is preferred. Advanced Excel and Power BI skills are preferred.
* Commercially oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, take ownership of deliverables and perform effectively under pressure.

**What equips you for the role**

* Professional certification such as CMA or FMVA is preferred.
* Knowledge of management reporting, automation and accounting systems.
* Understanding of Egypt real estate laws, guidelines and directives is desirable.
* Ability to approach problem-solving with simplicity and logic and communicate financial matters effectively to non-finance professionals.
* Ability to think holistically and understand the wider business impact of financial transactions and decisions.

**About Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
  
The real estate development and operations arm of Al-Futtaim, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi-billion-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years. Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
  
AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

title: Sub-Editor, ZAWYA
details:
ZAWYA is seeking a sub-editor to support its editorial operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing, copyediting, translating and proofreading news articles and other editorial content, ensuring that all published material meets ZAWYA’s standards of accuracy, clarity, consistency and quality.

  

Working closely with editors, reporters and other members of the ZAWYA team, the sub-editor will play a key role in maintaining the quality, accuracy and integrity of ZAWYA’s coverage. The role requires exceptional command of both English and Arabic, strong editorial judgment and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced digital newsroom, ensuring that content is accurate, engaging and suitable for publication across both languages. The ability to ensure accurate and appropriate use of financial and business terminology across the two languages is essential to this role.

  

**Responsibilities:**

Copyedit and proofread English and Arabic news articles, press releases and other editorial content to ensure accuracy, clarity, readability and consistency

Ensure all published content adheres to ZAWYA’s editorial guidelines, house style and quality standards

Review articles for grammatical, spelling, punctuation, factual and structural errors, making necessary corrections while preserving the original meaning and intent

Write and refine headlines, summaries and other supporting editorial text to ensure they are accurate and appropriate for ZAWYA’s professional readership

Translate English content to Arabic or vice versa when it is deemed suitable for the relevant ZAWYA audience

Identify and flag factual inconsistencies, potentially misleading statements, legal or reputational risks and other editorial concerns, escalating issues to senior editors where appropriate

Support the publication of content through ZAWYA’s content management system, ensuring appropriate formatting, categorisation and presentation across digital platforms, as well as helping with the curation of the ZAWYA websites

Maintain consistency in the use of financial terminology, company names, market references and other conventions across English and Arabic

  
  

**Experience / Skills**

Native-level mastery of **English and Arabic** language

Previous experience in sub-editing, copyediting or proofreading within a professional newsroom, financial news organisation or digital publishing environment

Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and correct linguistic, factual and stylistic inconsistencies

Good editorial judgment and an understanding of journalistic standards, including sourcing, verification, attribution, corrections and media ethics

Familiarity with financial markets, business and economic terminology, particularly in relation to the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region

Familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing workflows

title: Procurement Officer (Remote - Egypt)
details:
**About Mozn**

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

**About the role**

As a Procurement Officer at MOZN, you will own Technology, Non-Technology, and Logistics procurement. This covers the full cycle, from category strategy and sourcing through contracting, delivery, and supplier performance. **This is a remote role based in Egypt.**

You will deliver measurable savings and reduce supplier risk while staying within MOZN's approval matrix and procurement policies. You'll work closely with Finance, Legal, Risk & Compliance, IT, and internal requestors to make sure every purchase is competitive, compliant, and delivered on time.

**What you'll do**

**Purchasing Operations**

* Review approved purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders in line with procurement policies and SOPs.

**Category Strategy, Sourcing & Supplier Management**

* Build and execute category strategies for Technology, Non-Technology, and Logistics spend (e.g., hardware, software and licenses, managed services, facilities and general services, and freight and logistics), targeting cost savings, risk reduction, and value creation.
* Source qualified, competitive suppliers in the local market and internationally.
* Run RFI, RFP, and tender processes with scorecard-based technical and commercial evaluations, and document the basis for every recommendation.
* Carry out supplier prequalification and recommend approval or rejection. This includes site visits in Egypt, company profile review, due diligence (including sanctions and conflict-of-interest screening), and an information security review with IT for technology suppliers. Onboarding approval and vendor master data set-up sit with the designated owners.
* Manage relationships with strategic suppliers through regular performance reviews and improvement plans.

**Contract Negotiation & Management**

* Negotiate and manage contracts in line with MOZN's procurement terms and conditions.
* Lead negotiations on pricing, commercial terms, and SLAs for high-value and strategic contracts, within the mandate approved under the signed DoA.
* Carry out the first-level commercial review of vendor contracts (pricing, scope, SLAs, operational and compliance terms) and flag issues to Legal. Legal owns legal interpretation and drafting.
* Coordinate with Legal, the requestor, and Risk & Compliance to bring contracts with new suppliers to signature.
* Review the contract lifecycle with the requestor and reference department so renewals and other actions happen on time.

**Delivery & Implementation Oversight**

* Follow up on the delivery and implementation of products and services, coordinating internal teams and suppliers.
* Resolve delivery and implementation issues and escalate supplier performance risks promptly.

**Financial Coordination & Compliance**

* Work with Finance on budget approvals.
* Support timely supplier payment by making sure POs, receipts, and invoice documentation are accurate and complete. Payment processing and release sit with Finance.
* Track and report procurement savings, spend visibility, and cost avoidance using an agreed methodology.
* Make sure all activities comply with legal, regulatory, and internal policy requirements, and support internal and external audits.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Supply Chain).
* 3+ years of procurement experience, including at least 2 years across technology and non-technology categories.
* Experience in banking, financial services, or IT sectors.
* Track record of leading RFIs, RFPs, and tenders, handling vendor onboarding and compliance requirements, and running scorecard-based technical and commercial evaluations.
* Strong network of local suppliers and knowledge of the Egyptian and Saudi markets and regulations.
* Proficiency in Jira and ERP systems.
* Fluent English and Arabic is a must.

**Benefits**

* You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space.
* You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.
* The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best.
* You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI.
* We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech (French fluent )
details:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to post content.

If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Logistics Automation Engineer
details:
Posting Start Date: 11/9/26

**Purpose of the Job**
----------------------

The purpose of this role is to support the design, implementation, optimization, and governance of logistics automation systems across the global network. The role focuses on warehouse automation, material handling systems, robotics integration, operational performance improvement, data-driven optimization, and coordination with regional operations and facilities teams to ensure safe, efficient, and scalable logistics operations.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Support the Global Facilities Manager in delivering logistics automation initiatives, projects, and operational excellence programs across the global network.
* Lead and support the evaluation, design, implementation, and optimization of logistics automation solutions including conveyors, sortation systems, robotic systems, and warehouse technologies.
* Conduct operational assessments, process reviews, site surveys, and automation feasibility studies to identify opportunities for productivity improvement, cost reduction, and service enhancement.
* Manage maintenance strategies, AMCs, and service contracts for all automation systems.
* Lead RFPs/RFQs, vendor selection, and supplier performance management.
* Manage spare parts, critical inventory, and asset lifecycle planning.
* Monitor system reliability, uptime, maintenance KPIs, and SLA compliance.
* Drive continuous improvement, system upgrades, and asset optimization.
* Coordinate with OEMs, integrators, and maintenance service providers.
* Support CAPEX planning, budgeting, and automation investment initiatives.
* Provide technical support for Facilities Management activities and projects as required.
* Analyze warehouse and logistics processes, material flows, storage strategies, and operational data to identify automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop business cases, automation concepts, technical specifications, project requirements, and operational models for automation investments.
* Monitor the performance of automation systems through KPIs, dashboards, operational analytics, and performance reporting tools.
* Coordinate with country operations teams, facilities teams, engineering teams, vendors, system integrators, and automation providers to ensure successful project delivery and operational performance.
* Support the commissioning, testing, validation, and handover of automation systems and equipment across logistics facilities.
* Review automation system performance, reliability, utilization, downtime trends, and maintenance requirements, identifying corrective actions and improvement initiatives.
* Support the implementation of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), and their integration with automation technologies.
* Manage automation-related documentation, technical drawings, operational procedures, specifications, and system records.
* Participate in project planning, budgeting, feasibility Studies, procurement activities, vendor evaluations, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and project governance processes.
* Support risk assessments, operational readiness reviews, safety evaluations, and business continuity planning related to logistics automation systems.
* Contribute to innovation initiatives and identify emerging technologies that can improve warehouse productivity, operational efficiency, and customer service levels.
* Prepare executive-level reports, presentations, analyses, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making and capital investment planning.
* Perform assignments independently with guidance from the Global Facilities Manager on complex or strategic matters.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge through continuous learning, industry best practices, automation technologies, certifications, and professional development.

**Job Requirements - Experience and Education**
-----------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Automation Engineering.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in logistics automation, warehouse engineering, industrial automation, material handling systems, or related disciplines.
* Previous experience with Tier-1 logistics automation and intralogistics companies such as Vanderlande, Dematic, Swisslog, Daifuku, KNAPP, BEUMER Group, SSI Schäfer, TGW Logistics, Honeywell Intelligrated, or Fives Intralogistics will be considered a strong advantage.
* Experience with warehouse automation technologies including conveyors, sortation systems, robotic systems, and automated material handling equipment.
* Experience in logistics, supply chain, warehouse, distribution center, courier, express, e-commerce, aviation cargo, or industrial operations is preferred.
* Experience managing automation projects from concept development through implementation and operational support.
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), Warehouse Execution Systems (WES), and automation integration platforms.
* Experience conducting operational studies, workflow analysis, process mapping, capacity planning, and automation feasibility assessments.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, material handling processes, storage systems, inventory flows, and logistics network operations.
* Experience with industrial control systems, PLCs, HMI systems, sensors, and automation technologies is an advantage.
* Knowledge of robotics integration, machine vision systems, and autonomous vehicle technologies is an advantage.
* Experience managing and analyzing large datasets, operational KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with the ability to transform complex operational data into meaningful business insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Power Automate, and other reporting and visualization tools.
* Experience with SAP, Oracle, ASANA, AutoCAD, CAFM/CMMS, or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, and process optimization methodologies.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and vendor management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong coordination and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to influence and drive consistency across geographically dispersed teams.
* Proactive, self-motivated, innovative, and results-oriented mindset.

**Leadership Behaviors**
------------------------

Building Outstanding Teams

Setting a clear direction

Simplification

Collaborate & break silos

Execution & Accountability

Growth mindset

Innovation

Inclusion

External focus

**Skills**
----------

Organize and supervise the activities and work of subordinates to ensure that all work within a specific area of Production section activity is carried out in an efficient manner which is consistent with operating procedures and policy.

Recommend improvements to policy and direct the implementation of instructions covering all areas of production activity so that all relevant procedural/legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality, cost-effective service

Develop plans to increase operations efficiency and eliminate losses to deliver yearly production savings.  

* **Day- to-day Operations:**
* Supervises the day-to-day operations of Production to ensure that work processes are implemented as designed and comply with established policies, processes and procedures
* Work as directed by the manufacturing head in co-coordinating and checking the work of the Processes Operators within their groups to ensure the target of department is fully achieved.
* Put the budgetary plan related to the CAPEX of the department projects and R&M and supervise the projects in order to enhance the reliability of the process
* Maintain high standards of the work of the operation members in shifts in order to keep the work running smoothly from start to end point of processes.
* On daily basis, give the work schedule to his team to ensure adequate stocks of chemicals, etc. are available.
* Coordinate with the shift managers and alignment with the manufacturing head to ensure that all duties are carried out efficiently in all productions processes to meet the standard operation.
* Review all ends of shift reports to ensure that the job carried out during shifts is in accordance with the approved timetables and has been efficiently implemented.
* Arrange for training for the refinery team concerning efficient methods of work, correct operation of machines and correct attitudes to work in terms of discipline, timekeeping and cleanliness
* Arrange with manufacturing head to make decisions, allocation of equipment and labor to different locations in refinery to maintain the smooth operation.
* Liaise with the shift managers and all departments in the refinery with alignment with manufacturing head to Assure that all work inside refinery done with the high standard of safety, GMP and food safety.
* Ensure that all activities are monitored and regulatory compliance audits and inspections are conducted for an effective implementation of regulatory standards
* Supervise the implementation of projects to ensure that the project cycle is completed, meeting agreed project parameters (cost budget, timelines, scope and quality), standards and objectives
* **Continuous Improvement:**
* Stimulate subordinates and contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of section systems, processes and practices considering ‘international best practice’, improvement of business processes, cost reduction and productivity improvement
* **Reporting:**
* Prepare reports timely and accurately to meet Savola and department requirements, policies and standards.
* **Health, Safety, & Environment:**
* Monitor the adherence to all relevant safety and environmental management procedures and controls to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high-quality products/service and a responsible environmental attitude
* **Related Assignments:**
Perform other related duties or assignments as directed

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in chemistry (chemist or chemical engineer).

* **Experience:**
* 12 years practical experience of working in the process operations of the sugar industry including 5 years of which should have been at managerial level.
* **Knowledge:**
* Safety, Knowledge of own role & responsibilities

title: Senior Software Engineer / FDE (PAY)
details:
**Who Are We❓**

We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region.

**The Job in a Nutshell**

Foodics Financial Services builds the money products that help restaurants and merchants across the region run their businesses: payments, capital, and cashflow tools. We operate in a regulated environment , which means we care deeply about reliability, security, and correctness. We also move fast and ship products merchants actually feel.

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to work as a Forward Deployed Engineer: an engineer who lives closest to the problem. You'll sit with merchants, partner banks, and our own Operations, Risk, finance and Sales teams, see where the money flows break or slow down, and build the fix yourself, from a quick internal tool to a production feature. You'll be the shortest path between what happens in the field and what our platform does next.

**What You Will Do❓**

* Go where the problem is. Spend real time with merchants, acquiring and banking partners, and internal teams (Settlement, Risk, Onboarding, Sales, Customer Success). Watch how our products are used, and where people work around them.
* Turn field problems into shipped software. Take a messy, real-world problem, scope it, and deliver it end to end: backend services, APIs, data, and the frontend that people actually use.
* Build integrations and custom flows. Lead technical delivery for strategic merchants and partners: payment and settlement integrations, onboarding flows, reporting, and data exports, done to production standard.
* Prototype fast, then harden. Get a working version in front of users in days, learn from it, then make it reliable: idempotency, consistency, auditability, security, and observability for anything that touches real money.
* Build the internal tools that unblock operations. Reconciliation helpers, dispute and chargeback tooling, merchant support consoles, and automation that removes manual work from Ops and Finance.
* Be the voice of the field in product. Bring evidence back to Product, Design, and the core engineering teams. Spot patterns across customers, and push one-off fixes into reusable platform capabilities.
* Work AI-first. Use AI coding assistants, agents, and LLM APIs to multiply your output, and find places where AI can remove friction for merchants and internal teams, then build it.
* Own it in production. Support what you ship, take part in incident response for the systems you own, and keep stakeholders informed in plain language.

**What Are We Looking For❓**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production systems.
* Genuine full-stack ability: you design backend services, APIs, and data models, and you build clean, usable frontends.
* Customer-facing comfort: you have worked directly with customers, partners, or business users, and you can run a requirements session as well as a code review.
* A product mindset: you care about the merchant and the business outcome, and you can explain why something should be built, not only how.
* Bias for action: you deliver working software quickly, under ambiguity, without cutting corners on correctness.
* Integration experience: REST APIs, webhooks, third-party systems, and the debugging that comes with them.
* Technology-agnostic: you have worked across several languages and stacks and pick up new ones quickly.
* AI-first habits: you use AI coding assistants, agents, and LLM APIs daily and know where they help and where they don't.
* Clear written and spoken communication with technical and non-technical people. English required; Arabic is a strong plus.

**Who Will Excel❓**

* Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or technical implementation lead.
* Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or other regulated domains (PCI DSS, SAMA, or similar).
* Hands-on work with settlement, reconciliation, card acquiring, or banking integrations.
* Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integrations, RAG, agents, evaluation).
* Cloud infrastructure and DevOps experience (containers, CI/CD, observability).
* Experience with B2B, merchant-facing, or restaurant and retail products.

**What We Offer You❗**

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

* + We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
  + We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
  + Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
  + We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

title: MLOps / Platform Engineer — LLM Serving & Model Routing
details:
