Own the end-to-end Oracle Fusion Financials solution for Mada Media, from fit-to-standard design through configuration, migration, testing, cutover and stabilization. The lead is accountable for a coherent finance design across General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Tax, Expenses, revenue-related accounting, financial close and reporting, while integrating Finance with Procurement, Enterprise Contracts, CRM, Projects, EPM, AMS and external services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Financials discovery, CRP1/fit-to-standard and CRP2/TO-BE workshops and translate agreed processes into an implementable Oracle Fusion design.
* Own enterprise financial structures and configuration decisions including ledgers, legal entities/business units where applicable, chart of accounts, calendars, currencies, accounting options and reference data.
* Lead configuration and validation for GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Tax and Expenses; cover revenue/receivables accounting touchpoints relevant to Contracts and CRM.
* Design finance approval workflows and Delegation of Authority requirements with Security/GRC teams and ensure segregation-of-duties considerations are incorporated.
* Own the Financials sections of RD.011, RTM and BF.016/application configuration baseline and ensure all approved requirements are traceable to configuration or accepted gaps.
* Define Finance data migration scope, mapping and reconciliation rules with the Data Migration Lead; approve trial-load results and final financial reconciliation evidence.
* Define Finance integration requirements with Procurement, Enterprise Contracts, CRM, Projects/EPM, AMS, banks/payment services and other approved external systems; review MD.050/MD.070 content where applicable.
* Define reporting, BI Publisher/OTBI and finance KPI requirements and validate outputs with the Reporting/Analytics team.
* Prepare and support SIT/UAT scenarios, manage functional defects, validate regression results and drive business acceptance through TE.040/TE.130 evidence.
* Support cutover planning, opening balances, final data loads, period/control readiness, production validation and hypercare reconciliation.
* Lead and quality-review the work of the Financials Consultant and provide structured knowledge transfer to Mada Media Finance users and administrators.

 **Requirements**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 10+ years in Oracle Financials implementation/consulting preferred, with strong Oracle Fusion Cloud experience.
* At least 3 end-to-end Oracle Fusion Financials implementations strongly preferred, including one complex multi-module integration programme.
* Hands-on experience configuring and leading GL, AP, AR, Cash, Assets, Tax and Expenses; experience with Fusion receivables/revenue integrations is important.
* Proven ownership of finance migration, reconciliation, SIT/UAT and cutover activities.
* Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems or related discipline. Oracle Fusion Financials certification and accounting qualifications are advantageous.

**Key Delivery Outputs / Accountabilities**

* Financials TO-BE design, fit/gap decisions and RTM content.
* Approved BF.016/application configuration baseline for Finance.
* Finance data-migration mappings and reconciliation criteria under CV.010.
* Finance integration/report requirements and applicable MD.050/MD.070 inputs.
* TE.040 finance test scenarios/evidence and TE.130 UAT acceptance support.
* Cutover, opening-balance, production-validation and hypercare reconciliation support.

**Candidate Success Profile**

The preferred candidate is not only a configurator. They should be able to lead senior Finance stakeholders, defend fit-to-standard choices, understand accounting consequences, manage cross-module dependencies, and personally drive the controls, data reconciliation and acceptance required for a safe go-live.

**Role Boundaries / Interfaces**

* EPM planning/consolidation is owned by the EPM Consultant, although this role must manage Finance-EPM dependencies.
* Project Management/Project Financials are owned by the PPM Consultant where designated, with cross-functional Finance design jointly agreed.
* Enterprise Contracts/CRM functional ownership remains with the CX lead; Finance owns accounting, receivables, collections and reconciliation impacts.
* Technical integrations are built by OIC/technical resources; this role owns functional rules, mappings, validations and acceptance.

title: Senior Bid & Proposals Manager
details:
**Department:** Business Development  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Reporting to:** Partner/Director

**Role purpose**

TGP International is seeking an experienced, commercially minded, technically strong and creatively capable Senior Bid & Proposals Manager to lead the development and delivery of TGP’s technical bids, strategic proposals and client pitch submissions from our Cairo office.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the full bid and proposal lifecycle, from reviewing complex RFPs and tender requirements through to developing the submission strategy, shaping the commercial proposition and delivering persuasive, beautifully presented final submissions.

This role requires a strong combination of technical bid expertise, strategic proposal development and presentation capability. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable interpreting detailed tender requirements, compliance matrices and technical scopes as they are developing a compelling proposition, structuring a client narrative and producing executive-level presentation materials.

Working closely with senior leadership, Business Development and TGP’s specialist departments, the Senior Bid & Proposals Manager will ensure every submission is technically robust, fully compliant, commercially compelling, differentiated, visually exceptional and delivered on time.

**Key responsibilities**

**Proposal strategy and development**

* Take ownership of TGP’s strategic and commercial proposals, pitches and major submissions from initial brief through to final delivery.
* Understand the client, opportunity, competitive context and evaluation criteria and translate these into a clear proposal strategy.
* Work with Business Development and senior leadership to define the win strategy, key messages, differentiators and overall proposition.
* Develop the structure, storyline and flow of proposals and pitch presentations rather than simply compiling departmental inputs.
* Turn complex consultancy services, methodologies and technical information into clear, concise and persuasive client-facing content.
* Challenge generic or weak content and work with contributors to ensure responses directly address the client’s requirements.
* Identify the strongest relevant case studies, credentials, team experience and proof points to support each proposition.
* Ensure every proposal clearly communicates why TGP, why our approach and why our team.
* Lead the development of executive summaries, proposal narratives, methodologies, value propositions and key pitch messages.
* Personally write, edit and refine critical sections of proposals rather than relying solely on contributors to provide finished content.

**Technical bid management and coordination**

* Manage the complete bid process for RFPs, RFQs, EOIs, tenders, prequalification submissions and client proposals.
* Review and interpret tender documents, scopes of work, technical requirements, deliverables, evaluation criteria, deadlines and key risks.
* Develop and maintain bid plans, responsibility matrices, compliance matrices, internal timelines and submission schedules.
* Organise bid kick-off meetings and assign responsibilities across contributors.
* Coordinate input from Business Development, SME’s and external partners as required.
* Coordinate technical methodologies, workplans, delivery programmes, team structures and specialist responses across TGP departments.
* Review technical content critically for completeness, credibility, consistency and alignment with the proposed scope.
* Challenge contributors where responses are unclear, incomplete or do not sufficiently address the client requirement.
* Monitor progress closely, follow up on outstanding actions and escalate delays or risks promptly.
* Maintain rigorous version control and manage review, approval and sign-off processes.
* Ensure all submissions comply fully with client instructions, procurement requirements and submission formats.
* Lead the final technical and compliance review before submission.

**Pitch presentations and visual quality**

* Lead the development of high-quality client pitch presentations and strategic proposal decks.
* Define the presentation structure and narrative to ensure a compelling progression from client challenge through to TGP’s solution and value.
* Translate complex technical and commercial information into clear and engaging presentation content.
* Apply strong judgement around hierarchy, storytelling, pacing, imagery, charts, diagrams and data visualisation.
* Ensure proposals are concise, engaging and appropriate for senior client audiences rather than simply being technically complete.
* Maintain an exceptionally high standard of presentation across PowerPoint and other client-facing formats.
* Benchmark major submissions against leading global consulting, design and professional-services firms and continuously raise TGP’s pitch standard.

**Opportunity qualification and governance**

* Work with Business Development and leadership to assess whether opportunities align with the company’s strategy, capabilities, resources and commercial objectives.
* Coordinate bid/no-bid reviews and document agreed decisions.
* Assess opportunities from a client, technical and competitive perspective and identify what TGP will need to demonstrate to win.
* Ensure the proposal strategy and technical response approach are established early in the process.
* Identify requirements that could create legal, financial, operational, reputational or delivery risks.
* Ensure exceptions, assumptions, dependencies and qualifications are clearly recorded and approved.
* Maintain appropriate governance throughout the bid process, including internal reviews and delegated authority approvals.

**Commercial and financial coordination**

* Work closely with Finance to develop and validate pricing, budgets, resource plans, payment terms and commercial assumptions.
* Understand the relationship between technical scope, methodology, resourcing and price and ensure the commercial proposition supports the overall pitch.
* Challenge inconsistencies between the client’s requirements, proposed technical solution and commercial offer.
* Ensure all financial information is accurate, consistent and appropriately approved.
* Coordinate the completion of pricing schedules and other commercial submission documents.
* Ensure pricing is consistent across technical, commercial and supporting documents.
* Support commercial negotiations and post-submission clarifications when required.

**Legal, compliance and submission management**

* Work with Legal to review tender conditions, contracts, NDAs, declarations, warranties and other legal documentation.
* Identify non-standard or high-risk contractual requirements and ensure they are escalated appropriately.
* Coordinate corporate documentation, licences, certificates, policies and compliance declarations.
* Ensure bids comply with client instructions, applicable regulations and internal company policies.
* Coordinate bid-related client communications and clarifications.
* Manage submissions through relevant procurement and client portals where required.
* Ensure all required approvals, forms, supporting documents and signatures are complete before submission.
* Maintain a complete and accessible record of final submissions and client correspondence.

**Proposal quality and content**

* Lead the development of differentiated, persuasive, technically credible and commercially compelling proposals that demonstrate a strong understanding of the client and clearly articulate TGP’s value.
* Coordinate and shape methodologies, workplans, team structures, CVs, case studies and project credentials.
* Ensure methodologies and technical responses accurately reflect the proposed scope, delivery model, programme and team.
* Critically edit and rewrite content to improve clarity, brevity, consistency and persuasive impact.
* Ensure proposals have a clear narrative, strong executive-level messaging and logical story from beginning to end.
* Ensure technical and commercial sections reinforce the same core proposition.
* Ensure every major submission feels specifically created for the client rather than assembled from standard content.
* Maintain and continuously improve TGP’s bid content library, including standard responses, credentials, CVs, case studies, policies and templates.

**Submission, handover and continuous improvement**

* Conduct final technical, strategic, commercial and presentation-quality reviews before submission.
* Review submissions from the perspective of the client or evaluator and challenge whether they are compliant, credible, persuasive, differentiated and easy to understand.
* Following an award, coordinate a structured handover to the project or delivery team.
* Prepare handover information covering scope, pricing, assumptions, exclusions, programme, client commitments, risks and contractual obligations.
* Following unsuccessful bids, request feedback and coordinate lessons-learned reviews.
* Analyse successful and unsuccessful proposals to understand which technical approaches, messages and presentation techniques drive stronger results.
* Continually benchmark TGP’s submissions against leading international consultancies and professional-services firms.
* Improve bid processes, templates, governance and collaboration across departments.
* Build a best-in-class proposal toolkit, including technical response frameworks, presentation structures, executive-summary formats, case-study approaches and reusable proof points.
* Support the development of BD coordinators or administrators as the function grows.

  
**Requirements**

**Experience and qualifications**

* Approximately 7–10 years’ relevant experience in bid management, strategic proposal development, pursuits or business development.
* Demonstrable experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder bids from receipt through submission and handover.
* Demonstrable experience leading complex technical and commercial submissions, not solely coordinating standard proposals.
* Strong experience interpreting RFPs, scopes of work, technical requirements and formal procurement documentation.
* Strong knowledge of bid governance, compliance matrices, submission planning and document control.
* Strong understanding of technical proposal development, including methodologies, workplans, programmes, organisational structures and resource plans.
* Strong understanding of win themes, value propositions, proposal narratives and persuasive client presentations.
* Evidence of producing high-quality proposals and pitch presentations demonstrating excellent storytelling, structure and visual quality.
* Experience within consultancy, hospitality, events, design, architecture, engineering, real estate advisory, project management or professional services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting bids across the Middle East or international markets would be beneficial.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Arabic language capability would be an advantage.

**Skills and competencies**

* Strong technical bid-management capability.
* Exceptional proposal development and strategic storytelling skills.
* Excellent written communication, editing and proofreading ability.
* Ability to interpret complex technical scopes, methodologies and delivery requirements.
* Ability to interrogate technical content without needing to be the subject-matter expert.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, persuasive client-facing language.
* Strong commercial awareness and sound judgement.
* Ability to identify and articulate compelling differentiators and win themes.
* Strong project-management and stakeholder-management capability.
* Confidence constructively challenging technical experts, Directors and Partners.
* Advanced PowerPoint capability with a strong understanding of presentation structure, visual hierarchy and storytelling.
* Strong visual judgement and ability to translate complex information into charts, diagrams and presentation formats.
* Ability to build a compelling proposal or presentation from a blank page rather than relying solely on existing templates.
* Strong Word and Excel capability.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or InDesign would be advantageous.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, procurement portals and bid-management tools.
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage multiple high-pressure deadlines.

**Personal attributes**

* Accountable, dependable and comfortable taking ownership.
* Commercially curious and motivated by understanding what matters to the client and what will win.
* Highly driven by the quality of client-facing work.
* Confident taking complex or incomplete inputs and creating a clear, compelling story.
* Strong creative judgement combined with rigorous technical attention to detail.
* Comfortable challenging senior colleagues and technical specialists when content or presentation quality is not strong enough.
* Collaborative and comfortable working across different departments, disciplines and locations.
* Positive, solutions-focused and proactive.
* Able to create a strong sense of teamwork and shared ownership.
* Interested in continuously improving how TGP’s bid and proposal function operates.

**Measures of success**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* On-time and fully compliant submissions.
* Technical accuracy and credibility of methodologies and technical responses.
* Strategic strength and consistency of proposals.
* Quality, creativity and visual standard of pitch presentations.
* Clear improvement in the standard of TGP’s client-facing submissions.
* Strength of proposal narratives, win themes and differentiation.
* Ability to produce technically robust, commercially compelling and beautifully structured submissions.
* Reduced reliance on senior leadership to substantially restructure, rewrite or correct proposals before submission.
* Improved bid planning and cross-departmental coordination.
* Accuracy and consistency across technical and commercial submissions.
* Reduced last-minute requests and submission risks.
* Effective handover to delivery teams.
* Bid conversion and win rates.
* Positive feedback from internal stakeholders and clients

title: Investment Operations Director | Finance | Egypt
details:

title: Sales Proposal Engineer
details:
**Not just a job, but a career**

Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

**About the Team**  
Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

**Job Purpose:**

The ICSS Proposal Engineer is responsible for preparing competitive and compliant technical and commercial proposals for Integrated Control & Safety System (ICSS) projects in the oil & gas, petrochemical, power, and industrial sectors. The role involves analyzing customer requirements, developing system architecture, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and supporting business development activities to secure new orders.

**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:**

* Analyze customer RFQs, specifications, drawings, BOQs, and tender documents to prepare accurate technical and commercial proposals.
* Develop technical solutions, cost estimates and pricing strategies including:

o Distributed Control System (DCS)

o Emergency Shutdown System (ESD)

o Fire & Gas System (FGS)

o Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)

o PLC-based control systems

* Experience in system architecture design, I/O estimation, network design, cybersecurity, and cost estimation.
* Review project requirements and develop fit-for-purpose solutions covering automation, control systems, monitoring systems, and E&I scope.
* Prepare Bill of Materials, technical compliance documents, technical and commercial proposals.
* Coordinate with sales, engineering, procurement, and project execution teams to ensure cost optimized technical alignment with customer requirements.
* Evaluate subcontractor and vendor quotations, perform bid comparisons, and concluding commercial negotiations.
* Assist in defining Sales Stage system architecture, networking requirements, integration scope, and project execution strategy.
* Participate in technical clarification meetings (Prebid/Post Bid), bid reviews, risk assessments, and value engineering discussions with Internal Stakeholders and External customer/End Users.
* Ensure timely and High-quality submission of proposals while maintaining competitiveness and profitability.
* Review industry standards and ensure proposal compliance with IEC, ISA, API, NFPA, and customer specifications.
* Stay updated with industry trends, Egypt and Africa market requirements, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies.

**Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, or related Engineering field.
* Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Oil & Gas Automation, ICSS, DCS, SIS, SCADA, and PLC system proposal engineering.
* Proven experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals for upstream, midstream, and downstream Oil & Gas projects.
* Experience with EPC contractors, end users, and international standards in the automation and control systems domain.
* Strong knowledge of Integrated Control & Safety Systems (ICSS), including DCS, ESD, F&G, SCADA, and third-party package integration.
* Exposure to major automation platforms such as Yokogawa CENTUM VP/STARDOM, ProSafe RS Honeywell Experion, Emerson DeltaV, ABB 800xA, Siemens PCS7, or equivalent systems.
* Knowledge of brownfield modernization, migration, and digitalization projects will be an added advantage.

Strong commercial acumen with a successful track record in winning automation and ICSS projects.

**Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of Word, Excel, Visio and power point presentation
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA, Profibus/Profinet IEC 61850, Ethernet/IP
* Understanding of Africa and GCC Industrial standards, project specifications, and EPC project execution requirements.
* Functional Safety (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511) and Industrial cybersecurity concepts (IEC 62443).
* Knowledge of process control and instrumentation.
* Ability to interpret P&IDs, Cause & Effect diagrams, and control narratives
* Excellent analytical, commercial, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Good time management and organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple bids simultaneously.
* Customer-focused mindset with a proactive approach to delivering competitive and high-quality proposals.

**Skills:**

* Excellent Interpersonal skill required.
* Very Good communication in English. Arabic/local language a plus.
* Flexible to work extended hours as per demand of job.
* 30-40% travel in Africa and Middle East market anticipated.

You will work closely with Sales, technical Subject Matter Experts, and leadership to identify target markets, build campaigns, generate qualified leads, support pipeline growth, and translate complex technology offerings into clear business value for international buyers.

title: Regional Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (PSEAH) Officer (P)
details:
**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process.

For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates:

* Internal candidates

Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu

Second tier candidates include:
  
All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM.

**Organizational Context and Scope**

Established in 1951, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) is the leading global organization in the field of migration. In line with IOM’s prioritization of protection-centred approaches and integrity, transparency and accountability, IOM is committed to the prevention of and response to Protection from Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH) across all its operations.

As part of the Office of Ethics and PSEAH (OEP), the PSEAH Unit leads IOM’s work to combat sexual exploitation and abuse and sexual harassment in coordination with offices and missions across IOM and counterparts throughout the UN, Interagency Standing Committee ( IASC [JG1] ), and humanitarian community. The PSEAH Unit’s strategy focuses on strengthening leadership and organizational culture; institutional accountability and transparency; training and outreach; victim assistance; and partnership and coordination.

Under the direct supervision of the Senior Coordinator, PSEAH, the Regional Protection from Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH) Officer candidate will hold the following responsibilities.

  

Responsibilities: Lead and coordinate regional implementation of PSEAH: Oversee and manage the overall implementation of IOM’s PSEAH response across the region and ensure alignment with institutional policies, procedures and donor requirements.  
Contribute to global PSEAH initiatives: Support global-level PSEAH priorities in close coordination with the global IOM PSEAH Unit lead. This includes contributing to efforts to strengthen leadership and organizational culture, strengthen capacity building of key stakeholders, and enhance partnerships and inter-agency coordination.  
Provide technical support and guidance to country teams: Deliver ongoing technical guidance and support to IOM PSEAH Officers, Focal Points, Programme and Project staff and Regional Thematic Specialists to strengthen PSEAH integration at all levels.  
Support integration of PSEAH and resource mobilization: Ensure PSEAH components are embedded in project proposals, budgets and reports, and actively contribute to fundraising and donor engagement efforts across the region.  
Strengthen strategic planning and reporting on PSEAH: Contribute to regional and country-level strategic frameworks and response plans by ensuring PSEAH is systematically integrated; lead regional data collection, management and reporting to show scope and impact of PSEAH work.  
Engage and support IOM partners: In collaboration with the global PSEAH Unit and country missions, help strengthen partnerships with implementing organizations, third party contractors (TPCs) and other partners, identify capacity gaps, and provide tailored technical guidance.  
Lead regional training and awareness-raising efforts: Design, coordinate, and deliver regional capacity-building initiatives on PSEAH, including staff training, development of tools and implementation of awareness and communication strategies.  
Strengthen prevention and response mechanisms: Support country offices and sectoral units in conducting SEAH risk assessments and implementing risk mitigation measures; enhance existing/new complaint and feedback mechanisms to ensure these can receive sensitive complaints; and ensure victim-centered assistance in collaboration with protection, child protection (CP) and gender-based violence (GBV) actors.  
Foster coordination and represent IOM: Represent IOM in regional inter-agency fora, foster collaboration and knowledge exchange with UN partners and stakeholders, and support outreach to promote PSEAH integration across humanitarian and development efforts.  

* Perform other duties and tasks as may be assigned in support of the design and delivery of an effective work program.

  

Qualifications: Required Qualifications and Experience  
  
Education  
  
Master’s degree in Law, International Relations, Psychology, Social Sciences, Development Studies and Planning or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,  
University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.  
Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.  
  
Experience  
  
Professional experience in the fields of sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, protection, child protection, gender-based violence, accountability to affected populations (AAP), gender mainstreaming and/or humanitarian affairs;  
Experience in management of sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, child protection or gender-based violence cases;  
Strong coordination experience within the UN system and amongst interagency partners, including governments, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), and communities;  
Experience in developing and facilitating PSEAH trainings, in particular capacity-building, and communication materials to promote behavior change;  
Experience undertaking PSEAH risk assessments, in coordination with relevant offices, communities, partners, and UN and other key stakeholders;  
Experience in proposal development and the creation of standard operating procedures and tools; and,  
Experience in mainstreaming PSEAH, gender-based violence, child protection, protection, gender or accountability to affected populations.  
  
Skills  
  
Demonstrated ability to work across a wide variety of sectors/teams on cross-cutting themes;  
Excellent written and oral communication skills, effective in representation and liaison with external partners;  
Ability to organize work, work independently and prioritize work under pressure, coordinate multiple tasks, maintain attention to detail, and coordination with a variety of stakeholders;  
Ability to work with affected individuals with empathy, sensitivity and a victim-centred approach;  
Knowledge and understanding of IOM’s institutional approach on PSEAH and Ethics and related strategies, policies, rules and regulations; and,  
Ability to work with and maintain strict confidentiality, when necessary .  
  
Languages  
  
For this position, fluency in English and Arabic is required (oral and written).  
  
Working knowledge of French and another official UN language (Chinese, Russian and Spanish) is an advantage.  
  
Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.  
  
Required Competencies  
  
IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.  
  
Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:  
  
Inclusion and respect for diversity : Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.  
Integrity and transparency : Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.  
Professionalism : Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.  
Courage : Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.  
Empathy : Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.  
  
Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2  
  
Teamwork : Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.  
Delivering results : Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.  
Managing and sharing knowledge : Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.  
Accountability : Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.  
Communication : Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.  
  
Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2,  
  
Leadership : Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.  
Empowering others : Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.  
Building Trust : Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.  
Strategic thinking and vision : Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.  
Humility : Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.  
  
Notes  
  
Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.  
  
Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security as well as accreditation, any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted.  
  
IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.  
  
IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.  
  
IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts.  
  
IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Cyber Security Manager
details:
**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Cybersecurity Manager is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the organization’s information security program, ensuring alignment with regulatory obligations, international standards, and business objectives. The role owns the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) agenda, drives ISO 27001 certification and maintenance, ensures adherence to Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) cybersecurity requirements, and oversees the organization’s offensive security functions, including penetration testing and vulnerability management.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

#### **Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)**

* Develop, maintain, and enforce information security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines aligned with business strategy and regulatory expectations.
* Establish and operate the enterprise information security risk management framework — identifying, assessing, treating, and monitoring cyber risks with defined risk appetite and tolerance thresholds.
* Maintain the risk register, track remediation plans, and report residual risk to executive management and relevant committees.
* Lead security awareness and training programs to embed a strong security culture across the organization.
* Coordinate internal and external audits, manage findings to closure, and serve as the primary liaison for security-related audit engagements.
* Oversee third-party and vendor risk management, including due diligence and contractual security requirements.
  

#### **ISO 27001 / ISMS Management**

* Own the Information Security Management System (ISMS), driving initial certification and ongoing surveillance/recertification cycles.
* Define and maintain the ISMS scope, Statement of Applicability (SoA), and Annex A control implementation.
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analyses against ISO 27001 (and related standards such as ISO 27002, 27005, 27017/27018 where relevant).
* Manage internal ISMS audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and continual improvement cycles.
* Ensure control effectiveness through metrics, KPIs/KRIs, and periodic reporting.
  

#### **FRA & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure full compliance with Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) cybersecurity and IT governance requirements for non-banking financial institutions.
* Map regulatory controls to internal frameworks, conduct compliance gap assessments, and maintain evidence for regulatory inspections and submissions.
* Monitor changes in the regulatory landscape (FRA circulars, decrees, data protection law) and translate them into actionable controls.
* Prepare and submit required cybersecurity reports, self-assessments, and attestations to regulators within mandated timelines.
* Align the security program with complementary frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI DSS where applicable).
  

#### **Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Management**

* Establish and manage the vulnerability management lifecycle — scanning, prioritization, remediation tracking, and verification across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and endpoints.
* Plan and oversee regular internal and external penetration testing engagements (network, web/mobile application, API, wireless, social engineering).
* Manage relationships with third-party penetration testing providers and validate the quality and coverage of their work.
* Analyze findings, assign risk ratings, drive remediation with technical teams, and report on trends and closure rates.
* Oversee configuration/hardening reviews, secure baselines, and patch management governance.
* Support red team/blue team exercises and continuously improve detection and response capabilities.
  

#### **Leadership & Operations**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the cybersecurity team, setting objectives and building technical capability.
* Manage the security budget, tooling roadmap, and technology investments.
* Coordinate incident response readiness, contribute to major incident handling, and support business continuity/disaster recovery planning.
* Report security posture, risk trends, and program maturity to senior management, audit, and board-level committees.
  

#### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7–10+ years of information security experience, with at least 3–5 years in a managerial or team-lead capacity.

title: Marketing Project Manager
details:
Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech brands and products. We have a large marketing and technology plan, and most of it depends on people across several departments. We are looking for a Project Manager who makes sure that what was agreed actually gets done.

**The role**
------------

You will be the person who turns plans into delivered work. You take requirements from other departments and write them up as clear, agreed requests, link tasks that depend on each other, and chase every open item until it is closed. You work closely with the Head of MarTech and take the coordination load off them.

We are looking for someone with high ownership. A missed deadline is your problem until it is solved, and you do not stop at the first excuse. You do not need formal authority to get results. You need clarity, persistence and a good record of what was agreed.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Receive requests from other departments, ask the questions that make them clear, and write them up with an owner, an outcome and a date
* Map dependencies between tasks and warn early when one delay will move others
* Follow up with colleagues and vendors who miss commitments, and escalate with a short summary and a recommendation when follow-up fails
* Manage briefs, deadlines and acceptance for freelancers and external vendors
* Keep our internal project panel accurate, run the weekly review and prepare regular written updates for management
* Keep the Head of MarTech on track by reminding them of decisions and approvals waiting on them
* Handle the small tasks that stop things moving, such as scheduling, access requests, document chasing and meeting notes with action lists

**What the environment is like**
--------------------------------

We are a research organisation with a lot of process and regular reporting. Everything is run in English: meetings, messages, documents and reports. Many of the people you will depend on have their own priorities and no formal obligation to you, so you will succeed through persistence and a clear record. You need to be comfortable chasing senior colleagues repeatedly, escalating without apologising for it, and reminding your own manager of what is waiting on them.

The team moves fast and has no technical limits on tooling. We work roughly 8:00 to 18:00 UK time, so you need good overlap with those hours.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* Fluent English, written and spoken (C1 or higher). This is essential: you will write requirements and reports, run calls, and chase people in English every day
* High ownership: you treat a missed deadline as your own, and you do not stop until the item is closed
* 3+ years in project management, coordination or operations, or as an executive or chief-of-staff assistant, ideally across several teams
* A track record of getting results from people you do not manage
* Clear, structured writing: requirements, status updates and meeting notes others can act on
* Comfort pushing back on vague requests and holding senior people to commitments, politely and persistently
* Practical AI fluency: you use AI tools to draft, summarise and track, and you check the output
* You learn tools fast. We use a company project panel, Google Workspace, Slack and HubSpot, and no single tool is a requirement
* Nice to have: marketing or web project experience, vendor or freelancer management, fluent Russian

The Technical Manager – North Africa is the senior technical authority for CBRE Excellerate’s Enterprise Accounts portfolio across the North Africa region. The role is accountable for the safe, compliant and reliable operation of all hard services, engineering and building- and production-critical infrastructure across the region’s client sites, spanning office, industrial and manufacturing environments. The Technical Manager sets the regional maintenance and asset strategy, owns technical governance and standards, and ensures every site operates in line with CBRE Excellerate, statutory and client requirements.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, the role carries a clear growth mandate. With a significant and expanding manufacturing and industrial base across the region, the Technical Manager is expected to scale and strengthen CBRE Excellerate’s technical capability in North Africa – growing and developing the regional technical and mobile teams, expanding self-perform capability, embedding technical training and competency, and positioning the business to take on and win more technically-led work across the region.

The Technical Manager also holds oversight of the region’s operational delivery and operations team, working alongside account and operations leads to ensure technical findings translate into disciplined operational action, KPIs are met, and escalations are resolved with pace. This is a senior, hands-on regional leadership role that requires strong mechanical and electrical depth, credibility with clients and manufacturing and engineering stakeholders, and the ambition and drive to grow and enhance the region’s technical capability. The role reports to the Managing Director, Enterprise Accounts.  
  
**What you will be doing**  
This position has the authority to:

* **Regional Technical Leadership and Strategy**

Act as the senior technical authority for the North Africa Enterprise Accounts portfolio. Own the regional technical, maintenance and asset-management strategy; set engineering standards, maintenance frequencies and technical governance across all sites and accounts; and drive a consistent, standardised CBRE Excellerate technical operating model across the region.

* **Manufacturing, Industrial and Critical Environments**

Own the technical operation of manufacturing, industrial and business- and production-critical environments across the region. Develop and maintain Scopes of Service and Methods of Procedure (MoPs) for critical assets, run a formal change-control process, and protect uptime, business continuity and production availability. Oversee critical infrastructure such as BMS, EPMS, UPS, HVAC, power and utilities/process support where in scope, and drive the move towards condition-based and reliability-centred maintenance.

* **Technical Team and Mobile Team Leadership**

Lead, develop and be accountable for the region’s technical teams and mobile, multi-skilled engineering teams. Own the resourcing, deployment and utilisation of technical resource across sites, set technical performance standards, manage performance, and build a strong, safety-led technical delivery culture across North Africa.

* **Technical Capability Building and Regional Growth**

Grow and enhance the region’s self-perform technical capability. Develop and upskill technical talent through structured training, competency assessment and clear career pathways; expand multi-skilled and mobile team capacity; and strengthen self-delivery where it adds value for clients. Anticipate future skills requirements and put in place the people, structure and development needed to support the region’s growth agenda.

* **Asset Management and Lifecycle Planning**

Own regional asset registers, condition assessment and multi-year asset lifecycle and capital planning. Provide risk-managed, cost-effective lifecycle and replacement options to clients, and coordinate capital and improvement programmes so they are delivered seamlessly alongside live operations.

* **PPM, Reactive and Work Order (CAFM) Management**

Ensure planned preventive and reactive maintenance is delivered safely, on time and to standard across the region. Drive the adoption and disciplined use of Chase / CAFM work-order systems, evidence capture and closure, reducing reliance on manual trackers and strengthening technical visibility, reporting and control.

* **HSE, Statutory and Technical Compliance**

Ensure all technical works comply with statutory requirements, client standards, CBRE Excellerate procedures and site HSE rules in each North Africa country. Own technical compliance – permits to work, RAMS, isolations, statutory inspections, TCR/TCCC requirements, certificates and audit evidence – and drive a strong, visible safety culture with zero tolerance for unsafe practice.

* **Vendor, Subcontractor and Specialist Management**

Provide senior technical governance of vendors, subcontractors and specialist service providers across the region. Own technical scoping, quotation and MoP review, quality assurance and validation of works before closure; and ensure providers hold the required qualifications, permits and documentation and deliver value for money.

* **Operational Oversight of the Region**

Hold oversight of the region’s operational delivery and operations team. Work with account and operations leads to convert technical findings into operational action, monitor KPI/SLA performance and governance, act as a senior escalation point for technical and operational issues, and ensure actions are closed with pace and discipline.

* **Commercial, Budget and Growth Support**

Support budget setting, cost control, purchase-order discipline and technical cost validation across the region. Develop technical business cases and capital proposals, and provide technical input into bids, tenders, mobilisations and new-site onboarding to support the region’s growth.

* **Client and Stakeholder Management**

Act as the senior technical point of contact for clients across the region, including manufacturing and engineering stakeholders. Lead technical reviews, present KPI and reliability performance at executive reviews, and build client trust through technical credibility, control and follow-through.

* **Continuous Improvement and Standardisation**

Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and best practice across technical delivery, energy and reliability performance, processes and reporting throughout the region.

* **General**

Perform other duties as reasonably assigned in support of the North Africa Enterprise Accounts portfolio and the objectives of the Managing Director, Enterprise Accounts.  
  
**What you will bring**

  

* Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Building Services or a related engineering discipline; a Master’s, chartered status (e.g. CEng) or professional membership (e.g. CIBSE, IMechE, IET) is advantageous.
* 12 to 15 years’ technical and engineering experience within facilities management, building services, MEP or industrial/manufacturing maintenance, including significant time in a senior technical leadership role.
* Proven experience leading technical delivery across a multi-site, multi-country or regional portfolio.
* Strong manufacturing, industrial or critical-environment experience (for example pharmaceutical, FMCG, data centre, process or production environments), including business-critical infrastructure and uptime management.
* Demonstrated experience building and growing technical teams and capability, including self-perform, mobile and multi-skilled teams, technical training and competency development.
* Strong experience in asset management, lifecycle and capital planning, PPM strategy, and reliability- or condition-based maintenance.
* Experience owning statutory and technical compliance, HSE, permits to work, RAMS and audit regimes.
* Experience managing vendors, specialist contractors and technical budgets, and providing technical input to bids, tenders and mobilisations.
* Experience in a client-facing enterprise or corporate FM environment, presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* North Africa / MEA regional experience and Arabic and/or French language skills are strongly advantageous.

title: Senior Operations Manager
details:
**Senior Operations Manager**

**Purpose of the Job**

The Senior Operations Manager leads Coptic Orphans' operational functions: Facilities, Procurement, Asset Management, Business Process, and Data Processing, and sets the processes and practices that keep operational work consistent across every location. The role brings these functions together under one coordinated management and ensures the services the organization relies on are delivered reliably, consistently, and to a high standard across all locations. This role drives the continuous improvement of these functions and develops the managers who lead them, so that the organization's day-to-day operational needs are always met dependably worldwide and teams across Coptic Orphans can carry out their work without interruption.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

**Operational Management & Delivery**

* Oversee the Facilities, Procurement, Asset Management, Business Process, and Data Processing functions, ensuring each delivers reliable, high-quality service to the teams that rely on it.
* Ensure each function is properly resourced, organized, and equipped to deliver dependable service.
* Track the performance of each function, identify issues early, and escalate significant risks or gaps to top leadership.
* Translate the operational priorities and standards into clear expectations for each function and its manager.

**Continuous Improvement & Standardization**

* Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of each function and lead practical improvements to how the work is done.
* Standardize processes and practices within each function across all country offices, so that service is consistent wherever Coptic Orphans operates.
* Support the adoption of new systems, tools, and AI-enabled solutions that modernize operational work, in coordination with the Technology function.
* Strengthen how the functions serve their internal customers, using feedback from the teams they support to raise responsiveness and service quality.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, support, and develop the Office Operations Manager, Business Process Manager, and Data Processing Manager, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for their functions' performance.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, give constructive feedback, and support the growth of the managers and their teams.
* Foster a culture of accountability, service, and continuous improvement across the functions.

**Compliance, Continuity & Reporting**

* Ensure the operational functions comply with organizational policies and relevant local requirements in each country, within the frameworks set by the Finance and Legal Affairs functions.
* Plan for business continuity for operational and facilities-related matters, helping ensure the organization can keep functioning through disruption.
* Maintain accurate operational records and provide regular, clear reporting on the functions' performance.

**Required Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* Master's Degree is a plus.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in operations, administration, or a related area, including at least 3 years managing teams, and ideally managing other managers.
* Proven experience overseeing multiple operational or administrative functions and delivering dependable, high-quality service to internal teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop managers, set clear expectations, and hold a team accountable for results.
* Track record of improving processes and raising the efficiency, quality, and consistency of operational work.
* Experience working across multiple locations or countries is an advantage.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge across some of the following areas: facilities, procurement, process management, or data operations.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with teams across the organization.
* Demonstrated commitment to the mission, values, and vision of Coptic Orphans.

**Travel and Working Requirements**

* Typical office environment such as walking, sitting, typing, using office equipment, and occasional lifting of boxes or luggage during travel.
* Occasional domestic & international travel may be required.
* Working outside of the official hours and on weekends may be required.

title: Occupational Health & Safety Consultant – (Manufacturing) - Mid Level
details:
**Jadeer** is hiring on behalf of one of our clients, a leading multinational company specializing in industrial packaging and processing solutions, serving major manufacturers across the Middle East and North Africa region. The company is recognized globally for its innovation, operational excellence, and commitment to maintaining high standards of workplace health, safety, and employee well-being.

#### **Role Overview**

The Occupational Health & Safety Consultant will provide expert guidance and operational support on all matters related to workplace health, safety, and environmental compliance.

Working closely with the Country HR Representative and relevant local and global stakeholders, the consultant will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of OHS policies, procedures, governance processes, and workplace practices.

The ideal candidate should possess practical OHS experience within manufacturing, supply chain, industrial, or similarly complex operational environments, along with strong stakeholder-management, training, auditing, and reporting capabilities.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**OHS Strategy & Policy Implementation**

* Support the implementation of the country’s OHS strategy in alignment with global policies and local regulatory requirements
* Conduct gap analyses and recommend improvements based on legal requirements and industry best practices
* Ensure OHS policies, procedures, and guidelines are effectively implemented, maintained, communicated, and understood across the organization
* Support the continuous improvement of workplace health, safety, and environmental practices

**Risk Assessment & Incident Management**

* Conduct and support workplace risk assessments, hazard-identification activities, and job-safety analyses across relevant sites
* Guide the development and follow-up of corrective and preventive action plans addressing identified risks and incidents
* Support workplace incident and accident investigations, including root-cause analysis
* Monitor the implementation and timely closure of agreed corrective actions
* Provide practical recommendations to reduce workplace risks and prevent recurring incidents

**Compliance & OHS Governance**

* Support the monitoring of compliance with applicable occupational health, safety, environmental, and labour regulations
* Advise stakeholders on international OHS standards, corporate safety guidelines, site requirements, and relevant industry practices
* Act as a focal point for OHS governance meetings, including quarterly and monthly stakeholder meetings
* Coordinate with key stakeholders before meetings to ensure readiness and the availability of required information
* Prepare and circulate meeting minutes, track action points, and follow up to ensure timely closure
* Maintain appropriate OHS documentation and governance records

**Training & Safety Awareness**

* Co-develop and deliver OHS training programmes, awareness sessions, safety briefings, and emergency drills
* Support relevant teams in understanding their OHS responsibilities and required workplace practices
* Promote employee engagement in workplace safety and well-being initiatives
* Contribute to building and sustaining a proactive, safety-first culture

**Audits, Inspections & Performance Reporting**

* Conduct workplace audits, inspections, and safety tours in collaboration with project, service, facilities, and operational teams
* Support the development and maintenance of OHS performance indicators, dashboards, and reporting tools
* Prepare periodic OHS reports, findings, insights, and recommendations for local and global stakeholders
* Monitor safety-performance trends and recommend appropriate improvement initiatives
* Support internal and external OHS reviews when required

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Special Projects**

* Work closely with HR, facilities management, project teams, service teams, operational functions, and other key stakeholders
* Provide advisory and technical support on OHS-related matters across the organization
* Support OHS and employee well-being projects assigned by the relevant governance committee or Country HR Representative
* Coordinate with external service providers and contractors on workplace safety requirements when applicable

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or another relevant discipline
* 3–5 years of relevant OHS, EHS, or workplace-safety experience
* Previous experience within manufacturing, industrial, engineering, supply chain, or operational environments is highly preferred
* Practical experience conducting risk assessments, workplace inspections, audits, and incident investigations
* Good knowledge of local health and safety regulations and internationally recognized OHS practices
* Professional certification such as NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, or an equivalent qualification is an advantage
* Experience delivering safety training, awareness sessions, and emergency drills
* Strong report-writing, documentation, and presentation capabilities
* Good command of English and Arabic

##### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams
* Analytical mindset with a structured and practical problem-solving approach
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow up on multiple actions and priorities
* Confidence in advising stakeholders and promoting compliance at different organizational levels
* Cultural awareness and sensitivity to local workplace contexts
* Commitment to employee well-being and the development of a safety-first culture

##### **Working Arrangement**

* Work closely with the Country HR Representative as an advisory and operational support resource for OHS-related matters
* Collaborate regularly with local teams, global OHS stakeholders, contractors, and external service providers
* Travel to customer and operational sites for inspections, audits, meetings, and safety activities as required

##### **Location**

* Egypt
* Regular travel to relevant customer and operational sites

#### **Why Join This Opportunity?**

* Join a globally recognized multinational organization
* Contribute directly to workplace safety, employee well-being, and operational excellence
* Collaborate with local, regional, and global stakeholders
* Lead meaningful safety-improvement and compliance initiatives
* Gain exposure to a dynamic industrial and operational environment
* Support the development of a proactive and sustainable safety culture

#### **Ready to Make a Meaningful Impact on Workplace Safety?**

If you have a strong background in occupational health and safety and are passionate about creating safe, compliant, and healthy working environments, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of a professional team committed to operational excellence, employee well-being, and a strong safety-first culture.

title: Application Engineering Lead
details:
About ITT::

ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) is a diversified global leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions serving the flow, aerospace and defense, transportation, industrial, and energy markets. Through operational execution, innovation, and disciplined capital deployment, including strategic acquisitions such as SPX FLOW, ITT partners with its customers to deliver enduring solutions to the key industries that underpin our modern way of life.

Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, ITT has a market cap of roughly $20 billion and employs more than 15,000 people across 40 countries and serves customers in approximately 125 countries. Following the acquisition of SPX FLOW, the company is expected to generate $5.4 billion in annual revenue.

Our businesses are organized in three distinct segments, each based around our core engineering DNA:

**Flow Technologies:** A global leader in, providing a broad portfolio of pumps, valves, mixing and agitation equipment, heat transfer, homogenizers, separation, water and wastewater treatment, and engineered process solutions. Our leading brands include the iconic **Goulds Pumps** (with more than 175 years of history), **Anhydro, APV, Bornemann, Bran+Luebbe, C’treat, Engineered Valves, Gerstenberg Schröder, Habonim, Johnson Pump, Lightnin, Philadelphia, Plenty, PRO Cast, Rheinhütte, Seital Separation, Stelzer, Svanehøj, Tigerholm, Uutechnic, VIDAR, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell.**

**Motion Technologies:** A global leader in brake pads (ICE and electrified brake pads) and shock absorbers (energy absorption solutions) for transportation applications. Our leading brands include **Friction Technologies, KONI** and **Axtone.**

**Connect and Control Technologies:**A leader in critical applications for the aerospace, defense and industrial markets, including harsh environment connectors and control components. Our leading brands include **ITT Cannon, Enidine, Aerospace Controls** and **kSARIA.**

Position Summary:

* To supervise the Application Engineer team at the Cairo office, Egypt.
* Distribute workload in the department to ensure due dates are met and manage day-to-day activities through KPIs.
* Prepare quotes (low to highly complex) on time and with minimal supervision
* Enter orders in a timely and clean manner and support other AE’s for the same
* Support customers, Reps and ASM’s throughout the “quote to order” execution cycle
* Understand customer needs and market level
* Coordinate all players to achieve the target date and receive correct information
* Communicate with respective region SE’s & ASM’s in order to define priorities
* Support SE’s & ASM’s face to customer on technical and commercial discussions
* Train region of responsibility AE’s in order to give them all skills to quote more and more difficult projects
* Control of offers done by the respective responsibility region AE team

Essential Responsibilities:

title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Server OS Administrator
details:
**Job Description:**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Server OS Administrator with deep expertise in managing Oracle Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and Windows Server operating systems across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and hybrid environments. This role is responsible for OS provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, automation, and compliance ensuring enterprise compute workloads operate with maximum availability, security, and operational efficiency on OCI.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**OCI Compute & Instance Management**

* Provision and manage OCI compute instances (VM, Bare Metal, Flex shapes) across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server platforms.
* Configure and manage OCI instance metadata, cloud-init scripts, and custom images for standardized OS deployments.
* Build and maintain golden images (custom images, image pipelines) for Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server on OCI.
* Manage instance pools, autoscaling configurations, and capacity reservations for dynamic workload demands.
* Configure OCI boot/block volumes, volume groups, backup policies, and cross-region replication for OS-level storage.
* Manage OCI Bastion service and OS Management Hub for secure access and fleet management.

**Oracle Linux & RHEL Administration**

* Install, configure, and manage Oracle Linux (8.x/9.x) and RHEL (8.x/9.x) across OCI and on-premises environments.
* Administer kernel parameters, sysctl tuning, Huge Pages, NUMA, and kernel-level performance optimization.
* Manage package management using DNF/YUM, ULN (Unbreakable Linux Network), and Oracle Linux Manager/Spacewalk.
* Configure and maintain LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS, OCFS2), multipath, and iSCSI storage at the OS layer.
* Administer systemd services, cron scheduling, and process management.
* Manage Oracle Ksplice for zero-downtime kernel patching on Oracle Linux.
* Configure SELinux policies, firewalld rules, and iptables/nftables for OS-level security.

**Windows Server Administration**

* Install, configure, and manage Windows Server (2019/2022/2025) on OCI compute instances.
* Administer Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, and DHCP in OCI-hosted or hybrid-connected Windows environments.
* Manage Windows Server roles and features: IIS, File Server, Print Server, WSUS, and Failover Clustering.
* Configure and manage Windows Remote Desktop Services (RDS) and Windows Admin Center.
* Administer Windows storage: Storage Spaces, ReFS, NTFS permissions, and iSCSI initiators.
* Manage Windows Update for Business, WSUS, and patch compliance across OCI-hosted Windows fleets.
* Configure Windows Defender, Windows Firewall with Advanced Security, and security baselines.

**OS Patching & Lifecycle Management**

* Design and execute OS patching strategies across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server using OCI OS Management Hub.
* Manage patching schedules, patch compliance reporting, and exception handling across development, staging, and production environments.
* Implement zero-downtime patching workflows using Oracle Ksplice (Linux) and live patching techniques.
* Maintain OS lifecycle compliance track end-of-life, extended support, and upgrade paths across all supported OS versions.
* Coordinate patching windows with application and database teams, ensuring rollback readiness and change management alignment.

**Security Hardening & Compliance**

* Apply CIS benchmarks for Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server across all managed instances.
* Implement OS-level encryption: LUKS (Linux), BitLocker (Windows), and OCI Vault integration for key management.
* Configure and manage SSH hardening, PAM modules, sudoers policies, and certificate-based authentication (Linux).
* Manage local and domain-based access controls, privilege escalation policies, and service account governance.
* Implement audit logging using auditd (Linux), Windows Event Forwarding (WEF), and OCI Logging integration.
* Support compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, CIS) through evidence collection and remediation at the OS layer.

**Networking & OS-Level Connectivity**

* Configure OCI VNIC attachments, secondary VNICs, and OS-level network interface bonding/teaming.
* Manage OS-level DNS resolution, NTP/Chrony configuration, and host-based routing on OCI instances.
* Configure OS-level firewall rules aligned with OCI Security Lists and NSGs.
* Troubleshoot OS-level network issues including MTU, TCP tuning, and latency across OCI VCN topologies.
* Configure and manage VPN client connectivity and proxy settings for hybrid environments.

**Performance Monitoring & Tuning**

* Monitor OS performance metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, network) using OCI Monitoring Agent, OS Management Hub, and native OS tools (sar, vmstat, iostat, perfmon).
* Tune OS-level parameters for database, middleware, and application workloads including shared memory, semaphores, file descriptors, and kernel limits.
* Implement and manage OCI Compute metrics, custom alarms, and notifications for OS-level health monitoring.
* Conduct capacity planning and resource utilization analysis to inform scaling and right-sizing decisions.
* Integrate with enterprise monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, SCOM) for unified observability.

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Develop and maintain OS automation using Ansible, Terraform (OCI provider), and OCI Resource Manager.
* Build automated OS provisioning pipelines golden image creation, cloud-init bootstrapping, and post-provisioning configuration.
* Automate routine OS tasks: user management, log rotation, disk cleanup, certificate renewals, and compliance checks using Bash, Python, and PowerShell.
* Implement configuration management and drift detection using Ansible, Puppet, or Chef across managed fleets.
* Build self-service OS provisioning workflows integrated with CI/CD pipelines and ServiceNow ITSM.

**General**

* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles for OS administration procedures.
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, root cause analysis, and problem management.
* Collaborate with cloud architects, DBA teams, middleware teams, and client stakeholders on platform decisions.
Mentor junior OS administrators and contribute to knowledge sharing within the practice.  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of progressive experience in server OS administration with hands-on expertise across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server.
* Strong experience managing OS workloads on OCI (Compute instances, custom images, OS Management Hub).
* Expert-level knowledge of Linux administration: kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, package management, systemd, SELinux, and firewalld.
* Expert-level knowledge of Windows Server administration: Active Directory, GPO, IIS, Failover Clustering, and Windows security baselines.
* Proven experience designing and executing enterprise OS patching strategies across mixed Linux/Windows fleets.
* Strong proficiency in OS automation using Ansible and at least one scripting language: Bash, Python, or PowerShell.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform with OCI provider) for compute provisioning.
* Solid understanding of OCI networking: VCNs, subnets, NSGs, VNICs, and service gateways as they relate to OS-level configuration.
* Experience applying CIS benchmarks and security hardening across Linux and Windows platforms.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to produce clear operational documentation and engage with cross-functional teams.  

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle certifications: Oracle Linux System Administrator (OCA/OCP), OCI Architect Associate, OCI Operations Associate.
* Red Hat certifications: RHCSA, RHCE.
* Microsoft certifications: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800/AZ-801).
* Experience with Oracle Ksplice for zero-downtime kernel patching.
* Familiarity with OCI OS Management Hub and Oracle Linux Manager at scale.
* Experience with configuration management tools: Puppet, Chef, or SaltStack.
* Knowledge of container runtimes (Podman, Docker) and container host OS management on OCI.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, SCOM, or OEM.
* Familiarity with ITSM integration (ServiceNow) for automated provisioning and change management.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management awareness.
Experience working in managed services or consulting delivery environments.
